तस्मात् सर्वाधिकं  कौलं सर्वसाधारणं कथम्  || 83 ||
text_mt: The world is composed of Śiva and Śakti; Kaula is established in the world; / therefore Kaula is superior to all; how could it be common to all?

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍdarśanāni me'ṅgāni pādo kukṣiḥ karau śiraḥ  |
teṣu  bhedantu  yaḥ  kuryānmamāṅgaṃ  cchedayettu  saḥ  || 84 ||
meaning:
षड्दर्शनानि मेऽङ्गानि पादो कुक्षिः करौ शिरः  |
तेषु  भेदन्तु  यः  कुर्यान्ममाङ्गं  च्छेदयेत्तु  सः  || 84 ||
text_mt: The six philosophical systems are My limbs: feet, belly, hands, and head; / he who would make division among them cuts off My limb.

sanskrit_iast:
etānyeva  kulasyāpi  ṣaḍaṅgāni  bhavanti  hi  |
tasmādvedātmakaṃ śāstraṃ viddhi kaulātmakaṃ priye  || 85 ||
meaning:
एतान्येव  कुलस्यापि  षडङ्गानि  भवन्ति  हि  |
तस्माद्वेदात्मकं शास्त्रं विद्धि कौलात्मकं प्रिये  || 85 ||
text_mt: These very ones are also the six limbs of Kula; / therefore know the scripture whose essence is the Veda to have Kaula as its essence, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
darśaneṣvakhileṣveva    phaladaṃ    caikadaivatam  |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ  nṛṇāṃ kule'smin daivataṃ priye  || 86 ||
meaning:
दर्शनेष्वखिलेष्वेव    फलदं    चैकदैवतम्  |
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं  नृणां कुलेऽस्मिन् दैवतं प्रिये  || 86 ||
text_mt: In all philosophical systems, a single deity yields fruit; / in this Kula, O beloved, the deity grants enjoyment and liberation to men.

sanskrit_iast:
lokadharmaviruddhañca    siddhayogīśvari  priye  |
kulaṃ  pramāṇatāṃ  yāti  pratyakṣaphaladaṃ   yataḥ  || 87 ||
meaning:
लोकधर्मविरुद्धञ्च    सिद्धयोगीश्वरि  प्रिये  |
कुलं  प्रमाणतां  याति  प्रत्यक्षफलदं   यतः  || 87 ||
text_mt: Though opposed to the ways of the world, O beloved Mistress of accomplished yogins, / Kula attains authority, because it yields visible fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyakṣañca  pramāṇāya  sarveṣāṃ  prāṇināṃ  priye  |
upalabdhibalāttasya hatāḥ sarve kutākīkāḥ  || 88 ||
meaning:
प्रत्यक्षञ्च  प्रमाणाय  सर्वेषां  प्राणिनां  प्रिये  |
उपलब्धिबलात्तस्य हताः सर्वे कुताकीकाः  || 88 ||
text_mt: And direct perception is the means of valid knowledge for all living beings, O dear one; / by the power of its direct experience, all bad logicians are overthrown.

sanskrit_iast:
parokṣaṃ ko nu jānīte kasya kiṃ vā bhaviṣyati |
yadvā     pratyakṣaphaladaṃ    tadevottamadarśanam  || 89 ||
meaning:
परोक्षं को नु जानीते कस्य किं वा भविष्यति |
यद्वा     प्रत्यक्षफलदं    तदेवोत्तमदर्शनम्  || 89 ||
text_mt: Who indeed knows what is beyond perception, or what will happen to whom? / Whatever yields perceptible results, that alone is the supreme philosophical system.

sanskrit_iast:
kuladharmamimaṃ  jñātvā  mucyante  sarvamānavāḥ  |
iti matvā maheśāni mayā kaulaṃ vigahītam  || 90 ||
meaning:
कुलधर्ममिमं  ज्ञात्वा  मुच्यन्ते  सर्वमानवाः  |
इति मत्वा महेशानि मया कौलं विगहीतम्  || 90 ||
text_mt: “Having understood this duty of Kula, all human beings are liberated” — / considering this, O Great Goddess, Kaula was concealed by me.

sanskrit_iast:
tvatkāruṇyavihīnānāṃ kulajñānavirodhinām  |
paśunāmanabhijñānāṃ   kuladharmo    vigahītaḥ  || 91 ||
meaning:
त्वत्कारुण्यविहीनानां कुलज्ञानविरोधिनाम्  |
पशुनामनभिज्ञानां   कुलधर्मो    विगहीतः  || 91 ||
text_mt: For those deprived of your compassion, who oppose Kula knowledge, / uninitiated bound souls who are ignorant, the duty of Kula has been concealed.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya janmāntare pāpakarmabandho'dhiko bhavet  |
na  tasya  gurukāruṇyaṃ  kulajñānañca jāyate  ||  92 ||
meaning:
यस्य जन्मान्तरे पापकर्मबन्धोऽधिको भवेत्  |
न  तस्य  गुरुकारुण्यं  कुलज्ञानञ्च जायते  ||  92 ||
text_mt: For one whose bondage of demerit is great from other lifetimes, / no compassion of the guru arises, nor does Kula knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāndho naiva paśyanti sūrya sarvaprakāśakam  |
tathā kulaṃ na jānanti tava  mayāvimohitāḥ  || 93 ||
meaning:
यथान्धो नैव पश्यन्ति सूर्य सर्वप्रकाशकम्  |
तथा कुलं न जानन्ति तव  मयाविमोहिताः  || 93 ||
text_mt: Just as blind men do not see the sun which illuminates everything, / so those deluded by your cosmic illusion do not know Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
śaivavaiṣṇavasaurādi   darśanānyapi   bhaktitaḥ  |
bhajante mānavā  nityaṃ vṛthāyāsaphalāni ca  || 94 ||
meaning:
शैववैष्णवसौरादि   दर्शनान्यपि   भक्तितः  |
भजन्ते मानवा  नित्यं वृथायासफलानि च  || 94 ||
text_mt: Even with devotion, men constantly resort to systems / such as the Śaiva, Vaiṣṇava, and Saura, whose fruits are useless toil.

sanskrit_iast:
vedaśāstrāgamaiḥ  proktaṃ  bhogamokṣaikasādhanam  |
mūḍhā  nindanti hā hanta matpriyaṃ  tava darśanam  || 95 ||
meaning:
वेदशास्त्रागमैः  प्रोक्तं  भोगमोक्षैकसाधनम्  |
मूढा  निन्दन्ति हा हन्त मत्प्रियं  तव दर्शनम्  || 95 ||
text_mt: Alas, fools revile your system, which is dear to me / and proclaimed by the Vedas, scriptures, and sacred traditions as the sole means for enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrāmitā hi mayā devi paśavaḥ śāstrakoṭiṣu  |
kuladharma na jānanti  vṛthā  jñānābhimāninaḥ  || 96 ||
meaning:
भ्रामिता हि मया देवि पशवः शास्त्रकोटिषु  |
कुलधर्म न जानन्ति  वृथा  ज्ञानाभिमानिनः  || 96 ||
text_mt: Indeed, O Goddess, the uninitiated bound souls, led astray by me through millions of scriptures, / do not know the duty of Kula, falsely conceited in their knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
paśuśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi mayaiva kathitāni hi  |
mūrttyantarantu   gatvaiva   mohanāya  durātmanām  || 97 ||
meaning:
पशुशास्त्राणि सर्वाणि मयैव कथितानि हि  |
मूर्त्त्यन्तरन्तु   गत्वैव   मोहनाय  दुरात्मनाम्  || 97 ||
text_mt: Indeed, all the scriptures for uninitiated bound souls were spoken by me alone, / having assumed other forms merely for deluding the wicked.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpāpavaśānnṛṇāṃ   teṣu   vāñchābhijāyate  |
teṣāñca  sadāgatirnāsti  kalpakoṭiśatairapi  || 98 ||
meaning:
महापापवशान्नृणां   तेषु   वाञ्छाभिजायते  |
तेषाञ्च  सदागतिर्नास्ति  कल्पकोटिशतैरपि  || 98 ||
text_mt: Desire for them arises in men due to their great demerit, / and for them there is no good state, even after hundreds of millions of cosmic ages.

sanskrit_iast:
preryamāṇo'pi  pāpātmā  kule  naiva  pravarttate  |
vāryamāṇo'pi puṇyātmā kulamevābhilamvate  || 99 ||
meaning:
प्रेर्यमाणोऽपि  पापात्मा  कुले  नैव  प्रवर्त्तते  |
वार्यमाणोऽपि पुण्यात्मा कुलमेवाभिलम्वते  || 99 ||
text_mt: Even when urged, a sinner does not enter into Kula; / even when held back, a meritorious soul clings only to Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
kuladharmeṇa  devatvaṃ  devāḥ   sampratipedire  |
muniyogīśvarādyāśca  susiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ  || 100 ||
meaning:
कुलधर्मेण  देवत्वं  देवाः   सम्प्रतिपेदिरे  |
मुनियोगीश्वराद्याश्च  सुसिद्धिं परमां गताः  || 100 ||
text_mt: By the duty of Kula, the gods attained divinity, / and sages, lords of yoga, and others reached supreme accomplishment.

sanskrit_iast:
paśuvratādiniratāḥ sulabhā dāmbhikā  bhuvi  |
ye kaulameva sevante te mahānto'ti durlabhāḥ  || 101 ||
meaning:
पशुव्रतादिनिरताः सुलभा दाम्भिका  भुवि  |
ये कौलमेव सेवन्ते ते महान्तोऽति दुर्लभाः  || 101 ||
text_mt: Hypocrites devoted to vows of uninitiated bound souls are easily found on earth; / those who practice only Kaula are noble and extremely rare.

sanskrit_iast:
mānavā  bahavaḥ  santi mithyātattvārthavedinaḥ  |
durlabho'yaṃ   maheśāni   kulatattvaviśāradaḥ  || 102 ||
meaning:
मानवा  बहवः  सन्ति मिथ्यातत्त्वार्थवेदिनः  |
दुर्लभोऽयं   महेशानि   कुलतत्त्वविशारदः  || 102 ||
text_mt: There are many men who claim to know false realities; / rare, O Great Goddess, is one who is expert in the reality of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā rogāturāḥ kecinmānavāḥ kulanāyike  |
divyauṣadhaṃ  na  sevante  mahāvyādhivināśanam  || 103 ||
meaning:
यथा रोगातुराः केचिन्मानवाः कुलनायिके  |
दिव्यौषधं  न  सेवन्ते  महाव्याधिविनाशनम्  || 103 ||
text_mt: Just as some diseased men, O Leader of Kula, / do not take divine medicine that cures major illnesses,

sanskrit_iast:
tadvyādhivarddhanāpathyaṃ kurvanti hi kubheṣajam |
tathaiva janmamaraṇakṛtaṃ  sāṃsārikīṃ  kriyām  || 104 ||
meaning:
तद्व्याधिवर्द्धनापथ्यं कुर्वन्ति हि कुभेषजम् |
तथैव जन्ममरणकृतं  सांसारिकीं  क्रियाम्  || 104 ||
text_mt: and indeed resort to bad medicine and unhealthy habits that aggravate that disease, / just so they continually practice worldly action,

sanskrit_iast:
samācaranti   satataṃ  tvatkāruṇyavivajītāḥ  |
na  bhajante  kulaṃ  dharma  bhavavandhavimocanam  || 105 ||
meaning:
समाचरन्ति   सततं  त्वत्कारुण्यविवजीताः  |
न  भजन्ते  कुलं  धर्म  भववन्धविमोचनम्  || 105 ||
text_mt: which brings about birth and death, being devoid of your compassion; / they do not practice the duty of Kula, which liberates from the bonds of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā cāraṇyajātāṃstu marīcādīn vaṇigjanān |
mohato mānavāḥ prītyā yācante kulanāyike  || 106 ||
meaning:
यथा चारण्यजातांस्तु मरीचादीन् वणिग्जनान् |
मोहतो मानवाः प्रीत्या याचन्ते कुलनायिके  || 106 ||
text_mt: And just as men out of delusion gladly ask merchants, / O Leader of Kula, for forest products such as pepper,

sanskrit_iast:
anarghyāṇi ca ratnāni na yācante hi kecana  |
tathaiva  paśuśāstrāṇi  karmapāśaphalāni  ca  || 107 ||
meaning:
अनर्घ्याणि च रत्नानि न याचन्ते हि केचन  |
तथैव  पशुशास्त्राणि  कर्मपाशफलानि  च  || 107 ||
text_mt: and none ask for priceless jewels, / just so, those fools deluded by your cosmic illusion

sanskrit_iast:
iti pṛcchanti mūrkhāste tava  māyāvimohitā  |
kuladharma na  pṛcchanti  bhuktimuktiphalapradam  || 108 ||
meaning:
इति पृच्छन्ति मूर्खास्ते तव  मायाविमोहिता  |
कुलधर्म न  पृच्छन्ति  भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम्  || 108 ||
text_mt: ask for the scriptures of uninitiated bound souls whose results are the fetters of action; / they do not ask for the duty of Kula, which grants the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
kastūrīṃ  kardamadhiyā  karpūraṃ   lavaṇecchayā  |
śārkaraṃ  śakarābhrāntyā maṇiṃ  kācamanīṣayā  || 109||
meaning:
कस्तूरीं  कर्दमधिया  कर्पूरं   लवणेच्छया  |
शार्करं  शकराभ्रान्त्या मणिं  काचमनीषया  || 109||
text_mt: Taking musk to be mud, camphor to be salt, / sugar to be gravel, a jewel to be glass,

sanskrit_iast:
yathādṛṣṭaṃ  na  manyante  karasthamapi  pāmarāḥ  |
tathā kaulaṃ na  jānanti tvatprasādavivajītāḥ  || 110 ||
meaning:
यथादृष्टं  न  मन्यन्ते  करस्थमपि  पामराः  |
तथा कौलं न  जानन्ति त्वत्प्रसादविवजीताः  || 110 ||
text_mt: just as the wretched do not value what is seen, even when placed in their hand, / so those bereft of your grace do not recognize Kaula.

sanskrit_iast:
aho mohasya māhātmyaṃ tvanmāyājanitasya ca |
kimajñānapi     deveśi     mohayedamarānapi  || 111 ||
meaning:
अहो मोहस्य माहात्म्यं त्वन्मायाजनितस्य च |
किमज्ञानपि     देवेशि     मोहयेदमरानपि  || 111 ||
text_mt: Ah, the power of delusion born of your cosmic illusion! / What, O Queen of gods? It deludes the immortals as well as the ignorant!

sanskrit_iast:
peyaṃ madyaṃ palaṃ khādyaṃ samālokya priyāmukham  |
ityevācaraṇaṃ   jāpyaṃ   pariprāpyaṃ   paramrapadam  || 112 ||
meaning:
पेयं मद्यं पलं खाद्यं समालोक्य प्रियामुखम्  |
इत्येवाचरणं   जाप्यं   परिप्राप्यं   परम्रपदम्  || 112 ||
text_mt: Wine is to be drunk, meat is to be eaten, having looked upon the face of the beloved; / this very conduct is the repetition to be performed, and the supreme state is to be fully attained.

sanskrit_iast:
gurukāruṇyasaṃlabhyamīdṛśaṃ      kuladarśanam  |
tvadbhaktā  eva  jānanti  netare bhuktimuktidam  || 113 ||
meaning:
गुरुकारुण्यसंलभ्यमीदृशं      कुलदर्शनम्  |
त्वद्भक्ता  एव  जानन्ति  नेतरे भुक्तिमुक्तिदम्  || 113 ||
text_mt: Such is the vision of Kula, obtainable through the grace of the guru; / your devotees alone know it, which grants enjoyment and liberation, and none others.

sanskrit_iast:
gurūpadeśarahitā    mahānta    iti    kecana  |
mohayanti janān sarvān svayaṃ pūrvavimohitāḥ  || 114 ||
meaning:
गुरूपदेशरहिता    महान्त    इति    केचन  |
मोहयन्ति जनान् सर्वान् स्वयं पूर्वविमोहिताः  || 114 ||
text_mt: Some, devoid of a guru's instruction, thinking themselves great, / delude all people, being themselves already deluded.

sanskrit_iast:
durācāraparāḥ    kecidvācayanti    ca     pāmarāḥ  |
kathaṃbhūto bhavet svāmī sevakāḥ syustathāvidhāḥ  || 115 ||
meaning:
दुराचारपराः    केचिद्वाचयन्ति    च     पामराः  |
कथंभूतो भवेत् स्वामी सेवकाः स्युस्तथाविधाः  || 115 ||
text_mt: Some wretched men, devoted to evil conduct, cheat others; / as the master may be, so will the servants be.

sanskrit_iast:
bahavaḥ kaulikaṃ dharma  mithyājñānaviḍambakāḥ  |
svabudhdyā kalpayantītthaṃ pāramparyavivajītāḥ  || 116 ||
meaning:
बहवः कौलिकं धर्म  मिथ्याज्ञानविडम्बकाः  |
स्वबुध्द्या कल्पयन्तीत्थं पारम्पर्यविवजीताः  || 116 ||
text_mt: Many, parodying false knowledge, / thus invent Kaulika duty through their own intellect, bereft of tradition.

sanskrit_iast:
madyapānena   manujo  yadi  siddhaṃ  labheta  vai  |
madyapānaratāḥ sarve  siddhiṃ  gacchantu  pāmarāḥ  || 117 ||
meaning:
मद्यपानेन   मनुजो  यदि  सिद्धं  लभेत  वै  |
मद्यपानरताः सर्वे  सिद्धिं  गच्छन्तु  पामराः  || 117 ||
text_mt: If a man were indeed to attain perfection by drinking wine, / then let all wretched men devoted to drinking wine attain perfection!

sanskrit_iast:
māṃsabhakṣaṇamātreṇa   yadi   puṇyā  gatirbhavet  |
loke māsāśinaḥ sarve puṇyabhājo bhavanti hi  || 118 ||
meaning:
मांसभक्षणमात्रेण   यदि   पुण्या  गतिर्भवेत्  |
लोके मासाशिनः सर्वे पुण्यभाजो भवन्ति हि  || 118 ||
text_mt: If a meritorious state could result merely from eating meat, / then all meat-eaters in the world would indeed share in merit!

sanskrit_iast:
śaktisambhogamātreṇa   yadi   mokṣo   bhaveta   vai  |
sarve'pi jantavo loke muktāḥ syuḥ strīniṣevanāt  ||119 ||
meaning:
शक्तिसम्भोगमात्रेण   यदि   मोक्षो   भवेत   वै  |
सर्वेऽपि जन्तवो लोके मुक्ताः स्युः स्त्रीनिषेवनात्  ||119 ||
text_mt: If liberation were indeed attained merely by sexual union with a consort, / then all creatures in the world would be liberated from serving women!

sanskrit_iast:
kulamārgo mahādevi na mayā ninditaḥ kvacit  |
ācārarahitā  ye'tra   ninditāste  na  cetare  || 120 ||
meaning:
कुलमार्गो महादेवि न मया निन्दितः क्वचित्  |
आचाररहिता  येऽत्र   निन्दितास्ते  न  चेतरे  || 120 ||
text_mt: The path of Kula, O Great Goddess, has never been censured by me; / those here who are devoid of proper conduct are censured, not others.

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā kaulike dharme ācāraḥ kathito mayā  |
vicarantyanthā   devi   mūḍhāḥ  paṇḍitamāninaḥ  || 121 ||
meaning:
अन्यथा कौलिके धर्मे आचारः कथितो मया  |
विचरन्त्यन्था   देवि   मूढाः  पण्डितमानिनः  || 121 ||
text_mt: Conduct in the Kaulika duty was taught otherwise by me; / fools imagining themselves scholars practice it otherwise, O Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛpāṇadhārāgamanāt vyāghrakaṇṭhāvalambanāt  |
bhujaṅgadhāraṇānnūnamaśakyaṃ     kulavarttanam  || 122 ||
meaning:
कृपाणधारागमनात् व्याघ्रकण्ठावलम्बनात्  |
भुजङ्गधारणान्नूनमशक्यं     कुलवर्त्तनम्  || 122 ||
text_mt: Harder than walking on the edge of a sword, harder than clinging to a tiger's neck, / harder than holding a snake is indeed living according to Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛthā  pānantu   deveśi  surāpānaṃ  taducyate  |
tatmahāpātakaṃ  jñeyaṃ  vedādiṣu   nirūpitam  || 123 ||
meaning:
वृथा  पानन्तु   देवेशि  सुरापानं  तदुच्यते  |
तत्महापातकं  ज्ञेयं  वेदादिषु   निरूपितम्  || 123 ||
text_mt: Wasted drinking, O Queen of gods, that is called drinking liquor; / that should be known as a great sin, as described in the Vedas and other texts.

sanskrit_iast:
anāghreyamanālokyamaspṛśyañcāpyapeyakam  |
madyaṃ maṃsaṃ paśūnāntu kaulikānāṃ mahāphalam  || 124 ||
meaning:
अनाघ्रेयमनालोक्यमस्पृश्यञ्चाप्यपेयकम्  |
मद्यं मंसं पशूनान्तु कौलिकानां महाफलम्  || 124 ||
text_mt: Wine and meat are not to be smelled, not to be looked at, not to be touched, and not to be drunk / by uninitiated bound souls; but for Kaulikas they yield great fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
amedhyāni  dvijātīnāṃ  madyānyekādaśaiva tu  |
dvādaśantu    mahāmadyaṃ    sarveṣāmuttamottamam  || 125 ||
meaning:
अमेध्यानि  द्विजातीनां  मद्यान्येकादशैव तु  |
द्वादशन्तु    महामद्यं    सर्वेषामुत्तमोत्तमम्  || 125 ||
text_mt: Impure for the twice-born are eleven kinds of wine; / but the twelfth is the great wine, the highest of the high for all.

sanskrit_iast:
surā  vai  malamannānāṃ  pāpmā tu  malamucyate  |
tasmādbrāhmaṇarājanyau vaiśya  na surāṃ pibet  || 126||
meaning:
सुरा  वै  मलमन्नानां  पाप्मा तु  मलमुच्यते  |
तस्माद्ब्राह्मणराजन्यौ वैश्य  न सुरां पिबेत्  || 126||
text_mt: Liquor is indeed the impurity of grains, and impurity is said to be sin; / therefore, a brāhmaṇa, a kṣatriya, and a vaiśya must not drink liquor.

sanskrit_iast:
surādarśanamātreṇa   kuryāt  sūryāvalokanam  |
tatsamāghrāṇamātreṇa   prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ   caret  || 127 ||
meaning:
सुरादर्शनमात्रेण   कुर्यात्  सूर्यावलोकनम्  |
तत्समाघ्राणमात्रेण   प्राणायामत्रयं   चरेत्  || 127 ||
text_mt: Upon merely seeing liquor, one should gaze at the sun; / upon merely smelling it, one should perform three breath-controls.

sanskrit_iast:
ājānubhyāṃ  bhavenmagno  jale  copavasedahaḥ  |
ūdrdhva nābhestrirātrantu madyasya sparśane vidhiḥ|| 128 ||
meaning:
आजानुभ्यां  भवेन्मग्नो  जले  चोपवसेदहः  |
ऊद्र्ध्व नाभेस्त्रिरात्रन्तु मद्यस्य स्पर्शने विधिः|| 128 ||
text_mt: One should be submerged in water up to the knees and fast for a day [for touching it below the navel]; / for touching wine above the navel, the rule is a three-night fast.

sanskrit_iast:
surāpāne kāmakṛte jvalantīṃ tāṃ vinikṣipet  |
mukhe tayā vinirdagdhe tataḥ  śuddhimavāpnuyāt  || 129 ||
meaning:
सुरापाने कामकृते ज्वलन्तीं तां विनिक्षिपेत्  |
मुखे तया विनिर्दग्धे ततः  शुद्धिमवाप्नुयात्  || 129 ||
text_mt: In the case of drinking liquor intentionally, one should pour it boiling hot / into one's mouth; when burnt completely by it, one then attains purification.

sanskrit_iast:
madyasparśādidoṣasya   prāyaścittavidhiḥ  smṛtaḥ  |
avidhānena yo hanyādātmārthaṃ prāṇinaḥ priye  || 130||
meaning:
मद्यस्पर्शादिदोषस्य   प्रायश्चित्तविधिः  स्मृतः  |
अविधानेन यो हन्यादात्मार्थं प्राणिनः प्रिये  || 130||
text_mt: This is remembered as the rule of expiation for the fault of touching wine and the like. / Whoever slays animals for his own sake without ritual injunction, O dear one,

sanskrit_iast:
nivasennarake  ghore  dināni   paśuromabhiḥ  |
sa  mṛto'pi  durācārastirryagyoniṣu jāyate  || 131 ||
meaning:
निवसेन्नरके  घोरे  दिनानि   पशुरोमभिः  |
स  मृतोऽपि  दुराचारस्तिर्र्यग्योनिषु जायते  || 131 ||
text_mt: he dwells in a terrible hell for as many days as there are hairs on the animal; / and when dead, that evildoer is born in the wombs of beasts.

sanskrit_iast:
anumantā   viśvasitā  nihantā  krayavikrayī  |
saṃskartā copaharttā ca khāditā'ṣṭau ca ghātakāḥ  || 132 ||
meaning:
अनुमन्ता   विश्वसिता  निहन्ता  क्रयविक्रयी  |
संस्कर्ता चोपहर्त्ता च खादिताऽष्टौ च घातकाः  || 132 ||
text_mt: The one who approves, the one who dresses [the meat], the killer, the buyer, the seller, / the cook, the server, and the eater—these eight are killers.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaivīkrayiko  hanti khāditā  copabhogataḥ  |
ghātako vadha bandhābhyāṃ ityeṣa trividho vadhaḥ  || 133 ||
meaning:
धनैवीक्रयिको  हन्ति खादिता  चोपभोगतः  |
घातको वध बन्धाभ्यां इत्येष त्रिविधो वधः  || 133 ||
text_mt: The seller kills for wealth, and the eater through consumption; / the killer kills through striking and binding: thus killing is threefold.

sanskrit_iast:
māṃsasandarśanaṃ   kṛtvā   surādarśanavaccaret  |
tasmādavidhinā māṃsaṃ madyaṃ na sevate kvacit  || 134 ||
meaning:
मांससन्दर्शनं   कृत्वा   सुरादर्शनवच्चरेत्  |
तस्मादविधिना मांसं मद्यं न सेवते क्वचित्  || 134 ||
text_mt: Having sighted meat, one should act as if seeing liquor; / therefore, one never partakes of meat or liquor contrary to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhinā sevyate devi tarasā tvaṃ prasīdasi  |
nāśayatyaparijñānāt   satyameva  varānane  || 135 ||
meaning:
विधिना सेव्यते देवि तरसा त्वं प्रसीदसि  |
नाशयत्यपरिज्ञानात्   सत्यमेव  वरानने  || 135 ||
text_mt: When partaken according to rule, O Goddess, you are swiftly pleased; / [partaken] through lack of discernment, it truly destroys, O fair-faced one.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇaṃ   vāpyavidhānena    chedayenna    kadācana  |
vidhinā gāṃ dvijaṃ vāpi  hatyā pāpairna lipyate  || 136 ||
meaning:
तृणं   वाप्यविधानेन    छेदयेन्न    कदाचन  |
विधिना गां द्विजं वापि  हत्या पापैर्न लिप्यते  || 136 ||
text_mt: One should never cut even a blade of grass contrary to rule; / yet having slain even a cow or a twice-born according to rule, one is not tainted by demerit.

sanskrit_iast:
bahunātra   kimuktena   sāramekaṃ  śṛṇu  priye  |
jīvanmuktisukhopāyaṃ  kulaśāstreṣu gopitam  || 137 ||
meaning:
बहुनात्र   किमुक्तेन   सारमेकं  शृणु  प्रिये  |
जीवन्मुक्तिसुखोपायं  कुलशास्त्रेषु गोपितम्  || 137 ||
text_mt: What is the use of speaking much on this? Hear the single essence, O beloved: / the easy means to the bliss of living liberation, concealed in the Kula scriptures,

sanskrit_iast:
yanmumukṣoḥ phalaṃ devi kanakasyeva saurabham  |
kulajñe'pyūrdhvavikhyāte   jñānaṃ  tattadanuttamam  || 138 ||
meaning:
यन्मुमुक्षोः फलं देवि कनकस्येव सौरभम्  |
कुलज्ञेऽप्यूर्ध्वविख्याते   ज्ञानं  तत्तदनुत्तमम्  || 138 ||
text_mt: which is the fruit for one desirous of liberation, O Goddess, like fragrance in gold; / even when one knows Kula, in this celebrated upper [tradition] that knowledge is unsurpassed.

sanskrit_iast:
kulaśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi mayaivoktāni pārvati  |
pramāṇāni na sandeho  na  hantavyāni  hetubhiḥ  || 139 ||
meaning:
कुलशास्त्राणि सर्वाणि मयैवोक्तानि पार्वति  |
प्रमाणानि न सन्देहो  न  हन्तव्यानि  हेतुभिः  || 139 ||
text_mt: All the Kula scriptures were spoken by me alone, O Pārvatī; / they are authoritative, there is no doubt; they must not be attacked with rationalistic arguments.

sanskrit_iast:
devatābhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca  madhu vātā ṛtāyate  |
svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayā kṣīraṃ sapīrmadhūdakam  || 140 ||
meaning:
देवताभ्यः पितृभ्यश्च  मधु वाता ऋतायते  |
स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठया क्षीरं सपीर्मधूदकम्  || 140 ||
text_mt: "For the gods and the ancestors," "The winds blow sweet for the righteous," / "With the sweetest, most intoxicating," milk, clarified butter, honey, and water,

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyapāvāḥ khādiśca abadhnan puruṣaṃ paśum  |
dīkṣāmupeyādityādyāḥ  pramāṇaṃ  śrutayaḥ  priye  || 141 ||
meaning:
हिरण्यपावाः खादिश्च अबध्नन् पुरुषं पशुम्  |
दीक्षामुपेयादित्याद्याः  प्रमाणं  श्रुतयः  प्रिये  || 141 ||
text_mt: "The golden-purified," "the Khādi," "They bound the man as an animal," / "He should approach initiation"—such scriptures are the authority, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetat kathitaṃ kiñcit kulamāhātmyamambike  |
samāsena  kulaśāni  kiṃ  bhūyaḥ  śrotumicchasi  || 142 ||
meaning:
इत्येतत् कथितं किञ्चित् कुलमाहात्म्यमम्बिके  |
समासेन  कुलशानि  किं  भूयः  श्रोतुमिच्छसि  || 142 ||
text_mt: Thus this little has been spoken of the greatness of Kula, O Ambikā, / in summary, O Ruler of Kula. What more do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast: atha tṛtīyollāsaḥ
meaning: अथ तृतीयोल्लासः

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevyuvāca
kuleśa   śrotumicchāmi  sarvadharmottamottamam  |
ūrdhvāmnāyañca tanmantraṃ māhātmyaṃ vada me prabho  || 1 ||
meaning:
श्रीदेव्युवाच
कुलेश   श्रोतुमिच्छामि  सर्वधर्मोत्तमोत्तमम्  |
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायञ्च तन्मन्त्रं माहात्म्यं वद मे प्रभो  || 1 ||
text_mt: The auspicious Goddess said: / O Lord of Kula, I wish to hear what is the highest of all duties, / and the upper transmission, its mantra, and its greatness; tell me, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīīśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi  |
tasya   śravaṇamātreṇa   devatā   suprasīdati  || 2 ||
meaning:
श्रीईश्वर उवाच
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि  |
तस्य   श्रवणमात्रेण   देवता   सुप्रसीदति  || 2 ||
text_mt: The auspicious Lord said: / Hear, O Goddess, I shall tell that which you ask of me; / merely by hearing it, the deity is well pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
na kadācinmayā  proktamitaḥ  pūrva kuleśvari  |
kathayāmi tava  snehādūrdhvāmnāyaṃ  śṛṇu priye  || 3 ||
meaning:
न कदाचिन्मया  प्रोक्तमितः  पूर्व कुलेश्वरि  |
कथयामि तव  स्नेहादूर्ध्वाम्नायं  शृणु प्रिये  || 3 ||
text_mt: It has never been spoken by me before this, O Mistress of Kula; / out of affection for you I tell it; hear of the upper transmission, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
vedaśāstrapurāṇāni  prakāśyāni  kuleśvari  |
śaivaśāktāgamāḥ sarve rahasyāḥ parikīttītāḥ  || 4 ||
meaning:
वेदशास्त्रपुराणानि  प्रकाश्यानि  कुलेश्वरि  |
शैवशाक्तागमाः सर्वे रहस्याः परिकीत्तीताः  || 4 ||
text_mt: The Vedas, treatises, and Purāṇas are to be made public, O Mistress of Kula; / all the Śaiva and Śākta scriptures are declared to be secret.

sanskrit_iast:
rahasyātirahasyāni  kulaśāstrāṇi  pārvati  |
rahasyātirahasyānāṃ        rahasyamidamambike  || 5 ||
meaning:
रहस्यातिरहस्यानि  कुलशास्त्राणि  पार्वति  |
रहस्यातिरहस्यानां        रहस्यमिदमम्बिके  || 5 ||
text_mt: The Kula scriptures are more secret than the secret, O Pārvatī; / and this, O Ambikā, is the secret of the most secret.

sanskrit_iast:
ūdrdhvāmnāyasya tattvaṃ hi pūrṇabrahmātmakaṃ param  |
sugopitaṃ   mayā  yatnādidānīntu   prakāśyate  || 6 ||
meaning:
ऊद्र्ध्वाम्नायस्य तत्त्वं हि पूर्णब्रह्मात्मकं परम्  |
सुगोपितं   मया  यत्नादिदानीन्तु   प्रकाश्यते  || 6 ||
text_mt: For the reality of the upper transmission is supreme, consisting of the full Brahman; / it was carefully concealed by me, but is now being revealed.

sanskrit_iast:
mama  pañcamukhebhyaśca   pañcāmnāyāḥ samudgatāḥ  |
pūrvaśca    paścimaścaiva    dakṣiṇaścottarastathā  |
ūrdhvāmnāyaśca pañcaite mokṣamārgāḥ prakīttītāḥ  || 7 ||
meaning:
मम  पञ्चमुखेभ्यश्च   पञ्चाम्नायाः समुद्गताः  |
पूर्वश्च    पश्चिमश्चैव    दक्षिणश्चोत्तरस्तथा  |
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायश्च पञ्चैते मोक्षमार्गाः प्रकीत्तीताः  || 7 ||
text_mt: And from my five faces the five sacred transmissions arose: / the eastern, the western, the southern, the northern, / and the upper transmission—these five are proclaimed as paths to liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
āmnāyā bahavaḥ santi nordhvāmnāyena te samāḥ  |
satyametadvarārohe   nātra    kāryā   vicāraṇā  || 8 ||
meaning:
आम्नाया बहवः सन्ति नोर्ध्वाम्नायेन ते समाः  |
सत्यमेतद्वरारोहे   नात्र    कार्या   विचारणा  || 8 ||
text_mt: Many are the sacred transmissions, but they are not equal to the upper transmission; / this is true, O woman of graceful hips; no doubt should be entertained on this.

sanskrit_iast:
āmnāyā   bahavo   guptaścaturāmnāyabhedajāḥ  |
asmiṃstantre samākhyātāḥ pūrvaṃ te kulanāyike  || 9 ||
meaning:
आम्नाया   बहवो   गुप्तश्चतुराम्नायभेदजाः  |
अस्मिंस्तन्त्रे समाख्याताः पूर्वं ते कुलनायिके  || 9 ||
text_mt: Many secret sacred transmissions arising from the divisions of the four sacred transmissions / were proclaimed to you before in this tantra, O Queen of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
caturāmnāya vettāro bahavaḥ santi kāmini  |
ūrdhvāmnāyasya tattvajñā viralā vīravandite  || 10 ||
meaning:
चतुराम्नाय वेत्तारो बहवः सन्ति कामिनि  |
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायस्य तत्त्वज्ञा विरला वीरवन्दिते  || 10 ||
text_mt: Those who know the four sacred transmissions are many, O desirable woman; / but those who know the reality of the upper transmission are rare, O you praised by heroes.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvantaḥ pāṃsavo bhūmestāvantaḥ samudīritāḥ  |
ekaikāmnāyajā mantrā bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ  || 11 ||
meaning:
यावन्तः पांसवो भूमेस्तावन्तः समुदीरिताः  |
एकैकाम्नायजा मन्त्रा भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदाः  || 11 ||
text_mt: As many as are the dust particles of the earth, so many are declared / to be the mantras born of each sacred transmission, granting the fruit of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
upamantrāśca  tāvantaḥ  sāradāḥ  samudīritāḥ |
mayaiva kathitāste tu lokānugrahakāṅkṣayā  || 12 ||
meaning:
उपमन्त्राश्च  तावन्तः  सारदाः  समुदीरिताः |
मयैव कथितास्ते तु लोकानुग्रहकाङ्क्षया  || 12 ||
text_mt: And as many subsidiary mantras, essential [in power], have been declared; / they were spoken by me alone out of a desire to bestow grace upon the world.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmapi   mantrāṇāṃ  devatāstatphalapradāḥ  |
āvayoraṃśasambhūtāḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ  śucismite  || 13 ||
meaning:
सर्वेषामपि   मन्त्राणां  देवतास्तत्फलप्रदाः  |
आवयोरंशसम्भूताः समुद्दिष्टाः  शुचिस्मिते  || 13 ||
text_mt: The deities of all the mantras who bestow those fruits, / are pointed out as born from parts of the two of us, O you of pure smile.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamantrānahaṃ vedmi  nānyo jānāti kaścana  |
matprasādena  yaḥ  kaścidvetti  mānavakoṭiṣu  || 14 ||
meaning:
सर्वमन्त्रानहं वेद्मि  नान्यो जानाति कश्चन  |
मत्प्रसादेन  यः  कश्चिद्वेत्ति  मानवकोटिषु  || 14 ||
text_mt: I know all the mantras; no one else knows them; / whoever knows them among millions of human beings does so by my grace.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāmnāyañca yo vetti sa  mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
kiṃ  punaścaturāmnāyavettā  sākṣācchivo bhavet  || 15 ||
meaning:
एकाम्नायञ्च यो वेत्ति स  मुक्तो नात्र संशयः  |
किं  पुनश्चतुराम्नायवेत्ता  साक्षाच्छिवो भवेत्  || 15 ||
text_mt: He who knows even one sacred transmission is liberated, there is no doubt here; / how much more so the knower of the four sacred transmissions—he becomes Śiva himself.

sanskrit_iast:
caturāmnāyavijñānādūrdhvāmnāyaḥ   paraḥ   priye  |
tasmāttadeva jānīyād yadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥ  || 16 ||
meaning:
चतुराम्नायविज्ञानादूर्ध्वाम्नायः   परः   प्रिये  |
तस्मात्तदेव जानीयाद् यदीच्छेत् सिद्धिमात्मनः  || 16 ||
text_mt: Beyond the knowledge of the four sacred transmissions is the upper transmission, O beloved; / therefore, one should know that alone if one desires one's own perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvatvāt sarvadharmāṇāmūrdhvāmnāyaḥ praśasyate  |
ūrdhvaṃ nayatyadhaḥsthañca  ūrdhvāmnāya  itīritaḥ  || 17 ||
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वत्वात् सर्वधर्माणामूर्ध्वाम्नायः प्रशस्यते  |
ऊर्ध्वं नयत्यधःस्थञ्च  ऊर्ध्वाम्नाय  इतीरितः  || 17 ||
text_mt: Because it is elevated above all duties, the upper transmission is praised; / and because it leads the fallen upward, it is called the upper transmission.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvatattvāt kuleśāni dhvastasaṃsārasāgarāt  |
ūrdhvalokaikasevyatvādūrdhvāmnāya  iti smṛtaḥ  || 18 ||
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वतत्त्वात् कुलेशानि ध्वस्तसंसारसागरात्  |
ऊर्ध्वलोकैकसेव्यत्वादूर्ध्वाम्नाय  इति स्मृतः  || 18 ||
text_mt: Because it is the supreme reality, O Mistress of Kula, by which the ocean of the transmigratory cycle is destroyed, / and because it is worshipped solely by the higher realm, it is traditionally called the upper transmission.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddeveśi jānīhi sākṣānmokṣaikasādhanam  |
sarvāmnāyādhikaphalamūrdhvāmnāyaṃ parāt param  || 19 ||
meaning:
तस्माद्देवेशि जानीहि साक्षान्मोक्षैकसाधनम्  |
सर्वाम्नायाधिकफलमूर्ध्वाम्नायं परात् परम्  || 19 ||
text_mt: Therefore know, O Ruler of the gods, the upper transmission, which is the direct and sole means to liberation, / having fruit exceeding all sacred transmissions, higher than the highest.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalokeṣu sarvebhyo hyahaṃ pūjyo  yathā  priye  |
amnāyeṣu  ca sarveṣu ūrdhvāmnāyastathā śive  || 20 ||
meaning:
सर्वलोकेषु सर्वेभ्यो ह्यहं पूज्यो  यथा  प्रिये  |
अम्नायेषु  च सर्वेषु ऊर्ध्वाम्नायस्तथा शिवे  || 20 ||
text_mt: Just as in all worlds I am to be worshipped by all, O beloved, / so among all sacred transmissions is the upper transmission, O Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
devatānāṃ yathā viṣṇurjyotiṣāṃ bhāskaro yathā  |
tīrthānāntu yathā kāśī svarnadī saritāṃ yathā  || 21 ||
meaning:
देवतानां यथा विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां भास्करो यथा  |
तीर्थानान्तु यथा काशी स्वर्नदी सरितां यथा  || 21 ||
text_mt: As Viṣṇu is among the deities, as the sun is among the luminaries, / as Vārāṇasī is among sacred fords, as the heavenly river is among rivers,

sanskrit_iast:
parvatānāṃ  yathā   merustarūṇāṃ   candanaṃ  yathā  |
aśvamedhaḥ kratūnāñca pāṣāṇānāṃ yathā  maṇiḥ  || 22 ||
meaning:
पर्वतानां  यथा   मेरुस्तरूणां   चन्दनं  यथा  |
अश्वमेधः क्रतूनाञ्च पाषाणानां यथा  मणिः  || 22 ||
text_mt: as Meru is among mountains, as sandalwood is among trees, / as the horse sacrifice is among rituals, as the jewel is among stones,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā rasānāṃ mādhuryaṃ  dhātūnāṃ  kāñcanaṃ  yathā  |
catuṣpadāṃ  yathā  dhenuryathā  haṃsastu  pakṣiṇām  || 23 ||
meaning:
यथा रसानां माधुर्यं  धातूनां  काञ्चनं  यथा  |
चतुष्पदां  यथा  धेनुर्यथा  हंसस्तु  पक्षिणाम्  || 23 ||
text_mt: as sweetness is among tastes, as gold is among metals, / as the cow is among quadrupeds, as the swan is among birds,

sanskrit_iast:
āśramāṇāṃ yathā bhikṣurvarṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā  |
manuṣyāṇāṃ yathā  rājā'vayavānāṃ yathā  śiraḥ  || 24 ||
meaning:
आश्रमाणां यथा भिक्षुर्वर्णानां ब्राह्मणो यथा  |
मनुष्याणां यथा  राजाऽवयवानां यथा  शिरः  || 24 ||
text_mt: as the renunciant is among the stages of life, as the brāhmaṇa is among the social classes, / as the king is among men, as the head is among the limbs,

sanskrit_iast:
āmodānāñca kastūrī yathā kāñcīpurī purām |
tathaiva  sarvadharmāṇāmūrdhvāmnāyo'dhikaḥ  priye  || 25 ||
meaning:
आमोदानाञ्च कस्तूरी यथा काञ्चीपुरी पुराम् |
तथैव  सर्वधर्माणामूर्ध्वाम्नायोऽधिकः  प्रिये  || 25 ||
text_mt: as musk is among fragrances, as the city of Kāñcī is among cities, / just so, among all duties, the upper transmission is supreme, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
nānājanmājītāpārapuṇyakarmaphalodayāt  |
ūrdhvāmnāyaṃ vijānīyānnānyathā vīravandite  || 26 ||
meaning:
नानाजन्माजीतापारपुण्यकर्मफलोदयात्  |
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायं विजानीयान्नान्यथा वीरवन्दिते  || 26 ||
text_mt: Through the dawning of the fruit of boundless meritorious deeds acquired over various births, / one may come to know the upper transmission, not otherwise, O you praised by heroes.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyo  manuṣyalakṣeṣu  jānāti  kuladarśanam  |
teṣāṃ lakṣeṣu yaḥ kaścidūrdhvāmnāyaṃ pravetti ca  || 27 ||
meaning:
धन्यो  मनुष्यलक्षेषु  जानाति  कुलदर्शनम्  |
तेषां लक्षेषु यः कश्चिदूर्ध्वाम्नायं प्रवेत्ति च  || 27 ||
text_mt: A blessed man among hundreds of thousands of mortals knows the Kula view; / and among hundreds of thousands of those, rare is he who fully knows the upper transmission.

sanskrit_iast:
na vedairnāgamaiḥ śāstrairna purāṇaiḥ suvistaraiḥ  |
na yajñairna  tapobhirvā na tīrthavratakoṭibhiḥ  || 28 ||
meaning:
न वेदैर्नागमैः शास्त्रैर्न पुराणैः सुविस्तरैः  |
न यज्ञैर्न  तपोभिर्वा न तीर्थव्रतकोटिभिः  || 28 ||
text_mt: Not through the Vedas, nor through the Agamas, treatises, nor very extensive Purāṇas, / not through sacrifices, nor through austerities, nor through millions of sacred fords and observances,

sanskrit_iast:
nānyairupāyairddeveśi     mantrauṣadhipuraḥsaraiḥ  |
āmnāyo jñāyate codrdhvaḥ śrīmadgurumukhaṃ vinā || 29 ||
meaning:
नान्यैरुपायैर्द्देवेशि     मन्त्रौषधिपुरःसरैः  |
आम्नायो ज्ञायते चोद्र्ध्वः श्रीमद्गुरुमुखं विना || 29 ||
text_mt: Nor is the upper transmission known through other means, O Goddess of the gods, / such as mantras, herbal medicines, and the like, without the mouth of the venerable guru.

sanskrit_iast:
tamevānveṣayettatra    sarvajñaṃ  karuṇānidhim  |
sarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ  ūrdhvāmnāyārthakovidam  |
tasmāddeveśi jānīyādūrdhvāmnāyaṃ kuleśvari  || 30||
meaning:
तमेवान्वेषयेत्तत्र    सर्वज्ञं  करुणानिधिम्  |
सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नं  ऊर्ध्वाम्नायार्थकोविदम्  |
तस्माद्देवेशि जानीयादूर्ध्वाम्नायं कुलेश्वरि  || 30||
text_mt: One should seek him alone there, omniscient, a treasure of compassion, / endowed with all auspicious marks, expert in the meaning of the upper transmission. / From him, O Goddess of the gods, Mistress of Kula, one should learn the upper transmission.

sanskrit_iast:
āmnāyaṃ yo naro devi vijānāti ca tattvataḥ  |
labhate kāṅkṣatāṃ siddhiṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ varānane  || 31 ||
meaning:
आम्नायं यो नरो देवि विजानाति च तत्त्वतः  |
लभते काङ्क्षतां सिद्धिं सत्यं सत्यं वरानने  || 31 ||
text_mt: The man who knows the sacred transmission in its true reality, O Goddess, / attains the perfection he desires; truly, truly, O fair-faced one!

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvāmnāyaṃ vijānāti yaḥ samyak śrīgurormukhāt  |
śāstramārgeṇa   sa  naro  jīvanmukto  na  saṃśayaḥ  || 32 ||
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायं विजानाति यः सम्यक् श्रीगुरोर्मुखात्  |
शास्त्रमार्गेण   स  नरो  जीवन्मुक्तो  न  संशयः  || 32 ||
text_mt: The man who knows the upper transmission thoroughly from the mouth of the venerable guru / through the path of scripture is liberated while living; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
āmnāyamīdṛśaṃ   devi   vijānāti    ca   tattvataḥ  |
sa vandyaḥ sadguruḥ so'rcyaḥ sa  daivajñaḥ sa māntrikaḥ  |
sa sevyaḥ sa ca saṃstutyaḥ sa draṣṭavyaḥ sa sāttvikaḥ  || 33 ||
meaning:
आम्नायमीदृशं   देवि   विजानाति    च   तत्त्वतः  |
स वन्द्यः सद्गुरुः सोऽर्च्यः स  दैवज्ञः स मान्त्रिकः  |
स सेव्यः स च संस्तुत्यः स द्रष्टव्यः स सात्त्विकः  || 33 ||
text_mt: A man who knows such a sacred transmission in its true reality, O Goddess, / is to be praised; he is a true guru, he is to be worshipped, he is a knower of destiny, he is a master of mantras; / he is to be served, he is to be extolled, he is to be seen, he is endowed with sattva;

sanskrit_iast:
sa vratī  sa tapasvī  ca so'nuṣṭhātā  sa pūjakaḥ  |
sa          vedāgamaśāstrādisarvavidyāviśāradaḥ  || 34 ||
meaning:
स व्रती  स तपस्वी  च सोऽनुष्ठाता  स पूजकः  |
स          वेदागमशास्त्रादिसर्वविद्याविशारदः  || 34 ||
text_mt: He has kept vows, he has practiced austerities, he performs rites, he offers worship; / he is an expert in all branches of learning, beginning with the Vedas, Āgamas, and scriptures;

sanskrit_iast:
sa ācāryaḥ sa matimān sa yatiḥ sa ca kaulikaḥ  |
sa yajvā sa ca pūtātmā sa jāpī sa ca sādhakaḥ  || 35 ||
meaning:
स आचार्यः स मतिमान् स यतिः स च कौलिकः  |
स यज्वा स च पूतात्मा स जापी स च साधकः  || 35 ||
text_mt: He is an ācārya, he is wise, he is an ascetic, and he is a Kaulika; / he is a sacrificer, he is purified in self, he recites mantras, and he is a practitioner;

sanskrit_iast:
sa yogī  sa kṛtārthastu sa vīraḥ  sa  ca  uttamaḥ  |
sa puṇyātmā sa sarvajñaḥ sa muktaḥ sa śivaḥ priye  || 36 ||
meaning:
स योगी  स कृतार्थस्तु स वीरः  स  च  उत्तमः  |
स पुण्यात्मा स सर्वज्ञः स मुक्तः स शिवः प्रिये  || 36 ||
text_mt: He is a yogin, he has achieved his purpose, he is a hero, and he is supreme; / he is meritorious in soul, he is omniscient, he is liberated, he is Śiva, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkulaṃ  pāvanaṃ devi  dhanyā  tajjananī  smṛtā  |
tatpitā ca kṛtārthaḥ syānmuktāstatpitaraḥ priye  |
puṇyāstadvaṃśajāḥ   sarve   pūtāstanmitrabāndhavāḥ  || 37 ||
meaning:
तत्कुलं  पावनं देवि  धन्या  तज्जननी  स्मृता  |
तत्पिता च कृतार्थः स्यान्मुक्तास्तत्पितरः प्रिये  |
पुण्यास्तद्वंशजाः   सर्वे   पूतास्तन्मित्रबान्धवाः  || 37 ||
text_mt: His family is purifying, O Goddess; his mother is considered blessed; / his father has achieved his purpose, and his ancestors are liberated, O beloved; / all who are born of his lineage are meritorious, and his friends and relatives are purified.

sanskrit_iast:
bahuneha  kimuktena  cordhvāmnāyaparasya  ca  |
smaraṇaṃ kīrttanaṃ  vāpi darśanaṃ  vandanaṃ tathā  |
sambhāṣaṇañca kurute rājasūyādhikaṃ phalam  || 38 ||
meaning:
बहुनेह  किमुक्तेन  चोर्ध्वाम्नायपरस्य  च  |
स्मरणं कीर्त्तनं  वापि दर्शनं  वन्दनं तथा  |
सम्भाषणञ्च कुरुते राजसूयाधिकं फलम्  || 38 ||
text_mt: What is the use of saying much in this matter? Even the remembrance, praising, / seeing, bowing before, / and conversing with one dedicated to the upper transmission yields a fruit greater than a rājasūya sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
sa yatra vasate devi tatra śrīvījayo bhavet  |
anāmayaṃ   subhikṣañca   suvṛṣṭinīrupadravam  || 39 ||
meaning:
स यत्र वसते देवि तत्र श्रीवीजयो भवेत्  |
अनामयं   सुभिक्षञ्च   सुवृष्टिनीरुपद्रवम्  || 39 ||
text_mt: Where he resides, O Goddess, there prosperity and victory will be, / freedom from disease, abundance of food, plentiful rain, and freedom from affliction.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād  guruprasādena  ūrdhvāmnāyaṃ   narottamaḥ  |
yo vetti tattvato devi sa me priyatamo bhavet  || 40 ||
meaning:
तस्माद्  गुरुप्रसादेन  ऊर्ध्वाम्नायं   नरोत्तमः  |
यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतो देवि स मे प्रियतमो भवेत्  || 40 ||
text_mt: Therefore, the best of men who, by the grace of the guru, / knows the upper transmission in its true reality, O Goddess, becomes dearest to me.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāmnāyaḥ sṛṣṭirūpaḥ sthitirūpaśca dakṣiṇaḥ  |
saṃhāraḥ paścimo  devi  uttaro'nugraho  bhavet  || 41 ||
meaning:
पूर्वाम्नायः सृष्टिरूपः स्थितिरूपश्च दक्षिणः  |
संहारः पश्चिमो  देवि  उत्तरोऽनुग्रहो  भवेत्  || 41 ||
text_mt: The eastern transmission has the nature of creation, and the southern has the nature of maintenance; / the western is dissolution, O Goddess, and the northern is grace.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrayogaṃ viduḥ pūrvaṃ bhaktiyogañca dakṣiṇam  |
paścimaṃ  karmayogañca  jñānayogaṃ  tathottaram  || 42 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रयोगं विदुः पूर्वं भक्तियोगञ्च दक्षिणम्  |
पश्चिमं  कर्मयोगञ्च  ज्ञानयोगं  तथोत्तरम्  || 42 ||
text_mt: They know the eastern as the yoga of mantra and the southern as the yoga of devotion; / the western as the yoga of action and the northern as the yoga of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāmnāyasya   saṅketāścatuvīṃśatirīritāḥ  |
dakṣiṇāmnāyasaṅketāḥ  pañcavīṃśatirīritāḥ  || 43 ||
meaning:
पूर्वाम्नायस्य   सङ्केताश्चतुवींशतिरीरिताः  |
दक्षिणाम्नायसङ्केताः  पञ्चवींशतिरीरिताः  || 43 ||
text_mt: Twenty-four conventions are declared for the eastern transmission; / twenty-five conventions are declared for the southern transmission.

sanskrit_iast:
paścimāmnāyasaṅketāḥ dvātriṃśat samudāhṛtāḥ  |
viduḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadāmnāye saṅketāḥ śrīmaduttare  || 44 ||
meaning:
पश्चिमाम्नायसङ्केताः द्वात्रिंशत् समुदाहृताः  |
विदुः षट्त्रिंशदाम्नाये सङ्केताः श्रीमदुत्तरे  || 44 ||
text_mt: Thirty-two conventions of the western transmission are stated; / they know thirty-six conventions in the sacred, venerable northern transmission.

sanskrit_iast:
ūdrdhvāmnāyasya caitāni na santi kulanāyike  |
sākṣācchivasvarūpatvānna kiñcit karma vidyate  || 45 ||
meaning:
ऊद्र्ध्वाम्नायस्य चैतानि न सन्ति कुलनायिके  |
साक्षाच्छिवस्वरूपत्वान्न किञ्चित् कर्म विद्यते  || 45 ||
text_mt: And for the upper transmission, O leader of Kula, these do not exist; / because its nature is Śiva directly, no ritual action exists at all.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvāmnāyasya  māhātmyamahaṃ vedmi na  cāparaḥ  |
matsnehāttvañca    jānāsi    satyametadvarānane  || 46 ||
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायस्य  माहात्म्यमहं वेद्मि न  चापरः  |
मत्स्नेहात्त्वञ्च    जानासि    सत्यमेतद्वरानने  || 46 ||
text_mt: I know the greatness of the upper transmission, and no other; / and out of my love you also know it; this is true, O fair-faced one!

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvāmnāyasya māhātmyamiti te kathitaṃ mayā  |
samāsena   kuleśāni   mantramāhātmyamucyate  || 47 ||
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायस्य माहात्म्यमिति ते कथितं मया  |
समासेन   कुलेशानि   मन्त्रमाहात्म्यमुच्यते  || 47 ||
text_mt: Thus the greatness of the upper transmission has been spoken to you by me / in brief, O Mistress of Kula; the greatness of the mantra is [now] told.

sanskrit_iast:
itaḥ pūrvaṃ mayā noktaṃ yasya kasyāpi pārvati  |
tadvadāmi  tava  snehācchṛṇu  matprāṇavallabhe  || 48 ||
meaning:
इतः पूर्वं मया नोक्तं यस्य कस्यापि पार्वति  |
तद्वदामि  तव  स्नेहाच्छृणु  मत्प्राणवल्लभे  || 48 ||
text_mt: Before this, it was never spoken by me to anyone whatsoever, O Pārvatī; / I speak it to you out of love. Listen, O beloved of my life!

sanskrit_iast:
śrīprāsādaparāmantramūrdhvāmnāyamadhiṣṭhitam  |
āvayoḥ paramākāraṃ yo vetti sa svayaṃ śivaḥ  || 49 ||
meaning:
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रमूर्ध्वाम्नायमधिष्ठितम्  |
आवयोः परमाकारं यो वेत्ति स स्वयं शिवः  || 49 ||
text_mt: He who knows the venerable supreme mantra of Prāsāda presiding over the upper transmission, / the supreme form of us two, is himself Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
śivādikrimiparyantaṃ  prāṇināṃ  prāṇavartmanā  |
niśvāsocchvāsarūpeṇa mantro'yaṃ varttate priye  || 50 ||
meaning:
शिवादिक्रिमिपर्यन्तं  प्राणिनां  प्राणवर्त्मना  |
निश्वासोच्छ्वासरूपेण मन्त्रोऽयं वर्त्तते प्रिये  || 50 ||
text_mt: From Śiva down to a worm, through the path of breath of living beings, / this mantra operates in the form of inhalation and exhalation, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
anilena vinā megho yathākāśe na veṣṭate  |
parāprasādamantreṇa vinā lokastathā  priye  || 51 ||
meaning:
अनिलेन विना मेघो यथाकाशे न वेष्टते  |
पराप्रसादमन्त्रेण विना लोकस्तथा  प्रिये  || 51 ||
text_mt: Just as a cloud does not swirl in the sky without wind, / in the same way, O beloved, the world [does not exist] without the supreme mantra of Prāsāda.

sanskrit_iast:
parāprāsādamantreṇa       syūtametaccarācaram  |
abhinnaṃ  tattvato  devi tālavṛnte yathānilaḥ  || 52 ||
meaning:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रेण       स्यूतमेतच्चराचरम्  |
अभिन्नं  तत्त्वतो  देवि तालवृन्ते यथानिलः  || 52 ||
text_mt: This moving and unmoving universe is interwoven with the supreme mantra of Prāsāda, / undivided [from it] in true reality, O Goddess, just as wind [is from] a palm fan.

sanskrit_iast:
bīje'ṅkurastile   tailamagnāvuṣṇaṃ   ravau   prabhā |
candre jyotsnā'nalaḥ kāṣṭhe puṣpe gandhe jale dravaḥ  || 53 ||
meaning:
बीजेऽङ्कुरस्तिले   तैलमग्नावुष्णं   रवौ   प्रभा |
चन्द्रे ज्योत्स्नाऽनलः काष्ठे पुष्पे गन्धे जले द्रवः  || 53 ||
text_mt: Like the sprout in the seed, oil in sesame, heat in fire, brilliance in the sun, / moonlight in the moon, fire in wood, fragrance in a flower, fluidity in water,

sanskrit_iast:
śabde cārthaḥ śive śaktiḥ kṣīre sapīḥ phale ruciḥ  |
śarkarāyāñca   mādhuryaṃ   ghanasāre  ca  śītalam  || 54 ||
meaning:
शब्दे चार्थः शिवे शक्तिः क्षीरे सपीः फले रुचिः  |
शर्करायाञ्च   माधुर्यं   घनसारे  च  शीतलम्  || 54 ||
text_mt: And meaning in speech, Śakti in Śiva, ghee in milk, taste in fruit, / sweetness in sugar, and coldness in camphor,

sanskrit_iast:
nigrahānugraho   mantre   pratimāyāñca    devatā  |
darpaṇe  pratibimbañca  samīre   calanaṃ   yathā  |
parāprasādamantre'pi  prapañco'yaṃ  tathā sthitaḥ  || 55 ||
meaning:
निग्रहानुग्रहो   मन्त्रे   प्रतिमायाञ्च    देवता  |
दर्पणे  प्रतिबिम्बञ्च  समीरे   चलनं   यथा  |
पराप्रसादमन्त्रेऽपि  प्रपञ्चोऽयं  तथा स्थितः  || 55 ||
text_mt: Restraint and grace in a mantra, divinity in an image, / reflection in a mirror, and motion in the breeze, / just so does this cosmic manifestation abide in the supreme mantra of Prāsāda.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṭabīje  yathā   vṛkṣaḥ   sūkṣmarūpeṇa   tiṣṭhati  |
parāprāsādamantre'smin brahmāṇḍo'pi tathā sthitaḥ  || 56 ||
meaning:
वटबीजे  यथा   वृक्षः   सूक्ष्मरूपेण   तिष्ठति  |
पराप्रासादमन्त्रेऽस्मिन् ब्रह्माण्डोऽपि तथा स्थितः  || 56 ||
text_mt: Just as a tree abides in the banyan seed in subtle form, / so too does the cosmic egg abide in this supreme mantra of Prāsāda.

sanskrit_iast:
supakveṣu   padārtheṣu   suraseṣu   kuleśvari  |
lavaṇena vinā  svādu  yathā bhokturna jāyate  || 57 ||
meaning:
सुपक्वेषु   पदार्थेषु   सुरसेषु   कुलेश्वरि  |
लवणेन विना  स्वादु  यथा भोक्तुर्न जायते  || 57 ||
text_mt: In well-cooked foods, delicious though they be, O Mistress of Kula, / just as there is no pleasant taste for the eater without salt,

sanskrit_iast:
parāprāsādamantreṇa ye  vā  mantrā  na  saṅgatāḥ  |
te phalaṃ na prayacchanti mantraṃ  śaktivivajītāḥ || 58 ||
meaning:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रेण ये  वा  मन्त्रा  न  सङ्गताः  |
ते फलं न प्रयच्छन्ति मन्त्रं  शक्तिविवजीताः || 58 ||
text_mt: So mantras that are not joined with the supreme mantra of Prāsāda / do not yield fruit, being mantras devoid of power.

sanskrit_iast: śrīprāsādaparāmantro   gopanīyaḥ   prayatnataḥ  || 59 ||
meaning: श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रो   गोपनीयः   प्रयत्नतः  || 59 ||
text_mt: The venerable supreme mantra of Prāsāda must be concealed with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
vicāryāhaṃ    purāṇārthān    darśanāmnāyabhedajān  |
grasamān vedmyahaṃ mantrān śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca  || 60 ||
meaning:
विचार्याहं    पुराणार्थान्    दर्शनाम्नायभेदजान्  |
ग्रसमान् वेद्म्यहं मन्त्रान् शास्त्राणि विविधानि च  || 60 ||
text_mt: Having examined the meanings of the Purāṇas, born of differences in philosophical systems and sacred transmissions, / I know the all-devouring mantras and the diverse scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrākṣādayo devāḥ  śāstreṣu  vividheṣu ca  |
bhramanti  teṣu  mūḍhāste tava  māyāvimohitāḥ  || 61 ||
meaning:
सहस्राक्षादयो देवाः  शास्त्रेषु  विविधेषु च  |
भ्रमन्ति  तेषु  मूढास्ते तव  मायाविमोहिताः  || 61 ||
text_mt: The gods, beginning with Indra, wander in these diverse scriptures; / deluded in them, they are thoroughly bewildered by your cosmic illusion.

sanskrit_iast:
jāyante ca mirayante ca  saṃsārakleśabhāginaḥ  |
śrīprāsādaparāmantraṃ  na   gāyantaḥ  kuleśvari  |
na labhante hi  mokṣaṃ te tava māyāvimohitāḥ  || 62 ||
meaning:
जायन्ते च मिरयन्ते च  संसारक्लेशभागिनः  |
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रं  न   गायन्तः  कुलेश्वरि  |
न लभन्ते हि  मोक्षं ते तव मायाविमोहिताः  || 62 ||
text_mt: They are born and die, partaking of the afflictions of the transmigratory cycle; / not singing the venerable supreme mantra of Prāsāda, O Mistress of Kula, / they indeed do not attain liberation, bewildered by your cosmic illusion.

sanskrit_iast:
madrūpe śrīgurau yasya dṛḍhā bhaktiḥ prajāyate  |
śrīprāsādaparāmantraṃ sa  jñātvā  parimucyate  || 63 ||
meaning:
मद्रूपे श्रीगुरौ यस्य दृढा भक्तिः प्रजायते  |
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रं स  ज्ञात्वा  परिमुच्यते  || 63 ||
text_mt: He in whom firm devotion arises toward the venerable guru who has my form, / knowing the venerable supreme mantra of Prāsāda, is completely liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvajanmasahasreṣu         śaivādisamayodyatān  |
caturāmnāyajān mantrān gurvājñāṃ yo bhajiṣyati  || 64 ||
meaning:
पूर्वजन्मसहस्रेषु         शैवादिसमयोद्यतान्  |
चतुराम्नायजान् मन्त्रान् गुर्वाज्ञां यो भजिष्यति  || 64 ||
text_mt: He who, across thousands of previous births, undertaken in the Śaiva and other traditions, / has worshipped the command of the guru and the mantras born of the four sacred transmissions,

sanskrit_iast:
sa pāpakañcukānmuktaḥ  śuddhātmā  guruvatsalaḥ  |
śrīprāsādaparāmantraṃ   vijānāti   na   cānyathā  || 65 ||
meaning:
स पापकञ्चुकान्मुक्तः  शुद्धात्मा  गुरुवत्सलः  |
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रं   विजानाति   न   चान्यथा  || 65 ||
text_mt: Freed from the cuirass of demerit, pure in self, devoted to the guru, / knows the venerable supreme mantra of Prāsāda, and not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
sabrahmāviṣṇurudrāśca      śakrādisurapuṅgavāḥ  |
vasurudrārkadikpālā   manucandrādayaḥ   priye  || 66 ||
meaning:
सब्रह्माविष्णुरुद्राश्च      शक्रादिसुरपुङ्गवाः  |
वसुरुद्रार्कदिक्पाला   मनुचन्द्रादयः   प्रिये  || 66 ||
text_mt: Along with Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra, the preeminent gods beginning with Indra, / the Vasus, Rudras, Ādityas, guardians of the directions, Manus, and the Moon, O beloved,

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeyādimunayo    vasiṣṭhādimunīśvarāḥ  |
sanakādyāśca yogīśā jīvanmuktāḥ śukādayaḥ || 67 ||
meaning:
मार्कण्डेयादिमुनयो    वसिष्ठादिमुनीश्वराः  |
सनकाद्याश्च योगीशा जीवन्मुक्ताः शुकादयः || 67 ||
text_mt: Sages beginning with Mārkaṇḍeya, lordly sages beginning with Vasiṣṭha, / supreme yogins beginning with Sanaka, and those liberated while living beginning with Śuka,

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣakinnaragandharvāḥ      siddhavidyādharādayaḥ  |
śrīprāsādaparāmantraprabhavañcāmitaṃ       phalam  |
prāpya mantramimaṃ  puṇyaṃ  japantyadyāpi pārvati  || 68 ||
meaning:
यक्षकिन्नरगन्धर्वाः      सिद्धविद्याधरादयः  |
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रप्रभवञ्चामितं       फलम्  |
प्राप्य मन्त्रमिमं  पुण्यं  जपन्त्यद्यापि पार्वति  || 68 ||
text_mt: The yakṣas, kinnaras, gandharvas, siddhas, vidyādharas, and others, / having obtained this meritorious mantra, along with the measureless fruit born of the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra, / even today continue to recite it, O Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmarthyaṃ pūjyatā vidyā tejaḥ saukhyamarogitā  |
rājyaṃ   svargañca  mokṣañca  parāprāsādajāpinaḥ  || 69 ||
meaning:
सामर्थ्यं पूज्यता विद्या तेजः सौख्यमरोगिता  |
राज्यं   स्वर्गञ्च  मोक्षञ्च  पराप्रासादजापिनः  || 69 ||
text_mt: Competence, reverence, knowledge, splendour, happiness, freedom from disease, / kingdom, heaven, and liberation belong to one who recites the Parāprāsāda [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
brahmendrarudraviṣṇūnāmapi    dūrāyate    padam  |
sarvakarmavihīno'pi    parāprāsādamantravit  |
 sukhena yāṃ gatiṃ yāti na tāṃ sarve'pi dhāmīkāḥ || 70 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मेन्द्ररुद्रविष्णूनामपि    दूरायते    पदम्  |
सर्वकर्मविहीनोऽपि    पराप्रासादमन्त्रवित्  |
 सुखेन यां गतिं याति न तां सर्वेऽपि धामीकाः || 70 ||
text_mt: Even the status of Brahmā, Indra, Rudra, and Viṣṇu becomes distant [in comparison]; / even one devoid of all ritual actions who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra / goes with ease to that state which all the performers of ritual duties do not reach.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya cintāmaṇiḥ kāmadhenuḥ  kalpatarurgṛhe  |
kuberaḥ kiṅkaraḥ sākṣāt parāprāsādajāpinaḥ  || 71 ||
meaning:
तस्य चिन्तामणिः कामधेनुः  कल्पतरुर्गृहे  |
कुबेरः किङ्करः साक्षात् पराप्रासादजापिनः  || 71 ||
text_mt: In the house of one who recites the Parāprāsāda [mantra] are the wishing jewel, the wish-granting cow, and the wishing tree; / Kubera is his servant in visible presence.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā divyamaṇi sparśāllauho  bhavati kāñcanam  |
parāprāsādajāpācca      paśuḥ    paśupatirbhavet  || 72 ||
meaning:
यथा दिव्यमणि स्पर्शाल्लौहो  भवति काञ्चनम्  |
पराप्रासादजापाच्च      पशुः    पशुपतिर्भवेत्  || 72 ||
text_mt: Just as iron becomes gold from the touch of a celestial gem, / so an uninitiated bound soul becomes the Lord of bound souls from reciting the Parāprāsāda [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
śrīprāsādaparāmantraṃ  yo  vijānāti  tattvataḥ  |
sa māṃ tvāñca vijānāti cāvayorapyatipriyaḥ  || 73 ||
meaning:
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रं  यो  विजानाति  तत्त्वतः  |
स मां त्वाञ्च विजानाति चावयोरप्यतिप्रियः  || 73 ||
text_mt: He who truly knows the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra / knows me and you, and is also exceedingly dear to us both.

sanskrit_iast:
parāprāsādamantrajñaḥ  śvapaco'pi hi pārvati  |
devatāsthāpane  śaktaḥ  pratimādau na saṃśayaḥ  || 74 ||
meaning:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रज्ञः  श्वपचोऽपि हि पार्वति  |
देवतास्थापने  शक्तः  प्रतिमादौ न संशयः  || 74 ||
text_mt: One who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra, even if he were an outcaste, O Pārvatī, / is capable of consecrating a deity in an image or the like, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
mantramātrantu   yo  vetti  parāprāsādasaṃjñakam  |
śvapaco'pi hi mucyeta kiṃ punastadvidhānavit  || 75 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रमात्रन्तु   यो  वेत्ति  पराप्रासादसंज्ञकम्  |
श्वपचोऽपि हि मुच्येत किं पुनस्तद्विधानवित्  || 75 ||
text_mt: He who knows only the mantra called Parāprāsāda, / even if he were an outcaste, is freed; how much more so one who knows its ritual procedure!

sanskrit_iast:
parāprāsādamantrajño  yat karoti  yadicchati  |
yadbrūte tanmaheśāni tapo dhyānaṃ japo bhavet  || 76 ||
meaning:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रज्ञो  यत् करोति  यदिच्छति  |
यद्ब्रूते तन्महेशानि तपो ध्यानं जपो भवेत्  || 76 ||
text_mt: Whatever one who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra does, whatever he desires, / whatever he speaks, O Great Sovereign Lady, becomes austerity, meditation, and recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāpūrvaṃ   maheśāni  pāramparyasamanvitam  |
parāprāsādamantraṃ yo vetti so'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 77 ||
meaning:
दीक्षापूर्वं   महेशानि  पारम्पर्यसमन्वितम्  |
पराप्रासादमन्त्रं यो वेत्ति सोऽहं न संशयः || 77 ||
text_mt: He who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra preceded by initiation, / endowed with the lineage of tradition, O Great Sovereign Lady, is me, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
carācarasametāni    bhuvanāni    caturdaśa  |
parāprāsādamantrajñadehe  tiṣṭhanti  nityaśaḥ  || 78 ||
meaning:
चराचरसमेतानि    भुवनानि    चतुर्दश  |
पराप्रासादमन्त्रज्ञदेहे  तिष्ठन्ति  नित्यशः  || 78 ||
text_mt: The fourteen worlds, along with their mobile and immobile beings, / reside constantly in the body of one who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
parāprāsādamantrajño yatra  tiṣṭhati bhāmini  |
divyakṣetraṃ   samuddiṣṭaṃ  samantāddaśayojanam  || 79 ||
meaning:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रज्ञो यत्र  तिष्ठति भामिनि  |
दिव्यक्षेत्रं   समुद्दिष्टं  समन्ताद्दशयोजनम्  || 79 ||
text_mt: Wherever one who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra resides, O beautiful lady, / for ten yojanas all around is proclaimed a divine sacred field.

sanskrit_iast:
parāprāsādamantrārthatattvajñaṃ     kulanāyike  |
surāsurāśca  vandante  kiṃ   punarmānavādayaḥ  || 80 ||
meaning:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञं     कुलनायिके  |
सुरासुराश्च  वन्दन्ते  किं   पुनर्मानवादयः  || 80 ||
text_mt: To one who knows the reality of the meaning of the Parāprāsāda mantra, O Lady of Kula, / gods and demons bow; how much more so mortals and the like!

sanskrit_iast:
parāprāsādamantrajño  yatra  tiṣṭhati  pārvati  |
siddhakṣetraṃ madīyaṃ  vā  munidevagaṇaiḥ  saha  || 81 ||
meaning:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रज्ञो  यत्र  तिष्ठति  पार्वति  |
सिद्धक्षेत्रं मदीयं  वा  मुनिदेवगणैः  सह  || 81 ||
text_mt: Wherever one who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra resides, O Pārvatī, / is my own field of accomplished masters, together with the hosts of sages and gods.

sanskrit_iast:
śaiva   vaiṣṇavadaurgārkagāṇapatyendusambhavān  |
sarvamantrān sa jānāti parāprāsādamantravit  || 82 ||
meaning:
शैव   वैष्णवदौर्गार्कगाणपत्येन्दुसम्भवान्  |
सर्वमन्त्रान् स जानाति पराप्रासादमन्त्रवित्  || 82 ||
text_mt: He who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra knows all mantras, / those arising from Śiva, Viṣṇu, Durgā, the Sun, Gaṇapati, and the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīprāsādaparāmantro  jihvāgre  yasya  varttate  |
tasya darśanamātreṇa  śvapaco'pi  vimucyate  || 83 ||
meaning:
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रो  जिह्वाग्रे  यस्य  वर्त्तते  |
तस्य दर्शनमात्रेण  श्वपचोऽपि  विमुच्यते  || 83 ||
text_mt: On the tip of whose tongue rests the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra, / by the mere sight of him even an outcaste is liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇo vā'ntyajo vāpi śucirvāpyaśuciḥ priye  |
parāprāsādajāpī  yaḥ  sa  mukto  nātra  saṃśayaḥ  || 84 ||
meaning:
ब्राह्मणो वाऽन्त्यजो वापि शुचिर्वाप्यशुचिः प्रिये  |
पराप्रासादजापी  यः  स  मुक्तो  नात्र  संशयः  || 84 ||
text_mt: Whether a brāhmaṇa or an outcaste, whether pure or impure, O beloved, / he who recites the Parāprāsāda [mantra] is liberated; there is no doubt here.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchatastiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato'pi vā  |
parāprāsādamantro'yaṃ  deveśi  na  ca niṣphalaḥ  || 85 ||
meaning:
गच्छतस्तिष्ठतो वापि जाग्रतः स्वपतोऽपि वा  |
पराप्रासादमन्त्रोऽयं  देवेशि  न  च निष्फलः  || 85 ||
text_mt: Whether moving or standing, whether awake or sleeping, / this Parāprāsāda mantra, O Mistress of the gods, is never without fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
cireṇaikaikaphaladā  mantrāḥ santi sahasraśaḥ  |
kuleśi mantrarājo'yaṃ  śīghraṃ  sarvaphalapradaḥ  || 86 ||
meaning:
चिरेणैकैकफलदा  मन्त्राः सन्ति सहस्रशः  |
कुलेशि मन्त्रराजोऽयं  शीघ्रं  सर्वफलप्रदः  || 86 ||
text_mt: There are thousands of mantras that grant single fruits after a long time; / this king of mantras, O Mistress of Kula, quickly yields all fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
parāprāsādamantro'yaṃ     sarvamantrottamottamaḥ  |
jñānato'jñānato vāpi bhajatāṃ kāmado manuḥ  || 87 ||
meaning:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रोऽयं     सर्वमन्त्रोत्तमोत्तमः  |
ज्ञानतोऽज्ञानतो वापि भजतां कामदो मनुः  || 87 ||
text_mt: This Parāprāsāda mantra is the highest of all mantras; / whether through knowledge or through ignorance, for those who worship it, it is a mantra granting all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
śacīndrau rohiṇīcandrau svāhāgnī ca prabhāravī |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau  vāṇīdhātārau  rātrivāsarau  || 88 ||
meaning:
शचीन्द्रौ रोहिणीचन्द्रौ स्वाहाग्नी च प्रभारवी |
लक्ष्मीनारायणौ  वाणीधातारौ  रात्रिवासरौ  || 88 ||
text_mt: Śacī and Indra, Rohiṇī and the Moon, Svāhā and Fire, and Radiance and the Sun, / Lakṣmī and Nārāyaṇa, Speech and the Creator, night and day,

sanskrit_iast:
agnīṣomau  bindunādau  devi  prakṛtipūruṣau  |
ādhārādheyanāmānau  bhogamokṣau  kuleśvari  || 89 ||
meaning:
अग्नीषोमौ  बिन्दुनादौ  देवि  प्रकृतिपूरुषौ  |
आधाराधेयनामानौ  भोगमोक्षौ  कुलेश्वरि  || 89 ||
text_mt: Fire and Soma, point and resonance, O Goddess, Nature and Consciousness, / named as the locus and what is located, enjoyment and liberation, O Mistress of Kula,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāpānau ca vāgarthau priye vidhiniṣedhakau  |
sukhaduḥkhādi yad dvandvaṃ  dṛśyate śrūyate  mayā  |
sarvalokeṣu  tat  sarvamāvāmeva  na  saṃśayaḥ  || 90 ||
meaning:
प्राणापानौ च वागर्थौ प्रिये विधिनिषेधकौ  |
सुखदुःखादि यद् द्वन्द्वं  दृश्यते श्रूयते  मया  |
सर्वलोकेषु  तत्  सर्वमावामेव  न  संशयः  || 90 ||
text_mt: and the out-breath and in-breath, word and meaning, O beloved, prescription and prohibition— / whatever pair of opposites such as pleasure and pain is seen or heard by me / in all the worlds, all that is indeed the two of us, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
puṃstrīrūpāṇi sarvāṇi cāvayoraṃśakāni hi  |
parāprāsādamantro'yaṃ tasmāt  sarvātmako bhavet || 91 ||
meaning:
पुंस्त्रीरूपाणि सर्वाणि चावयोरंशकानि हि  |
पराप्रासादमन्त्रोऽयं तस्मात्  सर्वात्मको भवेत् || 91 ||
text_mt: All male and female forms are portions of the two of us; / therefore this Parāprāsāda mantra must be the self of all.

sanskrit_iast:
arūpaṃ   bhāvanāgamyaṃ  paraṃ  brahma  kuleśvari  |
niṣkalaṃ nirmalaṃ nityaṃ nirguṇaṃ  vyomasannibham  || 92 ||
meaning:
अरूपं   भावनागम्यं  परं  ब्रह्म  कुलेश्वरि  |
निष्कलं निर्मलं नित्यं निर्गुणं  व्योमसन्निभम्  || 92 ||
text_mt: Formless, accessible through contemplation, the supreme Brahman, O Mistress of Kula, / undivided, stainless, eternal, without qualities, resembling space,

sanskrit_iast:
anantamavyayaṃ    tattvaṃ    manovācāmagocaram  |
parāprāsādamantrārthasandhānāt      samprakāśate  || 93 ||
meaning:
अनन्तमव्ययं    तत्त्वं    मनोवाचामगोचरम्  |
पराप्रासादमन्त्रार्थसन्धानात्      सम्प्रकाशते  || 93 ||
text_mt: the endless, immutable reality beyond the reach of mind and speech, / shines forth through union with the meaning of the Parāprāsāda mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmantramidaṃ   devi  parāprāsādasaṃjñakam  |
paratattvasvarūpatvāt  saccidānandalakṣaṇāt  || 94 ||
meaning:
तस्मान्मन्त्रमिदं   देवि  पराप्रासादसंज्ञकम्  |
परतत्त्वस्वरूपत्वात्  सच्चिदानन्दलक्षणात्  || 94 ||
text_mt: Therefore, O Goddess, this mantra called Parāprāsāda, / having the nature of the supreme reality, characterised by being-consciousness-bliss,

sanskrit_iast:
śivaśaktimayatvācca    bhuktimuktipradānataḥ  |
sakarmāpi ca niṣkarma saguṇañcāpi nirguṇam  || 95 ||
meaning:
शिवशक्तिमयत्वाच्च    भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदानतः  |
सकर्मापि च निष्कर्म सगुणञ्चापि निर्गुणम्  || 95 ||
text_mt: composed of Śiva and Śakti, and bestowing enjoyment and liberation, / is both with action and without action, both with qualities and without qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīprāsādaparāmantraṃ      sarvamantraśiromaṇi  |
japan bhuktiñca muktiñca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 96 ||
meaning:
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रं      सर्वमन्त्रशिरोमणि  |
जपन् भुक्तिञ्च मुक्तिञ्च लभते नात्र संशयः  || 96 ||
text_mt: Reciting the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra, the crest-jewel of all mantras, / one attains both enjoyment and liberation; there is no doubt here.

sanskrit_iast:
bahunātra  kimuktena  sarvasāraṃ  śṛṇu  priye  |
śrīprāsādaparāmantrasamaṃ   mantraṃ   na  vidyate  || 97 ||
meaning:
बहुनात्र  किमुक्तेन  सर्वसारं  शृणु  प्रिये  |
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रसमं   मन्त्रं   न  विद्यते  || 97 ||
text_mt: What need is there of saying much here? Hear the essence of everything, O beloved: / there is no mantra equal to the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
idameva  paraṃ   jñānamidameva  paraṃ   tapaḥ  |
idameva  paraṃ   dhyānamidameva  parārcanam  || 98 ||
meaning:
इदमेव  परं   ज्ञानमिदमेव  परं   तपः  |
इदमेव  परं   ध्यानमिदमेव  परार्चनम्  || 98 ||
text_mt: This alone is supreme knowledge, this alone is supreme austerity, / this alone is supreme meditation, this alone is supreme worship.

sanskrit_iast:
idameva  parā  dīkṣā  idameva  paro japaḥ  |
idameva  paraṃ   tattvamidameva  paraṃ  vratam  || 99 ||
meaning:
इदमेव  परा  दीक्षा  इदमेव  परो जपः  |
इदमेव  परं   तत्त्वमिदमेव  परं  व्रतम्  || 99 ||
text_mt: This alone is supreme initiation, this alone is supreme recitation, / this alone is supreme ontological reality, this alone is the supreme observance.

sanskrit_iast:
idameva  paro yajña  idameva  parāt  param  |
idameva  paraṃ  śreya  idameva  paraṃ  phalam  || 100 ||
meaning:
इदमेव  परो यज्ञ  इदमेव  परात्  परम्  |
इदमेव  परं  श्रेय  इदमेव  परं  फलम्  || 100 ||
text_mt: This alone is the supreme sacrifice, this alone is higher than the highest, / this alone is the supreme welfare, this alone is the supreme fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
idameva  paraṃ  brahma  idameva  parā  gatiḥ  |
idameva paraṃ guhyaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ  na saṃśayaḥ  |
iti matvā manuvaraṃ tanniṣṭhaḥ syāt sadā priye || 101 ||
meaning:
इदमेव  परं  ब्रह्म  इदमेव  परा  गतिः  |
इदमेव परं गुह्यं सत्यं सत्यं  न संशयः  |
इति मत्वा मनुवरं तन्निष्ठः स्यात् सदा प्रिये || 101 ||
text_mt: This alone is the supreme Brahman, this alone is the supreme goal, / this alone is the supreme secret, truth, truth, there is no doubt; / thinking thus, one should be ever devoted to this best of mantras, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
āgamoktena vidhinā kramapūjāpuraḥsaram  |
śrīprasādaparāmantraṃ    śatamaṣṭottaraṃ  japet  |
mucyate   brahmahatyādimahāpāpaiśca  pañcabhiḥ  || 102 ||
meaning:
आगमोक्तेन विधिना क्रमपूजापुरःसरम्  |
श्रीप्रसादपरामन्त्रं    शतमष्टोत्तरं  जपेत्  |
मुच्यते   ब्रह्महत्यादिमहापापैश्च  पञ्चभिः  || 102 ||
text_mt: According to the rule declared in the scripture, preceded by sequence-worship, / one should recite the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra one hundred and eight times; / he is freed from the five great sins, such as slaying a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
dviśataṃ  yo  japeddevi  śrīprāsādaparāmanum  |
caturaśītilakṣāṃśadhāraṇācaritairapi  || 103 ||
meaning:
द्विशतं  यो  जपेद्देवि  श्रीप्रासादपरामनुम्  |
चतुरशीतिलक्षांशधारणाचरितैरपि  || 103 ||
text_mt: He who recites the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra two hundred times, O Goddess, / [is freed from the demerits] accumulated through inhabiting eighty-four hundred thousand wombs,

sanskrit_iast:
svayonijāṅgavaritairasaṃkhyajananājītaiḥ  |
vārddhake yauvane bālye jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu  || 104 ||
meaning:
स्वयोनिजाङ्गवरितैरसंख्यजननाजीतैः  |
वार्द्धके यौवने बाल्ये जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्तिषु  || 104 ||
text_mt: contracted from the limbs born of his own womb, acquired through countless births, / in old age, in youth, in childhood, in waking, dreaming, and deep sleep,

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā  manasā  vācā  jñānājñānakṛtairapi  |
mahāpātakasaṃghaiśca      hyupapātakakoṭibhiḥ  |
mucyate   nātra    sandehaḥ   satyametadvarānane  || 105 ||
meaning:
कर्मणा  मनसा  वाचा  ज्ञानाज्ञानकृतैरपि  |
महापातकसंघैश्च      ह्युपपातककोटिभिः  |
मुच्यते   नात्र    सन्देहः   सत्यमेतद्वरानने  || 105 ||
text_mt: committed by deed, mind, or speech, knowingly or unknowingly, / from crowds of great sins and indeed from crores of secondary sins; / he is freed, there is no doubt here; this is the truth, O fair-faced lady.

sanskrit_iast:
triśataṃ   yo  japeddevi   śrīprāsādaparāmanum  |
sarvakratuṣu yat puṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu  yat phalam  || 106 ||
meaning:
त्रिशतं   यो  जपेद्देवि   श्रीप्रासादपरामनुम्  |
सर्वक्रतुषु यत् पुण्यं सर्वदानेषु  यत् फलम्  || 106 ||
text_mt: He who recites the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra three hundred times, O Goddess, / whatever merit [there is] in all sacrifices, whatever fruit in all gifts,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavrateṣu yat puṇyaṃ  sarvatīrtheṣu  yat phalam  |
tat phalaṃ labhate devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 107 ||
meaning:
सर्वव्रतेषु यत् पुण्यं  सर्वतीर्थेषु  यत् फलम्  |
तत् फलं लभते देवि नात्र कार्या विचारणा  || 107 ||
text_mt: whatever merit in all observances, whatever fruit in all sacred fords, / that fruit he obtains, O Goddess; no hesitation should be entertained here.

sanskrit_iast:
catuḥśataṃ  japed  yastu  śrīprāsādaparāmanum  |
sadā   tasya  gṛhadvāre   hyaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhayaḥ  |
sevante  nātra  sandehaḥ  sarvasiddhisamanvitāḥ  || 108 ||
meaning:
चतुःशतं  जपेद्  यस्तु  श्रीप्रासादपरामनुम्  |
सदा   तस्य  गृहद्वारे   ह्यणिमाद्यष्टसिद्धयः  |
सेवन्ते  नात्र  सन्देहः  सर्वसिद्धिसमन्विताः  || 108 ||
text_mt: Whoever recites the glorious Prāsādaparā mantra four hundred times, / at the door of his house the eight supernatural powers beginning with atomicity, / endowed with all attainments, constantly attend; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
yad yanmano'bhilaṣitaṃ tattat  prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ  |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca  sākṣāttasya kare  sthitāḥ || 109 ||
meaning:
यद् यन्मनोऽभिलषितं तत्तत्  प्राप्नोत्यसंशयः  |
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाश्च  साक्षात्तस्य करे  स्थिताः || 109 ||
text_mt: Whatever his mind desires, that he undoubtedly attains, / and righteousness, wealth, pleasure, and liberation are directly held in his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
sālokyapramukhāṃ devi labhenmuktiṃ catuvīdhām  |
satyametanna   sandehaḥ sādhakaḥ  kulanāyike || 110 ||
meaning:
सालोक्यप्रमुखां देवि लभेन्मुक्तिं चतुवीधाम्  |
सत्यमेतन्न   सन्देहः साधकः  कुलनायिके || 110 ||
text_mt: O Goddess, he attains the four kinds of liberation beginning with dwelling in the same realm; / this is the truth, there is no doubt, O practitioner, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
japet   pañcaśataṃ  yastu  śrīprāsādaparāmanum  |
tatphalaṃ naiva śaknomi kathituṃ kulanāyike  || 111 ||
meaning:
जपेत्   पञ्चशतं  यस्तु  श्रीप्रासादपरामनुम्  |
तत्फलं नैव शक्नोमि कथितुं कुलनायिके  || 111 ||
text_mt: Whoever recites the glorious Prāsādaparā mantra five hundred times, / its fruit I am truly not able to tell, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena  sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā  |
śrīprāsādaparāmantraṃ  japed  bhuktivimuktaye  || 112 ||
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन  सर्वावस्थासु सर्वदा  |
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रं  जपेद्  भुक्तिविमुक्तये  || 112 ||
text_mt: Therefore, by every effort, in all states, and at all times, / one should recite the glorious Prāsādaparā mantra for enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti gurvadhikaṃ tattvaṃ na  śivādhikadaivatam  |
na hi  vedādhikā  vidyā na  kaulasamadarśanam  || 113 ||
meaning:
नास्ति गुर्वधिकं तत्त्वं न  शिवाधिकदैवतम्  |
न हि  वेदाधिका  विद्या न  कौलसमदर्शनम्  || 113 ||
text_mt: There is no reality higher than the guru, no deity higher than Śiva, / no knowledge higher than the Veda, and no viewpoint equal to the Kaula.

sanskrit_iast:
na kulādadhikaṃ jñānaṃ na  jñānādadhikaṃ  sukham  |
nāṣṭāṅgādadhikā pūjā na hi mokṣādhikaṃ phalam |
idaṃ  satyamidaṃ  satyaṃ  satyaṃ satyaṃ  na  saṃśayaḥ  || 114 ||
meaning:
न कुलादधिकं ज्ञानं न  ज्ञानादधिकं  सुखम्  |
नाष्टाङ्गादधिका पूजा न हि मोक्षाधिकं फलम् |
इदं  सत्यमिदं  सत्यं  सत्यं सत्यं  न  संशयः  || 114 ||
text_mt: There is no knowledge higher than Kula, no happiness higher than knowledge, / no worship higher than the eightfold worship, and no fruit higher than liberation. / This is true, this is true, true, true, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīprāsādaparāmantramāhātmyamiha      vaṇītum  |
na   śaknomi  varārohe  kalpakoṭiśatairapi  || 115 ||
meaning:
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रमाहात्म्यमिह      वणीतुम्  |
न   शक्नोमि  वरारोहे  कल्पकोटिशतैरपि  || 115 ||
text_mt: To describe the greatness of the glorious Prāsādaparā mantra here, / I am not able, O fair-hipped woman, even in hundreds of millions of aeons.

sanskrit_iast:
girau   sarṣapamātrantu  sāgare  vālukā  yathā  |
tathā ca mantramāhātmyaṃ  kiñcitte kathitaṃ mayā  || 116 ||
meaning:
गिरौ   सर्षपमात्रन्तु  सागरे  वालुका  यथा  |
तथा च मन्त्रमाहात्म्यं  किञ्चित्ते कथितं मया  || 116 ||
text_mt: Just as a mustard seed is on a mountain, or a grain of sand in an ocean, / so a little of the mantra's greatness has been told to you by me.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvāmnāyasya   māhātmyaṃ  śrīprāsādaparāmanoḥ  |
iti te kathitaṃ devi kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi  || 117 ||
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायस्य   माहात्म्यं  श्रीप्रासादपरामनोः  |
इति ते कथितं देवि किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि  || 117 ||
text_mt: The greatness of the upper transmission and of the glorious Prāsādaparā mantra / has thus been told to you, O Goddess. What more do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast: atha caturthollāsaḥ
meaning: अथ चतुर्थोल्लासः

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevyuvāca
kuleśa śrotumicchāmi śrīprāsādaparāmanum |
mantrarājaṃ vadeśāna nyāsadhyānādibhiḥ saha || 1 ||
meaning:
श्रीदेव्युवाच
कुलेश श्रोतुमिच्छामि श्रीप्रासादपरामनुम् |
मन्त्रराजं वदेशान न्यासध्यानादिभिः सह || 1 ||
text_mt: The glorious Goddess said: / O Lord of Kula, I wish to hear about the glorious Prāsādaparā mantra. / Speak, O Lord, of the king of mantras along with its ritual projection, meditation, and other rites.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīīśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
tasya   śravaṇamātreṇa  śivākāraḥ  prajāyate || 2 ||
meaning:
श्रीईश्वर उवाच
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि |
तस्य   श्रवणमात्रेण  शिवाकारः  प्रजायते || 2 ||
text_mt: The glorious Lord said: / Hear, O Goddess, I will explain what you ask of me; / merely by hearing it, one assumes the form of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
itaḥ pūrva mayā nokto mantro'yaṃ yasya kasyacit |
tava  snehādvadāmyadya  śṛṇu   matprāṇavallabhe || 3 ||
meaning:
इतः पूर्व मया नोक्तो मन्त्रोऽयं यस्य कस्यचित् |
तव  स्नेहाद्वदाम्यद्य  शृणु   मत्प्राणवल्लभे || 3 ||
text_mt: Before this, this mantra was not spoken by me to anyone whatsoever. / Out of love for you I speak it today; listen, O beloved of my life.

sanskrit_iast:
anantacandrabhuvanamindubinduyugānvitaḥ |
śrīprāsādaparāmantro   bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
अनन्तचन्द्रभुवनमिन्दुबिन्दुयुगान्वितः |
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रो   भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः || 4 ||
text_mt: Endowed with Ananta, the moon, the realm, and a pair of moons and drops, / the glorious Prāsādaparā mantra bestows the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
parāprāsādamantrastu  sādiruktaḥ kuleśvari |
prakāśānandarūpatvāt    pratyakṣaphaladānataḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रस्तु  सादिरुक्तः कुलेश्वरि |
प्रकाशानन्दरूपत्वात्    प्रत्यक्षफलदानतः || 5 ||
text_mt: The Parāprāsāda mantra is declared to begin with 'sa', O Mistress of Kula; / because it has the form of light and bliss, because it grants direct fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
prasannacittavaśyatvāt prasiddhārthanirūpaṇāt |
prāktanāghapraśamanāt   prapannāttīvināśanāt |
prasādakaraṇācchīghraṃ      prāsādamanurīritaḥ || 6 ||
meaning:
प्रसन्नचित्तवश्यत्वात् प्रसिद्धार्थनिरूपणात् |
प्राक्तनाघप्रशमनात्   प्रपन्नात्तीविनाशनात् |
प्रसादकरणाच्छीघ्रं      प्रासादमनुरीरितः || 6 ||
text_mt: because it subjugates serene minds, because it explains well-known realities, / because it pacifies past sins, because it destroys the distress of those who take refuge, / and because it quickly produces grace, it is called the Prāsāda mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
paratattvasvarūpatvāt  paramātmaprakāśanāt |
paramānandajananāt     paradharmanidarśanāt || 7 ||
meaning:
परतत्त्वस्वरूपत्वात्  परमात्मप्रकाशनात् |
परमानन्दजननात्     परधर्मनिदर्शनात् || 7 ||
text_mt: Because it has the essential nature of the supreme reality, because it illumines the supreme Self, / because it generates supreme bliss, because it reveals the supreme dharma,

sanskrit_iast:
parokṣaphaladānācca   paramaiśvaryakāraṇāt |
paratvāt  sarvamantrāṇāṃ parāmantra itīritaḥ || 8 ||
meaning:
परोक्षफलदानाच्च   परमैश्वर्यकारणात् |
परत्वात्  सर्वमन्त्राणां परामन्त्र इतीरितः || 8 ||
text_mt: because it grants indirect fruits, because it is the cause of supreme sovereignty, / and because it is higher than all mantras, it is called the Parā mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
kulamantramidaṃ devi nyāsaṃ śṛṇu vadāmi te |
ādau  prātaḥ  samutthāya  gurudevānucintanam || 9 ||
meaning:
कुलमन्त्रमिदं देवि न्यासं शृणु वदामि ते |
आदौ  प्रातः  समुत्थाय  गुरुदेवानुचिन्तनम् || 9 ||
text_mt: This is the Kula mantra, O Goddess. Listen to its ritual projection; I will tell you. / First, having risen in the morning, one contemplates the guru and the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
kandamūle manaḥ kṛtvā  kuryādviṇmūtramocanam |
śaucāsyaśodhanaṃ  snānaṃ sandhyātarpaṇamācaret || 10 ||
meaning:
कन्दमूले मनः कृत्वा  कुर्याद्विण्मूत्रमोचनम् |
शौचास्यशोधनं  स्नानं सन्ध्यातर्पणमाचरेत् || 10 ||
text_mt: Focusing the mind on the base-bulb, one should release feces and urine. / One should perform cleansing, washing the mouth, bathing, twilight prayers, and water libations.

sanskrit_iast:
ekānte    dvārayajanaṃ   vighnatrayanivāraṇam |
pūjāsthānapraveśaśca       tathāsanopaveśanam || 11 ||
meaning:
एकान्ते    द्वारयजनं   विघ्नत्रयनिवारणम् |
पूजास्थानप्रवेशश्च       तथासनोपवेशनम् || 11 ||
text_mt: In solitude, one performs worship at the door, warding off the three obstacles, / enters the place of worship, and likewise sits upon the seat.

sanskrit_iast:
devīpūjāgṛhadhyānaṃ       śivādiguruvandanam |
āsanaṃ        gaṇapakṣetrapālavandanamīśvari || 12 ||
meaning:
देवीपूजागृहध्यानं       शिवादिगुरुवन्दनम् |
आसनं        गणपक्षेत्रपालवन्दनमीश्वरि || 12 ||
text_mt: Meditation on the Goddess's house of worship, salutation to the gurus beginning with Śiva, / [consecration of] the seat, salutation to Gaṇeśa and the guardian of the sacred field, O sovereign Lady,

sanskrit_iast:
pādukāsmaraṇañcaiva   dinanāthārcanaṃ    priye |
karāṅgaśodhanaṃ   prāṇāyāmaḥ  svabrahmarandhrake || 13 ||
meaning:
पादुकास्मरणञ्चैव   दिननाथार्चनं    प्रिये |
कराङ्गशोधनं   प्राणायामः  स्वब्रह्मरन्ध्रके || 13 ||
text_mt: remembrance of the sandals, and worship of the sun, O dear one; / purification of hands and limbs, breath control, and in one's own cranial aperture,

sanskrit_iast:
digbandhanañcāṅgayugma vidhiyuktāñca mātṛkām |
daśaprakārabhūtākhyāṃ  lipiṃ  kamaṭhasaṃjñakām || 14 ||
meaning:
दिग्बन्धनञ्चाङ्गयुग्म विधियुक्ताञ्च मातृकाम् |
दशप्रकारभूताख्यां  लिपिं  कमठसंज्ञकाम् || 14 ||
text_mt: fencing the directions, the two limbs, and the phonemic energies according to the rules, / the script named as ten kinds of elements, known as the tortoise script.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣirasya paraḥ śambhuśchandaścāvyaktapūvīkā |
gāyatrī  devatā  cātra  sarvamantreśvarī  parā || 15 ||
meaning:
ऋषिरस्य परः शम्भुश्छन्दश्चाव्यक्तपूवीका |
गायत्री  देवता  चात्र  सर्वमन्त्रेश्वरी  परा || 15 ||
text_mt: Its seer is supreme Śambhu, its metre is Avyaktā, / and the deity here is Gāyatrī, Parā, sovereign Mistress of all mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghatrayayutaṃ mūlaṃ bījaṃ  śaktiśca kīlakam  |
ṣaḍdīrghayuktamūlabījena ṣaḍaṅgāni ca pārvati || 16 ||
meaning:
दीर्घत्रययुतं मूलं बीजं  शक्तिश्च कीलकम्  |
षड्दीर्घयुक्तमूलबीजेन षडङ्गानि च पार्वति || 16 ||
text_mt: The basic seed syllable is endowed with three long vowels, the power, and the pin; / and with the basic seed syllable endowed with six long vowels, [one projects] the six limbs, O Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
īśatatpuruṣāghorasadyojātātmanastathā |
pañcāṅguliṣu vinyasya mūttīṃ vaktreṣu vinyaset || 17 ||
meaning:
ईशतत्पुरुषाघोरसद्योजातात्मनस्तथा |
पञ्चाङ्गुलिषु विन्यस्य मूत्तीं वक्त्रेषु विन्यसेत् || 17 ||
text_mt: Then, having projected the identities of Īśāna, Tatpuruṣa, Aghora, [Vāmadeva], and Sadyojāta / onto the five fingers, one should project the forms onto the faces.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcasu   brahmaṇi   tathaivāṅgavinyāsamācaret |
ādhāraśaktimārabhya    pīṭhamantrāntamambike || 18 ||
meaning:
पञ्चसु   ब्रह्मणि   तथैवाङ्गविन्यासमाचरेत् |
आधारशक्तिमारभ्य    पीठमन्त्रान्तमम्बिके || 18 ||
text_mt: In the five Brahmans, one should likewise perform the projection of limbs, / beginning with the power of the support and ending with the throne mantra, O Mother.

sanskrit_iast:
alpaṣoḍhāṃ kuleśāni kuryāt pūrvoktavartmanā |
mahāṣoḍhāhvayaṃ nyāsaṃ  tataḥ kuryāt samāhitaḥ |
vakṣyamāṇena    vidhinā   devatābhāvasiddhaye || 19 ||
meaning:
अल्पषोढां कुलेशानि कुर्यात् पूर्वोक्तवर्त्मना |
महाषोढाह्वयं न्यासं  ततः कुर्यात् समाहितः |
वक्ष्यमाणेन    विधिना   देवताभावसिद्धये || 19 ||
text_mt: One should perform the minor sixfold projection, O Mistress of Kula, according to the path declared before. / Then, with collected mind, one should perform the projection named the great sixfold projection, / according to the rule to be stated, for the attainment of the state of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya kasyāpi naivoktaṃ tava snehādvadāmyaham |
prapañco      bhuvanaṃ     mūtīrmantradevatamātaraḥ |
mahāṣoḍhāhvayo   nyāsaḥ  sarvanyāsottamottamaḥ || 20 ||
meaning:
यस्य कस्यापि नैवोक्तं तव स्नेहाद्वदाम्यहम् |
प्रपञ्चो      भुवनं     मूतीर्मन्त्रदेवतमातरः |
महाषोढाह्वयो   न्यासः  सर्वन्यासोत्तमोत्तमः || 20 ||
text_mt: It has not been spoken to just anyone; out of love for you I declare it: / the cosmos, the world, the form, the mantra, the deities, and the mothers— / the projection named the great sixfold projection is the highest of all ritual projections.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrādau   parameśāni   prapañcanyāsa   ucyate |
prapañcadvīpajaladhigiripattanapīṭhakāḥ || 21 ||
meaning:
तत्रादौ   परमेशानि   प्रपञ्चन्यास   उच्यते |
प्रपञ्चद्वीपजलधिगिरिपत्तनपीठकाः || 21 ||
text_mt: Therein, first, O Supreme Lady, the projection of the cosmos is declared: / the cosmos, continents, oceans, mountains, cities, seats,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetraṃ vanāśramaguhānadīcatvarakodbhidaḥ |
svedāṇḍajajarāyujā ityuktāste hi  ṣoḍaśa || 22 ||
meaning:
क्षेत्रं वनाश्रमगुहानदीचत्वरकोद्भिदः |
स्वेदाण्डजजरायुजा इत्युक्तास्ते हि  षोडश || 22 ||
