text_mt: A hymn is equal to ten million acts of worship; recitation is equal to ten million hymns; / meditation is equal to ten million recitations; dissolution is equal to ten million meditations.

sanskrit_iast:
na hi dhyānāt paro mantro na devastvātmanaḥ paraḥ |
nānusandhāt parā pūjā na  hi tṛpteḥ paraṃ phalam || 37 ||
meaning:
न हि ध्यानात् परो मन्त्रो न देवस्त्वात्मनः परः |
नानुसन्धात् परा पूजा न  हि तृप्तेः परं फलम् || 37 ||
text_mt: There is no mantra higher than meditation; there is no deity higher than the self; / there is no worship higher than continuous contemplation; there is no fruit higher than contentment.

sanskrit_iast:
akriyaiva parā  pūjā  maunameva  paro  japaḥ |
acinteva  paraṃ  dhyānamanicchaiva  paraṃ phalam || 38 ||
meaning:
अक्रियैव परा  पूजा  मौनमेव  परो  जपः |
अचिन्तेव  परं  ध्यानमनिच्छैव  परं फलम् || 38 ||
text_mt: Actionlessness itself is the highest worship; silence alone is the highest recitation; / non-thought alone is the highest meditation; desirelessness alone is the highest fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrodakaivīnā sandhyāṃ  pūjāhomaivīnā  tapaḥ |
upacāraivīnā  pūjāṃ  yogī nityaṃ samācaret || 39 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रोदकैवीना सन्ध्यां  पूजाहोमैवीना  तपः |
उपचारैवीना  पूजां  योगी नित्यं समाचरेत् || 39 ||
text_mt: A yogin should constantly perform the twilight rite without mantra and water, / asceticism without ritual worship and fire oblation, and worship without external implements.

sanskrit_iast:
niḥsaṅgaśca  visaṅgaśca  nistīrṇopādhivāsanaḥ |
nijasvarūpanirmagnaḥ  sa  yogī paratattvavit || 40 ||
meaning:
निःसङ्गश्च  विसङ्गश्च  निस्तीर्णोपाधिवासनः |
निजस्वरूपनिर्मग्नः  स  योगी परतत्त्ववित् || 40 ||
text_mt: Free from attachment, disconnected, having crossed over the latent impressions of limiting adjuncts, / immersed in his own essential nature, that yogin is a knower of the supreme reality.

sanskrit_iast:
deho devālayo  devi  jīvo devaḥ sadāśivaḥ |
tyajedajñānanirmālyaṃ   so'hambhāvena   pūjayet || 41 ||
meaning:
देहो देवालयो  देवि  जीवो देवः सदाशिवः |
त्यजेदज्ञाननिर्माल्यं   सोऽहम्भावेन   पूजयेत् || 41 ||
text_mt: The body is the temple, O Goddess; the individual soul is the god Sadāśiva; / one should cast away the residual offering of ignorance and worship with the feeling of 'I am He.'

sanskrit_iast:
jīvaḥ śivaḥ śivo jīvaḥ sa jīvaḥ kevalaḥ śivaḥ |
pāśabaddhaḥ  smṛto  jīvaḥ pāśamuktaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
जीवः शिवः शिवो जीवः स जीवः केवलः शिवः |
पाशबद्धः  स्मृतो  जीवः पाशमुक्तः सदाशिवः || 42 ||
text_mt: The individual soul is Śiva, Śiva is the individual soul; that individual soul is solely Śiva. / Bound by the snare, he is designated as an individual soul; freed from the snare, he is Sadāśiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣeṇa  baddho  vrīhiḥ syāttuṣābhāve  hi  taṇḍulaḥ |
karmabaddhaḥ  smṛto  jīvaḥ  karmamuktaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
तुषेण  बद्धो  व्रीहिः स्यात्तुषाभावे  हि  तण्डुलः |
कर्मबद्धः  स्मृतो  जीवः  कर्ममुक्तः सदाशिवः || 43 ||
text_mt: Enclosed in the husk it is unhusked rice; in the absence of the husk it is indeed clean rice grain. / Bound by karma he is designated as an individual soul; freed from karma he is Sadāśiva.

sanskrit_iast:
agnī tiṣṭhati viprāṇāṃ hṛdi devo manīṣiṇām |
pratimāsvaprabuddhānāṃ   sarvatra  viditātmanām || 44 ||
meaning:
अग्नी तिष्ठति विप्राणां हृदि देवो मनीषिणाम् |
प्रतिमास्वप्रबुद्धानां   सर्वत्र  विदितात्मनाम् || 44 ||
text_mt: The god of the Brahmins resides in the sacred fire; of the wise, in the heart; / of the unawakened, in images; of those who have known the self, everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
yo   nindāstutiśītoṣṇasukhaduḥkhāribandhuṣu |
sama  āste  sa yogīndro harṣāharṣavivajītaḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
यो   निन्दास्तुतिशीतोष्णसुखदुःखारिबन्धुषु |
सम  आस्ते  स योगीन्द्रो हर्षाहर्षविवजीतः || 45 ||
text_mt: He who remains equanimous in blame and praise, cold and heat, pleasure and pain, enemies and kin, / devoid of joy and sorrow, is a lord of yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
nispṛho  nityasantuṣṭaḥ samadarśī  jitendriyaḥ |
āste   dehe  pravāsīva  yogī  paramatattvavit || 46 ||
meaning:
निस्पृहो  नित्यसन्तुष्टः समदर्शी  जितेन्द्रियः |
आस्ते   देहे  प्रवासीव  योगी  परमतत्त्ववित् || 46 ||
text_mt: Free from longing, always contented, seeing all equally, his senses conquered, / the yogin who knows the supreme reality abides in the body like a traveler.

sanskrit_iast:
niḥsaṅkalpo nivīkalpo nilīptopādhivāsanaḥ |
nijasvarūpanirmagnaḥ sa  yogī  paratattvavit || 47 ||
meaning:
निःसङ्कल्पो निवीकल्पो निलीप्तोपाधिवासनः |
निजस्वरूपनिर्मग्नः स  योगी  परतत्त्ववित् || 47 ||
text_mt: Free from intentional thought, free from conceptualization, unstained by the latent impressions of limiting adjuncts, / immersed in his own essential nature, that yogin is a knower of the supreme reality.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā   paṅgvandhabadhiraklībonmattajaḍādayaḥ	 |
nivasanti kuleśāni tathā yogī ca tattvavit	 || 48 ||
meaning:
यथा   पङ्ग्वन्धबधिरक्लीबोन्मत्तजडादयः	 |
निवसन्ति कुलेशानि तथा योगी च तत्त्ववित्	 || 48 ||
text_mt: Just as the lame, the blind, the deaf, the eunuch, the madman, the dull, and the like / dwell [in the world], O Mistress of Kula, so too lives the yogin who knows reality.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamudrāsamutpannaparamānandanirbharaḥ |
ya āste sa tu yogīndraḥ paśyatyātmānamātmani || 49 ||
meaning:
पञ्चमुद्रासमुत्पन्नपरमानन्दनिर्भरः |
य आस्ते स तु योगीन्द्रः पश्यत्यात्मानमात्मनि || 49 ||
text_mt: Filled with supreme bliss arising from the five mudrās, / he who thus abides is a lord of yogins; he sees the self in the self.

sanskrit_iast:
alimāṃsāṅganāsaṅge  yat  sukhaṃ  jāyate  priye |
tadeva  mokṣo  viduṣāmabudhānāntu   pātakam || 50 ||
meaning:
अलिमांसाङ्गनासङ्गे  यत्  सुखं  जायते  प्रिये |
तदेव  मोक्षो  विदुषामबुधानान्तु   पातकम् || 50 ||
text_mt: Whatever pleasure arises in union with wine, meat, and a woman, O beloved, / that alone is liberation for the wise, but a sin for the ignorant.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā māṃsāsavollāsī sadā caraṇacintakaḥ |
sadāsaṃśayahīno  yaḥ  kulayogī  sa ucyate || 51 ||
meaning:
सदा मांसासवोल्लासी सदा चरणचिन्तकः |
सदासंशयहीनो  यः  कुलयोगी  स उच्यते || 51 ||
text_mt: Ever delighting in meat and fermented liquor, ever meditating upon the [guru's] feet, / ever free from doubt—he is called a Kula yogin.

sanskrit_iast:
pibanmadyaṃ palaṃ khādan  svecchācāraparāyaṇaḥ |
ahaṃ  tadanayoraikyaṃ  bhāvayannivaset  sukhī || 52 ||
meaning:
पिबन्मद्यं पलं खादन्  स्वेच्छाचारपरायणः |
अहं  तदनयोरैक्यं  भावयन्निवसेत्  सुखी || 52 ||
text_mt: Drinking liquor, eating meat, devoted to spontaneous conduct, / meditating upon the oneness of 'I' and 'That,' he should dwell in happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
āmiṣāsavasaurabhyahīnaṃ  yasya   mukhaṃ  bhavet |
prāyaścittī  sa  varjyaśca  paśureva  na  saṃśayaḥ || 53 ||
meaning:
आमिषासवसौरभ्यहीनं  यस्य   मुखं  भवेत् |
प्रायश्चित्ती  स  वर्ज्यश्च  पशुरेव  न  संशयः || 53 ||
text_mt: He whose mouth is devoid of the fragrance of meat and fermented liquor / must perform expiation and is to be shunned; he is nothing but an uninitiated bound soul, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadāsavagandhaḥ syāt paśuḥ paśupatiḥ svayam |
vinālimāṃsagandhena  sākṣāt  paśupatiḥ paśuḥ || 54 ||
meaning:
यावदासवगन्धः स्यात् पशुः पशुपतिः स्वयम् |
विनालिमांसगन्धेन  साक्षात्  पशुपतिः पशुः || 54 ||
text_mt: As long as there is the scent of fermented liquor, an uninitiated bound soul is himself the Lord of Bound Souls; / without the scent of wine and meat, the Lord of Bound Souls directly becomes an uninitiated bound soul.

sanskrit_iast:
loke nikṛṣṭamutkṛṣṭaṃ lokotkṛṣṭaṃ nikṛṣṭakam |
kulamārga   samuddiṣṭaṃ   bhairaveṇa    mahātmanā || 55 ||
meaning:
लोके निकृष्टमुत्कृष्टं लोकोत्कृष्टं निकृष्टकम् |
कुलमार्ग   समुद्दिष्टं   भैरवेण    महात्मना || 55 ||
text_mt: What is base in the world is exalted; what is exalted in the world is base: / thus the Kula path has been taught by the great-souled Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
anācāraḥ   sadācārastvakārya   kāryamuttamam |
asatyamapi satyaṃ syāt kaulikānāṃ kuleśvari || 56 ||
meaning:
अनाचारः   सदाचारस्त्वकार्य   कार्यमुत्तमम् |
असत्यमपि सत्यं स्यात् कौलिकानां कुलेश्वरि || 56 ||
text_mt: Non-conduct is righteous conduct, and what ought not to be done is the highest duty; / even untruth becomes truth for the Kaulikas, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
apeyamapi    peyaṃ  syādabhakṣyaṃ  bhakṣyameva   ca |
agamyamapi gamyaṃ syāt kaulikānāṃ kuleśvari || 57 ||
meaning:
अपेयमपि    पेयं  स्यादभक्ष्यं  भक्ष्यमेव   च |
अगम्यमपि गम्यं स्यात् कौलिकानां कुलेश्वरि || 57 ||
text_mt: Even what cannot be drunk is drinkable; what is inedible is truly edible; / even what is not to be approached is approachable for the Kaulikas, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
na vidhirna niṣedhaḥ syānna puṇyaṃ na ca pātakam |
na svargo naiva narakaṃ kaulikānāṃ kuleśvari || 58 ||
meaning:
न विधिर्न निषेधः स्यान्न पुण्यं न च पातकम् |
न स्वर्गो नैव नरकं कौलिकानां कुलेश्वरि || 58 ||
text_mt: There is no injunction and no prohibition; there is neither merit nor sin; / there is neither heaven nor hell for the Kaulikas, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
anabhijñā  abhijñanti  daridrā  dhanayanti  ca |
vinaṣṭā api varddhante kaulikāḥ kulanāyike || 59 ||
meaning:
अनभिज्ञा  अभिज्ञन्ति  दरिद्रा  धनयन्ति  च |
विनष्टा अपि वर्द्धन्ते कौलिकाः कुलनायिके || 59 ||
text_mt: The ignorant become knowledgeable, and the poor become wealthy; / even when ruined, the Kaulikas prosper, O Queen of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
ripavaścāpi  mitranti  sākṣāddāsanti  bhūmipāḥ |
bāndhavanti janāḥ sarve kaulikānāṃ kuleśvari || 60 ||
meaning:
रिपवश्चापि  मित्रन्ति  साक्षाद्दासन्ति  भूमिपाः |
बान्धवन्ति जनाः सर्वे कौलिकानां कुलेश्वरि || 60 ||
text_mt: Even enemies act as friends, kings act as direct servants, / and all people act as relatives for the Kaulikas, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
vimukhāḥ sumukhāḥ sarve  gavītāḥ praṇayanti  ca |
bādhakāḥ sādhakāyante kaulikānāṃ kuleśvari || 61 ||
meaning:
विमुखाः सुमुखाः सर्वे  गवीताः प्रणयन्ति  च |
बाधकाः साधकायन्ते कौलिकानां कुलेश्वरि || 61 ||
text_mt: All who are adverse become favorable, and the proud bow down; / adversaries act as practitioners for Kaulikas, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
nirguṇāḥ  saguṇāyante   akulaṃ  sukulāyate |
adharmāścāpi dharmanti  kaulikānāṃ  kuleśvari || 62 ||
meaning:
निर्गुणाः  सगुणायन्ते   अकुलं  सुकुलायते |
अधर्माश्चापि धर्मन्ति  कौलिकानां  कुलेश्वरि || 62 ||
text_mt: Those without virtues act as if possessed of virtues, that which lacks Kula acts as of good family, / and non-dharmas act as dharma for Kaulikas, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtyurvaidyāyate devi  sākṣāt  svargāyate  gṛham |
puṇyāyante'ṅganāsaṅgāḥ kaulikānāṃ kuleśvari || 63 ||
meaning:
मृत्युर्वैद्यायते देवि  साक्षात्  स्वर्गायते  गृहम् |
पुण्यायन्तेऽङ्गनासङ्गाः कौलिकानां कुलेश्वरि || 63 ||
text_mt: Death acts as a physician, O Goddess, the home acts directly as heaven, / and association with women acts as merit for Kaulikas, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
bahunātra   kimuktena  kulayogīśvarāḥ  priye |
sadā saṅkalpasiddhāḥ syurnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 64 ||
meaning:
बहुनात्र   किमुक्तेन  कुलयोगीश्वराः  प्रिये |
सदा सङ्कल्पसिद्धाः स्युर्नात्र कार्या विचारणा || 64 ||
text_mt: What need is there to say much here, O dear one? / Lords of Kula yogins are always accomplished in their will; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
yena  kenāpi  veśena  yena  kenāpyalakṣitaḥ |
yatra kutrāśrame  tiṣṭhet kulayogī kuleśvari || 65 ||
meaning:
येन  केनापि  वेशेन  येन  केनाप्यलक्षितः |
यत्र कुत्राश्रमे  तिष्ठेत् कुलयोगी कुलेश्वरि || 65 ||
text_mt: In whatever dress, unnoticed by anyone, / in whatever stage of life a Kula yogin may dwell, O Mistress of Kula,

sanskrit_iast:
yogino  vividhairveśairnarāṇāṃ   hitakāriṇaḥ |
bhramanti     pṛthivīmetāmavijñātasvarūpiṇaḥ || 66 ||
meaning:
योगिनो  विविधैर्वेशैर्नराणां   हितकारिणः |
भ्रमन्ति     पृथिवीमेतामविज्ञातस्वरूपिणः || 66 ||
text_mt: yogins, bringing benefit to human beings in various garbs, / wander this earth with their true nature unknown.

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛnnaivātmavijñānaṃ kṣapayanti kuleśvari |
unmattamūkajaḍavannivasellokamadhyataḥ || 67 ||
meaning:
सकृन्नैवात्मविज्ञानं क्षपयन्ति कुलेश्वरि |
उन्मत्तमूकजडवन्निवसेल्लोकमध्यतः || 67 ||
text_mt: They never squander their knowledge of the Self, O Mistress of Kula; / [such a one] should dwell among people like a madman, a mute, or an idiot.

sanskrit_iast:
alakṣyo hi yathā loke vyomni candrārkayogataḥ |
nakṣatrāṇāṃ  grahāṇāñca  tathā vṛttantu  yoginām || 68 ||
meaning:
अलक्ष्यो हि यथा लोके व्योम्नि चन्द्रार्कयोगतः |
नक्षत्राणां  ग्रहाणाञ्च  तथा वृत्तन्तु  योगिनाम् || 68 ||
text_mt: Just as the movement of the asterisms and planets in the sky is invisible in the world / because of the union of the moon and the sun, so is the conduct of yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśe pakṣiṇāṃ devi jale'pi jalacāriṇām	 |
yathā  gatirna  dṛśyeta  tathā  vṛttaṃ  hi  yoginām || 69 ||
meaning:
आकाशे पक्षिणां देवि जलेऽपि जलचारिणाम्	 |
यथा  गतिर्न  दृश्येत  तथा  वृत्तं  हि  योगिनाम् || 69 ||
text_mt: Just as the path of birds in the sky, O Goddess, or of aquatic creatures in water / cannot be seen, so indeed is the conduct of yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
asanta iva bhāṣante  carantyajñā  iva  priye |
pāmarā iva dṛśyante kulayoga  viśāradāḥ || 70 ||
meaning:
असन्त इव भाषन्ते  चरन्त्यज्ञा  इव  प्रिये |
पामरा इव दृश्यन्ते कुलयोग  विशारदाः || 70 ||
text_mt: They speak like wicked people, they move about like fools, O dear one, / they appear like outcasts—those who are skilled in Kula yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
janā   yathāvamanyante   gaccheyurnaiva  saṅgatim |
na kiñcidapi bhāṣante tathā  yogī pravarttate || 71 ||
meaning:
जना   यथावमन्यन्ते   गच्छेयुर्नैव  सङ्गतिम् |
न किञ्चिदपि भाषन्ते तथा  योगी प्रवर्त्तते || 71 ||
text_mt: In such a way that people despise [him] and would not associate with [him] at all, / and they say nothing to him, so does the yogin conduct himself.

sanskrit_iast:
mukto'pi bālavat krīḍet kuleśo jaḍavaccaret |
vadedunmattavadvidvān   kulayogī  maheśvari || 72 ||
meaning:
मुक्तोऽपि बालवत् क्रीडेत् कुलेशो जडवच्चरेत् |
वदेदुन्मत्तवद्विद्वान्   कुलयोगी  महेश्वरि || 72 ||
text_mt: Though liberated, he should play like a child; the lord of Kula should behave like an idiot; / the wise Kula yogin should speak like a madman, O Great Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā hasati loko'yaṃ jugupsati ca kutsati |
vilokya dūrato yāti tathā yogī pravarttate || 73 ||
meaning:
यथा हसति लोकोऽयं जुगुप्सति च कुत्सति |
विलोक्य दूरतो याति तथा योगी प्रवर्त्तते || 73 ||
text_mt: In such a way that this world laughs, sneers, and reviles, / and seeing [him], turns away from afar, so does the yogin conduct himself.

sanskrit_iast:
kvacicchiṣṭaḥ kvacidbhraṣṭaḥ kvacid bhūtapiśācavat |
nānāveśadharo        yogī       vicarejjagatītale || 74 ||
meaning:
क्वचिच्छिष्टः क्वचिद्भ्रष्टः क्वचिद् भूतपिशाचवत् |
नानावेशधरो        योगी       विचरेज्जगतीतले || 74 ||
text_mt: Sometimes disciplined, sometimes fallen, sometimes like a ghost or a piśāca, / adopting various garbs, the yogin should wander on the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
yogī  lokopakārāya bhogān bhuṅkte  na kāṃṅkṣayā |
anugṛhṇan   janān  sarvān  krīḍecca  pṛthivītale || 75 ||
meaning:
योगी  लोकोपकाराय भोगान् भुङ्क्ते  न कांङ्क्षया |
अनुगृह्णन्   जनान्  सर्वान्  क्रीडेच्च  पृथिवीतले || 75 ||
text_mt: The yogin enjoys pleasures for the welfare of the world, not out of desire; / bestowing grace on all people, he should play on the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśoṣī  yathā  sūryaḥ  savabhogī   yathā'nalaḥ |
yogī bhuktvākhilān bhogān tathā pāpairna lipyate || 76 ||
meaning:
सर्वशोषी  यथा  सूर्यः  सवभोगी   यथाऽनलः |
योगी भुक्त्वाखिलान् भोगान् तथा पापैर्न लिप्यते || 76 ||
text_mt: Just as the sun dries up everything, just as fire consumes everything, / so the yogin, having enjoyed all pleasures, is not tainted by demerits.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasparśī  yathā  vāyuryathākāśaśca  sarvagaḥ |
sarve yathā nadīsnātāstathā yogī sadā śuciḥ || 77 ||
meaning:
सर्वस्पर्शी  यथा  वायुर्यथाकाशश्च  सर्वगः |
सर्वे यथा नदीस्नातास्तथा योगी सदा शुचिः || 77 ||
text_mt: Just as the wind touches everything, just as space is all-pervading, / and just as all are [cleansed] who have bathed in a river, so the yogin is always pure.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā  grāmagataṃ  toyaṃ  nadīyuktaṃ  bhavecchuci |
tathā  mlecchagṛhānnādi  yogihastāpītaṃ śuci || 78 ||
meaning:
यथा  ग्रामगतं  तोयं  नदीयुक्तं  भवेच्छुचि |
तथा  म्लेच्छगृहान्नादि  योगिहस्तापीतं शुचि || 78 ||
text_mt: Just as water flowing through a village becomes pure when joined with a river, / so food and the like from a barbarian's house, when received by the hands of a yogin, is pure.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā''caranti  deveśi  kulajñānaviśāradāḥ |
tadeva viduṣāṃ mānyamātmano hitakāṅkṣiṇām || 79 ||
meaning:
यथा'ऽचरन्ति  देवेशि  कुलज्ञानविशारदाः |
तदेव विदुषां मान्यमात्मनो हितकाङ्क्षिणाम् || 79 ||
text_mt: As those skilled in Kula knowledge conduct themselves, O Ruler of the Gods, / that alone is to be respected by the wise who desire their own welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmiṃścaranti yogīśāḥ sā mārgaḥ paramo mataḥ |
yasyāmudeti sūryo  hi  pūrvāśā  sā nigadyate || 80 ||
meaning:
यस्मिंश्चरन्ति योगीशाः सा मार्गः परमो मतः |
यस्यामुदेति सूर्यो  हि  पूर्वाशा  सा निगद्यते || 80 ||
text_mt: The path on which the lords of yogins walk is considered the supreme path; / for that direction in which the sun rises is called the east.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra yatra gajo  yāti tatra mārgo yathā bhavet |
kulayogī vared yatra sa sa mārgaḥ kuleśvari || 81 ||
meaning:
यत्र यत्र गजो  याति तत्र मार्गो यथा भवेत् |
कुलयोगी वरेद् यत्र स स मार्गः कुलेश्वरि || 81 ||
text_mt: Wherever an elephant goes, a path is made there; / wherever the Kula yogin chooses to go, that indeed is the path, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
nadīṃ vakrāmṛjuṃ  karttuṃ  niroddhuṃ  tatpravāhakam |
svecchāvihāriṇaṃ śāntaṃ ko vā vārayituṃ kṣamaḥ || 82 ||
meaning:
नदीं वक्रामृजुं  कर्त्तुं  निरोद्धुं  तत्प्रवाहकम् |
स्वेच्छाविहारिणं शान्तं को वा वारयितुं क्षमः || 82 ||
text_mt: Who indeed is capable of making a crooked river straight, of halting its current, / or of checking [that yogin], peaceful and wandering at his own will?

sanskrit_iast:
yadvanmantrabalopetaḥ    krīḍanīyairna    dṛśyate |
tadvanna  dṛśyate  jñānī   krīḍannindriyapannagaiḥ || 83 ||
meaning:
यद्वन्मन्त्रबलोपेतः    क्रीडनीयैर्न    दृश्यते |
तद्वन्न  दृश्यते  ज्ञानी   क्रीडन्निन्द्रियपन्नगैः || 83 ||
text_mt: Just as one endowed with the power of mantras is not bitten by his playthings, / so the knower is not bitten while playing with the serpents of the senses.

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttaduḥkhasantuṣṭā   nirdvandvā   gatamatsarāḥ |
kulajñānaratāḥ śāntāstvadbhaktāste ca kaulikāḥ || 84 ||
meaning:
निवृत्तदुःखसन्तुष्टा   निर्द्वन्द्वा   गतमत्सराः |
कुलज्ञानरताः शान्तास्त्वद्भक्तास्ते च कौलिकाः || 84 ||
text_mt: Those whose suffering has ceased and who are contented, free from duality and devoid of envy, / devoted to Kula knowledge, peaceful, and devoted to you—they are Kaulikas.

sanskrit_iast:
amadakrodhadambhāśāhaṅkārāḥ    satyavādinaḥ |
kaulikendrā  hyacapalā ye nendriyavaśānugāḥ || 85 ||
meaning:
अमदक्रोधदम्भाशाहङ्काराः    सत्यवादिनः |
कौलिकेन्द्रा  ह्यचपला ये नेन्द्रियवशानुगाः || 85 ||
text_mt: Free from intoxication, anger, deceit, desire, and egoism, speakers of truth, / steadfast, and not subject to the senses are the foremost Kaulikas.

sanskrit_iast:
kīrttyamāne kule yeṣāṃ romāñco gadgadasvaraḥ |
ānandāśru pateddevi kathitāḥ kaulikottamāḥ || 86 ||
meaning:
कीर्त्त्यमाने कुले येषां रोमाञ्चो गद्गदस्वरः |
आनन्दाश्रु पतेद्देवि कथिताः कौलिकोत्तमाः || 86 ||
text_mt: Those whose hair bristles, whose voice chokes, / and from whose eyes tears of bliss fall when Kula is praised, O Goddess, are called the best of Kaulikas.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadharmādhiko  loke  kuladharmaḥ  śivoditaḥ |
iti te niścitadhiyaḥ proktāste kaulikottamāḥ || 87 ||
meaning:
सर्वधर्माधिको  लोके  कुलधर्मः  शिवोदितः |
इति ते निश्चितधियः प्रोक्तास्ते कौलिकोत्तमाः || 87 ||
text_mt: Those whose intellect is certain that 'the duty of Kula taught by Śiva / is superior to all duties in the world' are declared to be the best of Kaulikas.

sanskrit_iast:
yo bhavet kulatattvajñaḥ kulaśāstraviśāradaḥ |
kulārcanarataḥ sa syāt kauliko nāparaḥ priye || 88 ||
meaning:
यो भवेत् कुलतत्त्वज्ञः कुलशास्त्रविशारदः |
कुलार्चनरतः स स्यात् कौलिको नापरः प्रिये || 88 ||
text_mt: He who knows the reality of Kula, is skilled in the Kula scriptures, / and is devoted to worship according to Kula—he would be a Kaulika, not anyone else, O dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
kulabhaktān  kulajñānān  kulācārakulavratān |
prīto bhavati yo dṛṣṭvā kaulikaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ || 89 ||
meaning:
कुलभक्तान्  कुलज्ञानान्  कुलाचारकुलव्रतान् |
प्रीतो भवति यो दृष्ट्वा कौलिकः स च मे प्रियः || 89 ||
text_mt: He who is pleased upon seeing devotees of Kula, those who possess Kula knowledge, / and those who observe the conduct of Kula and the vows of Kula—he is a Kaulika and dear to me.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvatrayaśrīcaraṇamūlamantrārthatattvavit |
devatāgurubhaktāśca kaulikaḥ syācca dīkṣayā || 90 ||
meaning:
तत्त्वत्रयश्रीचरणमूलमन्त्रार्थतत्त्ववित् |
देवतागुरुभक्ताश्च कौलिकः स्याच्च दीक्षया || 90 ||
text_mt: He who knows the reality of the triad of realities, the venerable feet, and the meaning of the root mantra, / and is devoted to the deity and the guru, becomes a Kaulika through initiation.

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhaṃ   sarvalokeṣu   kulācāryasya   darśanam |
supākenaiva  puṇyānāṃ  labhyate  nānyathā  priye || 91 ||
meaning:
दुर्लभं   सर्वलोकेषु   कुलाचार्यस्य   दर्शनम् |
सुपाकेनैव  पुण्यानां  लभ्यते  नान्यथा  प्रिये || 91 ||
text_mt: The sight of a Kula master is difficult to attain in all the worlds; / it is obtained only through the full maturation of merits, not otherwise, O dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsmṛtaḥ kīttīto dṛṣṭo vandino bhāṣito'pi vā |
punāti    kuladhamīṣṭhaścāṇḍālo'pi  yadṛcchayā || 92 ||
meaning:
संस्मृतः कीत्तीतो दृष्टो वन्दिनो भाषितोऽपि वा |
पुनाति    कुलधमीष्ठश्चाण्डालोऽपि  यदृच्छया || 92 ||
text_mt: Remembered, praised, seen, saluted, or even spoken to, / one firmly established in the duty of Kula purifies spontaneously even if he is an outcaste.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajño vāpi mūrkho vāpyuttamo vā'dhamo'pi vā |
yatra  devi  kulajñānī  tatrāhañca   tvayā  saha || 93 ||
meaning:
सर्वज्ञो वापि मूर्खो वाप्युत्तमो वाऽधमोऽपि वा |
यत्र  देवि  कुलज्ञानी  तत्राहञ्च   त्वया  सह || 93 ||
text_mt: Whether all-knowing or a fool, whether highest or lowest, / wherever there is a knower of Kula, O Goddess, there am I together with you.

sanskrit_iast:
nāhaṃ vasāmi  kailāse na  merau  na ca mandire |
kulajñā yatra tiṣṭhanti tatra tiṣṭhāmi bhāmini || 94 ||
meaning:
नाहं वसामि  कैलासे न  मेरौ  न च मन्दिरे |
कुलज्ञा यत्र तिष्ठन्ति तत्र तिष्ठामि भामिनि || 94 ||
text_mt: I do not dwell on Kailāsa, nor on Mount Meru, nor in a temple; / wherever the knowers of Kula abide, there I abide, O passionate lady.

sanskrit_iast:
sudūramapi  gantavyaṃ   yatra  māheśvaro  janaḥ |
draṣṭavyañca  prayatnena  tatra  sannihito  hyaham || 95 ||
meaning:
सुदूरमपि  गन्तव्यं   यत्र  माहेश्वरो  जनः |
द्रष्टव्यञ्च  प्रयत्नेन  तत्र  सन्निहितो  ह्यहम् || 95 ||
text_mt: One should go even very far to where a person devoted to Maheśvara is, / and see [him] with effort, for I am present right there.

sanskrit_iast:
atidūrasthito  vāpi  draṣṭavyaḥ kuladeśikaḥ |
samīpe  varttamāno'pi na  draṣṭavyaḥ paśuḥ priye || 96 ||
meaning:
अतिदूरस्थितो  वापि  द्रष्टव्यः कुलदेशिकः |
समीपे  वर्त्तमानोऽपि न  द्रष्टव्यः पशुः प्रिये || 96 ||
text_mt: A Kula guru is to be seen even if dwelling extremely far away; / an uninitiated bound soul is not to be seen, O dear one, even if present nearby.

sanskrit_iast:
kulajñānī vased yatra sa deśaḥ puṇyabhāk tataḥ |
darśanādarcanāttasya          trisaptakulamuddharet || 97 ||
meaning:
कुलज्ञानी वसेद् यत्र स देशः पुण्यभाक् ततः |
दर्शनादर्चनात्तस्य          त्रिसप्तकुलमुद्धरेत् || 97 ||
text_mt: The country where a knower of Kula lives is endowed with merit; / from seeing and honoring him, one delivers twenty-one generations of one's family.

sanskrit_iast:
kulajñāninamālokya svasantānagṛhe sthitam |
śaṃsanti pitarastasya yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim || 98 ||
meaning:
कुलज्ञानिनमालोक्य स्वसन्तानगृहे स्थितम् |
शंसन्ति पितरस्तस्य यास्यामः परमां गतिम् || 98 ||
text_mt: Beholding the knower of Kula residing in the house of his own lineage, / his ancestors praise [him, saying]: 'We shall attain the supreme state.'

sanskrit_iast:
samāśvasanti  pitaraḥ suvṛṣṭimiva karṣakāḥ |
yo'smatkuleṣu putro vā pautro vā kauliko bhavet || 99 ||
meaning:
समाश्वसन्ति  पितरः सुवृष्टिमिव कर्षकाः |
योऽस्मत्कुलेषु पुत्रो वा पौत्रो वा कौलिको भवेत् || 99 ||
text_mt: The ancestors take comfort, as farmers do at good rain, [thinking]: / 'Whoever among our families becomes a Kaulika, whether a son or a grandson,'

sanskrit_iast:
sa dhanyaḥ khalu loke'smin puruṣaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ |
yatsamīpaṃ samāyānti kulācāryā mudā priye || 100 ||
meaning:
स धन्यः खलु लोकेऽस्मिन् पुरुषः क्षीणकल्मषः |
यत्समीपं समायान्ति कुलाचार्या मुदा प्रिये || 100 ||
text_mt: that man indeed is blessed in this world, his sins destroyed, / to whose presence Kula masters arrive with joy, O dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
kaulikendre samāyāte  kaulikāvasathaṃ  prati |
samāyānti mudā devi yoginyo yogibhiḥ saha || 101 ||
meaning:
कौलिकेन्द्रे समायाते  कौलिकावसथं  प्रति |
समायान्ति मुदा देवि योगिन्यो योगिभिः सह || 101 ||
text_mt: When a lord of Kaulikas has arrived at the dwelling of a Kaulika, / the yoginīs come with joy along with the yogins, O Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
praviśya  kulayogīndraṃ  bhaṇante   pitṛdevatāḥ |
tasmāt sampūjayedbhaktyā kulajñānaparāyaṇān || 102 ||
meaning:
प्रविश्य  कुलयोगीन्द्रं  भणन्ते   पितृदेवताः |
तस्मात् सम्पूजयेद्भक्त्या कुलज्ञानपरायणान् || 102 ||
text_mt: Entering the supreme Kula yogin, the ancestral deities speak; / therefore, one should worship with devotion those who are devoted to Kula knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyarcayitvā tvāṃ devi tvadbhaktānnārcayanti ye |
pāpiṣṭhāstvatprasādasya  bhājanaṃ na bhavanti  te || 103 ||
meaning:
अभ्यर्चयित्वा त्वां देवि त्वद्भक्तान्नार्चयन्ति ये |
पापिष्ठास्त्वत्प्रसादस्य  भाजनं न भवन्ति  ते || 103 ||
text_mt: Those who, having worshipped you, O Goddess, do not worship your devotees, / are the most sinful; they do not become vessels of your grace.

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyaṃ purato nyastaṃ darśanāt svīkṛtaṃ tvayā |
rasān bhaktasya jihvāgrādaśnāmi kamalekṣaṇe || 104 ||
meaning:
नैवेद्यं पुरतो न्यस्तं दर्शनात् स्वीकृतं त्वया |
रसान् भक्तस्य जिह्वाग्रादश्नामि कमलेक्षणे || 104 ||
text_mt: The food offering placed before [You] was accepted by You through [Your] gaze; / I taste the flavors from the tip of the devotee's tongue, O lotus-eyed Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
tvadbhaktapūjanāddevi   pūjito'haṃ   na  saṃśayaḥ |
tasmānmama priyākāṅkṣī tvadbhaktāneva pūjayet || 105 ||
meaning:
त्वद्भक्तपूजनाद्देवि   पूजितोऽहं   न  संशयः |
तस्मान्मम प्रियाकाङ्क्षी त्वद्भक्तानेव पूजयेत् || 105 ||
text_mt: By worshipping Your devotee, O Goddess, I am worshipped without a doubt; / therefore, one who desires My favor must worship only Your devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
yat  kṛtaṃ   kulaniṣṭhānāṃ  taddevānāṃ  kṛtaṃ  bhavet |
surāḥ kulapriyāḥ sarve tasmāt kaulikamarcayet || 106 ||
meaning:
यत्  कृतं   कुलनिष्ठानां  तद्देवानां  कृतं  भवेत् |
सुराः कुलप्रियाः सर्वे तस्मात् कौलिकमर्चयेत् || 106 ||
text_mt: Whatever is done for those steadfast in Kula is done for the gods; / all gods love Kula, therefore one should worship a Kaulika.

sanskrit_iast:
na  tuṣyāmyahamanyatra   tathā  bhaktyā  supūjitaḥ |
kaulikendre'cīte samyak yathā tuṣyāmi pārvati || 107 ||
meaning:
न  तुष्याम्यहमन्यत्र   तथा  भक्त्या  सुपूजितः |
कौलिकेन्द्रेऽचीते सम्यक् यथा तुष्यामि पार्वति || 107 ||
text_mt: I am not so pleased elsewhere, [even] well worshipped with devotion, / as I am pleased, O Pārvatī, when an eminent Kaulika is properly worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
yat phalaṃ  kaulikendrāṇāṃ  pūjayā labhate priye |
tat      phalaṃ    nāpnuyāttīrthatapodānamakhavrataiḥ || 108 ||
meaning:
यत् फलं  कौलिकेन्द्राणां  पूजया लभते प्रिये |
तत्      फलं    नाप्नुयात्तीर्थतपोदानमखव्रतैः || 108 ||
text_mt: The reward that one attains through worshipping eminent Kaulikas, O beloved, / that reward one cannot attain through sacred fords, austerities, gifts, sacrifices, and observances.

sanskrit_iast:
dattamiṣṭaṃ   hutaṃ   taptaṃ    pūjitaṃ   japtamambike |
kaulikasya  bhavedvayarthaṃ  kulajñaṃ  yo'vamānayet || 109 ||
meaning:
दत्तमिष्टं   हुतं   तप्तं    पूजितं   जप्तमम्बिके |
कौलिकस्य  भवेद्वयर्थं  कुलज्ञं  योऽवमानयेत् || 109 ||
text_mt: What is given, offered in sacrifice, poured in oblation, endured in austerity, worshipped, and recited, O Ambikā, / becomes useless for a Kaulika who insults one who knows Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
śmaśānaṃ tad  gṛhaṃ  devi sa  pāpī  śvapacādhamaḥ |
yaḥ praviśya kulaṃ dharma kulācāraṃ na vetti cet || 110 ||
meaning:
श्मशानं तद्  गृहं  देवि स  पापी  श्वपचाधमः |
यः प्रविश्य कुलं धर्म कुलाचारं न वेत्ति चेत् || 110 ||
text_mt: That house is a cremation ground, O Goddess, and he is a sinner lower than a dog-cooker, / who, having entered the duty of Kula, does not understand the conduct of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
kulaniṣṭhān  parityajya  yaccānyasmai  pradīyate |
taddānaṃ  niṣphalaṃ  devi  dātā    ca  narakaṃ  vrajet || 111 ||
meaning:
कुलनिष्ठान्  परित्यज्य  यच्चान्यस्मै  प्रदीयते |
तद्दानं  निष्फलं  देवि  दाता    च  नरकं  व्रजेत् || 111 ||
text_mt: And whatever is given to another while abandoning those steadfast in Kula, / that gift is fruitless, O Goddess, and the giver goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
bhinnabhāṇḍe  jalaṃ  yadvat śilāyāmuptabījavat |
bhasmanīva    hutaṃ    havyaṃ   tadvaddānamakaulike || 112 ||
meaning:
भिन्नभाण्डे  जलं  यद्वत् शिलायामुप्तबीजवत् |
भस्मनीव    हुतं    हव्यं   तद्वद्दानमकौलिके || 112 ||
text_mt: Just like water in a broken vessel, just like seed sown upon a rock, / just like an oblation offered into ashes, so is a gift given to a non-Kaulika.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāśaktyā tu yat kiñcid yo dadyāt kulayogine |
viśeṣatithiṣu  prītyā  tatphalaṃ  naiva  varṇyate || 113 ||
meaning:
यथाशक्त्या तु यत् किञ्चिद् यो दद्यात् कुलयोगिने |
विशेषतिथिषु  प्रीत्या  तत्फलं  नैव  वर्ण्यते || 113 ||
text_mt: Whatever little one gives according to one's capacity to a Kula yogin / with love on special lunar days, its reward cannot be described.

sanskrit_iast:
yo  devi svayamāhūya  kulajñānān śubhe dine |
abhyarcya   devatābuddhyā  gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || 114 ||
meaning:
यो  देवि स्वयमाहूय  कुलज्ञानान् शुभे दिने |
अभ्यर्च्य   देवताबुद्ध्या  गन्धपुष्पाक्षतादिभिः || 114 ||
text_mt: One who personally invites those who know Kula on an auspicious day, O Goddess, / and, worshipping [them] with the mindset that they are deities, using perfumes, flowers, unbroken grains, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
mādibhiḥ pañcamudrābhiḥ sadbhaktyā paritoṣayet |
teṣu   tuṣṭeṣvahaṃ  tuṣṭastuṣṭāḥ  syuḥ  sarvadevatāḥ || 115 ||
meaning:
मादिभिः पञ्चमुद्राभिः सद्भक्त्या परितोषयेत् |
तेषु   तुष्टेष्वहं  तुष्टस्तुष्टाः  स्युः  सर्वदेवताः || 115 ||
text_mt: satisfies [them] with true devotion through the five seals beginning with 'm'— / when they are satisfied, I am satisfied, and all the deities are satisfied.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaginīṃ vā sutāṃ bhāryāṃ yo dadyāt kulayogine |
madhumattāya  deveśi  tasya  puṇyaṃ  na   gaṇyate || 116 ||
meaning:
भगिनीं वा सुतां भार्यां यो दद्यात् कुलयोगिने |
मधुमत्ताय  देवेशि  तस्य  पुण्यं  न   गण्यते || 116 ||
text_mt: One who gives a sister, a daughter, or a wife to a Kula yogin / intoxicated with wine, O Ruler of the Gods, his merit cannot be measured.

sanskrit_iast:
anikhātavinikṣiptamaprayatnena       vaddhītam |
paralokasya   pātheyaṃ  vīracakre'pītaṃ  madhu || 117 ||
meaning:
अनिखातविनिक्षिप्तमप्रयत्नेन       वद्धीतम् |
परलोकस्य   पाथेयं  वीरचक्रेऽपीतं  मधु || 117 ||
text_mt: A treasure deposited without digging, accumulated without effort, / provisions for the journey to the other world, is the wine drunk in the circle of heroes.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpācārasamāyuktaṃ     sarvalokabahiṣkṛtam |
jāyate hi  kuladravyaṃ kulayogīśvarāpītam || 118 ||
meaning:
पापाचारसमायुक्तं     सर्वलोकबहिष्कृतम् |
जायते हि  कुलद्रव्यं कुलयोगीश्वरापीतम् || 118 ||
text_mt: Though connected with sinful conduct and outcast from the entire world, / [the substance] becomes indeed an article of Kula when drunk by an eminent Kula yogin.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmin  deśe  vaset  vīraḥ  kulapūjārataḥ  priye |
so'pi deśo bhavet pūtaḥ kiṃ punastatpurasthitāḥ || 119 ||
meaning:
यस्मिन्  देशे  वसेत्  वीरः  कुलपूजारतः  प्रिये |
सोऽपि देशो भवेत् पूतः किं पुनस्तत्पुरस्थिताः || 119 ||
text_mt: In whichever land a hero devoted to Kula worship resides, O beloved, / even that land becomes purified, how much more so those who dwell in that city!

sanskrit_iast:
kaulikendre sakṛdbhukte puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet |
kiṃ  punarbahubhirbhuktaistat  puṇyaṃ   naiva   gaṇyate || 120 ||
meaning:
कौलिकेन्द्रे सकृद्भुक्ते पुण्यं कोटिगुणं भवेत् |
किं  पुनर्बहुभिर्भुक्तैस्तत्  पुण्यं   नैव   गण्यते || 120 ||
text_mt: When an eminent Kaulika eats even once, the merit becomes multiplied ten-millionfold; / how much more when many have eaten—that merit cannot be calculated at all.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt  sarvaprayatnena  sarvāvasthāsu  sarvadā |
kuladharmarato   bhūyāt   kulajñāninamarcayet || 121 ||
meaning:
तस्मात्  सर्वप्रयत्नेन  सर्वावस्थासु  सर्वदा |
कुलधर्मरतो   भूयात्   कुलज्ञानिनमर्चयेत् || 121 ||
text_mt: Therefore, with every effort, in all states, and at all times, / one should remain devoted to the duty of Kula and worship one who knows Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānino'jñānino vāpi yāvat dehasya dhāraṇā |
tāvadvarṇāśramācāraḥ    karttavyaḥ   karmamuktaye || 122 ||
meaning:
ज्ञानिनोऽज्ञानिनो वापि यावत् देहस्य धारणा |
तावद्वर्णाश्रमाचारः    कर्त्तव्यः   कर्ममुक्तये || 122 ||
text_mt: Whether for the wise or the ignorant, as long as the body is maintained, / so long must the conduct of caste and stage of life be practiced for release from action.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇonmūlite'jñāne jñānena  śivatāṃ  vrajet |
śive tenaiva muktiḥ syādataḥ karma samācaret || 123 ||
meaning:
कर्मणोन्मूलितेऽज्ञाने ज्ञानेन  शिवतां  व्रजेत् |
शिवे तेनैव मुक्तिः स्यादतः कर्म समाचरेत् || 123 ||
text_mt: When ignorance is uprooted by action, one attains Śivahood through knowledge; / in Śiva alone there is liberation through it; therefore one should perform action.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādanindyakarmāṇi  nityakarmāṇi  vā   caret |
karmamuktaḥ sukhākāṅkṣī karmaniṣṭhaḥ sukhaṃ vrajet || 124 ||
meaning:
कुर्यादनिन्द्यकर्माणि  नित्यकर्माणि  वा   चरेत् |
कर्ममुक्तः सुखाकाङ्क्षी कर्मनिष्ठः सुखं व्रजेत् || 124 ||
text_mt: One should perform irreproachable actions or observe obligatory duties; / released from action, desiring happiness, one steadfast in action attains happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakarmāṇi  saṃtyaktuṃ na  śakyaṃ  dehadhāriṇā |
tyajet karmaphalaṃ yo vā sa tyāgītyabhidhīyate || 125 ||
meaning:
सर्वकर्माणि  संत्यक्तुं न  शक्यं  देहधारिणा |
त्यजेत् कर्मफलं यो वा स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते || 125 ||
text_mt: It is not possible for an embodied being to renounce all actions; / but one who renounces the fruit of action is called a renouncer.

sanskrit_iast:
svakāryeṣu  pravarttante  karaṇānīti  cintayet |
ahambhāvamapāsyaiva yaḥ kuryāt sa na lipyate || 126 ||
meaning:
स्वकार्येषु  प्रवर्त्तन्ते  करणानीति  चिन्तयेत् |
अहम्भावमपास्यैव यः कुर्यात् स न लिप्यते || 126 ||
text_mt: One should reflect that the senses engage in their own functions; / one who acts casting aside egoism is not tainted.

sanskrit_iast:
kriyamāṇāni karmāṇi jñānaprāpteranantaram |
na ca spṛśanti tattvajñaṃ jalaṃ padmadalaṃ yathā || 127 ||
meaning:
क्रियमाणानि कर्माणि ज्ञानप्राप्तेरनन्तरम् |
न च स्पृशन्ति तत्त्वज्ञं जलं पद्मदलं यथा || 127 ||
text_mt: Actions performed after the attainment of knowledge / do not touch the knower of reality, just as water [does not touch] a lotus petal.

sanskrit_iast:
tanniṣṭhasya ca karmāṇi puṇyāpuṇyāni saṃkṣayam |
prayānti naiva lipyante  kriyamāṇāni  vā punaḥ || 128 ||
meaning:
तन्निष्ठस्य च कर्माणि पुण्यापुण्यानि संक्षयम् |
प्रयान्ति नैव लिप्यन्ते  क्रियमाणानि  वा पुनः || 128 ||
text_mt: For one steadfast in that [knowledge], actions, both virtuous and unvirtuous, go to destruction; / or, being performed again, they do not taint [him].

sanskrit_iast:
utpannasahajānandatattvajñānarataḥ           priye |
saṃtyaktasarvasaṅkalpaḥ sa vidvān karma santyajet || 129 ||
meaning:
उत्पन्नसहजानन्दतत्त्वज्ञानरतः           प्रिये |
संत्यक्तसर्वसङ्कल्पः स विद्वान् कर्म सन्त्यजेत् || 129 ||
text_mt: Devoted to the knowledge of reality of innate bliss that has arisen, O beloved, / having abandoned all volition, that wise one may abandon action.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛthaiva  yaiḥ  parityaktaṃ  karmakāṇḍamapaṇḍitaiḥ |
pāṣaṇḍāḥ paṇḍitammanyāste yānti narakaṃ priye || 130 ||
meaning:
वृथैव  यैः  परित्यक्तं  कर्मकाण्डमपण्डितैः |
पाषण्डाः पण्डितम्मन्यास्ते यान्ति नरकं प्रिये || 130 ||
text_mt: Those ignorant ones by whom the section on action was abandoned in vain, / hypocrites who consider themselves learned, they go to hell, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
phalaṃ prāpya yathā vṛkṣaḥ puṣpaṃ tyajati nispṛhaḥ |
tattvaṃ prāpya tathā yogī tyajet karmaparigraham || 131 ||
meaning:
फलं प्राप्य यथा वृक्षः पुष्पं त्यजति निस्पृहः |
तत्त्वं प्राप्य तथा योगी त्यजेत् कर्मपरिग्रहम् || 131 ||
text_mt: Just as a tree, having obtained fruit, sheds the blossom without desire, / so a yogin, having obtained reality, should renounce the undertaking of action.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhāyutenāpi     brahmahatyāyutena    ca |
puṇyapāpairna lipyante yeṣāṃ brahma hṛdi sthitam || 132 ||
meaning:
अश्वमेधायुतेनापि     ब्रह्महत्यायुतेन    च |
पुण्यपापैर्न लिप्यन्ते येषां ब्रह्म हृदि स्थितम् || 132 ||
text_mt: Even by ten thousand horse-sacrifices and by ten thousand murders of a brāhmaṇa, / they are not tainted by merit or demerit, in whose heart Brahman is established.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni karmāṇi jihvopasthanimittataḥ |
jihvopasthaparityāgī karmaṇā kiṃ kariṣyati || 133 ||
meaning:
पृथिव्यां यानि कर्माणि जिह्वोपस्थनिमित्ततः |
जिह्वोपस्थपरित्यागी कर्मणा किं करिष्यति || 133 ||
text_mt: Whatever actions there are on earth for the sake of the tongue and the genitals— / what will one who has renounced the tongue and genitals do with action?

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ kiñcit yogaṃ yogīśalakṣaṇam |
samāsena  kuleśāni  kiṃ  bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 134 ||
meaning:
इति ते कथितं किञ्चित् योगं योगीशलक्षणम् |
समासेन  कुलेशानि  किं  भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि || 134 ||
text_mt: Thus has been declared to you briefly something of yoga and the marks of the lord of yogins, / O Mistress of Kula; what further do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast: atha daśamollāsaḥ
meaning: अथ दशमोल्लासः

sanskrit_iast:
śrī devyuvāca
kuleśa śrotumicchāmi viśeṣadivasārcanam |
tatsaparyāphalaṃ  deva  vada   me  parameśvara || 1 ||
meaning:
श्री देव्युवाच
कुलेश श्रोतुमिच्छामि विशेषदिवसार्चनम् |
तत्सपर्याफलं  देव  वद   मे  परमेश्वर || 1 ||
text_mt: The auspicious Goddess said: / O Lord of Kula, I wish to hear about worship on special days, / and the fruit of that worship, O God; tell me, O Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
tasya   śravaṇamātreṇa  sarvapāpaiḥ   pramucyate || 2 ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि |
तस्य   श्रवणमात्रेण  सर्वपापैः   प्रमुच्यते || 2 ||
text_mt: The Lord said: / Hear, O Goddess, I shall explain what you ask of Me; / by the mere hearing of it, one is released from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
uttamā nityapūjā syāt madhyamaṃ parvapūjanam |
māsapūjā'dhamā  devi māsādūrdhva paśurbhavet || 3 ||
meaning:
उत्तमा नित्यपूजा स्यात् मध्यमं पर्वपूजनम् |
मासपूजाऽधमा  देवि मासादूर्ध्व पशुर्भवेत् || 3 ||
text_mt: Daily worship is best, worship on festival days is middling, / monthly worship is lowest, O Goddess; beyond a month, one becomes an uninitiated bound soul.

sanskrit_iast:
vihitairmādibhirdravyairmāsādūrdhvaṃ    samarcanam |
paśorbhūyaḥ praveśecchā yadi syāddīkṣayet punaḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
विहितैर्मादिभिर्द्रव्यैर्मासादूर्ध्वं    समर्चनम् |
पशोर्भूयः प्रवेशेच्छा यदि स्याद्दीक्षयेत् पुनः || 4 ||
text_mt: Worship beyond a month must be performed with the prescribed substances beginning with 'm'; / if an uninitiated bound soul has the desire to enter again, one should initiate him anew.

sanskrit_iast:
madyaṃ  māṃsañca  matsyaśca  mudrā  maithunameva ca |
makārapañcakaṃ   devi  devatāprītikārakam || 5 ||
meaning:
मद्यं  मांसञ्च  मत्स्यश्च  मुद्रा  मैथुनमेव च |
मकारपञ्चकं   देवि  देवताप्रीतिकारकम् || 5 ||
text_mt: Wine, meat, fish, parched grain, and sexual union— / these are the five 'm's, O Goddess, which produce delight for the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
mādipañcakamīśāni   devatāprītaye   sudhīḥ |
yathāvidhi niṣeveta tṛṣṇayā cet sa pātakī || 6 ||
meaning:
मादिपञ्चकमीशानि   देवताप्रीतये   सुधीः |
यथाविधि निषेवेत तृष्णया चेत् स पातकी || 6 ||
text_mt: A wise person should consume the five beginning with 'm', O Ruler, according to the injunction, / for the delight of the deities; if out of lust, he is a sinner.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīcaturddaśyāvamāvāsyātha   pūṇīmā |
saṃkrāntiḥ pañca  parvāṇi teṣu puṇyadineṣu ca || 7 ||
meaning:
कृष्णाष्टमीचतुर्द्दश्यावमावास्याथ   पूणीमा |
संक्रान्तिः पञ्च  पर्वाणि तेषु पुण्यदिनेषु च || 7 ||
text_mt: The eighth and fourteenth of the dark fortnight, the new moon, then the full moon, / and the passage of the sun: these are the five festival days, and on these holy days,

sanskrit_iast:
gurujanmadine   prāpte   tadgurostadgurorapi |
mānavaughādipuṃsāñca   svajanmadivase   tathā || 8 ||
meaning:
गुरुजन्मदिने   प्राप्ते   तद्गुरोस्तद्गुरोरपि |
मानवौघादिपुंसाञ्च   स्वजन्मदिवसे   तथा || 8 ||
text_mt: when the birthday of the guru arrives, and of his guru, and of that [guru's] guru as well, / and of the line of human teachers and so forth, as well as on one's own birthday,

sanskrit_iast:
sampattau ca yajellābhe tapodīkṣāvratotsave |
pīṭhopagamane    vīrapīṭhe    svajanadarśane || 9 ||
meaning:
सम्पत्तौ च यजेल्लाभे तपोदीक्षाव्रतोत्सवे |
पीठोपगमने    वीरपीठे    स्वजनदर्शने || 9 ||
text_mt: and in prosperity, on gaining wealth, at a festival of austerity, initiation, or vow, / on approaching a sacred seat, at a hero's sacred seat, and upon seeing one's own kin, one should worship.

sanskrit_iast:
deśikāgamane       puṇyatīrthadaivatadarśane |
evamādiṣu   deveśi  viśeṣadivaseṣu   ca || 10 ||
meaning:
देशिकागमने       पुण्यतीर्थदैवतदर्शने |
एवमादिषु   देवेशि  विशेषदिवसेषु   च || 10 ||
text_mt: at the arrival of the guru, at the seeing of a sacred ford or deity, / and on such occasions, O Queen of the Gods, as well as on special days,

sanskrit_iast:
yathādhanaṃ yathāśraddhaṃ  yathādravyaṃ yathocitam |
yathākālaṃ yathādeśaṃ tathā pūjāṃ samācaret || 11 ||
meaning:
यथाधनं यथाश्रद्धं  यथाद्रव्यं यथोचितम् |
यथाकालं यथादेशं तथा पूजां समाचरेत् || 11 ||
text_mt: according to one's wealth, according to one's faith, according to one's materials, according to propriety, / according to time, and according to place, one should perform worship in that manner.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryeṇa  vidhānena  kārayeccakrapūjanam |
svayaṃ  vā  pūjayeddevi  bindupūjāpuraḥsaram || 12 ||
meaning:
आचार्येण  विधानेन  कारयेच्चक्रपूजनम् |
स्वयं  वा  पूजयेद्देवि  बिन्दुपूजापुरःसरम् || 12 ||
text_mt: One should have the worship of the cakra performed by a master in accordance with the injunction, / or one should worship oneself, O Goddess, preceded by the worship of the drop.

sanskrit_iast:
sa  te  lokamavāpnoti  punarāvṛttivajītam |
akurvan kauliko mohāddevatāśāpamāpnuyāt || 13 ||
meaning:
स  ते  लोकमवाप्नोति  पुनरावृत्तिवजीतम् |
अकुर्वन् कौलिको मोहाद्देवताशापमाप्नुयात् || 13 ||
text_mt: He attains your realm, which is free of return; / a Kaulika who fails to do so out of delusion incurs the curse of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
māse vāpi trimāse vā ṣaṇmāse vatsare'pi vā |
śrīguruṃ pūjayedbhaktyā'prāpte tatstrīsutādikān || 14 ||
meaning:
मासे वापि त्रिमासे वा षण्मासे वत्सरेऽपि वा |
श्रीगुरुं पूजयेद्भक्त्याऽप्राप्ते तत्स्त्रीसुतादिकान् || 14 ||
text_mt: In a month, or in three months, or in six months, or in a year, / one should worship the venerable guru with devotion; if he is not present, his wife, sons, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
tadabhāve kulajñañca tacchiṣyaṃ vānyayoginam |
santoṣayet kuladravyaiḥ kulapūjāpuraḥsaram || 15 ||
meaning:
तदभावे कुलज्ञञ्च तच्छिष्यं वान्ययोगिनम् |
सन्तोषयेत् कुलद्रव्यैः कुलपूजापुरःसरम् || 15 ||
text_mt: In their absence, one should satisfy a knower of Kula, or his disciple, or another yogin, / with Kula substances, preceded by worship of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
rogeṣvāpatsu doṣeṣu duḥsaṅge dunīmittake |
pūjayed yoginīvṛndaṃ devi taddoṣaśāntaye || 16 ||
meaning:
रोगेष्वापत्सु दोषेषु दुःसङ्गे दुनीमित्तके |
पूजयेद् योगिनीवृन्दं देवि तद्दोषशान्तये || 16 ||
text_mt: In diseases, in calamities, in faults, in bad association, and in ill omens, / one should worship the assembly of yoginīs, O Goddess, for the pacification of those faults.

sanskrit_iast:
yatraikāmnāyatattvajñaḥ kulācāryaḥ  kuleśvari |
kaulikāstricatuḥpañca śaktayaśca tathā priye || 17 ||
meaning:
यत्रैकाम्नायतत्त्वज्ञः कुलाचार्यः  कुलेश्वरि |
कौलिकास्त्रिचतुःपञ्च शक्तयश्च तथा प्रिये || 17 ||
text_mt: Where there is a Kula master who knows the reality of a single sacred transmission, O Mistress of Kula, / and Kaulikas, three, four, or five, as well as Śaktis, O dear one,

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthagvā  pūjayeddevi  mithunākārato'pi vā |
gandhapuṣpākṣatādyaistu  deveśi  samalaṅkṛtāḥ |
bhakṣyabhojyādipiśitaiḥ padārthaiḥ ṣaḍrasānvitaiḥ || 18 ||
meaning:
पृथग्वा  पूजयेद्देवि  मिथुनाकारतोऽपि वा |
गन्धपुष्पाक्षताद्यैस्तु  देवेशि  समलङ्कृताः |
भक्ष्यभोज्यादिपिशितैः पदार्थैः षड्रसान्वितैः || 18 ||
text_mt: one should worship them, O Goddess, either separately or in the form of couples; / adorned with perfumes, flowers, unhusked grains, and other [offerings], O Queen of the Gods, / with eatables, foodstuffs, flesh, and articles endowed with the six flavours,

sanskrit_iast:
prauḍhollāsena sahitā yadi tā nivasanti ca |
tacchrīcakramiti  proktaṃ  vṛndañcāpi taducyate || 19 ||
meaning:
प्रौढोल्लासेन सहिता यदि ता निवसन्ति च |
तच्छ्रीचक्रमिति  प्रोक्तं  वृन्दञ्चापि तदुच्यते || 19 ||
text_mt: if they dwell together with the mature exultation, / that is proclaimed as the Śrīcakra, and it is also called the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryānnavakumārīṇāṃ    pūjāmāśvinamāsake |
prātanīmantrayedbhaktyā  sādhakaḥ śuddhamānasaḥ || 20 ||
meaning:
कुर्यान्नवकुमारीणां    पूजामाश्विनमासके |
प्रातनीमन्त्रयेद्भक्त्या  साधकः शुद्धमानसः || 20 ||
text_mt: One should perform the worship of nine maidens in the month of Āśvina; / the practitioner, pure in mind, should invite [them] with devotion in the morning.

sanskrit_iast:
manoharāmekavarṣī    bālāñca    śubhalakṣaṇām |
mantrī snātvātha śuddhātmā kuryāddevi kramārcanam || 21 ||
meaning:
मनोहरामेकवर्षी    बालाञ्च    शुभलक्षणाम् |
मन्त्री स्नात्वाथ शुद्धात्मा कुर्याद्देवि क्रमार्चनम् || 21 ||
text_mt: A lovely one-year-old girl endowed with auspicious marks, / having bathed, pure in self, the mantrin should then perform the sequential worship, O Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyaṅgasnānaśuddhāntāṃ     pūjāsadanamānayet |
devatāsannidhau   bālāmupaveśya   samarcayet || 22 ||
meaning:
अभ्यङ्गस्नानशुद्धान्तां     पूजासदनमानयेत् |
देवतासन्निधौ   बालामुपवेश्य   समर्चयेत् || 22 ||
text_mt: Having purified her with an unction and a bath, he should bring her to the house of worship; / seating the young girl in the presence of the deity, he should worship her.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpādibhirdhūpairdīpaiśca      kuladīpakaiḥ |
bhogyabhojyānnapānādyaiḥ kṣīrājyamadhumāṃsakaiḥ |
kadalīnārikelādiphalaistāṃ    paritoṣayet || 23 ||
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्धूपैर्दीपैश्च      कुलदीपकैः |
भोग्यभोज्यान्नपानाद्यैः क्षीराज्यमधुमांसकैः |
कदलीनारिकेलादिफलैस्तां    परितोषयेत् || 23 ||
text_mt: With perfumes, flowers, and the like, with incenses, and with lights—the lamps of Kula— / with various foods, drinks, milk, clarified butter, honey, and meats, / and with fruits such as plantains and coconuts, he should satisfy her completely.

sanskrit_iast:
saśaktikaḥ svayaṃ  devi  prauḍhāntollāsasaṃyutaḥ |
yathāśakti   japedekottaravṛddhyā'thavā   manum || 24 ||
meaning:
सशक्तिकः स्वयं  देवि  प्रौढान्तोल्लाससंयुतः |
यथाशक्ति   जपेदेकोत्तरवृद्ध्याऽथवा   मनुम् || 24 ||
text_mt: Accompanied by his Śakti, himself possessed of the exultation that reaches its culmination, O Goddess, / he should recite the mantra according to his ability, or with an increase of one by one.

sanskrit_iast:
bālāmalaṅkṛtāṃ paśyan cintayet sveṣṭadevatām |
tatastāṃ   devatābuddhyā  namaskṛtya  visarjayet || 25 ||
meaning:
बालामलङ्कृतां पश्यन् चिन्तयेत् स्वेष्टदेवताम् |
ततस्तां   देवताबुद्ध्या  नमस्कृत्य  विसर्जयेत् || 25 ||
text_mt: Looking upon the adorned girl, he should meditate on his chosen deity; / then, having bowed to her with the awareness that she is the deity, he should dismiss her.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyāyāṃ   dvivarṣāntāmekavarṣāñca  pūjayet |
evaṃ tithau kumārīñca yajet pūrvadinācītām || 26 ||
meaning:
द्वितीयायां   द्विवर्षान्तामेकवर्षाञ्च  पूजयेत् |
एवं तिथौ कुमारीञ्च यजेत् पूर्वदिनाचीताम् || 26 ||
text_mt: On the second day, he should worship a girl up to two years old and one of one year; / in this manner, on each lunar day, he should worship the maiden [and those] gathered on the preceding days.

sanskrit_iast:
navamyāmekavarṣādi-navavarṣāntakanyakāḥ       |
bālā śuddhā ca lalitā mālinī ca vasundharā |
sarasvatī  ramā gaurī durgā ca nava  kīttītāḥ || 27 ||
meaning:
नवम्यामेकवर्षादि-नववर्षान्तकन्यकाः       |
बाला शुद्धा च ललिता मालिनी च वसुन्धरा |
सरस्वती  रमा गौरी दुर्गा च नव  कीत्तीताः || 27 ||
text_mt: On the ninth day, [he should worship] girls from one year of age up to nine years: / Bālā, Śuddhā, Lalitā, Mālinī, Vasundharā, / Sarasvatī, Ramā, Gaurī, and Durgā—these are proclaimed as the nine.

sanskrit_iast:
tritārādyairnamo'ntaiśca         devatāpadapaścimaiḥ |
nāmabhiśca caturthyantaiḥ pūjayettāḥ pṛthak pṛthak || 28 ||
meaning:
त्रिताराद्यैर्नमोऽन्तैश्च         देवतापदपश्चिमैः |
नामभिश्च चतुर्थ्यन्तैः पूजयेत्ताः पृथक् पृथक् || 28 ||
text_mt: With names beginning with the three tārās, ending in 'namas', / following the word 'devatā', and ending in the dative case, he should worship them individually.

sanskrit_iast:
baṭukaṃ  pañcavarṣañca  navavarṣaṃ  gaṇeśvaram |
gandhapuṣpāmbarākalpairyathāvibhavavistaraiḥ || 29 ||
meaning:
बटुकं  पञ्चवर्षञ्च  नववर्षं  गणेश्वरम् |
गन्धपुष्पाम्बराकल्पैर्यथाविभवविस्तरैः || 29 ||
text_mt: A Baṭuka of five years and a Gaṇeśvara of nine years, / with perfumes, flowers, garments, ornaments, according to the extent of his wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyarcya  devatābuddhyā  padārthaiḥ paritoṣayet |
svakāryaphalasiddhyarthaṃ vittaśāṭhyavivajītaḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
अभ्यर्च्य  देवताबुद्ध्या  पदार्थैः परितोषयेत् |
स्वकार्यफलसिद्ध्यर्थं वित्तशाठ्यविवजीतः || 30 ||
text_mt: having worshipped [them] with the awareness that they are deities, he should satisfy [them] with articles, / free from stinginess regarding his wealth, for the sake of the accomplishment of the fruit of his own work.

sanskrit_iast:
navarātraṃ  japedekottaravṛddhyā krameṇa ca |
navarātrakṛtāṃ pūjāṃ devi devyai samarpayet || 31 ||
meaning:
नवरात्रं  जपेदेकोत्तरवृद्ध्या क्रमेण च |
नवरात्रकृतां पूजां देवि देव्यै समर्पयेत् || 31 ||
text_mt: For nine nights he should recite [the mantra] in sequence with an increase of one by one; / O Goddess, he should offer the worship performed during the nine nights to the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā kumārīstā visarjayet |
evaṃ     navakumārīṇāmarcanaṃ    prātavatsaram || 32 ||
meaning:
ताम्बूलं दक्षिणां दत्त्वा कुमारीस्ता विसर्जयेत् |
एवं     नवकुमारीणामर्चनं    प्रातवत्सरम् || 32 ||
text_mt: Having given betel and a sacrificial fee, he should dismiss those maidens; / in this way, the worship of the nine maidens [is performed] year after year.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ karoti sa puṇyātmā devatāprītimāpnuyāt |
mano'bhilāṣaṃ  samprāpya  nivasettava  sannidhau || 33 ||
meaning:
यः करोति स पुण्यात्मा देवताप्रीतिमाप्नुयात् |
मनोऽभिलाषं  सम्प्राप्य  निवसेत्तव  सन्निधौ || 33 ||
text_mt: He who performs this is a meritorious soul and attains the favour of the deity; / having obtained his heart's desire, he shall dwell in your presence.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā  yauvanārūḍhāḥ  pramadā nava pārvati |
manojñāḥ pūjayedbhaktyā navarātriṣu mantravit || 34 ||
meaning:
अथवा  यौवनारूढाः  प्रमदा नव पार्वति |
मनोज्ञाः पूजयेद्भक्त्या नवरात्रिषु मन्त्रवित् || 34 ||
text_mt: Or rather, nine charming young women who have attained youth, O Pārvatī, / the knower of mantras should worship with devotion during the nine nights:

sanskrit_iast:
hṛllekhāṃ gaganāṃ raktāṃ mahocchuṣmāṃ karālikām |
icchāṃ jñānāṃ  kriyāṃ durgāṃ  baṭukañca gaṇeśvaram |
pūrvavat   pūrvamadyādyaiḥ   padārthaiḥ   paritoṣayet || 35 ||
meaning:
हृल्लेखां गगनां रक्तां महोच्छुष्मां करालिकाम् |
इच्छां ज्ञानां  क्रियां दुर्गां  बटुकञ्च गणेश्वरम् |
पूर्ववत्   पूर्वमद्याद्यैः   पदार्थैः   परितोषयेत् || 35 ||
text_mt: Hṛllekhā, Gaganā, Raktā, Mahocchuṣmā, Karālikā, / Icchā, Jñānā, Kriyā, Durgā, as well as Baṭuka and Gaṇeśvara, / he should satisfy as before with the previously mentioned articles, liquor and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
prauḍhāntollāsasaṃyuktāḥ santuṣṭā yadi tāḥ priye |
sādhakastuṣṭimāsādya    nivasettava   sannidhau || 36 ||
meaning:
प्रौढान्तोल्लाससंयुक्ताः सन्तुष्टा यदि ताः प्रिये |
साधकस्तुष्टिमासाद्य    निवसेत्तव   सन्निधौ || 36 ||
text_mt: If, endowed with the exultation that reaches its culmination, they are satisfied, O dear one, / the practitioner, having attained satisfaction, shall dwell in your presence.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ    yaḥ   pūjayeddevi   prativarṣaṃ   yatavrataḥ |
ṣaṇmāse vā trimāse vā māse māse'thavā priye || 37 ||
meaning:
एवं    यः   पूजयेद्देवि   प्रतिवर्षं   यतव्रतः |
षण्मासे वा त्रिमासे वा मासे मासेऽथवा प्रिये || 37 ||
text_mt: He who thus worships every year, O Goddess, steadfast in his vows, / or in six months, or in three months, or month by month, O dear one,

sanskrit_iast:
tisro  vā  pañca vā  sapta  pūjayeddevatādhiyā |
sarvaiśvaryasamṛddhātmā  sa  bhavedāvayoḥ  priyaḥ || 38 ||
meaning:
तिस्रो  वा  पञ्च वा  सप्त  पूजयेद्देवताधिया |
सर्वैश्वर्यसमृद्धात्मा  स  भवेदावयोः  प्रियः || 38 ||
text_mt: and worships three, or five, or seven [women] with the thought that they are the deity, / his self enriched with all sovereignty, he shall become dear to both of us.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguvāre  kuleśāni  kāntāmārūḍhayauvanām |
sarvalakṣaṇasampannāmanukūlāṃ       manoramām || 39 ||
meaning:
भृगुवारे  कुलेशानि  कान्तामारूढयौवनाम् |
सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नामनुकूलां       मनोरमाम् || 39 ||
text_mt: On Friday, O Mistress of Kula, [he should invite] a beloved woman who has attained youth, / endowed with all auspicious marks, agreeable, and charming,

sanskrit_iast:
kulākulāṣṭakāṃ devi nimantryāhūya puṣpiṇīm |
abhyaṅgasnānaśuddhāṅgīmāsane     copaveśayet || 40 ||
meaning:
कुलाकुलाष्टकां देवि निमन्त्र्याहूय पुष्पिणीम् |
अभ्यङ्गस्नानशुद्धाङ्गीमासने     चोपवेशयेत् || 40 ||
text_mt: of the eight Kula and Akula [families], O Goddess, and having invited and summoned her while in her menses, / her limbs purified by unction and bathing, he should seat her upon a seat.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpāmbarākalpairalaṅkṛtya vidhānavit |
ātmānaṃ gandhapuṣpādyairalaṅkuryāt kuleśvari || 41 ||
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पाम्बराकल्पैरलङ्कृत्य विधानवित् |
आत्मानं गन्धपुष्पाद्यैरलङ्कुर्यात् कुलेश्वरि || 41 ||
text_mt: Adorning her with perfumes, flowers, garments, and ornaments, the knower of the injunction, / O Mistress of Kula, should adorn himself with perfumes, flowers, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhya devatāṃ tasyāṃ yajennyāsakrameṇa ca |
kṛtvā kramārcanaṃ dhūpadīpāñca kuladīpakān || 42 ||
meaning:
आवाह्य देवतां तस्यां यजेन्न्यासक्रमेण च |
कृत्वा क्रमार्चनं धूपदीपाञ्च कुलदीपकान् || 42 ||
text_mt: Invoking the deity into her, he should worship through the sequence of nyāsa; / having performed the sequential worship, [offering] incense, lamps, and the lamps of Kula,

sanskrit_iast:
pradarśya devatābuddhyā padārthaiḥ  ṣaḍrasānvitaiḥ |
māṃsādibhakṣyabhojyādyaistoṣayeddevi bhaktitaḥ || 43 ||
meaning:
प्रदर्श्य देवताबुद्ध्या पदार्थैः  षड्रसान्वितैः |
मांसादिभक्ष्यभोज्याद्यैस्तोषयेद्देवि भक्तितः || 43 ||
text_mt: showing them with the awareness that she is the deity, with articles endowed with the six flavours, / with meats, eatables, foods, and the like, he should satisfy her with devotion, O Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
prauḍhāntollāsasahitāṃ tāṃ prapaśyan japenmanum |
yauvanollāsasahitaḥ  svayaṃ  taddhyānatatparaḥ || 44 ||
meaning:
प्रौढान्तोल्लाससहितां तां प्रपश्यन् जपेन्मनुम् |
यौवनोल्लाससहितः  स्वयं  तद्ध्यानतत्परः || 44 ||
text_mt: Beholding her possessed of the exultation that reaches its culmination, he should recite the mantra, / himself possessed of the exultation of youth, intent upon meditation on her.

sanskrit_iast:
nivīkāreṇa   cittena  hyaṣṭottarasahasrakam |
japādikaṃ samarpyātha tayā saha niśāṃ nayet || 45 ||
meaning:
निवीकारेण   चित्तेन  ह्यष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम् |
जपादिकं समर्प्याथ तया सह निशां नयेत् || 45 ||
text_mt: With an unperturbed mind, having offered one thousand and eight / recitations and other [rites], he should then spend the night with her.

sanskrit_iast:
tripañcasaptanavasu   bhṛguvāreṣu  yaḥ  priye |
pūjayedvidhinā'nena tasya puṇyaṃ na gaṇyate || 46 ||
meaning:
त्रिपञ्चसप्तनवसु   भृगुवारेषु  यः  प्रिये |
पूजयेद्विधिनाऽनेन तस्य पुण्यं न गण्यते || 46 ||
text_mt: He who worships according to this injunction on three, five, seven, or nine / Fridays, O dear one, his merit cannot be counted.

sanskrit_iast:
catuḥ pīṭhārcanaphalaṃ  sa  prāpnoti  kuleśvari |
yad yat svamanaso'bhīṣṭaṃ tattadāpnotyasaṃśayam || 47 ||
meaning:
चतुः पीठार्चनफलं  स  प्राप्नोति  कुलेश्वरि |
यद् यत् स्वमनसोऽभीष्टं तत्तदाप्नोत्यसंशयम् || 47 ||
text_mt: He obtains the fruit of worshipping the four seats, O Mistress of Kula; / whatever is desired in his own mind, that he attains without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
navamyāṃ vārcayedevaṃ  vidhānena vidhānavit |
stotraiḥ saṃpūjayet sarvairmahadaiśvaryamāpnuyāt || 48 ||
meaning:
नवम्यां वार्चयेदेवं  विधानेन विधानवित् |
स्तोत्रैः संपूजयेत् सर्वैर्महदैश्वर्यमाप्नुयात् || 48 ||
text_mt: Or on the ninth lunar day, the knower of the injunction should thus worship according to the injunction; / he should worship completely with all hymns of praise, and he shall attain great sovereignty.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāt karkaṭake vāpi makare mithunārcanam |
tulāyāṃ  siṃhameṣe vā  sarvasaṃkrāntiṣu  priye || 49 ||
meaning:
कुर्यात् कर्कटके वापि मकरे मिथुनार्चनम् |
तुलायां  सिंहमेषे वा  सर्वसंक्रान्तिषु  प्रिये || 49 ||
text_mt: One should perform the worship of couples in Cancer, or in Capricorn, / in Libra, or in Leo, or in Aries, or on all solar transits, O dear one:

sanskrit_iast:
gaurīśivau   ramāviṣṇū  vāṇīsarasijāsanau |
śacīndrau rohiṇīcandrau svāhāgnī ca prabhāravī || 50 ||
meaning:
गौरीशिवौ   रमाविष्णू  वाणीसरसिजासनौ |
शचीन्द्रौ रोहिणीचन्द्रौ स्वाहाग्नी च प्रभारवी || 50 ||
text_mt: Gaurī and Śiva, Ramā and Viṣṇu, Vāṇī and the Lotus-Seated One, / Śacī and Indra, Rohiṇī and the Moon, Svāhā and Fire, Prabhā and the Sun,

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrakālīvīrabhadrau         bhairavībhairavāvapi |
mithunāni   navābhyarcya   pūrvoktenaiva  vartmanā || 51 ||
meaning:
भद्रकालीवीरभद्रौ         भैरवीभैरवावपि |
मिथुनानि   नवाभ्यर्च्य   पूर्वोक्तेनैव  वर्त्मना || 51 ||
text_mt: Bhadrakālī and Vīrabhadra, and also Bhairavī and Bhairava; / having worshipped these nine couples strictly by the path spoken of before,

sanskrit_iast:
tritārādinamo'ntena  tattannāmnā vidhānavit |
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya madyādyaiḥ paritoṣayet || 52 ||
meaning:
त्रितारादिनमोऽन्तेन  तत्तन्नाम्ना विधानवित् |
गन्धपुष्पादिभिः पूज्य मद्याद्यैः परितोषयेत् || 52 ||
text_mt: The knower of the rule, [invoking] each respective name beginning with the three tāras and ending with 'namaḥ', / having worshipped them with perfumes, flowers, and the like, should satisfy them with wine and other offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
prauḍhāntollāsayuktāni kurvīta mithunāni ca |
evaṃ  kṛte   na  sandehastuṣṭā  mithunadevatāḥ |
anugṛhṇanti taṃ  devi prayacchanti manoratham || 53 ||
meaning:
प्रौढान्तोल्लासयुक्तानि कुर्वीत मिथुनानि च |
एवं  कृते   न  सन्देहस्तुष्टा  मिथुनदेवताः |
अनुगृह्णन्ति तं  देवि प्रयच्छन्ति मनोरथम् || 53 ||
text_mt: And he should bring the couples to the stage of advanced exultation. / When this is done, there is no doubt: the deities of the couples, being pleased, / bestow their grace upon him, O Goddess, and grant his heart's desire.

sanskrit_iast:
prativarṣantu yaḥ kuryāt sabhaktyā mithunārcanam |
tava loke  sa  nivaset  sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ || 54 ||
meaning:
प्रतिवर्षन्तु यः कुर्यात् सभक्त्या मिथुनार्चनम् |
तव लोके  स  निवसेत्  सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्वितः || 54 ||
text_mt: He who performs the worship of the couples with devotion every year / shall dwell in your realm, endowed with all sovereignty.

sanskrit_iast:
atha  vaiśākhamāsasya  śuklapratipadīśvari |
brāhme muhūrtte utthāya snānaṃ sandhyāmupāsya ca || 55 ||
meaning:
अथ  वैशाखमासस्य  शुक्लप्रतिपदीश्वरि |
ब्राह्मे मुहूर्त्ते उत्थाय स्नानं सन्ध्यामुपास्य च || 55 ||
text_mt: Now, O Lady, on the first lunar day of the bright fortnight of the month of Vaiśākha, / having risen at the hour of Brahman, bathed, and performed the twilight devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
manojñe rahasi  sthāne  pūrvāśābhimukhasthitaḥ |
ātmānaṃ gandhapuṣpādyairalaṅkṛtya vidhānavit || 56 ||
meaning:
मनोज्ञे रहसि  स्थाने  पूर्वाशाभिमुखस्थितः |
आत्मानं गन्धपुष्पाद्यैरलङ्कृत्य विधानवित् || 56 ||
text_mt: in a delightful, secret place, facing the eastern quarter, / having adorned himself with perfumes, flowers, and the like, the knower of the rule,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā puroditanyāsān devatābhāvamāsthitaḥ |
kiñcidabhyudite  sūrye  maṇḍale  sveṣṭadevatām || 57 ||
meaning:
कृत्वा पुरोदितन्यासान् देवताभावमास्थितः |
किञ्चिदभ्युदिते  सूर्ये  मण्डले  स्वेष्टदेवताम् || 57 ||
text_mt: having performed the previously taught nyāsas, assuming the state of divinity, / when the sun has slightly risen, in the maṇḍala [should contemplate] his chosen deity;

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā sāvaraṇāṃ samyak pūjayedvidhinā priye |
ṣoḍaśairupacāraistu         cakrapūjāpuraḥsaram || 58 ||
meaning:
ध्यात्वा सावरणां सम्यक् पूजयेद्विधिना प्रिये |
षोडशैरुपचारैस्तु         चक्रपूजापुरःसरम् || 58 ||
text_mt: having meditated [on her] together with her retinue, he should worship properly according to rule, O beloved, / with the sixteen offerings, preceded by the worship of the cakra.

sanskrit_iast:
kuladīpān  pradarśyātha   śivāya   gururūpiṇe |
matsyamāṃsādi  vidhivadbhakṣya  bhojyasamanvitam || 59 ||
meaning:
कुलदीपान्  प्रदर्श्याथ   शिवाय   गुरुरूपिणे |
मत्स्यमांसादि  विधिवद्भक्ष्य  भोज्यसमन्वितम् || 59 ||
text_mt: Having displayed the Kula lamps, then, to Śiva in the form of the guru, / [he presents] fish, meat, and the like, together with edibles and chewables according to rule;

sanskrit_iast:
arghyaṃ nivedya taccheṣaṃ svayaṃ bhaktyā pibet priye |
yauvanollāsasahito    nivīkāreṇa   cetasā || 60 ||
meaning:
अर्घ्यं निवेद्य तच्छेषं स्वयं भक्त्या पिबेत् प्रिये |
यौवनोल्लाससहितो    निवीकारेण   चेतसा || 60 ||
text_mt: having offered the water offering, he should himself drink the remainder with devotion, O beloved, / accompanied by the exultation of youth, with an unperturbed mind.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyaṃstanmaṇḍalaṃ   devīmaṣṭottarasahasrakam |
japtvā samarpya tatpūjāṃ devatāñca samuddharet || 61 ||
meaning:
ध्यायंस्तन्मण्डलं   देवीमष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम् |
जप्त्वा समर्प्य तत्पूजां देवताञ्च समुद्धरेत् || 61 ||
text_mt: Meditating on that maṇḍala, having recited the Goddess [mantra] one thousand and eight times, / having dedicated that worship, he should dismiss the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ   śuklapratipadaṃ  samārabhya  dine  dine |
kuryājjapārcanaṃ     kṛṣṇacaturddaśyantamambike || 62 ||
meaning:
एवं   शुक्लप्रतिपदं  समारभ्य  दिने  दिने |
कुर्याज्जपार्चनं     कृष्णचतुर्द्दश्यन्तमम्बिके || 62 ||
text_mt: Thus, beginning on the first day of the bright fortnight, day after day / he should perform recitation and worship until the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, O Ambikā.

sanskrit_iast:
amāvasyādine devi pūjayecchaktikaulikān |
tripañcasapta   nava  vā  vittalobhavivajītaḥ || 63 ||
meaning:
अमावस्यादिने देवि पूजयेच्छक्तिकौलिकान् |
त्रिपञ्चसप्त   नव  वा  वित्तलोभविवजीतः || 63 ||
text_mt: On the new-moon day, O Goddess, he should worship Kaulikas and their Śaktis— / three, five, seven, or nine—free from greed for wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yo māsamātrantu kuryāt sūryodayārcanam |
devatā tasya santuṣṭā dadāti phalamīpsitam || 64 ||
meaning:
एवं यो मासमात्रन्तु कुर्यात् सूर्योदयार्चनम् |
देवता तस्य सन्तुष्टा ददाति फलमीप्सितम् || 64 ||
text_mt: He who thus performs worship at sunrise for just a month, / his deity, fully pleased, grants the desired fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
mādhyāhne  cārcayeddevaṃ  sāyāhne  cārcayet priye |
sa tu tatphalamāpnoti yoginīnāṃ priyo bhavet || 65 ||
meaning:
माध्याह्ने  चार्चयेद्देवं  सायाह्ने  चार्चयेत् प्रिये |
स तु तत्फलमाप्नोति योगिनीनां प्रियो भवेत् || 65 ||
text_mt: And he should worship the God at midday, and worship him in the evening, O beloved; / he indeed obtains that fruit and becomes dear to the yoginīs.

sanskrit_iast:
trisandhāṃ   yo'rcayedevaṃ  māsamātraṃ  vidhānavit |
kāṅkṣitāṃ labhate siddhiṃ devavad vicared bhuvi || 66 ||
meaning:
त्रिसन्धां   योऽर्चयेदेवं  मासमात्रं  विधानवित् |
काङ्क्षितां लभते सिद्धिं देववद् विचरेद् भुवि || 66 ||
text_mt: He who, knowing the rule, thus worships at the three twilights for just a month, / attains the desired siddhi and wanders the earth like a god.

sanskrit_iast:
māghaśuklapratipadi         divāhāravivajītaḥ |
snātvā śuklāmbaradharaḥ sāyaṃ sandhyāmupāsya ca || 67 ||
meaning:
माघशुक्लप्रतिपदि         दिवाहारविवजीतः |
स्नात्वा शुक्लाम्बरधरः सायं सन्ध्यामुपास्य च || 67 ||
text_mt: On the first day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, abstaining from food during the day, / having bathed, wearing white garments, and having performed the evening twilight devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
sūryārcanoktamārgeṇa     sarvadravyasamanvitaḥ |
yauvanollāsasahitaścandrasthāṃ devatāṃ smaran || 68 ||
meaning:
सूर्यार्चनोक्तमार्गेण     सर्वद्रव्यसमन्वितः |
यौवनोल्लाससहितश्चन्द्रस्थां देवतां स्मरन् || 68 ||
text_mt: by the path taught for the worship of the sun, equipped with all substances, / accompanied by the exultation of youth, remembering the deity residing in the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
candrāstamayaparyantaṃ       japenmantrananyadhīḥ |
evaṃ   pratidinaṃ  śuklacaturddaśyantamarcayet || 69 ||
meaning:
चन्द्रास्तमयपर्यन्तं       जपेन्मन्त्रनन्यधीः |
एवं   प्रतिदिनं  शुक्लचतुर्द्दश्यन्तमर्चयेत् || 69 ||
text_mt: he should recite the mantra with undivided mind until the setting of the moon; / thus every day he should worship until the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight.

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsyāṃ yathāśaktyā pūjayecchaktikaulikān |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā śuklapakṣārcanaṃ priye || 70 ||
meaning:
पौर्णमास्यां यथाशक्त्या पूजयेच्छक्तिकौलिकान् |
एवं यः कुरुते भक्त्या शुक्लपक्षार्चनं प्रिये || 70 ||
text_mt: On the full-moon day, according to his capacity, he should worship Kaulikas and their Śaktis; / he who thus performs the worship of the bright fortnight with devotion, O beloved,

sanskrit_iast:
sarva    pāpaviśuddhātmā   sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ |
sarvalokaikasaṃpūjyaḥ    śivavannivased bhuvi || 71 ||
meaning:
सर्व    पापविशुद्धात्मा   सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्वितः |
सर्वलोकैकसंपूज्यः    शिववन्निवसेद् भुवि || 71 ||
text_mt: his soul purified of all demerit, endowed with all sovereignty, / uniquely venerable to all the worlds, shall dwell on earth like Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣe'rcanaṃ    yadvattadvat   pakṣe   sitetare |
yaḥ karoti vidhānena sarvān kāmān samaśnute || 72 ||
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षेऽर्चनं    यद्वत्तद्वत्   पक्षे   सितेतरे |
यः करोति विधानेन सर्वान् कामान् समश्नुते || 72 ||
text_mt: Just as the worship in the bright fortnight, so in the other fortnight; / he who performs it according to the rule attains all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
iha bhuktvā'khilān bhogān devavat priyadarśanaḥ |
yoginīvīramelanaṃ    labhate   nātra   saṃśayaḥ || 73 ||
meaning:
इह भुक्त्वाऽखिलान् भोगान् देववत् प्रियदर्शनः |
योगिनीवीरमेलनं    लभते   नात्र   संशयः || 73 ||
text_mt: Having enjoyed all pleasures here, handsome as a god, / he attains the gathering of yoginīs and vīras; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kāttīkamāsasya śuklapratipadīśvari |
snātvācamya viśuddhātmā nyāsān kṛtvā puroditān || 74 ||
meaning:
अथ कात्तीकमासस्य शुक्लप्रतिपदीश्वरि |
स्नात्वाचम्य विशुद्धात्मा न्यासान् कृत्वा पुरोदितान् || 74 ||
text_mt: Now, O Lady, on the first day of the bright fortnight of the month of Kārttika, / having bathed and sipped water, purified in soul, having performed the previously taught nyāsas,

sanskrit_iast:
prasupte jīvaloke tu muditātmā  mahāniśi |
pūrvārcanokta   vidhinā  sarvadravyasamanvitaḥ || 75 ||
meaning:
प्रसुप्ते जीवलोके तु मुदितात्मा  महानिशि |
पूर्वार्चनोक्त   विधिना  सर्वद्रव्यसमन्वितः || 75 ||
text_mt: when the world of living beings is asleep, with a joyful soul at dead of night, / by the rule taught for the earlier worship, equipped with all substances,

sanskrit_iast:
ājyenānāmikāsthūlavattīṃ prajvālya pārvati |
pañcavarṇarajaścitravasupatrasaroruhe            || 76 ||
meaning:
आज्येनानामिकास्थूलवत्तीं प्रज्वाल्य पार्वति |
पञ्चवर्णरजश्चित्रवसुपत्रसरोरुहे            || 76 ||
text_mt: having kindled with clarified butter a wick as thick as the ring finger, O Pārvatī, / upon an eight-petalled lotus variegated with powders of five colors,

sanskrit_iast:
madhupūrṇe   ca  kalase  kāṃsyapātre  manohare |
dīpaṃ  saṃsthāpya  purata  uttarābhimukhasthitaḥ || 77 ||
meaning:
मधुपूर्णे   च  कलसे  कांस्यपात्रे  मनोहरे |
दीपं  संस्थाप्य  पुरत  उत्तराभिमुखस्थितः || 77 ||
text_mt: upon an attractive bronze vessel and a jar filled with wine, / having placed the lamp in front, stationed facing the north,

sanskrit_iast:
dīpe sāvaraṇāṃ devīṃ dhyātvā vidhivadarcayet |
yauvanollāsasahito dīpasthāṃ devatāṃ smaran || 78 ||
meaning:
दीपे सावरणां देवीं ध्यात्वा विधिवदर्चयेत् |
यौवनोल्लाससहितो दीपस्थां देवतां स्मरन् || 78 ||
text_mt: having meditated on the Goddess with her retinue in the lamp, he should worship her according to rule; / accompanied by the exultation of youth, remembering the deity residing in the lamp,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottarasahasrantu       japenmantramananyadhīḥ |
evaṃ   samarcayet  kṛṣṇacaturddaśyantamambike || 79 ||
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरसहस्रन्तु       जपेन्मन्त्रमनन्यधीः |
एवं   समर्चयेत्  कृष्णचतुर्द्दश्यन्तमम्बिके || 79 ||
text_mt: he should recite the mantra one thousand and eight times with undivided mind; / thus he should worship until the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, O Ambikā.

sanskrit_iast:
amāvāsyādine bhaktyā pūjayecchaktikaulikān |
evaṃ   kṛte   kuleśāni  devatā  prītimāpnuyāt || 80 ||
meaning:
अमावास्यादिने भक्त्या पूजयेच्छक्तिकौलिकान् |
एवं   कृते   कुलेशानि  देवता  प्रीतिमाप्नुयात् || 80 ||
text_mt: On the new-moon day, he should worship Kaulikas and their Śaktis with devotion; / when this is done, O Mistress of Kula, the deity attains delight.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā      sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ |
sarvalokaikasammānyaḥ sañcaret sa yathāsukham || 81 ||
meaning:
सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा      सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्वितः |
सर्वलोकैकसम्मान्यः सञ्चरेत् स यथासुखम् || 81 ||
text_mt: With his self enriched with all desires, endowed with all sovereignty, / uniquely honored by all the worlds, he wanders about as he pleases.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāṣṭakārcanaṃ  kuryāt   śaktaścedekavāsare |
athavāṣṭāṣṭadivaseṣvatha    dvyaṣṭadineṣu    ca |
dvātriṃśaddivaseṣvevaṃ    catuḥṣaṣṭidineṣu    ca || 82 ||
meaning:
अष्टाष्टकार्चनं  कुर्यात्   शक्तश्चेदेकवासरे |
अथवाष्टाष्टदिवसेष्वथ    द्व्यष्टदिनेषु    च |
द्वात्रिंशद्दिवसेष्वेवं    चतुःषष्टिदिनेषु    च || 82 ||
text_mt: He should perform the worship of the eight eights if he is capable on a single day, / or over eight times eight days, or over sixteen days, / over thirty-two days, or over sixty-four days.

sanskrit_iast:
guruṇā  kārayeddevi   kramajñenāpareṇa   vā |
kramajñaścet svayaṃ kuryādvittaśāṭhyavivajītaḥ || 83 ||
meaning:
गुरुणा  कारयेद्देवि   क्रमज्ञेनापरेण   वा |
क्रमज्ञश्चेत् स्वयं कुर्याद्वित्तशाठ्यविवजीतः || 83 ||
text_mt: He should have it performed by a guru, O Goddess, or by another who knows the sequence; / if he knows the sequence himself, he should perform it, free from deceit regarding wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlāṣṭakantu  brahmādyāścāsitāṅgādibhairavāḥ |
maṅgalādyaiśca mithunairaṣṭabhiḥ śabditāḥ priye || 84 ||
meaning:
मूलाष्टकन्तु  ब्रह्माद्याश्चासिताङ्गादिभैरवाः |
मङ्गलाद्यैश्च मिथुनैरष्टभिः शब्दिताः प्रिये || 84 ||
text_mt: The primary eight are Brahmā and the others, and the Bhairavas beginning with Asitāṅga; / they are designated by the eight couples beginning with Maṅgalā, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlāṣṭakodbhavānīti prasiddhāni kulāgame |
akṣobhyādicatuḥṣaṣṭimithunāni samarcayet || 85 ||
meaning:
मूलाष्टकोद्भवानीति प्रसिद्धानि कुलागमे |
अक्षोभ्यादिचतुःषष्टिमिथुनानि समर्चयेत् || 85 ||
text_mt: Arising from the primary eight, thus known in the Kula tradition, / one should worship the sixty-four couples beginning with Akṣobhya,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktena    vidhānena   yathāvibhavavistaram |
kramalopaṃ  na  kurvīta  sveṣṭakāryārthasiddhaye || 86 ||
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तेन    विधानेन   यथाविभवविस्तरम् |
क्रमलोपं  न  कुर्वीत  स्वेष्टकार्यार्थसिद्धये || 86 ||
text_mt: by the previously taught rule, according to the extent of one's wealth; / he should not omit the sequence, for the accomplishment of the purpose of his desired aim.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpākṣatādyaiśca    matsyamāṃsāsavādibhiḥ |
bhakṣyabhojyādibhirnānāpadārthaiḥ  ṣaḍrasānvitaiḥ |
samyak  santoṣayeddevi  mithunānyatibhaktitaḥ || 87 ||
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पाक्षताद्यैश्च    मत्स्यमांसासवादिभिः |
भक्ष्यभोज्यादिभिर्नानापदार्थैः  षड्रसान्वितैः |
सम्यक्  सन्तोषयेद्देवि  मिथुनान्यतिभक्तितः || 87 ||
text_mt: With perfumes, flowers, unhusked barley grains, and the like, with fish, meat, fermented liquor, and the like, / with various dishes such as edibles and chewables endowed with the six tastes, / he should thoroughly satisfy the couples with great devotion, O Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
prauḍhāntollāsaparyantaṃ kuryāt śrīcakramambike |
evaṃ  yaḥ kurute  devi sakṛdaṣṭāṣṭakārcanam || 88 ||
meaning:
प्रौढान्तोल्लासपर्यन्तं कुर्यात् श्रीचक्रमम्बिके |
एवं  यः कुरुते  देवि सकृदष्टाष्टकार्चनम् || 88 ||
text_mt: Up to the stage of advanced exultation he should perform the Śrīcakra, O Ambikā; / he who thus, O Goddess, performs even once the worship of the eight eights,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādidevatābhiḥ   sa   pūjyate |
kiṃ punarmānavādyaiśca sākṣāt śiva ivāparaḥ || 89 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशादिदेवताभिः   स   पूज्यते |
किं पुनर्मानवाद्यैश्च साक्षात् शिव इवापरः || 89 ||
text_mt: is worshipped by the deities beginning with Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśa— / what then of human beings and the rest? He is visibly another Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
yadarcanāccatuḥṣaṣṭiyoginīgaṇasaṃstutaḥ         |
punarāvṛttirahito      nivasettava     sannidhau || 90 ||
meaning:
यदर्चनाच्चतुःषष्टियोगिनीगणसंस्तुतः         |
पुनरावृत्तिरहितो      निवसेत्तव     सन्निधौ || 90 ||
text_mt: From whose worship, praised by the troop of sixty-four yoginīs, / free from return, he shall dwell in your presence.

sanskrit_iast:
samastadevatāprītikāraṇaṃ          parameśvari |
asmāt paratarā pūjā nāsti satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 91 ||
meaning:
समस्तदेवताप्रीतिकारणं          परमेश्वरि |
अस्मात् परतरा पूजा नास्ति सत्यं न संशयः || 91 ||
text_mt: It is the cause of the delight of all the deities, O Supreme Mistress; / higher than this there is no worship, in truth, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyadevaṃvidhaṃ cakraṃ yo bhaktyāṣṭāṣṭakaṃ priye |
yajñadānatapastīrthavratakoṭiphalaṃ       labhet || 92 ||
meaning:
पश्यदेवंविधं चक्रं यो भक्त्याष्टाष्टकं प्रिये |
यज्ञदानतपस्तीर्थव्रतकोटिफलं       लभेत् || 92 ||
text_mt: He who with devotion beholds such a cakra of the eight eights, O beloved, / obtains the fruit of ten million sacrifices, gifts, austerities, holy fords, and observances.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā yaḥ kārayeddevi bhaktyāṣṭāṣṭakapūjanam |
catuḥsāgaraparyantāṃ  mahīṃ  śāsti na saṃśayaḥ || 93 ||
meaning:
राजा यः कारयेद्देवि भक्त्याष्टाष्टकपूजनम् |
चतुःसागरपर्यन्तां  महीं  शास्ति न संशयः || 93 ||
text_mt: A king who has the worship of the eight eights performed with devotion, O Goddess, / rules the earth as far as the four oceans; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkaṇṭhādīni  pañcāśanmithunāni samarcayet |
pūrvoktena vidhānena  kuleśvari vidhānavit || 94 ||
meaning:
श्रीकण्ठादीनि  पञ्चाशन्मिथुनानि समर्चयेत् |
पूर्वोक्तेन विधानेन  कुलेश्वरि विधानवित् || 94 ||
text_mt: One who knows the rite should worship the fifty couples beginning with Śrīkaṇṭha / according to the previously stated rule, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
svakāryaphalasiddhyarthaṃ vittaśāṭhyavivajītaḥ |
prauḍhāntollāsayuktāni mithunāni samarcayet || 95 ||
meaning:
स्वकार्यफलसिद्ध्यर्थं वित्तशाठ्यविवजीतः |
प्रौढान्तोल्लासयुक्तानि मिथुनानि समर्चयेत् || 95 ||
text_mt: Free from deceit regarding wealth, for the sake of attaining the fruit of his undertaking, / he should worship the couples accompanied by the advanced stage of ecstatic bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
santuṣṭāni prayacchanti sādhakāyepsitaṃ phalam |
avyāhatājñaḥ  sarvatra   pūjyate devavat priye |
tava   loke  vaseddevi   brahmādisurasaṃstutaḥ || 96 ||
meaning:
सन्तुष्टानि प्रयच्छन्ति साधकायेप्सितं फलम् |
अव्याहताज्ञः  सर्वत्र   पूज्यते देववत् प्रिये |
तव   लोके  वसेद्देवि   ब्रह्मादिसुरसंस्तुतः || 96 ||
text_mt: Satisfied, they bestow the desired fruit upon the practitioner. / With unhindered command everywhere, he is worshiped like a god, O beloved; / he dwells in your realm, O Goddess, praised by the gods headed by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
keśavādi gaṇeśādi kāmādi  mithunāni  ca |
śrīkaṇṭhādi samabhyarcya tatphalaṃ labhate dhruvam || 97 ||
meaning:
केशवादि गणेशादि कामादि  मिथुनानि  च |
श्रीकण्ठादि समभ्यर्च्य तत्फलं लभते ध्रुवम् || 97 ||
text_mt: Having thoroughly worshiped the couples beginning with Keśava, beginning with Gaṇeśa, / beginning with Kāma, and beginning with Śrīkaṇṭha, he surely obtains that fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
anugrahantu yaḥ kuryāt ḍākinyādisamarcane |
māse māse'thavā varṣe svajanmadivase priye || 98 ||
meaning:
अनुग्रहन्तु यः कुर्यात् डाकिन्यादिसमर्चने |
मासे मासेऽथवा वर्षे स्वजन्मदिवसे प्रिये || 98 ||
text_mt: Whoever performs the bestowal of grace in the worship of the ḍākinīs and others / month by month, or year by year, [or] on his own birthday, O beloved,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktena   vidhānena  yathāvibhavavistaram |
prauḍhāntollāsaparyantaṃ   toṣayettadvidhānavit || 99 ||
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तेन   विधानेन  यथाविभवविस्तरम् |
प्रौढान्तोल्लासपर्यन्तं   तोषयेत्तद्विधानवित् || 99 ||
text_mt: according to the previously stated rule, according to the extent of his wealth, / up to the advanced stage of ecstatic bliss, one who knows the rite should satisfy [them].

sanskrit_iast:
kurvantyanugrahaṃ  devi  santuṣṭāḥ  sarvadevatāḥ |
sarvopadrava    rahitaḥ  sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ || 100 ||
meaning:
कुर्वन्त्यनुग्रहं  देवि  सन्तुष्टाः  सर्वदेवताः |
सर्वोपद्रव    रहितः  सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्वितः || 100 ||
text_mt: All the deities, being pleased, bestow grace, O Goddess. / Free from all afflictions, endowed with all sovereignty,

sanskrit_iast:
loke'smin saṃstutaḥ sarvaiḥ sa jīveccharadāṃ śatam |
dehānte  samavāpnoti  tava  lokaṃ  na  saṃśayaḥ || 101 ||
meaning:
लोकेऽस्मिन् संस्तुतः सर्वैः स जीवेच्छरदां शतम् |
देहान्ते  समवाप्नोति  तव  लोकं  न  संशयः || 101 ||
text_mt: praised by all in this world, he lives for a hundred autumns; / at the end of the body, he attains your realm, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
dūtīyāgantu yaḥ kuryāt pūrvoktavidhinā priye |
nivīkalpena   cittena   navaśaktisamanvitaḥ || 102 ||
meaning:
दूतीयागन्तु यः कुर्यात् पूर्वोक्तविधिना प्रिये |
निवीकल्पेन   चित्तेन   नवशक्तिसमन्वितः || 102 ||
text_mt: Whoever performs the sacrifice of the female messenger according to the previously stated rule, O beloved, / with an unwavering mind, accompanied by the nine śaktis,

sanskrit_iast:
