varṣe   varṣe  catuḥṣaṣṭipīṭhārcanaphalaṃ   labhet |
ājñāsiddhirbhavettasya   devatāprītimāpnuyāt || 103 ||
meaning:
वर्षे   वर्षे  चतुःषष्टिपीठार्चनफलं   लभेत् |
आज्ञासिद्धिर्भवेत्तस्य   देवताप्रीतिमाप्नुयात् || 103 ||
text_mt: obtains year after year the fruit of worshiping the sixty-four sacred seats; / his command becomes effective, and he wins the favor of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
trikapūjāntu yaḥ kuryādicchājñānakriyātmikām |
āgamokteta     vidhinā    pūrvavettadvidhānavit || 104 ||
meaning:
त्रिकपूजान्तु यः कुर्यादिच्छाज्ञानक्रियात्मिकाम् |
आगमोक्तेत     विधिना    पूर्ववेत्तद्विधानवित् || 104 ||
text_mt: Whoever performs the worship of the triad consisting of will, knowledge, and action, / according to the rule declared in the Āgamas, as before, knowing that rite,

sanskrit_iast:
padārthaistoṣayet   samyak  yathāvibhavavistaram |
santuṣṭā    devatāstisraḥ    sarvakarmaphalapradāḥ |
deveśi  sādhakābhīṣṭaṃ  prayacchanti  na  saṃśayaḥ || 105 ||
meaning:
पदार्थैस्तोषयेत्   सम्यक्  यथाविभवविस्तरम् |
सन्तुष्टा    देवतास्तिस्रः    सर्वकर्मफलप्रदाः |
देवेशि  साधकाभीष्टं  प्रयच्छन्ति  न  संशयः || 105 ||
text_mt: should satisfy [them] properly with offerings according to the extent of his wealth. / Satisfied, the three deities, who grant the fruits of all rites, / bestow the practitioner's desired aim, O Goddess of the gods, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
ityādidevatāpūjāṃ     viśeṣadivaseṣu   yaḥ |
karoti śastravidhinā sa bhavedāvayoḥ priyaḥ || 106 ||
meaning:
इत्यादिदेवतापूजां     विशेषदिवसेषु   यः |
करोति शस्त्रविधिना स भवेदावयोः प्रियः || 106 ||
text_mt: Whoever performs worship of deities such as these on special days / according to the scriptural rule becomes dear to both of us.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīcakraṃ  kauliko   mohādviśeṣadivaseṣu  yaḥ |
na karoti samarthaḥ san sa bhaved yoginīpaśuḥ || 107 ||
meaning:
श्रीचक्रं  कौलिको   मोहाद्विशेषदिवसेषु  यः |
न करोति समर्थः सन् स भवेद् योगिनीपशुः || 107 ||
text_mt: A Kaulika who, being capable, out of delusion does not make / a Śrīcakra on special days becomes an uninitiated bound soul to the yoginīs.

sanskrit_iast:
kulapūjāṃ vinā  cakre  nādhikāraḥ kathañcana |
kulapūjāṃ suniyataṃ yaḥ karoti sa kaulikaḥ || 108 ||
meaning:
कुलपूजां विना  चक्रे  नाधिकारः कथञ्चन |
कुलपूजां सुनियतं यः करोति स कौलिकः || 108 ||
text_mt: Without the worship of Kula, there is no qualification whatsoever regarding the cakra. / One who regularly performs the worship of Kula is a Kaulika.

sanskrit_iast:
vinā  mantreṇa  pūjā  ceddevatā  na  prasīdati |
kulapūjāṃ suniyataṃ yaḥ karoti hi kaulikaḥ |
kuleśi   sarvadāpnoti   yoginīvīramelanam || 109 ||
meaning:
विना  मन्त्रेण  पूजा  चेद्देवता  न  प्रसीदति |
कुलपूजां सुनियतं यः करोति हि कौलिकः |
कुलेशि   सर्वदाप्नोति   योगिनीवीरमेलनम् || 109 ||
text_mt: If worship is without a mantra, the deity is not pleased. / The Kaulika who regularly performs the worship of Kula, / O Mistress of Kula, always attains communion with the yoginīs and heroes.

sanskrit_iast:
nīco'pi vā sakṛdbhaktyā kārayed yaḥ kulārcanam |
sa sadgatimavāpnoti kimutānye dvijātayaḥ || 110 ||
meaning:
नीचोऽपि वा सकृद्भक्त्या कारयेद् यः कुलार्चनम् |
स सद्गतिमवाप्नोति किमुतान्ये द्विजातयः || 110 ||
text_mt: Even a low-born person who performs worship according to Kula even once with devotion / attains the good path; what then to say of the twice-born?

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā |
kulapūjārato    bhūyādabhīṣṭaphalasiddhaye || 111 ||
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन सर्वावस्थासु सर्वदा |
कुलपूजारतो    भूयादभीष्टफलसिद्धये || 111 ||
text_mt: Therefore, with every effort, in all states, at all times, / one should be devoted to the worship of Kula for the attainment of desired fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
kulapūjādhiko yajñaḥ kulapūjādhikaṃ vratam |
kulapūjādhikaṃ  tīrthaṃ  kulapūjādhikaṃ tapaḥ || 112 ||
meaning:
कुलपूजाधिको यज्ञः कुलपूजाधिकं व्रतम् |
कुलपूजाधिकं  तीर्थं  कुलपूजाधिकं तपः || 112 ||
text_mt: No sacrifice is higher than Kula worship; no vow is higher than Kula worship; / no pilgrimage is higher than Kula worship; no asceticism is higher than Kula worship;

sanskrit_iast:
kulapūjādhikaṃ dānaṃ  kulapūjādhikā kriyā |
kulapūjādhikaṃ jñānaṃ kulapūjādhikaṃ  sukham || 113 ||
meaning:
कुलपूजाधिकं दानं  कुलपूजाधिका क्रिया |
कुलपूजाधिकं ज्ञानं कुलपूजाधिकं  सुखम् || 113 ||
text_mt: no gift is higher than Kula worship; no ritual is higher than Kula worship; / no knowledge is higher than Kula worship; no happiness is higher than Kula worship;

sanskrit_iast:
kulapūjādhiko dharmaḥ kulapūjādhikaṃ phalam |
kulapūjādhikaṃ  dhyānaṃ kulapūjādhikaṃ  mahaḥ || 114 ||
meaning:
कुलपूजाधिको धर्मः कुलपूजाधिकं फलम् |
कुलपूजाधिकं  ध्यानं कुलपूजाधिकं  महः || 114 ||
text_mt: no duty is higher than Kula worship; no fruit is higher than Kula worship; / no meditation is higher than Kula worship; no splendour is higher than Kula worship;

sanskrit_iast:
kulapūjādhiko yogaḥ kulapūjādhikā gatiḥ |
kulapūjādhikaṃ bhāgyaṃ kulapūjādhikā'rcanā || 115 ||
meaning:
कुलपूजाधिको योगः कुलपूजाधिका गतिः |
कुलपूजाधिकं भाग्यं कुलपूजाधिकाऽर्चना || 115 ||
text_mt: no yoga is higher than Kula worship; no destination is higher than Kula worship; / no fortune is higher than Kula worship; no worship is higher than Kula worship.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti nāsti punarnāsti tvāṃ śape kulanāyike |
bahunātra   kimuktena   rahasyaṃ   śṛṇu  pārvati || 116 ||
meaning:
नास्ति नास्ति पुनर्नास्ति त्वां शपे कुलनायिके |
बहुनात्र   किमुक्तेन   रहस्यं   शृणु  पार्वति || 116 ||
text_mt: There is none, there is none, again there is none, I swear by you, O leader of Kula! / What is the use of much said here? Hear the secret, O Pārvatī!

sanskrit_iast:
vedaśāstroktamārgeṇa   kulapūjāṃ  karoti  yaḥ |
tatsamīpe sthitaṃ māṃ tvāṃ viddhi nānyatra bhāminī |
idaṃ  satyamidaṃ  satyaṃ satyaṃ  satyaṃ  na  saṃśayaḥ || 117 ||
meaning:
वेदशास्त्रोक्तमार्गेण   कुलपूजां  करोति  यः |
तत्समीपे स्थितं मां त्वां विद्धि नान्यत्र भामिनी |
इदं  सत्यमिदं  सत्यं सत्यं  सत्यं  न  संशयः || 117 ||
text_mt: Whoever performs Kula worship by the path taught in the Vedas and scriptures— / know that I and you dwell near him, nowhere else, O passionate lady! / This is true, this is true, true, true, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
khabhūmidigjalagirivanasarvacarāḥ    priye |
sahasrakoṭiyoginyastāvanto  bhairavā api |
niyuktā hi mayā devi kulasaṃrakṣaṇāya ca || 118 ||
meaning:
खभूमिदिग्जलगिरिवनसर्वचराः    प्रिये |
सहस्रकोटियोगिन्यस्तावन्तो  भैरवा अपि |
नियुक्ता हि मया देवि कुलसंरक्षणाय च || 118 ||
text_mt: Moving in the sky, earth, directions, water, mountains, and forests, everywhere, O beloved, / thousands of crores of yoginīs, and just as many Bhairavas, / have indeed been appointed by me, O Goddess, for the protection of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
divase  divase  sarve  pārvati muditānanāḥ |
sādhakāneva vīkṣante svasvapūjanalipsayā || 119 ||
meaning:
दिवसे  दिवसे  सर्वे  पार्वति मुदिताननाः |
साधकानेव वीक्षन्ते स्वस्वपूजनलिप्सया || 119 ||
text_mt: Day after day, O Pārvatī, all of them, with joyful faces, / look out for practitioners with the desire for their own worship.

sanskrit_iast:
apūjitāstu  vighnanti  pālayanti  supūjitāḥ |
gurubhaktān sadācārān guhyadharmān sadāśivān || 120 ||
meaning:
अपूजितास्तु  विघ्नन्ति  पालयन्ति  सुपूजिताः |
गुरुभक्तान् सदाचारान् गुह्यधर्मान् सदाशिवान् || 120 ||
text_mt: Unworshiped, they obstruct; well-worshiped, they protect / those devoted to the guru, of good conduct, of secret duty, who are Sadāśivas.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktihīnān durācārān nāśayanti prakāśakān |
śrīcakre  saṃsmarettasmād  yoginībhairavān  priye || 121 ||
meaning:
भक्तिहीनान् दुराचारान् नाशयन्ति प्रकाशकान् |
श्रीचक्रे  संस्मरेत्तस्माद्  योगिनीभैरवान्  प्रिये || 121 ||
text_mt: Lacking devotion, of bad conduct, and revealers [of secrets], they destroy; / therefore, one should contemplate the yoginīs and Bhairavas in the Śrīcakra, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
na smared yadi mūḍhātmā yoginīnāṃ bhavet paśuḥ |
tasmāt  śrīcakramadhye tu saṃsmaret  sarvadevatāḥ || 122 ||
meaning:
न स्मरेद् यदि मूढात्मा योगिनीनां भवेत् पशुः |
तस्मात्  श्रीचक्रमध्ये तु संस्मरेत्  सर्वदेवताः || 122 ||
text_mt: If a foolish soul does not remember [them], he becomes an uninitiated bound soul to the yoginīs; / therefore, one should contemplate all the deities within the Śrīcakra.

sanskrit_iast:
anugṛhṇanti  deveśi sādhakān  nātra saṃśayaḥ |
anugrahantu  vakṣyāmi  śṛṇu  devi  yathākramam || 123 ||
meaning:
अनुगृह्णन्ति  देवेशि साधकान्  नात्र संशयः |
अनुग्रहन्तु  वक्ष्यामि  शृणु  देवि  यथाक्रमम् || 123 ||
text_mt: They bestow grace upon the practitioners, O Goddess of the gods, there is no doubt here. / I shall explain the bestowal of grace, hear [it] in due order, O Goddess:

sanskrit_iast:
ātmano'nugrahārthaṃ   vā  parārthaṃ  śreṣṭhamuttamam |
śucidravyasamāyuktaṃ      cakrapūjāsamanvitam || 124 ||
meaning:
आत्मनोऽनुग्रहार्थं   वा  परार्थं  श्रेष्ठमुत्तमम् |
शुचिद्रव्यसमायुक्तं      चक्रपूजासमन्वितम् || 124 ||
text_mt: For the bestowal of grace upon oneself or upon another, excellent and supreme, / equipped with pure substances, accompanied by the worship of the cakra,

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā homapātraṃ pṛthaka pṛthak |
prapūjayecca    varṇasthāḥ  sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 125 ||
meaning:
सर्वेषां दक्षिणां दत्त्वा होमपात्रं पृथक पृथक् |
प्रपूजयेच्च    वर्णस्थाः  सर्वाभरणभूषिताः || 125 ||
text_mt: having given a sacrificial fee to all, each separately, and a vessel for the fire offering, / one should worship [the śaktis] situated in the phonemes, adorned with all ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
harṣānandasvayaṃyuktāḥ prasannāśca pṛthak pṛthak |
pāyasājyaudanairyuktairnaivedyairbhaktisaṃyutaiḥ       || 126 ||
meaning:
हर्षानन्दस्वयंयुक्ताः प्रसन्नाश्च पृथक् पृथक् |
पायसाज्यौदनैर्युक्तैर्नैवेद्यैर्भक्तिसंयुतैः       || 126 ||
text_mt: personally endowed with joy and bliss, and pleased, each separately, / with devotional food offerings consisting of milk-rice, clarified butter, and cooked rice.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ samyagarcayitvā gaṇeśvaram |
hasakha phreṃ hesauṃ(hsauṃ) ḍāṃ ḍīṃ ḍamalavarayūṃ tataḥ || 127 ||
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पादिभिः सम्यगर्चयित्वा गणेश्वरम् |
हसख फ्रें हेसौं(ह्सौं) डां डीं डमलवरयूं ततः || 127 ||
text_mt: Having properly worshiped the Lord of Gaṇas with perfumes, flowers, and the like, / then [with] 'hasakha phreṃ hesauṃ ḍāṃ ḍīṃ ḍamalavarayūṃ',

sanskrit_iast:
śrīpādukāṃ hesau(hsau)miti ca hasakhaphreṃ puṭantataḥ |
saṅkalpya   manaso'bhīṣṭaṃ  madhuratritayaḥ  priye || 128 ||
meaning:
श्रीपादुकां हेसौ(ह्सौ)मिति च हसखफ्रें पुटन्ततः |
सङ्कल्प्य   मनसोऽभीष्टं  मधुरत्रितयः  प्रिये || 128 ||
text_mt: and the venerable sandals [with] 'hesauṃ', and enclosed by 'hasakhaphreṃ', / having resolved upon the heart's desire with the three sweets, O beloved,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ samyagarcayitvā pṛthak pṛthak |
pūjayitvepsitān kāmān prārthayet kamalānane || 129 ||
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पादिभिः सम्यगर्चयित्वा पृथक् पृथक् |
पूजयित्वेप्सितान् कामान् प्रार्थयेत् कमलानने || 129 ||
text_mt: having properly worshiped each separately with perfumes, flowers, and the like, / having worshiped, one should ask for the desired wishes, O lotus-faced one.

sanskrit_iast:
īpsitāni ca sarvāṇi sādhako  labhate  varam |
ātmanaśca  parasyāpi rakṣārthaṃ pūjayet priye || 130 ||
meaning:
ईप्सितानि च सर्वाणि साधको  लभते  वरम् |
आत्मनश्च  परस्यापि रक्षार्थं पूजयेत् प्रिये || 130 ||
text_mt: And the practitioner obtains all his desired wishes as a boon. / One should worship for the protection of oneself and of another as well, O beloved,

sanskrit_iast:
rogāṇāṃ  nāśanārthañca  yathātra  putrasiddhaye |
vaśyārthaṃ  maṅgalārthañca   dharmakarmārthasiddhaye || 131 ||
meaning:
रोगाणां  नाशनार्थञ्च  यथात्र  पुत्रसिद्धये |
वश्यार्थं  मङ्गलार्थञ्च   धर्मकर्मार्थसिद्धये || 131 ||
text_mt: as well as for the destruction of diseases, here for the attainment of a son, / for subjugation, for auspiciousness, and for the attainment of the goals of righteous action.

sanskrit_iast:
saptāhaṃ   pūjayeddevi  caturddaśadināni   ca |
ekaviṃśadinānyatra  labhate cepsitaṃ phalam || 132 ||
meaning:
सप्ताहं   पूजयेद्देवि  चतुर्द्दशदिनानि   च |
एकविंशदिनान्यत्र  लभते चेप्सितं फलम् || 132 ||
text_mt: One should worship for seven days, O Goddess, or fourteen days, / or twenty-one days here, and one obtains the desired fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāñca  pṛthag dadyādvastrabhūṣāṅgurīyakam |
kulāṣṭakasamāyuktaṃ    catuḥṣaṣṭisamanvitam || 133 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणाञ्च  पृथग् दद्याद्वस्त्रभूषाङ्गुरीयकम् |
कुलाष्टकसमायुक्तं    चतुःषष्टिसमन्वितम् || 133 ||
text_mt: And one should give a separate fee of garments, ornaments, and a ring, / joined with the eight Kulas, accompanied by the sixty-four [deities].

sanskrit_iast:
acītañca   prayatnena   siddhirbhavatyanekaśaḥ |
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥ || 134 ||
meaning:
अचीतञ्च   प्रयत्नेन   सिद्धिर्भवत्यनेकशः |
वित्तशाठ्यं न कुर्वीत यदीच्छेत् सिद्धिमात्मनः || 134 ||
text_mt: Worshiped with diligence, manifold success arises; / one should not practice deceit regarding wealth if one desires success for oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ  ṣaṭkaṃ  samākhyātamanugrahaṃ   varānane |
acītavyaṃ prayatnena sādhakaiḥ sveṣṭasiddhaye || 135 ||
meaning:
एवं  षट्कं  समाख्यातमनुग्रहं   वरानने |
अचीतव्यं प्रयत्नेन साधकैः स्वेष्टसिद्धये || 135 ||
text_mt: Thus the group of six has been proclaimed as an act of grace, O lovely-faced one; / it must be gathered with effort by practitioners to attain their desired success.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvaiva pūjayedetā ḍākinyādyā varānane |
saṃpūjya saptamīṃ devīṃ pūjayet sarvasiddhaye || 136 ||
meaning:
ध्यात्वैव पूजयेदेता डाकिन्याद्या वरानने |
संपूज्य सप्तमीं देवीं पूजयेत् सर्वसिद्धये || 136 ||
text_mt: Only after meditating should one worship these [goddesses] beginning with Ḍākinī, O lovely-faced one; / having worshipped the seventh goddess, one should worship for all accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktidehasamutpannaṃ     śaktinirmālyabhojane |
svavargeṇa   samāyuktā  dattanirmālyamityapi |
pratigṛhṇayugaṃ svāhā iti nirmālyasarjanam || 137 ||
meaning:
शक्तिदेहसमुत्पन्नं     शक्तिनिर्माल्यभोजने |
स्ववर्गेण   समायुक्ता  दत्तनिर्माल्यमित्यपि |
प्रतिगृह्णयुगं स्वाहा इति निर्माल्यसर्जनम् || 137 ||
text_mt: Arising from the body of Śakti, for the consumption of the remnants of Śakti, / united with their own group, saying "Accept, accept the offered remnants, svāhā"—such is the disposal of remnants.

sanskrit_iast:
ḍākinī sarpavadanā vittajā jvalanaprabhā |
kamaṇḍaluṃ karttṛkāñca dhārayantī varapradā || 138 ||
meaning:
डाकिनी सर्पवदना वित्तजा ज्वलनप्रभा |
कमण्डलुं कर्त्तृकाञ्च धारयन्ती वरप्रदा || 138 ||
text_mt: Ḍākinī has a serpent's face, is born of wealth, and has the radiance of fire; / holding a water-pot and a chopper, she is the granter of boons.

sanskrit_iast:
ulūkavadanā devī rākiṇī nīlasannibhā |
khaḍgakheṭakasaṃyuktā  sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā || 139 ||
meaning:
उलूकवदना देवी राकिणी नीलसन्निभा |
खड्गखेटकसंयुक्ता  सर्वालङ्कारभूषिता || 139 ||
text_mt: The goddess Rākiṇī has an owl's face and resembles a dark-blue sapphire; / equipped with a sword and shield, she is adorned with every ornament.

sanskrit_iast:
lākinī śrīkapālāḍhyā pāśāṃkuśadharā satī |
pāṭalīpuṣpasaṅkāśā        sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā || 140 ||
meaning:
लाकिनी श्रीकपालाढ्या पाशांकुशधरा सती |
पाटलीपुष्पसङ्काशा        सर्वाभरणभूषिता || 140 ||
text_mt: Lākinī is endowed with a glorious skull-bowl, holding a noose and a goad, the chaste one; / resembling the trumpet-flower, she is adorned with all ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
kākinī hayavaktrā ca māṇikyasadṛśaprabhā |
trimukhīṃ  muṇḍasaṃyuktā  siddhidā sarvaśobhanā || 141 ||
meaning:
काकिनी हयवक्त्रा च माणिक्यसदृशप्रभा |
त्रिमुखीं  मुण्डसंयुक्ता  सिद्धिदा सर्वशोभना || 141 ||
text_mt: And Kākinī has a horse's face and a lustre like a ruby; / three-faced, accompanied by a severed head, the granter of success, entirely auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
śākinī tvañjanaprakhyā mārjārāsyā suśobhanā |
kuliśañca tathā daṇḍaṃ  dhārayanti  śucismitā || 142 ||
meaning:
शाकिनी त्वञ्जनप्रख्या मार्जारास्या सुशोभना |
कुलिशञ्च तथा दण्डं  धारयन्ति  शुचिस्मिता || 142 ||
text_mt: Śākinī indeed has the appearance of collyrium, a cat's face, exceedingly splendid; / holding a thunderbolt and a staff, smiling purely.

sanskrit_iast:
hākinī ṛkṣavadanā  nīlanīradasannibhā |
kapālaśūlahastā ca kheṭakairupaśobhitā |
ekadvitricatuḥpañcaṣaṇmukhā  sarabhābhayā || 143 ||
meaning:
हाकिनी ऋक्षवदना  नीलनीरदसन्निभा |
कपालशूलहस्ता च खेटकैरुपशोभिता |
एकद्वित्रिचतुःपञ्चषण्मुखा  सरभाभया || 143 ||
text_mt: Hākinī has a bear's face and resembles a dark blue-black cloud; / with a skull-bowl and trident in hand, adorned with shields, / having one, two, three, four, five, or six faces, terrible, granting fearlessness.

sanskrit_iast:
iti  te  kathitaṃ  kiñcidviśeṣadivasārcanam |
samāsena kuleśāni kimbhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 144 ||
meaning:
इति  ते  कथितं  किञ्चिद्विशेषदिवसार्चनम् |
समासेन कुलेशानि किम्भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि || 144 ||
text_mt: Thus has been briefly told to you something of the worship on special days, / O Mistress of Kula; what more do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast: athaikādaśollāsaḥ
meaning: अथैकादशोल्लासः

sanskrit_iast:
śrī devyuvāca
kuleśa  śrotumicchāmi  sarvalokaikapūjita |
kulācārakramaṃ  deva  vada  me karuṇānidhe || 1 ||
meaning:
श्री देव्युवाच
कुलेश  श्रोतुमिच्छामि  सर्वलोकैकपूजित |
कुलाचारक्रमं  देव  वद  मे करुणानिधे || 1 ||
text_mt: The holy Goddess said: / O Lord of Kula, I wish to hear, O you who alone are worshipped by all the worlds; / tell me, O God, O treasure of compassion, the sequence of the conduct of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
tasya  śravaṇamātreṇa   paśupāśaiḥ  pramucyate || 2 ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि |
तस्य  श्रवणमात्रेण   पशुपाशैः  प्रमुच्यते || 2 ||
text_mt: The Lord said: / Hear, O Goddess, I shall proclaim what you ask of me; / merely by hearing it, one is released from the bonds of the uninitiated bound soul.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi ceddīkṣito jyeṣṭhaḥ kulapūjādivajītaḥ |
tatkaniṣṭhaḥ kramajñaścet kulapūjāṃ samācaret || 3 ||
meaning:
यदि चेद्दीक्षितो ज्येष्ठः कुलपूजादिवजीतः |
तत्कनिष्ठः क्रमज्ञश्चेत् कुलपूजां समाचरेत् || 3 ||
text_mt: If a senior [initiate] who is initiated is devoid of Kula worship and the like, / and a junior to him knows the sequence, he may perform Kula worship.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsamīpaṃ  tato  gatvā namaskṛtya guruṃ yathā |
tasmai nivedya tatsarvaṃ  śeṣa  bhuñjīta  pārvatī || 4 ||
meaning:
तत्समीपं  ततो  गत्वा नमस्कृत्य गुरुं यथा |
तस्मै निवेद्य तत्सर्वं  शेष  भुञ्जीत  पार्वती || 4 ||
text_mt: Then, having approached him and bowed as to a guru, / having offered all that to him, one should consume the remainder, O Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāmadhye  gurau jyeṣṭhe pūjye  vāpi samāgate |
natvā  brūyāt   sthitaṃ  śiṣṭamācarettadanujñayā || 5 ||
meaning:
पूजामध्ये  गुरौ ज्येष्ठे पूज्ये  वापि समागते |
नत्वा  ब्रूयात्   स्थितं  शिष्टमाचरेत्तदनुज्ञया || 5 ||
text_mt: If, in the midst of worship, a guru, an elder, or a venerable person arrives, / having bowed, one should inform [him of what is] established, and perform the rest with his permission.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhasya ca kaniṣṭhasya śiṣyāvekatra saṃsthitau |
tatra    pūrvavadācāraḥ  kathitaḥ   kulanāyike || 6 ||
meaning:
ज्येष्ठस्य च कनिष्ठस्य शिष्यावेकत्र संस्थितौ |
तत्र    पूर्ववदाचारः  कथितः   कुलनायिके || 6 ||
text_mt: And if the disciples of a senior and of a junior are seated together, / the practice there is declared to be as before, O leader of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñātakaulike  prāpte  paurvāparyantu  cintayet |
smṛtvā svasya guruṃ devi svasya mārgeṇa tarpayet || 7 ||
meaning:
अज्ञातकौलिके  प्राप्ते  पौर्वापर्यन्तु  चिन्तयेत् |
स्मृत्वा स्वस्य गुरुं देवि स्वस्य मार्गेण तर्पयेत् || 7 ||
text_mt: When an unknown Kaulika has arrived, one should consider seniority and juniority; / remembering one's own guru, O Goddess, one should satisfy [him] according to one's own path.

sanskrit_iast:
nityārcanaṃ   dine   kuryādrātrau  naimittikārcanam |
ubhayoḥ kāmyakarmāṇi ceti śāstrasya nirṇayaḥ || 8 ||
meaning:
नित्यार्चनं   दिने   कुर्याद्रात्रौ  नैमित्तिकार्चनम् |
उभयोः काम्यकर्माणि चेति शास्त्रस्य निर्णयः || 8 ||
text_mt: One should perform daily worship by day, and occasional worship at night; / and rites for specific desires during both: such is the determination of the scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
asnātvā'nāsanastho vā bhuktvā vā pralapannapi |
gandhapuṣpākṣatā         kalpavastrādyairanalaṃkṛtaḥ |
avinyastaśarīro  vā  kulapūjāṃ  na  cācaret || 9 ||
meaning:
अस्नात्वाऽनासनस्थो वा भुक्त्वा वा प्रलपन्नपि |
गन्धपुष्पाक्षता         कल्पवस्त्राद्यैरनलंकृतः |
अविन्यस्तशरीरो  वा  कुलपूजां  न  चाचरेत् || 9 ||
text_mt: Without bathing, or without sitting on a seat, or having eaten, or even chattering, / unadorned with perfume, flowers, unbroken rice, suitable garments, and the like, / or without having performed nyāsa on the body, one must not perform Kula worship.

sanskrit_iast:
vinā mantreṇa  yā  pūjā  vinā māṃsena tarpaṇam |
vinā śaktyā tu yatpānaṃ niṣphalaṃ kathitaṃ priye || 10 ||
meaning:
विना मन्त्रेण  या  पूजा  विना मांसेन तर्पणम् |
विना शक्त्या तु यत्पानं निष्फलं कथितं प्रिये || 10 ||
text_mt: Worship without mantra, libation without meat, / and drinking without a Śakti is declared fruitless, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīcakrameko  vā  kuryādekapātrantu  nārcayet |
nārcayedekahastena     na    pibedekapāṇinā || 11 ||
meaning:
श्रीचक्रमेको  वा  कुर्यादेकपात्रन्तु  नार्चयेत् |
नार्चयेदेकहस्तेन     न    पिबेदेकपाणिना || 11 ||
text_mt: One may form the Śrīcakra alone, but one should not worship in a single vessel; / one should not worship with one hand, nor should one drink with a single hand.

sanskrit_iast:
matsyamāṃsāsavairddevi  nārcayet  paśusannidhau |
praṇamya praviśeccakraṃ vinirgacchetpraṇamya ca || 12 ||
meaning:
मत्स्यमांसासवैर्द्देवि  नार्चयेत्  पशुसन्निधौ |
प्रणम्य प्रविशेच्चक्रं विनिर्गच्छेत्प्रणम्य च || 12 ||
text_mt: One should not worship with fish, meat, and fermented liquor in the presence of an uninitiated bound soul, O Goddess; / having bowed, one should enter the cakra, and having bowed, one should depart.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīcakre  nāsane  tiṣṭhenna  ca  vīrāsane   priye |
śrīcakradarśane    devi   netrayoḥ   pāpanāśanam |
tannāsti ced vraṇadvandvaṃ kaulikasyākṣiyugmakam || 13 ||
meaning:
श्रीचक्रे  नासने  तिष्ठेन्न  च  वीरासने   प्रिये |
श्रीचक्रदर्शने    देवि   नेत्रयोः   पापनाशनम् |
तन्नास्ति चेद् व्रणद्वन्द्वं कौलिकस्याक्षियुग्मकम् || 13 ||
text_mt: One should not sit on a [common] seat, nor in the hero's posture, within the Śrīcakra, O beloved; / at the sight of the Śrīcakra, O Goddess, sin in the eyes is destroyed; / if that is absent, a pair of sores are the Kaulika's two eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
anācārān sadācārān cakrasthān śaktikaulikān |
śivagaurīdhiyā    devi   bhāvayennāvamānayet || 14 ||
meaning:
अनाचारान् सदाचारान् चक्रस्थान् शक्तिकौलिकान् |
शिवगौरीधिया    देवि   भावयेन्नावमानयेत् || 14 ||
text_mt: Those of improper conduct or those of good conduct, those stationed in the cakra, whether Śaktis or Kaulikas, / one should contemplate with the thought of Śiva and Gaurī, O Goddess; one must not disrespect them.

sanskrit_iast:
kulācāryagṛhaṃ  gatvā  bhaktyā  pāpaviśuddhaye |
yācedamṛtañcānnañca    tadabhāve   jalaṃ   pibet || 15 ||
meaning:
कुलाचार्यगृहं  गत्वा  भक्त्या  पापविशुद्धये |
याचेदमृतञ्चान्नञ्च    तदभावे   जलं   पिबेत् || 15 ||
text_mt: Having gone to the house of a Kula master with devotion for the purification of sins, / one should ask for nectar and food; in its absence, one should drink water.

sanskrit_iast:
kulācāryeṇa tacchaktyā  dattaṃ pātrañca bhaktitaḥ |
namaskṛtya  tu  gṛhṇīyādanyathā  narakaṃ vrajet || 16 ||
meaning:
कुलाचार्येण तच्छक्त्या  दत्तं पात्रञ्च भक्तितः |
नमस्कृत्य  तु  गृह्णीयादन्यथा  नरकं व्रजेत् || 16 ||
text_mt: A cup given with devotion by the Kula master and by his Śakti / one should receive only after bowing; otherwise, one goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
asnātvā vāpyabhaktyā vā lobhādvāpi kuleśvari |
yaḥ  seveta   kuladravyaṃ   dāridryaṃ  samavāpnuyāt || 17 ||
meaning:
अस्नात्वा वाप्यभक्त्या वा लोभाद्वापि कुलेश्वरि |
यः  सेवेत   कुलद्रव्यं   दारिद्र्यं  समवाप्नुयात् || 17 ||
text_mt: Whether without bathing, or without devotion, or out of greed, O Mistress of Kula, / whoever consumes a substance of Kula shall incur poverty.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣṇīṣī kañcukī nagno muktakeśo gaṇāvṛtaḥ |
vyagro ruṣṭo  vivādī ca na seveta kulāmṛtam || 18 ||
meaning:
उष्णीषी कञ्चुकी नग्नो मुक्तकेशो गणावृतः |
व्यग्रो रुष्टो  विवादी च न सेवेत कुलामृतम् || 18 ||
text_mt: Wearing a turban, wearing a jacket, naked, with dishevelled hair, surrounded by a crowd, / distracted, angry, or quarrelsome, one must not consume the nectar of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
yogāmṛtena   niṣṭhīvānmadyabhāṇḍaparibhramāt |
ūrdhva nālena pānācca devatāśāpamāpnuyāt || 19 ||
meaning:
योगामृतेन   निष्ठीवान्मद्यभाण्डपरिभ्रमात् |
ऊर्ध्व नालेन पानाच्च देवताशापमाप्नुयात् || 19 ||
text_mt: From spitting out the nectar of yoga, from moving about with the vessel of liquor, / and from drinking through an upward pipe, one incurs the curse of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāsane  niviṣṭastu  bhuñjānastvekabhājane |
ekapātre  pibeddravyaṃ  te  yānti narakaṃ priye || 20 ||
meaning:
एकासने  निविष्टस्तु  भुञ्जानस्त्वेकभाजने |
एकपात्रे  पिबेद्द्रव्यं  ते  यान्ति नरकं प्रिये || 20 ||
text_mt: Seated on a single seat, eating from a single dish, / or drinking the substance from a single cup, they go to hell, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ  seveta  kuladravyamekagrāme  sthite  gurau |
tatkulajñe  ca  tatputre  svajeṣṭhe  kuladeśike |
vinānujñāṃ  maheśāni  so'kṣayaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 21 ||
meaning:
यः  सेवेत  कुलद्रव्यमेकग्रामे  स्थिते  गुरौ |
तत्कुलज्ञे  च  तत्पुत्रे  स्वजेष्ठे  कुलदेशिके |
विनानुज्ञां  महेशानि  सोऽक्षयं नरकं व्रजेत् || 21 ||
text_mt: Whoever consumes a substance of Kula while his guru is in the same village, / or his [guru's] son who knows Kula, or his own elder who is a Kula guru, / without their permission, O Great Ruler, goes to everlasting hell.

sanskrit_iast:
ucchiṣṭo na spṛśeccakre kuladravyāṇi pārvati |
bahiḥprakṣālya ca karau kuladravyāṇi dāpayet || 22 ||
meaning:
उच्छिष्टो न स्पृशेच्चक्रे कुलद्रव्याणि पार्वति |
बहिःप्रक्षाल्य च करौ कुलद्रव्याणि दापयेत् || 22 ||
text_mt: Being impure with food remnants, one must not touch the substances of Kula in the cakra, O Pārvatī; / having washed both hands outside, one should have the substances of Kula offered.

sanskrit_iast:
madyabhāṇḍaṃ  samudhṛtca  na  pātraṃ  pūrayet priye |
bhogapātraṃ   surākuṇḍe  nikṣipenna  kadācana || 23 ||
meaning:
मद्यभाण्डं  समुधृत्च  न  पात्रं  पूरयेत् प्रिये |
भोगपात्रं   सुराकुण्डे  निक्षिपेन्न  कदाचन || 23 ||
text_mt: Having lifted the vessel of liquor, one should not fill a cup, O beloved; / one must never throw a drinking-cup into the liquor-basin.

sanskrit_iast:
cakramadhye   śucidhiyā  karaprakṣālanādikam |
yaḥ karoti hi  mūḍhātmā sa bhavedāpadāmpadam || 24 ||
meaning:
चक्रमध्ये   शुचिधिया  करप्रक्षालनादिकम् |
यः करोति हि  मूढात्मा स भवेदापदाम्पदम् || 24 ||
text_mt: In the midst of the cakra, with a mind regarding purity, washing hands and the like, / whatever foolish person does so indeed becomes an abode of misfortunes.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣṭhīvanaṃ    malaṃ    mūtramadhovāyuvisarjanam |
śrīcakramadhye yaḥ kuryāt sa bhaved yoginīpaśuḥ || 25 ||
meaning:
निष्ठीवनं    मलं    मूत्रमधोवायुविसर्जनम् |
श्रीचक्रमध्ये यः कुर्यात् स भवेद् योगिनीपशुः || 25 ||
text_mt: Spitting, voiding feces or urine, or passing wind downward / whoever does in the midst of the Śrīcakra becomes a sacrificial beast of the yoginīs.

sanskrit_iast:
cakramadhye  ghaṭe  bhagne  pātre  ca patite bhuvi |
dīpanāśe ca śāntyarthaṃ śrīcakraṃ kārayet priye || 26 ||
meaning:
चक्रमध्ये  घटे  भग्ने  पात्रे  च पतिते भुवि |
दीपनाशे च शान्त्यर्थं श्रीचक्रं कारयेत् प्रिये || 26 ||
text_mt: When a jar is broken in the midst of the cakra, or a cup has fallen to the ground, / or a lamp is extinguished, one should perform the Śrīcakra for pacification, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
mattā japanti dhyāyanti stuvanti praṇamanti ca |
bodhayanti ca pṛcchanti nandanti jñāninaḥ priye || 27 ||
meaning:
मत्ता जपन्ति ध्यायन्ति स्तुवन्ति प्रणमन्ति च |
बोधयन्ति च पृच्छन्ति नन्दन्ति ज्ञानिनः प्रिये || 27 ||
text_mt: Intoxicated, the wise recite mantras, meditate, praise, and bow; / they awaken, inquire, and rejoice, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
mattā bhramanti garjanti  hasanti  vivadanti ca |
rudanti striyamicchanti nindantyajñāninaḥ priye || 28 ||
meaning:
मत्ता भ्रमन्ति गर्जन्ति  हसन्ति  विवदन्ति च |
रुदन्ति स्त्रियमिच्छन्ति निन्दन्त्यज्ञानिनः प्रिये || 28 ||
text_mt: Intoxicated, the ignorant wander, roar, laugh, and quarrel; / they weep, desire women, and revile, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
parihāsaṃ  pralāpañca   vitaṇḍāṃ  bahubhāṣitam |
audāsīnyaṃ bhayaṃ krodhaṃ cakramadhye vivarjayet || 29 ||
meaning:
परिहासं  प्रलापञ्च   वितण्डां  बहुभाषितम् |
औदासीन्यं भयं क्रोधं चक्रमध्ये विवर्जयेत् || 29 ||
text_mt: Mockery, idle chatter, cavilling, excessive speaking, / indifference, fear, and anger one should completely abandon in the midst of the cakra.

sanskrit_iast:
pātrahasto    mahādevi    na   bhrameccakramadhyataḥ |
pūrṇapātraṃ  kare  kṛtvā  na  tiṣṭhettu  ciraṃ  priye || 30 ||
meaning:
पात्रहस्तो    महादेवि    न   भ्रमेच्चक्रमध्यतः |
पूर्णपात्रं  करे  कृत्वा  न  तिष्ठेत्तु  चिरं  प्रिये || 30 ||
text_mt: With vessel in hand, O Great Goddess, one should not wander about the middle of the circle. / Having taken a full vessel in one's hand, O beloved, one should not linger long.

sanskrit_iast:
nālapet pātrahastaḥ san na bhindyāt pātramambike |
pādābhyāṃ na spṛśet pātraṃ  na  binduṃ  pātayedadhaḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
नालपेत् पात्रहस्तः सन् न भिन्द्यात् पात्रमम्बिके |
पादाभ्यां न स्पृशेत् पात्रं  न  बिन्दुं  पातयेदधः || 31 ||
text_mt: With vessel in hand, one should not converse; one should not break the vessel, O Mother. / One should not touch the vessel with both feet, nor let a drop fall to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
naikahastena   dātavyaṃ   na   mudrāvajītaṃ   priye |
pātraṃ na cālayeta sthānānna kuryāt pātrasaṅkaram || 32 ||
meaning:
नैकहस्तेन   दातव्यं   न   मुद्रावजीतं   प्रिये |
पात्रं न चालयेत स्थानान्न कुर्यात् पात्रसङ्करम् || 32 ||
text_mt: It should not be given with one hand, nor without a mudrā, O beloved. / One should not move the vessel from its place, nor cause intermingling of the vessels.

sanskrit_iast:
saśabdaṃ  na  pibenmadyaṃ  tathaiva  na  ca  pūrayet |
nānyonyaṃ   tāḍayetpātraṃ  tathā  na  pātayedadhaḥ || 33 ||
meaning:
सशब्दं  न  पिबेन्मद्यं  तथैव  न  च  पूरयेत् |
नान्योन्यं   ताडयेत्पात्रं  तथा  न  पातयेदधः || 33 ||
text_mt: One should not drink the wine noisily, nor fill it likewise [with noise]. / One should not strike one vessel against another, nor let it fall to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhāraṃ noddharet  pātramanādhāre na nikṣipet |
riktapātraṃ na kurvīta na pātraṃ bhrāmayet priye || 34 ||
meaning:
साधारं नोद्धरेत्  पात्रमनाधारे न निक्षिपेत् |
रिक्तपात्रं न कुर्वीत न पात्रं भ्रामयेत् प्रिये || 34 ||
text_mt: One should not lift the vessel together with its base, nor place it down without a base. / One should not leave the vessel empty, nor wave the vessel about, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
na pātraṃ laṃghayeddhīmān pātraṃ notpātayet priye |
prakṣālya gopayet  pātramityājñā parameśvari || 35 ||
meaning:
न पात्रं लंघयेद्धीमान् पात्रं नोत्पातयेत् प्रिये |
प्रक्षाल्य गोपयेत्  पात्रमित्याज्ञा परमेश्वरि || 35 ||
text_mt: The wise person should not step over the vessel, nor upend the vessel, O beloved. / Having washed it, one should conceal the vessel; such is the command, O Supreme Mistress.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā  sandīpitollāsaḥ kaulikaḥ paśumīkṣate |
paṭhedvā  paśuśāstrāṇi  saṅgacchedvā paśustriyam || 36 ||
meaning:
यदा  सन्दीपितोल्लासः कौलिकः पशुमीक्षते |
पठेद्वा  पशुशास्त्राणि  सङ्गच्छेद्वा पशुस्त्रियम् || 36 ||
text_mt: When his joy is blazing bright, if the Kaulika looks upon an uninitiated bound soul, / or reads the scriptures of uninitiated bound souls, or copulates with a woman of the uninitiated bound souls,

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāt paśuprasaṅgaṃ  vā paśukāryāṇi vā caret |
dharmārthāyuryaśaḥpuṇyamarthasaukhyādi     naśyati || 37 ||
meaning:
कुर्यात् पशुप्रसङ्गं  वा पशुकार्याणि वा चरेत् |
धर्मार्थायुर्यशःपुण्यमर्थसौख्यादि     नश्यति || 37 ||
text_mt: or keeps company with an uninitiated bound soul, or performs the deeds of uninitiated bound souls, / his religious duty, wealth, lifespan, fame, merit, material well-being, and so forth perish.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīcakrasthaṃ  kuladravyaṃ  yaḥ paśubhyaḥ prayacchati |
snehāllobhādbhayādvāpi  sa bhaved yoginīpaśuḥ || 38 ||
meaning:
श्रीचक्रस्थं  कुलद्रव्यं  यः पशुभ्यः प्रयच्छति |
स्नेहाल्लोभाद्भयाद्वापि  स भवेद् योगिनीपशुः || 38 ||
text_mt: Whoever gives to uninitiated bound souls the substance of Kula placed in the Śrīcakra / out of affection, greed, or fear becomes a sacrificial beast of the yoginīs.

sanskrit_iast:
ripuṇāpi  na  karttavyo  vāgvādaścakramadhyataḥ |
pitṛmātṛsamaṃ    paśyettenoktaṃ   paruṣaṃ   sahet || 39 ||
meaning:
रिपुणापि  न  कर्त्तव्यो  वाग्वादश्चक्रमध्यतः |
पितृमातृसमं    पश्येत्तेनोक्तं   परुषं   सहेत् || 39 ||
text_mt: Even with an enemy, no dispute in words should be engaged in within the circle. / One should view [him] as equal to father and mother, and endure harsh words spoken by him.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāstrīputramitrādi  dṛṣṭvā  cetaḥ   prahṛṣyati |
tathā cet kaulikān dṛṣṭvā sa bhaved yoginīpriyaḥ || 40 ||
meaning:
यथास्त्रीपुत्रमित्रादि  दृष्ट्वा  चेतः   प्रहृष्यति |
तथा चेत् कौलिकान् दृष्ट्वा स भवेद् योगिनीप्रियः || 40 ||
text_mt: Just as the mind rejoices upon seeing wife, son, friend, and the like, / if it is so upon seeing Kaulikas, he becomes dear to the yoginīs.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādistambaparyantaṃ  yasya  me   gurusantatiḥ |
yasya me sarvaśiṣyasya ko na pūjyo mahītale |
ddati niścitabuddhiryaḥ  sa  bhavedāvayoḥ priyaḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तं  यस्य  मे   गुरुसन्ततिः |
यस्य मे सर्वशिष्यस्य को न पूज्यो महीतले |
द्दति निश्चितबुद्धिर्यः  स  भवेदावयोः प्रियः || 41 ||
text_mt: "From Brahmā down to a clump of grass is the succession of my gurus; / since all are disciples to me, who on earth is not worthy of worship?" / Whoever has such a resolute mind becomes dear to both of us.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ  gururahaṃ  jyeṣṭhastvahaṃ  vedmīti  gavītaḥ |
ahameva gatiryeṣāṃ  kaulikā  na bhavanti te || 42 ||
meaning:
अहं  गुरुरहं  ज्येष्ठस्त्वहं  वेद्मीति  गवीतः |
अहमेव गतिर्येषां  कौलिका  न भवन्ति ते || 42 ||
text_mt: Those who, puffed up with pride, think: "I am the guru, I am the eldest, I know," / and who consider only themselves as the resort—they are not Kaulikas.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīguruṃ kulaśāstrāṇi pūjāsthānāni yāni ca |
bhaktyā śrīpūrvakaṃ devi  praṇamya parikīrttayet || 43 ||
meaning:
श्रीगुरुं कुलशास्त्राणि पूजास्थानानि यानि च |
भक्त्या श्रीपूर्वकं देवि  प्रणम्य परिकीर्त्तयेत् || 43 ||
text_mt: The venerable guru, the scriptures of Kula, and whatever sacred places of worship there be, / one should proclaim with devotion, prefixing "Śrī," after bowing down, O Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
guruṃ nāmnā  na  bhāveta  japakālādṛte  priye |
śrīnātha deva svāmīti vivāde sādhane vadet || 44 ||
meaning:
गुरुं नाम्ना  न  भावेत  जपकालादृते  प्रिये |
श्रीनाथ देव स्वामीति विवादे साधने वदेत् || 44 ||
text_mt: One should not think of the guru by name except at the time of mantra-repetition, O beloved; / one should say "Śrīnātha," "Deva," "Svāmin" in debate and in spiritual practice.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīguroḥ  pādukāṃ  mudrāṃ  mūlamantraṃ  svapādukām |
śiṣyādanyasya deveśi na vaded yasya kasyacit || 45 ||
meaning:
श्रीगुरोः  पादुकां  मुद्रां  मूलमन्त्रं  स्वपादुकाम् |
शिष्यादन्यस्य देवेशि न वदेद् यस्य कस्यचित् || 45 ||
text_mt: The guru's sandals, the mudrā, the root mantra, and one's own sandals, / O Mistress of the gods, one should never disclose to anyone other than a disciple.

sanskrit_iast:
pāramparyāgamāmnāyaṃ   mantrācārādikaṃ   priye |
sarva gurumukhāllabdhaṃ saphalaṃ syānna cānyathā || 46 ||
meaning:
पारम्पर्यागमाम्नायं   मन्त्राचारादिकं   प्रिये |
सर्व गुरुमुखाल्लब्धं सफलं स्यान्न चान्यथा || 46 ||
text_mt: The traditional succession, the Āgama, the sacred transmission, the mantras, conduct, and so forth, O beloved— / all that is obtained from the mouth of the guru becomes fruitful, not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīśāstrāśrayamūlañca  pustakaṃ  na vadet priye |
nityaṃ samarcayedbhaktyā paśuhaste na nikṣipet || 47 ||
meaning:
श्रीशास्त्राश्रयमूलञ्च  पुस्तकं  न वदेत् प्रिये |
नित्यं समर्चयेद्भक्त्या पशुहस्ते न निक्षिपेत् || 47 ||
text_mt: One should not recite from a book the root of the refuge of the sacred scriptures, O beloved; / one should always worship it with devotion, and not place it in the hands of an uninitiated bound soul.

sanskrit_iast:
svadāravanniṣeveta   kulaśāstrāṇi  pārvati |
paśuśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi varjayet paradāravat || 48 ||
meaning:
स्वदारवन्निषेवेत   कुलशास्त्राणि  पार्वति |
पशुशास्त्राणि सर्वाणि वर्जयेत् परदारवत् || 48 ||
text_mt: One should attend upon the scriptures of Kula as upon one's own wife, O Pārvatī; / one should avoid all scriptures of the uninitiated bound souls as another's wife.

sanskrit_iast:
svacarmasthaṃ  yathā  kṣīramapeyaṃ  syād dvijottamaiḥ |
tathā paśumukhāddharmo na śrotavyo hi kaulikaiḥ || 49 ||
meaning:
स्वचर्मस्थं  यथा  क्षीरमपेयं  स्याद् द्विजोत्तमैः |
तथा पशुमुखाद्धर्मो न श्रोतव्यो हि कौलिकैः || 49 ||
text_mt: Just as milk placed in a dog's skin becomes undrinkable for the best of the twice-born, / even so duty should not be heard from the mouth of an uninitiated bound soul by Kaulikas.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śṛṇoti kulācāraṃ yathāśāstrañca yo vadet |
tāvubhau gacchataḥ  sākṣād  yoginīvīramelanam || 50 ||
meaning:
यः शृणोति कुलाचारं यथाशास्त्रञ्च यो वदेत् |
तावुभौ गच्छतः  साक्षाद्  योगिनीवीरमेलनम् || 50 ||
text_mt: He who listens to the conduct of Kula, and he who speaks it according to scripture— / both of them go directly to the assembly of yoginīs and vīras.

sanskrit_iast:
aśraddhadhānā ye cātra kuladharme kuleśvari |
narakānno nivarttante  yāvadāhūta  saṃplavam || 51 ||
meaning:
अश्रद्धधाना ये चात्र कुलधर्मे कुलेश्वरि |
नरकान्नो निवर्त्तन्ते  यावदाहूत  संप्लवम् || 51 ||
text_mt: And those who lack faith here in the duty of Kula, O Mistress of Kula, / do not return from hell as long as the universal dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
ūḍhā dhṛtā  tathā krītā mūlyena ca samāhṛtā |
sakṛt kāmaratā vāpi  pañcadhā guruyoṣitaḥ |
alaṃghyāḥ  pūjanīyāḥ syurguruvadguruyoṣitaḥ || 52 ||
meaning:
ऊढा धृता  तथा क्रीता मूल्येन च समाहृता |
सकृत् कामरता वापि  पञ्चधा गुरुयोषितः |
अलंघ्याः  पूजनीयाः स्युर्गुरुवद्गुरुयोषितः || 52 ||
text_mt: Wedded, maintained, purchased, or brought by paying a price, / or enjoyed in love even once—fivefold are the women of the guru; / the guru's women are not to be violated; they are to be worshipped just like the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
guruśaktiṃ  vīrabhāryāṃ  kumārīṃ  vratadhāriṇīm |
vyaṅgāṅgī vikṛtāṅgīñca kubjāmapi na kāmayet || 53 ||
meaning:
गुरुशक्तिं  वीरभार्यां  कुमारीं  व्रतधारिणीम् |
व्यङ्गाङ्गी विकृताङ्गीञ्च कुब्जामपि न कामयेत् || 53 ||
text_mt: The guru's consort, the wife of a vīra, a virgin, an ascetic woman, / one with missing limbs, one with deformed limbs, and even a hunchback—one should not desire them.

sanskrit_iast:
sutāñca bhaginīṃ pautrīṃ snuṣāṃ vāpi priyāmapi |
na kāmayed  guroragre  kuryānnānyonyasaṃgraham || 54 ||
meaning:
सुताञ्च भगिनीं पौत्रीं स्नुषां वापि प्रियामपि |
न कामयेद्  गुरोरग्रे  कुर्यान्नान्योन्यसंग्रहम् || 54 ||
text_mt: A daughter, a sister, a granddaughter, a daughter-in-law, or even one's beloved— / one should not desire in the presence of the guru, nor should they touch one another.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṃśukāṃ kṛṣṇavaṇārṃ kumārīñca kṛśodarīm |
manoharāṃ           yauvanasthāmarcayeddevatādhiyā || 55 ||
meaning:
कृष्णांशुकां कृष्णवणार्ं कुमारीञ्च कृशोदरीम् |
मनोहरां           यौवनस्थामर्चयेद्देवताधिया || 55 ||
text_mt: Dressed in black cloth, of dark complexion, a slender-waisted maiden, / captivating, established in youth—one should worship [her] with the thought that she is a deity.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadāpi   na  seveta   balena  kulayoginīm |
cakramadhye svayaṃ  kṣubdhāṃ  kāmayet  kulasundari || 56 ||
meaning:
एकदापि   न  सेवेत   बलेन  कुलयोगिनीम् |
चक्रमध्ये स्वयं  क्षुब्धां  कामयेत्  कुलसुन्दरि || 56 ||
text_mt: Never should one consort with a Kula yoginī by force; / one should make love to her in the circle when she is herself aroused, O beauty of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
āmamāṃsaṃ surākumbhaṃ  mattebhaṃ  siddhiliṅginam |
sahakāramaśokañca krīḍālolāḥ kumārikāḥ || 57 ||
meaning:
आममांसं सुराकुम्भं  मत्तेभं  सिद्धिलिङ्गिनम् |
सहकारमशोकञ्च क्रीडालोलाः कुमारिकाः || 57 ||
text_mt: Raw meat, a jar of liquor, an intoxicated elephant, one bearing the insignia of spiritual attainment, / a mango tree, an aśoka tree, young maidens eager for play,

sanskrit_iast:
ekravṛkṣaṃ  śmaśānañca  samūhaṃ   yoṣatāmapi |
nārīñca raktavasanāṃ dṛṣṭvā vandeta bhaktitaḥ || 58 ||
meaning:
एक्रवृक्षं  श्मशानञ्च  समूहं   योषतामपि |
नारीञ्च रक्तवसनां दृष्ट्वा वन्देत भक्तितः || 58 ||
text_mt: a solitary tree, a cremation ground, an assembly of women, / and a woman wearing red garments—having seen these, one should bow down with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
guruśaktisutajyeṣṭhakaniṣṭhān    kuladeśikān |
kuladarśanaśāstrāṇi  kuladravyāṇi kaulikān || 59 ||
meaning:
गुरुशक्तिसुतज्येष्ठकनिष्ठान्    कुलदेशिकान् |
कुलदर्शनशास्त्राणि  कुलद्रव्याणि कौलिकान् || 59 ||
text_mt: The consort of the guru, his son, elders, juniors, the Kula gurus, / the scriptures of the Kula doctrine, the substances of Kula, Kaulikas,

sanskrit_iast:
prerakān sūcakāṃścāpi vācakān darśakāṃstathā |
śikṣakān bodhakān yogī yoginīsiddhirūpakān || 60 ||
meaning:
प्रेरकान् सूचकांश्चापि वाचकान् दर्शकांस्तथा |
शिक्षकान् बोधकान् योगी योगिनीसिद्धिरूपकान् || 60 ||
text_mt: the instigators, the indicators, the expounders, the pointers, / the teachers, the awakeners—the yogin [should revere as] having the form of the perfection of the yoginīs.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāṃ kumārikāṃ nagnāmunmattāṃ  vāpi yoṣitam |
na   nindenna   jugupseta   na   hasennāvamānayet || 61 ||
meaning:
कन्यां कुमारिकां नग्नामुन्मत्तां  वापि योषितम् |
न   निन्देन्न   जुगुप्सेत   न   हसेन्नावमानयेत् || 61 ||
text_mt: A maiden, a virgin, a naked woman, or a mad woman— / one should not blame, nor loathe, nor mock, nor disrespect.

sanskrit_iast:
nāpriyaṃ nānṛtaṃ  brūyāt  kasyāpi  kulayoginaḥ |
kurūpā  ceti kṛṣṇeti na vadet  kulayoṣitam || 62 ||
meaning:
नाप्रियं नानृतं  ब्रूयात्  कस्यापि  कुलयोगिनः |
कुरूपा  चेति कृष्णेति न वदेत्  कुलयोषितम् || 62 ||
text_mt: One should not speak anything unpleasant or untrue to any Kula yogin; / nor should one say to a woman of Kula that she is ugly or dark.

sanskrit_iast:
parīkṣayenna bhaktānāṃ vīrāṇāñca kṛtākṛtam |
na paśyedvanitāṃ nagnāmunmattāṃ prakaṭastanīm || 63 ||
meaning:
परीक्षयेन्न भक्तानां वीराणाञ्च कृताकृतम् |
न पश्येद्वनितां नग्नामुन्मत्तां प्रकटस्तनीम् || 63 ||
text_mt: One should not scrutinize the deeds and omissions of devotees and vīras; / one should not gaze upon a woman naked, intoxicated, or with exposed breasts.

sanskrit_iast:
divase na ramennārīṃ tadyoniṃ  naiva  vīkṣayet |
yā kācidaṅganā loke sā  mātṛ kulasambhavā || 64 ||
meaning:
दिवसे न रमेन्नारीं तद्योनिं  नैव  वीक्षयेत् |
या काचिदङ्गना लोके सा  मातृ कुलसम्भवा || 64 ||
text_mt: One should not sport with a woman by day, nor look upon her vulva; / whatever woman there is in the world, she is a mother born of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
kupyanti kulayoginyo vanitānāṃ vyatikramāt |
striyaṃ śatāparādhāñcet  puṣpeṇāpi  na  tāḍayet |
doṣānna  gaṇayet strīṇāṃ guṇāneva prakāśayet || 65 ||
meaning:
कुप्यन्ति कुलयोगिन्यो वनितानां व्यतिक्रमात् |
स्त्रियं शतापराधाञ्चेत्  पुष्पेणापि  न  ताडयेत् |
दोषान्न  गणयेत् स्त्रीणां गुणानेव प्रकाशयेत् || 65 ||
text_mt: The Kula yoginīs grow angry at transgressions against women. / Even if a woman has committed a hundred offenses, one should not strike her even with a flower; / one should not count the faults of women; one should display only their virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhanti kulayoginyaḥ kulavṛkṣeṣu sarvadā |
tatpatreṣu  na  bhoktavyamarcayettu   viśeṣataḥ || 66 ||
meaning:
तिष्ठन्ति कुलयोगिन्यः कुलवृक्षेषु सर्वदा |
तत्पत्रेषु  न  भोक्तव्यमर्चयेत्तु   विशेषतः || 66 ||
text_mt: The Kula yoginīs reside always in the trees of Kula; / one must not eat from their leaves, but should worship them especially.

sanskrit_iast:
na svapet  kulavṛkṣādho  na  copadravamācaret |
dṛṣṭvā bhaktyā namaskuryācchedayenna kadācana || 67 ||
meaning:
न स्वपेत्  कुलवृक्षाधो  न  चोपद्रवमाचरेत् |
दृष्ट्वा भक्त्या नमस्कुर्याच्छेदयेन्न कदाचन || 67 ||
text_mt: One should not sleep under a tree of Kula, nor cause any disturbance [to it]; / seeing it, one should bow down with devotion, and never cut it down.

sanskrit_iast:
śleṣmātakaṃ karañjākhyaṃ nimbāśvatthakadambakāḥ |
bilvavaṭoḍumbarāśca   tintiḍī   navamī  smṛtā || 68 ||
meaning:
श्लेष्मातकं करञ्जाख्यं निम्बाश्वत्थकदम्बकाः |
बिल्ववटोडुम्बराश्च   तिन्तिडी   नवमी  स्मृता || 68 ||
text_mt: The śleṣmātaka, the one called karañja, the nimba, the aśvattha, the kadamba, / the bilva, the vaṭa, and the uḍumbara, and the tamarind is remembered as the ninth.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaṃ bhṛgoḥ pātaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ vratadhāraṇam |
tīrthayātrābhigamanaṃ kaulaḥ pañca  vivarjayet || 69 ||
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तं भृगोः पातं संन्यासं व्रतधारणम् |
तीर्थयात्राभिगमनं कौलः पञ्च  विवर्जयेत् || 69 ||
text_mt: Atonement, falling from a precipice, renunciation, observing vows, / and going on pilgrimages to holy bathing places—a Kaula should avoid these five.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrahatyā    vṛthāpānaṃ  vīrapatnīniṣevaṇam |
vīradravyāpaharaṇam   tatsaṃyogaśca   pañcamaḥ |
mahāpātakamityuktaṃ kaulikānāṃ kulānvaye || 70 ||
meaning:
वीरहत्या    वृथापानं  वीरपत्नीनिषेवणम् |
वीरद्रव्यापहरणम्   तत्संयोगश्च   पञ्चमः |
महापातकमित्युक्तं कौलिकानां कुलान्वये || 70 ||
text_mt: Slaying a vīra, drinking without ritual purpose, consorting with a vīra's wife, / stealing a vīra's property, and associating with them [who do so] is the fifth— / this is called a mortal sin among Kaulikas in the lineage of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
śaive tattvaparijñānaṃ  gāruḍe  viṣabhakṣaṇam |
jyotiṣe grahaṇaṃ sāraṃ kaule'nugrahanigrahau || 71 ||
meaning:
शैवे तत्त्वपरिज्ञानं  गारुडे  विषभक्षणम् |
ज्योतिषे ग्रहणं सारं कौलेऽनुग्रहनिग्रहौ || 71 ||
text_mt: In the Śaiva system, complete knowledge of reality is essential; in the Gāruḍa system, the consuming of poison; / in astronomy, eclipse [calculation]; and in the Kaula system, grace and chastisement.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāguruśāstrāṇāṃ siddhācāraviḍambakāḥ |
vidyācauro gurudrohī  brahmarākṣasatāṃ vrajet || 72 ||
meaning:
देवतागुरुशास्त्राणां सिद्धाचारविडम्बकाः |
विद्याचौरो गुरुद्रोही  ब्रह्मराक्षसतां व्रजेत् || 72 ||
text_mt: Those who mock deities, gurus, and scriptures, or the conduct of the perfected, / a thief of esoteric knowledge, or one who betrays the guru, will become a brahmarākṣasa.

sanskrit_iast:
guruvākyaṃ hataṃ kṛtvā vīrān nirbhartsya ca priye |
guruṃ huṅkṛtya tuṅkṛtya  vīraṃ nijītya vādataḥ |
vikalpya kulaśāstrāṇi bhavanti brahmarākṣasāḥ || 73 ||
meaning:
गुरुवाक्यं हतं कृत्वा वीरान् निर्भर्त्स्य च प्रिये |
गुरुं हुङ्कृत्य तुङ्कृत्य  वीरं निजीत्य वादतः |
विकल्प्य कुलशास्त्राणि भवन्ति ब्रह्मराक्षसाः || 73 ||
text_mt: Having disregarded the guru’s word and reviled the heroes, O beloved, / having grunted and snapped at the guru, having conquered a hero in dispute, / and having entertained doubts about the Kula scriptures, they become brahmarākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
ekākṣarapradātāraṃ     yo    guruñcāvamānayet |
śvānaṃ yoniśataṃ gatvā caṇḍālatvamavāpnuyāt || 74 ||
meaning:
एकाक्षरप्रदातारं     यो    गुरुञ्चावमानयेत् |
श्वानं योनिशतं गत्वा चण्डालत्वमवाप्नुयात् || 74 ||
text_mt: Whoever insults a guru who has imparted even a single syllable / passes through a hundred canine wombs and attains the state of an outcaste.

sanskrit_iast:
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhāryāṃ bhrātaraṃ bāndhavaṃ sutam |
kulanindākaraṃ devi hanyādevāvicārayan || 75 ||
meaning:
मातरं पितरं भार्यां भ्रातरं बान्धवं सुतम् |
कुलनिन्दाकरं देवि हन्यादेवाविचारयन् || 75 ||
text_mt: Mother, father, wife, brother, kinsman, or son: / whoever reviles the Kula, O Goddess, one should slay without hesitation.

sanskrit_iast:
gurvarthaṃ devatārthaṃ vā  kaulikārthaṃ  kuleśvari |
kulāgamārthamathavā    kuladharmārthameva   vā || 76 ||
meaning:
गुर्वर्थं देवतार्थं वा  कौलिकार्थं  कुलेश्वरि |
कुलागमार्थमथवा    कुलधर्मार्थमेव   वा || 76 ||
text_mt: For the sake of the guru, or for the sake of the deity, or for the sake of a Kaulika, O Mistress of Kula, / or for the sake of the Kula scriptures, or indeed for the sake of the duty of Kula,

sanskrit_iast:
devi nindākaraṃ hatvā bādhitaḥ svayameva vā |
yastyajeddustyajaprāṇān sa pare līyate śive || 77 ||
meaning:
देवि निन्दाकरं हत्वा बाधितः स्वयमेव वा |
यस्त्यजेद्दुस्त्यजप्राणान् स परे लीयते शिवे || 77 ||
text_mt: having slain one who reviles, O Goddess, or being himself afflicted, / whoever relinquishes his life-breaths, so hard to abandon, is absorbed into the Supreme Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ekasminnidhanaṃ  yatra  prāpite  duṣṭacāriṇi |
bahūnāṃ bhavati kṣemaṃ puṇyaṃ tasya vadhe bhavet || 78 ||
meaning:
एकस्मिन्निधनं  यत्र  प्रापिते  दुष्टचारिणि |
बहूनां भवति क्षेमं पुण्यं तस्य वधे भवेत् || 78 ||
text_mt: Where, upon bringing destruction to a single evil-doer, / welfare results for many, merit arises from his slaying.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīcakrakṛtavṛttāntaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham |
kadācinnaiva   vaktavyamityājñā   parameśvari || 79 ||
meaning:
श्रीचक्रकृतवृत्तान्तं शुभं वा यदि वाऽशुभम् |
कदाचिन्नैव   वक्तव्यमित्याज्ञा   परमेश्वरि || 79 ||
text_mt: Events that occur within the Śrīcakra, whether auspicious or inauspicious, / must never be spoken of: this is the command, O Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
kuladharmaprasaṅgañca   paśūnāṃ  purataḥ  priye |
kadācinnaiva  kurvīta śūdrāgre devapāṭhavat || 80 ||
meaning:
कुलधर्मप्रसङ्गञ्च   पशूनां  पुरतः  प्रिये |
कदाचिन्नैव  कुर्वीत शूद्राग्रे देवपाठवत् || 80 ||
text_mt: And conversation regarding the duty of Kula in front of uninitiated bound souls, O beloved, / must never be held, just like reciting the Veda before a Śūdra.

sanskrit_iast:
pīṭhakṣetrāgamāmnāyaṃ tadvidyācārakaulikān |
kuladravyādikaṃ devi na vadet paśusannidhau || 81 ||
meaning:
पीठक्षेत्रागमाम्नायं तद्विद्याचारकौलिकान् |
कुलद्रव्यादिकं देवि न वदेत् पशुसन्निधौ || 81 ||
text_mt: Sacred seats, sacred fields, scriptures, sacred transmissions, their knowledge, conduct, Kaulikas, / and the Kula substances and the like, O Goddess, one should not mention in the presence of an uninitiated bound soul.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā rakṣati caurebhyo dhanadhānyādikaṃ priye |
kuladharmaṃ  tathā devi  paśubhyaḥ parirakṣayet || 82 ||
meaning:
यथा रक्षति चौरेभ्यो धनधान्यादिकं प्रिये |
कुलधर्मं  तथा देवि  पशुभ्यः परिरक्षयेत् || 82 ||
text_mt: Just as one protects wealth, grain, and the like from thieves, O beloved, / so, O Goddess, should one protect the duty of Kula from uninitiated bound souls.

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥ kaulo bahiḥ śaivo janamadhye tu vaiṣṇavaḥ |
kaulaṃ    sugopayeddevi    nārikelaphalāmbuvat || 83 ||
meaning:
अन्तः कौलो बहिः शैवो जनमध्ये तु वैष्णवः |
कौलं    सुगोपयेद्देवि    नारिकेलफलाम्बुवत् || 83 ||
text_mt: Inwardly a Kaula, outwardly a Śaiva, but in the midst of people a Vaiṣṇava, / one should guard the Kaula [secret] closely, O Goddess, like the water inside a coconut.

sanskrit_iast:
kuladharmādikaṃ sarvaṃ sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā |
gopayecca   prayatnena  jananījāragarbhavat || 84 ||
meaning:
कुलधर्मादिकं सर्वं सर्वावस्थासु सर्वदा |
गोपयेच्च   प्रयत्नेन  जननीजारगर्भवत् || 84 ||
text_mt: Everything pertaining to the duty of Kula, in all conditions and at all times, / one must conceal with effort, like the child of a mother's paramour.

sanskrit_iast:
vedaśāstrapurāṇāni  spaṣṭāni gaṇikā iva |
iyantu śāmbhavī vidyā guptā kulavadhūriva || 85 ||
meaning:
वेदशास्त्रपुराणानि  स्पष्टानि गणिका इव |
इयन्तु शाम्भवी विद्या गुप्ता कुलवधूरिव || 85 ||
text_mt: The Vedas, scriptures, and Purāṇas are exposed like courtesans; / but this Śāmbhava lore is hidden like a noble wife.

sanskrit_iast:
suguptakaulikācāramanugṛhṇanti  devatāḥ |
vāñchāsiddhiṃ prayacchanti nāśayanti prakāśakān || 86 ||
meaning:
सुगुप्तकौलिकाचारमनुगृह्णन्ति  देवताः |
वाञ्छासिद्धिं प्रयच्छन्ति नाशयन्ति प्रकाशकान् || 86 ||
text_mt: The deities bestow grace upon the well-concealed conduct of Kaulikas; / they grant the fulfillment of desires, and they destroy those who disclose it.

sanskrit_iast:
kuleśi  kulaśāstrajñāḥ kulapūjāparāyaṇāḥ |
ye tvāṃ rahasi sevante te tiṣṭhanti tavāntike || 87 ||
meaning:
कुलेशि  कुलशास्त्रज्ञाः कुलपूजापरायणाः |
ये त्वां रहसि सेवन्ते ते तिष्ठन्ति तवान्तिके || 87 ||
text_mt: O Mistress of Kula, those who know the Kula scriptures, intent upon Kula worship, / who serve you in secret, abide near you.

sanskrit_iast:
guruṃ prakāśayeddhīmān mantraṃ  yatnena gopayet |
aprakāśaprakāśābhyāṃ naśyataḥ sampadāyuṣī || 88 ||
meaning:
गुरुं प्रकाशयेद्धीमान् मन्त्रं  यत्नेन गोपयेत् |
अप्रकाशप्रकाशाभ्यां नश्यतः सम्पदायुषी || 88 ||
text_mt: The wise person should make the guru known and conceal the mantra with care; / by concealing [the guru] and making [the mantra] known, wealth and lifespan are destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvācāraparibhraṣṭaḥ  kulācāraṃ samāśrayet |
kulācāraparibhraṣṭau rauravaṃ  narakaṃ  vrajet || 89 ||
meaning:
सर्वाचारपरिभ्रष्टः  कुलाचारं समाश्रयेत् |
कुलाचारपरिभ्रष्टौ रौरवं  नरकं  व्रजेत् || 89 ||
text_mt: One fallen from all [other] conduct should take refuge in the conduct of Kula; / but one who falls from the conduct of Kula will go to the Raurava hell.

sanskrit_iast:
śāstreṣu     niṣkṛtirdṛṣṭā    mahāpātakināmapi |
kulabhraṣṭasya deveśi na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit || 90 ||
meaning:
शास्त्रेषु     निष्कृतिर्दृष्टा    महापातकिनामपि |
कुलभ्रष्टस्य देवेशि न दृष्टा निष्कृतिः क्वचित् || 90 ||
text_mt: In the scriptures, expiation is seen even for great sinners; / for one fallen from the Kula, O Goddess of gods, expiation is nowhere seen.

sanskrit_iast:
kuladharma samāśritya ācāraṃ yo na pālayet |
yathecchacāriṇastasya  mahāpātakinaḥ  priye || 91 ||
meaning:
कुलधर्म समाश्रित्य आचारं यो न पालयेत् |
यथेच्छचारिणस्तस्य  महापातकिनः  प्रिये || 91 ||
text_mt: Whoever, having taken refuge in the duty of Kula, does not maintain proper conduct, / for that great sinner acting according to his own whims, O beloved,

sanskrit_iast:
āpado duritaṃ rogā dāridryaṃ kalaho bhayam |
yoginīnāṃ prakopaśca skhalitāni  pade  pade || 92 ||
meaning:
आपदो दुरितं रोगा दारिद्र्यं कलहो भयम् |
योगिनीनां प्रकोपश्च स्खलितानि  पदे  पदे || 92 ||
text_mt: there are misfortunes, wrongdoing, diseases, poverty, strife, fear, / the wrath of the yoginīs, and stumblings at every step.

sanskrit_iast:
bhraṃśamānaḥ  pranaṣṭaśca   tejohīno'tidurmatiḥ |
ninditaḥ sarvavidviṣṭo vihvalaḥ saṅgavajītaḥ |
deśāddeśāntaraṃ  yāti  kāryahāniśca sarvadā || 93 ||
meaning:
भ्रंशमानः  प्रनष्टश्च   तेजोहीनोऽतिदुर्मतिः |
निन्दितः सर्वविद्विष्टो विह्वलः सङ्गवजीतः |
देशाद्देशान्तरं  याति  कार्यहानिश्च सर्वदा || 93 ||
text_mt: Falling, ruined, devoid of radiance, thoroughly evil-minded, / reviled, hated by all, distraught, abandoned by companions, / he goes from land to land, and his undertakings are always frustrated.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi kulamārgasthāḥ śākinyaḥ kulapālikāḥ |
bhakṣayanti purā  tāsāṃ  varo datto mayeva tu || 94 ||
meaning:
तत्रापि कुलमार्गस्थाः शाकिन्यः कुलपालिकाः |
भक्षयन्ति पुरा  तासां  वरो दत्तो मयेव तु || 94 ||
text_mt: Even there, the śākinīs established in the Kula path, the guardians of the Kula, / devour [him]; for formerly a boon was given to them by me.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādācāravān devi yoginīnāṃ priyo bhavet |
nāśayanti    caturvedānanācārāḥ  kuleśvari || 95 ||
meaning:
तस्मादाचारवान् देवि योगिनीनां प्रियो भवेत् |
नाशयन्ति    चतुर्वेदाननाचाराः  कुलेश्वरि || 95 ||
text_mt: Therefore, O Goddess, one of proper conduct becomes dear to the yoginīs; / improper conduct ruins [even] the four Vedas, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
pādukāmātrasārajñaḥ  sadācāreṣu   yantritaḥ |
sadācāreṇa   devatvaṃ   yoginīvīramelanam |
samprāpnuvanti tiryaktvaṃ kaulikāstadviparyayāt || 96 ||
meaning:
पादुकामात्रसारज्ञः  सदाचारेषु   यन्त्रितः |
सदाचारेण   देवत्वं   योगिनीवीरमेलनम् |
सम्प्राप्नुवन्ति तिर्यक्त्वं कौलिकास्तद्विपर्ययात् || 96 ||
text_mt: Knowing the essence of merely the sandals [of the guru], restrained in virtuous conduct, / through virtuous conduct Kaulikas attain godhood and union with yoginīs and heroes; / from its opposite, they attain the condition of animals.

sanskrit_iast:
ājñāsiddhamidaṃ   kaulamanācārādvinaśyati |
ācārapālanāt satyamājñāsiddhirbhaviṣyati || 97 ||
meaning:
आज्ञासिद्धमिदं   कौलमनाचाराद्विनश्यति |
आचारपालनात् सत्यमाज्ञासिद्धिर्भविष्यति || 97 ||
text_mt: This Kaula [path] is perfected by command; it is destroyed by improper conduct; / through observing proper conduct, truly, perfection of the command will come to be.

sanskrit_iast:
nābhiṣeko na mantro vā na śāstrapaṭhanādikam |
kāraṇaṃ  kuladharmasya  sadācāraḥ  kuleśvari || 98 ||
meaning:
नाभिषेको न मन्त्रो वा न शास्त्रपठनादिकम् |
कारणं  कुलधर्मस्य  सदाचारः  कुलेश्वरि || 98 ||
text_mt: Neither consecration, nor mantra, nor the recitation of scriptures and the like / is the cause of the duty of Kula, O Mistress of Kula, but rather virtuous conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
parā    śrīpādukātattvatrayācārādivāsanāḥ |
yo vetti samayī sa syāt kaulikaścāpi śāmbhavi || 99 ||
meaning:
परा    श्रीपादुकातत्त्वत्रयाचारादिवासनाः |
यो वेत्ति समयी स स्यात् कौलिकश्चापि शाम्भवि || 99 ||
text_mt: Whoever knows the supreme, sacred sandals, the triad of realities, conduct, and other inner meanings, / he is an initiate of vows and also a Kaulika, O daughter of Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvanna  kauliko  devi yāvanna samayīkṛtaḥ |
dehapāte vimokṣaḥ syāt samayācārapālanāt || 100 ||
meaning:
तावन्न  कौलिको  देवि यावन्न समयीकृतः |
देहपाते विमोक्षः स्यात् समयाचारपालनात् || 100 ||
text_mt: One is not a Kaulika, O Goddess, so long as one has not been initiated into vows; / upon the fall of the body, liberation will occur through observing the conduct of vows.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃskāreṇa vihīnatvād guruvākyasya laṅghanāt |
ācāravarjanāddevi kaulikaḥ patito bhavet || 101 ||
meaning:
संस्कारेण विहीनत्वाद् गुरुवाक्यस्य लङ्घनात् |
आचारवर्जनाद्देवि कौलिकः पतितो भवेत् || 101 ||
text_mt: Through lack of purification rites, through transgression of the guru's word, / [and] through abandoning conduct, O Goddess, a Kaulika becomes fallen.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ dravyaṃ mantrayantrādilopanam |
anarhapaśuduḥsaṅgamantrasāṅkaryasambhavam      || 102 ||
meaning:
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं द्रव्यं मन्त्रयन्त्रादिलोपनम् |
अनर्हपशुदुःसङ्गमन्त्रसाङ्कर्यसम्भवम्      || 102 ||
text_mt: Omission of daily rites, occasional rites, substances, mantras, yantras, and the like; / arising from evil association with unworthy, uninitiated bound souls, and from confusion of mantras;

sanskrit_iast:
guptaprakaṭasambhūtaṃ   jñānājñānakṛtaṃ   priye |
evamādiṣu   doṣeṣu  pāpasya  gurulāghavam || 103 ||
meaning:
गुप्तप्रकटसम्भूतं   ज्ञानाज्ञानकृतं   प्रिये |
एवमादिषु   दोषेषु  पापस्य  गुरुलाघवम् || 103 ||
text_mt: produced secretly or openly, done knowingly or unknowingly, O beloved: / among such faults, the gravity or lightness of the demerit [is determined].

sanskrit_iast:
deśaṃ kālaṃ vayo vittaṃ samyag jñātvā yathāvidhi |
prāyaścittaṃ     gururddadyāt      sarvapāpaviśuddhaye || 104 ||
meaning:
देशं कालं वयो वित्तं सम्यग् ज्ञात्वा यथाविधि |
प्रायश्चित्तं     गुरुर्द्दद्यात्      सर्वपापविशुद्धये || 104 ||
text_mt: Knowing fully the place, time, age, and capacity according to the rule, / the guru should prescribe an expiation for purification from all demerits.

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyo'pi guruṇā''jñaptaṃ prāyaścittaṃ samācaret |
athavā   sarvapāpānāṃ    gurunāmajapaḥ   smṛtaḥ || 105 ||
meaning:
शिष्योऽपि गुरुणा'ऽज्ञप्तं प्रायश्चित्तं समाचरेत् |
अथवा   सर्वपापानां    गुरुनामजपः   स्मृतः || 105 ||
text_mt: The disciple too must perform the expiation commanded by the guru; / or else, the repetition of the guru's name is taught [as an expiation] for all demerits.

sanskrit_iast:
jāmbūnadasya  kaluṣaṃ  pariśuddhaṃ   yathāgninā |
anācārasya mālinyaṃ prāyañcittāgninā dahet || 106 ||
meaning:
जाम्बूनदस्य  कलुषं  परिशुद्धं   यथाग्निना |
अनाचारस्य मालिन्यं प्रायञ्चित्ताग्निना दहेत् || 106 ||
text_mt: Just as the impurity of gold is cleansed by fire, / one should burn away the taint of improper conduct with the fire of expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
bahunātra  kimuktena  rahasyaṃ  śṛṇu  pārvatī |
varṇāśramāṇāṃ sarveṣāmācāraḥ sadgatipradaḥ || 107 ||
meaning:
बहुनात्र  किमुक्तेन  रहस्यं  शृणु  पार्वती |
वर्णाश्रमाणां सर्वेषामाचारः सद्गतिप्रदः || 107 ||
text_mt: What is the use of speaking much on this matter? Hear the secret, O Pārvatī: / for all classes and stages of life, proper conduct grants a good destination.

sanskrit_iast:
gurustrivāramācāraṃ   kathayecca   kuleśvari |
na gṛhṇāti hi śiṣyaścettadā pāpaṃ gurorna hi || 108 ||
meaning:
गुरुस्त्रिवारमाचारं   कथयेच्च   कुलेश्वरि |
न गृह्णाति हि शिष्यश्चेत्तदा पापं गुरोर्न हि || 108 ||
text_mt: The guru should state the conduct three times, O Mistress of Kula; / if the disciple does not receive it, then no demerit attaches to the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
mantridoṣaśca rājānaṃ jāyādoṣaḥ patiṃ yathā |
tathā prāpnotyasandehaṃ  śiṣyapāpaṃ guruṃ priye || 109 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रिदोषश्च राजानं जायादोषः पतिं यथा |
तथा प्राप्नोत्यसन्देहं  शिष्यपापं गुरुं प्रिये || 109 ||
text_mt: Just as the fault of a minister falls upon the king, and the fault of a wife upon the husband, / so, without doubt, the demerit of the disciple falls upon the guru, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ  kiñcit samāsena kuleśvari |
kulācāravidhiṃ devi kimbhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 110 ||
meaning:
इति ते कथितं  किञ्चित् समासेन कुलेश्वरि |
कुलाचारविधिं देवि किम्भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि || 110 ||
text_mt: Thus has something been told to you in brief, O Mistress of Kula, / regarding the rule of conduct of Kula, O Goddess; what further do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast: atha dvādaśollāsaḥ
meaning: अथ द्वादशोल्लासः

sanskrit_iast:
śrī devyuvāca
kuleśa śrotumicchāmi pādukā bhaktilakṣaṇam |
ācāramapi  deveśa   vada   me  karuṇānidhe || 1 ||
meaning:
श्री देव्युवाच
कुलेश श्रोतुमिच्छामि पादुका भक्तिलक्षणम् |
आचारमपि  देवेश   वद   मे  करुणानिधे || 1 ||
text_mt: The Goddess said: / O Lord of Kula, I wish to hear the characteristics of devotion to the sandals [of the guru]; / tell me also the conduct, O Lord of gods, O ocean of compassion.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
tasya   śravaṇamātreṇa  bhaktirāśu  prajāpate || 2 ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि |
तस्य   श्रवणमात्रेण  भक्तिराशु  प्रजापते || 2 ||

sanskrit_iast:
vāgbhavā mūlavalaye sūtrādyāḥ kavalīkṛtāḥ |
evaṃ kulārṇave  jñānaṃ pādukāyāṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 3 ||
meaning:
वाग्भवा मूलवलये सूत्राद्याः कवलीकृताः |
एवं कुलार्णवे  ज्ञानं पादुकायां प्रतिष्ठितम् || 3 ||
text_mt:
Originating in speech, [the scriptures] beginning with the sūtras are swallowed up in the root circle;
In this way, in the Kulārṇava, knowledge is established in the [guru's] sandals (pādukā).

sanskrit_iast:
koṭikoṭimahādānāt koṭikoṭimahāvratāt |
koṭikoṭimahāyajñāt parā śrīpādukāsmṛtiḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
कोटिकोटिमहादानात् कोटिकोटिमहाव्रतात् |
कोटिकोटिमहायज्ञात् परा श्रीपादुकास्मृतिः || 4 ||
text_mt:
Superior to millions upon millions of great gifts, superior to millions upon millions of great vows,
Superior to millions upon millions of great sacrifices is the remembrance of the sacred sandals.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭikoṭimantrajāpāt koṭitīrthāvagāhanāt |
koṭidevārcanāddevi  parā   śrīpādukāsmṛtiḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
कोटिकोटिमन्त्रजापात् कोटितीर्थावगाहनात् |
कोटिदेवार्चनाद्देवि  परा   श्रीपादुकास्मृतिः || 5 ||
text_mt:
Superior to millions upon millions of mantra recitations, superior to immersion in millions of sacred bathing places,
Superior to the worship of millions of gods, O Goddess, is the remembrance of the sacred sandals.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāroge   mahotpāte   mahādoṣe   mahābhaye |
mahāpadi  mahāpāpe  smṛtā  rakṣati pādukā || 6 ||
meaning:
महारोगे   महोत्पाते   महादोषे   महाभये |
महापदि  महापापे  स्मृता  रक्षति पादुका || 6 ||
text_mt:
In great illness, in great calamity, in great fault, in great fear,
In great misfortune, in great demerit, the sandals, remembered, protect.

sanskrit_iast:
durācāre   durālāpe   duḥsaṅge   duṣpratigrahe |
durācāre ca durbuddhau  smṛtā  rakṣati pādukā || 7 ||
meaning:
दुराचारे   दुरालापे   दुःसङ्गे   दुष्प्रतिग्रहे |
दुराचारे च दुर्बुद्धौ  स्मृता  रक्षति पादुका || 7 ||
text_mt:
In improper conduct, in improper speech, in bad company, in improper acceptance [of gifts],
In improper conduct and evil intent, the sandals, remembered, protect.

sanskrit_iast:
tenādhītaṃ smṛtaṃ  jñātam  iṣṭaṃ dattañca pūjitam |
jihvāgre varttate yasya sadā śrīpādukāsmṛtiḥ || 8 ||
meaning:
तेनाधीतं स्मृतं  ज्ञातम्  इष्टं दत्तञ्च पूजितम् |
जिह्वाग्रे वर्त्तते यस्य सदा श्रीपादुकास्मृतिः || 8 ||
text_mt:
By him has been studied, remembered, known, sacrificed, given, and worshipped,
Upon the tip of whose tongue the remembrance of the sacred sandals always abides.

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛt śrīpādukāṃ devi yo vā japati bhaktitaḥ |
sa   sarvapāparahitaḥ  prāpnoti   paramāṃ  gatim || 9 ||
meaning:
सकृत् श्रीपादुकां देवि यो वा जपति भक्तितः |
स   सर्वपापरहितः  प्राप्नोति   परमां  गतिम् || 9 ||
text_mt:
Whoever, O Goddess, recites [the mantra of] the sacred sandals even once with devotion,
Freed from all demerit, he attains the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
śucirvāpyaśucirvāpi bhaktyā smarati pādukām |
anāyāsena   dharmārthakāmamokṣān  labhate  saḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
शुचिर्वाप्यशुचिर्वापि भक्त्या स्मरति पादुकाम् |
अनायासेन   धर्मार्थकाममोक्षान्  लभते  सः || 10 ||
text_mt:
Whether pure or impure, whoever remembers the sandals with devotion,
Effortlessly obtains duty, wealth, desire, and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnāthacaraṇāmbhojaṃ   yasyāṃ   diśi  virājate |
tasyāṃ diśi namaskuryāt bhaktyā pratidinaṃ priye || 11 ||
meaning:
श्रीनाथचरणाम्भोजं   यस्यां   दिशि  विराजते |
तस्यां दिशि नमस्कुर्यात् भक्त्या प्रतिदिनं प्रिये || 11 ||
text_mt:
In whichever direction the lotus feet of the venerable master shine,
In that direction one should bow down daily with devotion, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
na pādukāparo  mantro  na  devaḥ  śrīguroḥ  paraḥ |
na hi śāktāt parā dīkṣā na puṇyaṃ kulapūjanāt || 12 ||
meaning:
न पादुकापरो  मन्त्रो  न  देवः  श्रीगुरोः  परः |
न हि शाक्तात् परा दीक्षा न पुण्यं कुलपूजनात् || 12 ||
text_mt:
There is no mantra superior to the sandals; there is no god superior to the venerable guru;
Indeed, there is no initiation superior to the Śākta initiation; there is no merit [superior] to worship of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānamūlaṃ gurormūttīḥ pūjāmūlaṃ  guroḥ padam |
mantramūlaṃ gurorvākyaṃ mokṣamūlaṃ guroḥ kṛpā || 13 ||
meaning:
ध्यानमूलं गुरोर्मूत्तीः पूजामूलं  गुरोः पदम् |
मन्त्रमूलं गुरोर्वाक्यं मोक्षमूलं गुरोः कृपा || 13 ||
text_mt:
The root of meditation is the form of the guru; the root of worship is the feet of the guru;
The root of mantra is the word of the guru; the root of liberation is the grace of the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
gurumūlāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā loke'smin kulanāyike |
tasmāt  sevyo  gurunītyaṃ  siddhyarthaṃ  bhaktisaṃyutaiḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
गुरुमूलाः क्रियाः सर्वा लोकेऽस्मिन् कुलनायिके |
तस्मात्  सेव्यो  गुरुनीत्यं  सिद्ध्यर्थं  भक्तिसंयुतैः || 14 ||
text_mt:
All rituals in this world have their root in the guru, O mistress of Kula;
Therefore, the guru should constantly be served with devotion for the sake of accomplishment.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadāttīrbhayaṃ śoko  lobhamohabhramādayaḥ |
yāvannāyāti śaraṇaṃ śrīguruṃ bhaktavatsalam || 15 ||
meaning:
तावदात्तीर्भयं शोको  लोभमोहभ्रमादयः |
यावन्नायाति शरणं श्रीगुरुं भक्तवत्सलम् || 15 ||
text_mt:
So long do affliction, fear, sorrow, greed, delusion, bewilderment, and the rest persist,
As long as one does not take refuge in the venerable guru, who is affectionate to his devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvad bhramanti  saṃsāre  sarvaduḥkhamalīmasāḥ |
na bhavet sadgurau bhaktiryāvaddeveśi dehinām || 16 ||
meaning:
तावद् भ्रमन्ति  संसारे  सर्वदुःखमलीमसाः |
न भवेत् सद्गुरौ भक्तिर्यावद्देवेशि देहिनाम् || 16 ||
text_mt:
So long do they wander in the transmigratory cycle, soiled by all suffering,
As long as embodied beings have no devotion to the true guru, O ruler of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasiddhiphalopeto mantraḥ śudhyati śobhanaḥ |
guruprasādamūlo'yaṃ       paratattvamahākramaḥ || 17 ||
meaning:
सर्वसिद्धिफलोपेतो मन्त्रः शुध्यति शोभनः |
गुरुप्रसादमूलोऽयं       परतत्त्वमहाक्रमः || 17 ||
text_mt:
Endowed with the fruit of all accomplishments, the auspicious mantra becomes pure;
This great lineage of the supreme reality has its root in the grace of the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā dadāti santuṣṭaḥ  prasanno  varado  manum |
tathā bhaktyā dhanaiḥ prāṇairguruṃ yatnena toṣayet || 18 ||
meaning:
यथा ददाति सन्तुष्टः  प्रसन्नो  वरदो  मनुम् |
तथा भक्त्या धनैः प्राणैर्गुरुं यत्नेन तोषयेत् || 18 ||
text_mt:
So that, satisfied and pleased, he grants the mantra as a bestower of boons,
One should diligently please the guru with devotion, wealth, and vital breaths.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā dadyāt svaśiṣyāya svātmānaṃ deśikottamaḥ |
tadā  mukto  bhavecchiṣyastato  nāsti  punarbhavaḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
यदा दद्यात् स्वशिष्याय स्वात्मानं देशिकोत्तमः |
तदा  मुक्तो  भवेच्छिष्यस्ततो  नास्ति  पुनर्भवः || 19 ||
text_mt:
When the best of teachers gives his own self to his disciple,
Then the disciple becomes liberated; from that, there is no rebirth.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadārādhayecchiṣyaḥ prasanno'sau yadā bhavet |
gurau prasanne śiṣyasya sadyaḥ  pāpakṣayo bhavet || 20 ||
meaning:
तावदाराधयेच्छिष्यः प्रसन्नोऽसौ यदा भवेत् |
गुरौ प्रसन्ने शिष्यस्य सद्यः  पापक्षयो भवेत् || 20 ||
text_mt:
The disciple should worship him until he becomes pleased;
When the guru is pleased, the disciple's demerits are immediately destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
manasāpi  na  kāṅkṣante  yān  kāmānanujīvinaḥ |
sampādayanti tān sarvān svāmino bhaktavatsalāḥ || 21 ||
meaning:
मनसापि  न  काङ्क्षन्ते  यान्  कामाननुजीविनः |
सम्पादयन्ति तान् सर्वान् स्वामिनो भक्तवत्सलाः || 21 ||
text_mt:
The desires that dependents do not even wish for in their minds,
All those are fulfilled by masters who are affectionate to their devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādidevatāmuniyoginaḥ    |
kurvantyanugrahaṃ tuṣṭā gurau tuṣṭe na saṃśayaḥ || 22 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशादिदेवतामुनियोगिनः    |
कुर्वन्त्यनुग्रहं तुष्टा गुरौ तुष्टे न संशयः || 22 ||
text_mt:
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Maheśa, and other deities, sages, and yogins,
Pleased, bestow their grace when the guru is pleased—there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā tuṣṭena guruṇā yaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ kṛpālunā |
karmamukto bhavecchiṣyoḥ bhuktimuktyoḥ sa bhājanam || 23 ||
meaning:
भक्त्या तुष्टेन गुरुणा यः प्रदिष्टः कृपालुना |
कर्ममुक्तो भवेच्छिष्योः भुक्तिमुक्त्योः स भाजनम् || 23 ||
text_mt:
The disciple who is instructed by a guru pleased with his devotion and compassionate,
Becomes freed from karma; he is a vessel for enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyeṇāpi tathā kāryaṃ tathā santoṣito guruḥ |
priyaṃ kuryācca deveśi manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || 24 ||
meaning:
शिष्येणापि तथा कार्यं तथा सन्तोषितो गुरुः |
प्रियं कुर्याच्च देवेशि मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः || 24 ||
text_mt:
The disciple must also act in such a way that the guru is pleased,
And he should do what is pleasing, O ruler of the gods, with actions of mind, speech, and body.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi  tuṣṭena  guruṇātmaśiṣyo  yatra  kutracit |
mukto'sīti samādiṣṭaḥ so'pi muktiṃ vrajet priye || 25 ||
meaning:
यदि  तुष्टेन  गुरुणात्मशिष्यो  यत्र  कुत्रचित् |
मुक्तोऽसीति समादिष्टः सोऽपि मुक्तिं व्रजेत् प्रिये || 25 ||
text_mt:
If, by a pleased guru anywhere, his own disciple
Is told, 'You are liberated,' he too attains liberation, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā  niṣprapañcena  dhāmnā  kenacidīśvaraḥ |
karoti   gururūpeṇa   paśupāśavimocanam || 26 ||
meaning:
अथवा  निष्प्रपञ्चेन  धाम्ना  केनचिदीश्वरः |
करोति   गुरुरूपेण   पशुपाशविमोचनम् || 26 ||
text_mt:
Or rather, by some unmanifest splendor, the Lord,
In the form of the guru, effects the release from the fetters of the uninitiated bound soul.

sanskrit_iast:
na me priyaścaturvedī madbhaktaḥ śvapaco'pi vā |
tasmai deyaṃ tato grāhyaṃ sa tu pūjyo hyahaṃ tathā || 27 ||
meaning:
न मे प्रियश्चतुर्वेदी मद्भक्तः श्वपचोऽपि वा |
तस्मै देयं ततो ग्राह्यं स तु पूज्यो ह्यहं तथा || 27 ||
text_mt:
One who knows the four Vedas is not dear to me, but my devotee is, even if an outcaste;
To him it should be given, from him it should be received, and he is to be worshipped just as I am.

sanskrit_iast:
vipraḥ  ṣaḍguṇayuktaścedabhakto  na  praśasyate |
mleccho'pi guṇahīno'pi bhaktimān śiṣya ucyate || 28 ||
meaning:
विप्रः  षड्गुणयुक्तश्चेदभक्तो  न  प्रशस्यते |
म्लेच्छोऽपि गुणहीनोऽपि भक्तिमान् शिष्य उच्यते || 28 ||
text_mt:
A Brahmin, even if endowed with the six qualities, is not praised if devoid of devotion;
Even a foreigner, even if devoid of qualities, is called a disciple if possessing devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
gurubhaktivihīnasya tapo vidyā kulaṃ vratam |
sarvaṃ naśyati  tatraiva  bhūṣaṇaṃ  lokarañjanam || 29 ||
meaning:
गुरुभक्तिविहीनस्य तपो विद्या कुलं व्रतम् |
सर्वं नश्यति  तत्रैव  भूषणं  लोकरञ्जनम् || 29 ||
text_mt:
For one devoid of devotion to the guru, austerity, learning, lineage, and vow,
All perish right there; [they are mere] ornament pleasing to the world.

sanskrit_iast:
gurubhaktyagninā      samyagdagdhadurmatikalmaṣaḥ |
śvapaco'pi paraiḥ pūjyo vidvānapi na nāstikaḥ || 30 ||
meaning:
गुरुभक्त्यग्निना      सम्यग्दग्धदुर्मतिकल्मषः |
श्वपचोऽपि परैः पूज्यो विद्वानपि न नास्तिकः || 30 ||
text_mt:
One whose impurity of evil intellect is thoroughly burned by the fire of devotion to the guru,
Even if an outcaste, is to be worshipped by others; even a learned man [is not], if he is an unbeliever.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmārthakāmaiḥ kintasya  mokṣa  eva kare sthitaḥ |
sarvārthaiḥ śrīgurau devi yasya bhaktiḥ sadā sthirā || 31 ||
meaning:
धर्मार्थकामैः किन्तस्य  मोक्ष  एव करे स्थितः |
सर्वार्थैः श्रीगुरौ देवि यस्य भक्तिः सदा स्थिरा || 31 ||
text_mt:
What need has he of duty, wealth, and desire? Liberation itself stands in his hand,
Whose devotion to the venerable guru, O Goddess, is always steady in every way.

sanskrit_iast:
sa   śivo  gururūpeṇa  bhuktimuktiprado  mama |
iti bhaktyā smared yastu tasya sidviradūrataḥ || 32 ||
meaning:
स   शिवो  गुरुरूपेण  भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदो  मम |
इति भक्त्या स्मरेद् यस्तु तस्य सिद्विरदूरतः || 32 ||
text_mt:
‘That Śiva in the form of the guru bestows enjoyment and liberation upon me’—
Whoever remembers thus with devotion, accomplishment is not far from him.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya  deve  parā  bhaktiryathā  deve  tathā  gurau |
tasya te kathitā hyarthāḥ prakāśante kuleśvari || 33 ||
meaning:
यस्य  देवे  परा  भक्तिर्यथा  देवे  तथा  गुरौ |
तस्य ते कथिता ह्यर्थाः प्रकाशन्ते कुलेश्वरि || 33 ||
text_mt:
He who has supreme devotion to God, and as to God, so to the guru,
To him these explained truths shine forth, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇe   mahādeve  mātāpitrośca  rājani |
bhaktiryathā mahādevi tathā kāryā nije gurau || 34 ||
meaning:
नारायणे   महादेवे  मातापित्रोश्च  राजनि |
भक्तिर्यथा महादेवि तथा कार्या निजे गुरौ || 34 ||
text_mt:
As devotion is paid to Nārāyaṇa, to Mahādeva, to mother and father, and to the king,
So should it be paid to one's own guru, O great Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau vāṇīdhātārau girijāśivau |
śrīguruṃ  gurupatnīñca  pitarāviti  cintayet || 35 ||
meaning:
लक्ष्मीनारायणौ वाणीधातारौ गिरिजाशिवौ |
श्रीगुरुं  गुरुपत्नीञ्च  पितराविति  चिन्तयेत् || 35 ||
text_mt:
One should meditate upon the venerable guru and the guru's wife as parents,
Like Lakṣmī and Nārāyaṇa, Sarasvatī and Brahmā, Pārvatī and Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
gurubhaktyā yathā devi prāpyante sarvasiddhayaḥ |
yajñaḥ  dānatapastīrthavratādyairna   tathā   priye || 36 ||
meaning:
गुरुभक्त्या यथा देवि प्राप्यन्ते सर्वसिद्धयः |
यज्ञः  दानतपस्तीर्थव्रताद्यैर्न   तथा   प्रिये || 36 ||
text_mt:
As all accomplishments are obtained through devotion to the guru, O Goddess,
They are not thus obtained through sacrifices, gifts, austerities, bathing places, vows, and the like, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīgurau niścalā bhaktirvarddhate hi yathā yathā |
tathā tathāsya vijñānaṃ  varddhate kulanāyike || 37 ||
meaning:
श्रीगुरौ निश्चला भक्तिर्वर्द्धते हि यथा यथा |
तथा तथास्य विज्ञानं  वर्द्धते कुलनायिके || 37 ||
text_mt:
Just as unswerving devotion to the venerable guru grows,
So also his discernment grows, O mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
ki tīrthādyairmahāyāsaiḥ kiṃ vrataiḥ kāyaśoṣaṇaiḥ |
nirvyājasevā  deveśi bhaktireṣā  hi sadguroḥ || 38 ||
meaning:
कि तीर्थाद्यैर्महायासैः किं व्रतैः कायशोषणैः |
निर्व्याजसेवा  देवेशि भक्तिरेषा  हि सद्गुरोः || 38 ||
text_mt:
What is the use of sacred bathing places and the like with great exertions? What of vows that wither the body?
Unfeigned service, O ruler of the gods, is indeed this devotion to the true guru.

sanskrit_iast:
kāyākleśena mahatā tapasā vāpi yat phalam |
tat  phalaṃ  labhate  devi  sukhena  gurusevayā || 39 ||
meaning:
कायाक्लेशेन महता तपसा वापि यत् फलम् |
तत्  फलं  लभते  देवि  सुखेन  गुरुसेवया || 39 ||
text_mt:
Whatever fruit is attained by severe bodily mortification or austerity,
That fruit one attains with ease, O Goddess, through service to the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
bhogamokṣāthīnāṃ brahmaviṣṇvīśapadakāṅkṣiṇām |
bhaktireva  gurau  devi nānyaḥ panthā iti śrutiḥ || 40 ||
meaning:
भोगमोक्षाथीनां ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीशपदकाङ्क्षिणाम् |
भक्तिरेव  गुरौ  देवि नान्यः पन्था इति श्रुतिः || 40 ||
text_mt:
For those who desire enjoyment and liberation, for those who long for the abode of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva,
Devotion to the guru alone [is the means], O Goddess; 'there is no other path,' says scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
aśubhāni ca karmāṇi mahāpātakajāni ca |
bhaktiḥ kṣaṇena  dahati  tūlarāśimivānalaḥ || 41 ||
meaning:
अशुभानि च कर्माणि महापातकजानि च |
भक्तिः क्षणेन  दहति  तूलराशिमिवानलः || 41 ||
text_mt:
And inauspicious deeds, even those born of the greatest sins,
Devotion burns in an instant, like fire a heap of cotton.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāsāya namastasmai sarvasiddhipradāyine |
yena mṛddāruddaṣadaḥ phalantyaviphalaṃ phalam || 42 ||
meaning:
विश्वासाय नमस्तस्मै सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायिने |
येन मृद्दारुद्दषदः फलन्त्यविफलं फलम् || 42 ||
text_mt:
Homage to that trust which bestows all accomplishments,
Through which clay, wood, and stones bear unfailing fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
na yogo na tapo nārcākramaḥ ko'pi pralīyate |
amāye kulamārge'smin bhaktireva viśiṣyate || 43 ||
meaning:
न योगो न तपो नार्चाक्रमः कोऽपि प्रलीयते |
अमाये कुलमार्गेऽस्मिन् भक्तिरेव विशिष्यते || 43 ||
text_mt:
Neither yoga, nor austerity, nor any sequence of worship dissolves;
In this genuine path of Kula, devotion alone is preeminent.

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣād gurumaye  devi  sarvasmin  bhuvanāntare |
kinnu bhaktimatāṃ kṣetre mantraḥ keṣāṃ na sidhyati || 44 ||
meaning:
साक्षाद् गुरुमये  देवि  सर्वस्मिन्  भुवनान्तरे |
किन्नु भक्तिमतां क्षेत्रे मन्त्रः केषां न सिध्यति || 44 ||
text_mt:
When the entire interior of the worlds is visibly made of the guru, O Goddess,
In the field of those who possess devotion, for whom does the mantra not bear fruit?

sanskrit_iast:
gurau  manuṣyabuddhiñca  mantre  cākṣarabuddhikam |
pratimāsu śilābuddhi kurvāṇo narakaṃ vrajet || 45 ||
meaning:
गुरौ  मनुष्यबुद्धिञ्च  मन्त्रे  चाक्षरबुद्धिकम् |
प्रतिमासु शिलाबुद्धि कुर्वाणो नरकं व्रजेत् || 45 ||
text_mt: One who regards the guru as a human being, a mantra as mere letters, / and images [of deities] as stone, goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
guruṃ na marttyaṃ budhyeta yadi  budhyeta tasya hi |
na kadācidbhavet siddhirmantrairvā devatārcanaiḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
गुरुं न मर्त्त्यं बुध्येत यदि  बुध्येत तस्य हि |
न कदाचिद्भवेत् सिद्धिर्मन्त्रैर्वा देवतार्चनैः || 46 ||
