text_mt: One must not regard the guru as mortal; if one does regard him [so], / one will never attain success, either through mantras or through worship of deities.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīguruṃ prākṛtaiḥ sārddhaṃ ye smaranti vadanti ca |
teṣāṃ hi sukṛtaṃ sarvaṃ  pātakaṃ  bhavati  priye || 47 ||
meaning:
श्रीगुरुं प्राकृतैः सार्द्धं ये स्मरन्ति वदन्ति च |
तेषां हि सुकृतं सर्वं  पातकं  भवति  प्रिये || 47 ||
text_mt: Those who remember or speak of the venerable guru alongside ordinary people— / all their good deeds, O dear one, become sins.

sanskrit_iast:
janmahetū  hi  pitarau  pūjanīyau  prayatnataḥ |
guruvīśeṣataḥ   pūjyo  dharmādharmapradarśakaḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
जन्महेतू  हि  पितरौ  पूजनीयौ  प्रयत्नतः |
गुरुवीशेषतः   पूज्यो  धर्माधर्मप्रदर्शकः || 48 ||
text_mt: Parents, being the cause of one's birth, are indeed to be worshipped with effort; / the guru is to be worshipped even more, as the shower of what is righteous and unrighteous.

sanskrit_iast:
guruḥ pitā gururmātā  gururddevo  maheśvaraḥ |
śive ruṣṭe gurustrātā gurau ruṣṭe na kaścana || 49 ||
meaning:
गुरुः पिता गुरुर्माता  गुरुर्द्देवो  महेश्वरः |
शिवे रुष्टे गुरुस्त्राता गुरौ रुष्टे न कश्चन || 49 ||
text_mt: The guru is father, the guru is mother, the guru is God Maheśvara; / when Śiva is angered, the guru is the protector, but when the guru is angered, no one [can protect].

sanskrit_iast:
gurohītaṃ hi karttavyaṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ |
ahitācaraṇāddevi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate krimiḥ || 50 ||
meaning:
गुरोहीतं हि कर्त्तव्यं मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः |
अहिताचरणाद्देवि विष्ठायां जायते क्रिमिः || 50 ||
text_mt: What is beneficial to the guru must indeed be done with mind, speech, and physical actions; / from acting against his welfare, O Goddess, one is born as a worm in excrement.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīravittaprāṇaiśca  śrīguruṃ  vañcayanti   ye |
krimikīṭapataṅgatvaṃ prātnuvanti na saṃśayaḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
शरीरवित्तप्राणैश्च  श्रीगुरुं  वञ्चयन्ति   ये |
क्रिमिकीटपतङ्गत्वं प्रात्नुवन्ति न संशयः || 51 ||
text_mt: Those who deceive the venerable guru in matters of body, wealth, or vital breath / attain the state of worms, insects, and moths; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
mantra   tyāgādbhavenmṛtyurgurutyāgāddaridratā |
gurumantraparityāgādrauravaṃ   narakaṃ  vrajet || 52 ||
meaning:
मन्त्र   त्यागाद्भवेन्मृत्युर्गुरुत्यागाद्दरिद्रता |
गुरुमन्त्रपरित्यागाद्रौरवं   नरकं  व्रजेत् || 52 ||
text_mt: From abandoning the mantra comes death; from abandoning the guru comes poverty; / from abandoning both guru and mantra, one goes to the Raurava hell.

sanskrit_iast:
gurvarthaṃ    dhārayeddehaṃ   tadarthaṃ    dhanamarjayet |
nijaprāṇān parityajya gurukāryaṃ samācaret || 53 ||
meaning:
गुर्वर्थं    धारयेद्देहं   तदर्थं    धनमर्जयेत् |
निजप्राणान् परित्यज्य गुरुकार्यं समाचरेत् || 53 ||
text_mt: One should maintain one's body for the sake of the guru, and earn wealth for his sake; / abandoning one's own life, one should carry out the work of the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
gurūktaṃ paruṣaṃ vākyamāśiṣaṃ  paricintayet |
tena santāḍito vāpi prasādamiti saṃsmaret || 54 ||
meaning:
गुरूक्तं परुषं वाक्यमाशिषं  परिचिन्तयेत् |
तेन सन्ताडितो वापि प्रसादमिति संस्मरेत् || 54 ||
text_mt: A harsh word spoken by the guru one should contemplate as a blessing; / even if struck by him, one should remember it as grace.

sanskrit_iast:
bhogya bhojyāni vastūni guruve ca samarpayet |
taccheṣamiti sañcintya cānubhūyāt kuleśvari || 55 ||
meaning:
भोग्य भोज्यानि वस्तूनि गुरुवे च समर्पयेत् |
तच्छेषमिति सञ्चिन्त्य चानुभूयात् कुलेश्वरि || 55 ||
text_mt: One should offer objects of enjoyment and food to the guru; / considering them to be his remnants, one should enjoy them, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
gurvagre  na  tapaḥ  kuryānnopavāsavratādikam |
tīrthayātrāṃ na kuryācca na snāyādātmaśuddhaye || 56 ||
meaning:
गुर्वग्रे  न  तपः  कुर्यान्नोपवासव्रतादिकम् |
तीर्थयात्रां न कुर्याच्च न स्नायादात्मशुद्धये || 56 ||
text_mt: In the presence of the guru, one should not practice asceticism, nor fasts, vows, and the like; / one should not undertake pilgrimages, nor bathe for the purification of oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
na viyogaṃ  guroḥ kuryāt  yuṣmado naiva  bhāṣayet |
ṛṇadānaṃ  tathā''dānaṃ  vastūnāṃ   krayavikrayam |
na kuryād gurubhiḥ sārddhaṃ śiṣyo bhūtvā kathañcana || 57 ||
meaning:
न वियोगं  गुरोः कुर्यात्  युष्मदो नैव  भाषयेत् |
ऋणदानं  तथा'ऽदानं  वस्तूनां   क्रयविक्रयम् |
न कुर्याद् गुरुभिः सार्द्धं शिष्यो भूत्वा कथञ्चन || 57 ||
text_mt: One must not separate oneself from the guru, nor address him as 'you'; / giving or taking loans, or buying and selling goods— / having become a disciple, one should never do these with gurus.

sanskrit_iast:
na   kuryānnāstikairvādaṃ    sambhāṣaṇamapīśvari |
vilokya dūrato gacchennāsīta saha taiḥ kvacit || 58 ||
meaning:
न   कुर्यान्नास्तिकैर्वादं    सम्भाषणमपीश्वरि |
विलोक्य दूरतो गच्छेन्नासीत सह तैः क्वचित् || 58 ||
text_mt: One must not engage in debate with materialists, nor even in conversation, O Sovereign Lady; / having seen them from afar, one should walk away; one should never sit with them anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
gurau    sannihite   yastu   pūjayedanyamambike |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ sā pūjā niṣphalā bhavet || 59 ||
meaning:
गुरौ    सन्निहिते   यस्तु   पूजयेदन्यमम्बिके |
स याति नरकं घोरं सा पूजा निष्फला भवेत् || 59 ||
text_mt: He who worships another when the guru is present, O Mother, / goes to a terrible hell, and that worship becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
śirasā  na  vahedbhāraṃ  gurupādābjadhāriṇā |
tadājñayā tu karttavyamājñārūpo guruḥ smṛtaḥ || 60 ||
meaning:
शिरसा  न  वहेद्भारं  गुरुपादाब्जधारिणा |
तदाज्ञया तु कर्त्तव्यमाज्ञारूपो गुरुः स्मृतः || 60 ||
text_mt: One should not carry a burden on the head that bears the lotus feet of the guru; / but it may be done at his command, for the guru is taught to be the embodiment of the command.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrāgamādyamanyatra  śrutaṃ  yasmai  nivedayet |
gurvājñayā tu gṛhṇīyāttanniṣiddhaṃ vivarjayet || 61 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रागमाद्यमन्यत्र  श्रुतं  यस्मै  निवेदयेत् |
गुर्वाज्ञया तु गृह्णीयात्तन्निषिद्धं विवर्जयेत् || 61 ||
text_mt: Whatever mantra, sacred tradition, or other instruction heard elsewhere one reports to him, / one should accept only by the guru's command; whatever is forbidden by him, one should abandon.

sanskrit_iast:
svaśāstroktaṃ rahasyārthaṃ na vaded yasya kasyacit |
yadi brūyāt  sa  samayāccyuta  eva  na  saṃśayaḥ || 62 ||
meaning:
स्वशास्त्रोक्तं रहस्यार्थं न वदेद् यस्य कस्यचित् |
यदि ब्रूयात्  स  समयाच्च्युत  एव  न  संशयः || 62 ||
text_mt: One must not speak the secret meaning declared in one's own scripture to just anyone; / if one speaks it, one has fallen from the pledge; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
advaitaṃ   bhāvayennityaṃ  na  dvaitaṃ  guruṇā   saha |
ātmavat sarvabhūtebhyo hitaṃ kuryāt kuleśvari || 63 ||
meaning:
अद्वैतं   भावयेन्नित्यं  न  द्वैतं  गुरुणा   सह |
आत्मवत् सर्वभूतेभ्यो हितं कुर्यात् कुलेश्वरि || 63 ||
text_mt: One should always contemplate non-duality, never duality with the guru; / as with oneself, one should act for the welfare of all beings, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmārthamānasadbhāvaiḥ   śuśrūṣā  syāccatuvīdhā |
śuśrūṣayā dhiyā devi śiṣyaḥ santoṣayed gurum || 64 ||
meaning:
आत्मार्थमानसद्भावैः   शुश्रूषा  स्याच्चतुवीधा |
शुश्रूषया धिया देवि शिष्यः सन्तोषयेद् गुरुम् || 64 ||
text_mt: Service is of four kinds: by means of the self, wealth, mind, and true disposition; / through service accompanied by intelligence, O Goddess, the disciple should please the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
pade pade'śvamedhasya  phalaṃ  prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ |
śuśrūṣaṇaparo    yastu    gurudevamahātmanām || 65 ||
meaning:
पदे पदेऽश्वमेधस्य  फलं  प्राप्नोत्यसंशयः |
शुश्रूषणपरो    यस्तु    गुरुदेवमहात्मनाम् || 65 ||
text_mt: At every step, one attains the fruit of a horse sacrifice, without doubt— / one who is devoted to the service of the great-souled Guru-God.

sanskrit_iast:
kevalaṃ guruśuśrūṣā  tvatkṛpākāriṇī priye |
sadbhaktisahitā cet sā sarvakāmaphalapradā || 66 ||
meaning:
केवलं गुरुशुश्रूषा  त्वत्कृपाकारिणी प्रिये |
सद्भक्तिसहिता चेत् सा सर्वकामफलप्रदा || 66 ||
text_mt: Service to the guru alone brings about your grace, O dear one; / if accompanied by true devotion, it bestows the fruit of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīyante sarvapāpāni  varddhante  puṇyarāśayaḥ |
sidhyanti sarvakāryāṇi guruśuśrūṣayā priye || 67 ||
meaning:
क्षीयन्ते सर्वपापानि  वर्द्धन्ते  पुण्यराशयः |
सिध्यन्ति सर्वकार्याणि गुरुशुश्रूषया प्रिये || 67 ||
text_mt: All sins are destroyed, heaps of merit increase, / and all undertakings succeed through service to the guru, O dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
yad  yadātmahitaṃ  vastu  tattaddhitamupācaret |
gurudevārcako yastu tasya puṇyaṃ na gaṇyate || 68 ||
meaning:
यद्  यदात्महितं  वस्तु  तत्तद्धितमुपाचरेत् |
गुरुदेवार्चको यस्तु तस्य पुण्यं न गण्यते || 68 ||
text_mt: Whatever object is beneficial to oneself, that very benefit one should offer [to him]; / for one who worships the Guru-God, his merit cannot be counted.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā vittānusāreṇa gurumuddiśya yat kṛtam |
alpe  mahati vā  tulyaṃ  puṇyamāḍhyadaridrayoḥ || 69 ||
meaning:
भक्त्या वित्तानुसारेण गुरुमुद्दिश्य यत् कृतम् |
अल्पे  महति वा  तुल्यं  पुण्यमाढ्यदरिद्रयोः || 69 ||
text_mt: Whatever is done for the sake of the guru with devotion, according to one's wealth, / whether small or great, the merit is equal for the rich and the poor.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasvamapi yo  dadyād  gurau  bhaktivivajītaḥ |
śiṣyo na phalamāpnoti bhaktireva hi kāraṇam || 70 ||
meaning:
सर्वस्वमपि यो  दद्याद्  गुरौ  भक्तिविवजीतः |
शिष्यो न फलमाप्नोति भक्तिरेव हि कारणम् || 70 ||
text_mt: Even if one gives one's entire possession, devoid of devotion to the guru, / the disciple does not attain the fruit, for devotion alone is the cause.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmin dravye gurorasti spṛhā nānubhavettu tat |
avaśyaṃ yadi  vāñchā  syādanubhūyāttadājñayā || 71 ||
meaning:
यस्मिन् द्रव्ये गुरोरस्ति स्पृहा नानुभवेत्तु तत् |
अवश्यं यदि  वाञ्छा  स्यादनुभूयात्तदाज्ञया || 71 ||
text_mt: An object for which the guru has a desire, one should not enjoy; / if there is an unavoidable desire, one may enjoy it by his command.

sanskrit_iast:
yastilārddhaṃ   tadarddhaṃ   vā   gurusvamupajīvati |
lobhānmohāt sa pacyeta narake ca trisaptake || 72 ||
meaning:
यस्तिलार्द्धं   तदर्द्धं   वा   गुरुस्वमुपजीवति |
लोभान्मोहात् स पच्येत नरके च त्रिसप्तके || 72 ||
text_mt: He who lives off even half a sesame seed, or half of that, of the guru's property / out of greed or delusion, cooks in the twenty-one hells.

sanskrit_iast:
atyalpaṃ hi gurordravyamadattaṃ  svīkaroti  yaḥ |
sa tiryag yonimāpannaḥ kravyādairbhakṣyate priye || 73 ||
meaning:
अत्यल्पं हि गुरोर्द्रव्यमदत्तं  स्वीकरोति  यः |
स तिर्यग् योनिमापन्नः क्रव्यादैर्भक्ष्यते प्रिये || 73 ||
text_mt: He who takes even the slightest property of the guru without it being given, / entering an animal womb, is devoured by carnivorous beasts, O dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
gurudravyābhilāṣī  ca  gurustrīgamanotsukaḥ |
patitasya kṣullakasya prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate || 74 ||
meaning:
गुरुद्रव्याभिलाषी  च  गुरुस्त्रीगमनोत्सुकः |
पतितस्य क्षुल्लकस्य प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते || 74 ||
text_mt: One who covets the guru's property, and one eager to approach the guru's wife— / for that fallen, wretched person, no expiation exists.

sanskrit_iast:
ājñābhaṅgo'rthaharaṇaṃ       gurorapriyavarttanam |
gurudrohamidaṃ  prāhuryaḥ  karoti  sa  pātakī || 75 ||
meaning:
आज्ञाभङ्गोऽर्थहरणं       गुरोरप्रियवर्त्तनम् |
गुरुद्रोहमिदं  प्राहुर्यः  करोति  स  पातकी || 75 ||
text_mt: Disobedience of the command, stealing his wealth, behaving unpleasantly toward the guru— / this they call betrayal of the guru; whoever commits it is a sinner.

sanskrit_iast:
svadravyaviniyogañca   nānivedya   gurau   caret |
anivedya tu yaḥ kuryāt sa bhaved brahmaghātakaḥ || 76 ||
meaning:
स्वद्रव्यविनियोगञ्च   नानिवेद्य   गुरौ   चरेत् |
अनिवेद्य तु यः कुर्यात् स भवेद् ब्रह्मघातकः || 76 ||
text_mt: One should not dispose of one's own property without informing the guru; / he who does so without informing him becomes a murderer of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
guroḥ sthānaṃ sampradāyaṃ taddharmaṃ yo vināśayet |
gurubhiḥ sa bahiṣkāryo daṇḍyo vadhyaḥ sa ghātakaiḥ || 77 ||
meaning:
गुरोः स्थानं सम्प्रदायं तद्धर्मं यो विनाशयेत् |
गुरुभिः स बहिष्कार्यो दण्ड्यो वध्यः स घातकैः || 77 ||
text_mt: He who destroys the guru's dwelling place, lineage, or tradition / is to be excommunicated by the gurus, punished, and executed by executioners.

sanskrit_iast:
gurukopādvināśaḥ syād gurudrohāttu pātakam |
vimṛtyugurunindāyāṃ       gurvaniṣṭānmahāpadaḥ || 78 ||
meaning:
गुरुकोपाद्विनाशः स्याद् गुरुद्रोहात्तु पातकम् |
विमृत्युगुरुनिन्दायां       गुर्वनिष्टान्महापदः || 78 ||
text_mt: From the guru's anger comes destruction, and from betrayal of the guru comes sin; / untimely death comes from reviling the guru, and great misfortune from wishing ill to the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvedagnipraviṣṭo vā naraḥ pītaviṣo'pi vā |
mṛtyuhastagato  vāpi  nāparādhakaro  guroḥ || 79 ||
meaning:
जीवेदग्निप्रविष्टो वा नरः पीतविषोऽपि वा |
मृत्युहस्तगतो  वापि  नापराधकरो  गुरोः || 79 ||
text_mt: A man who has entered fire, or one who has drunk poison, / or one who has fallen into the hands of Death may live, but not one who offends the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra śrīgurunindā syāt pidhāya śravaṇe'mbike |
sadyastasmādviniṣkrāmet  punarna  śravaṇaṃ  yathā |
gurornāma smaret paścāt śravaṇe sā pratikriyā || 80 ||
meaning:
यत्र श्रीगुरुनिन्दा स्यात् पिधाय श्रवणेऽम्बिके |
सद्यस्तस्माद्विनिष्क्रामेत्  पुनर्न  श्रवणं  यथा |
गुरोर्नाम स्मरेत् पश्चात् श्रवणे सा प्रतिक्रिया || 80 ||
text_mt: Where reviling of the venerable guru occurs, covering both ears, O Mother, / one should immediately depart from there, so that it is not heard again; / afterwards, one should remember the guru's name: that is the remedy for the hearing.

sanskrit_iast:
gurumitrasuhṛddāsīdāsādyān      nāvamānayet |
na nindedasya samayān vedaśāstrāgamādikān || 81 ||
meaning:
गुरुमित्रसुहृद्दासीदासाद्यान्      नावमानयेत् |
न निन्देदस्य समयान् वेदशास्त्रागमादिकान् || 81 ||
text_mt: One should not disrespect the guru's friend, confidant, female servant, male servant, and the like; / one should not censure his pledges, Vedas, scriptures, sacred transmissions, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
guroḥ    śrīpādukābhūṣā   gurunāmasmṛtirjapaḥ |
gurvājñākaraṇaṃ  kṛtyaṃ  śuśrūṣā  bhajanaṃ  guroḥ || 82 ||
meaning:
गुरोः    श्रीपादुकाभूषा   गुरुनामस्मृतिर्जपः |
गुर्वाज्ञाकरणं  कृत्यं  शुश्रूषा  भजनं  गुरोः || 82 ||
text_mt: The ornament is the venerable sandals of the guru; the recitation is remembrance of the guru's name; / the duty is carrying out the guru's command; worship of the guru is service.

sanskrit_iast:
vivikṣurddeśikāvāsaṃ  śāntacitto'tibhaktimān |
vāhanaṃ  pādukāṃ   chatraṃ  cāmaraṃ  vyajanādikam |
tāmbūlaṃ  kajjalaṃ  veśamutsṛjya   praviśecchanaiḥ || 83 ||
meaning:
विविक्षुर्द्देशिकावासं  शान्तचित्तोऽतिभक्तिमान् |
वाहनं  पादुकां   छत्रं  चामरं  व्यजनादिकम् |
ताम्बूलं  कज्जलं  वेशमुत्सृज्य   प्रविशेच्छनैः || 83 ||
text_mt: Desiring to enter the master's dwelling, with tranquil mind and great devotion, / leaving behind vehicle, sandals, umbrella, chowrie, fan, and the like, / betel, collyrium, and fine attire, one should enter slowly.

sanskrit_iast:
pādukāmāsanaṃ   vastraṃ   vāhanaṃ  chatracāmare |
dṛṣṭvā gurornamaskuryānnātmabhogāya kāmayet || 84 ||
meaning:
पादुकामासनं   वस्त्रं   वाहनं  छत्रचामरे |
दृष्ट्वा गुरोर्नमस्कुर्यान्नात्मभोगाय कामयेत् || 84 ||
text_mt: Having seen the sandals, seat, clothing, vehicle, umbrella, and chowries / of the guru, one should bow to them; one must not desire them for one's own enjoyment.

sanskrit_iast:
pādaprakṣālanaṃ  snānamabhyaṅgaṃ  dantadhāvanam |
mūtraṃ niṣṭhīvanaṃ kṣauraṃ śayanaṃ strīniṣevanam || 85 ||
meaning:
पादप्रक्षालनं  स्नानमभ्यङ्गं  दन्तधावनम् |
मूत्रं निष्ठीवनं क्षौरं शयनं स्त्रीनिषेवनम् || 85 ||
text_mt: Washing the feet, bathing, oil massage, brushing teeth, / urinating, spitting, shaving, sleeping, consorting with women,

sanskrit_iast:
vīrāsanaṃ sudurvākyaṃ śāsanaṃ hāsyarodanam |
keśamocanamuṣṇīṣaṃ kañcukaṃ nagnatāṃ tathā || 86 ||
meaning:
वीरासनं सुदुर्वाक्यं शासनं हास्यरोदनम् |
केशमोचनमुष्णीषं कञ्चुकं नग्नतां तथा || 86 ||
text_mt: sitting in the hero's posture, abusive speech, giving commands, laughing and weeping, / untying hair, wearing a turban, wearing a jacket, as well as nakedness—

sanskrit_iast:
pādaprasāraṇaṃ  vādaṃ  kalahaṃ  dūṣaṇaṃ  priye |
aṅgabhaṅgāṅgavādyādikarāsphālanadhūnanam   || 87 ||
meaning:
पादप्रसारणं  वादं  कलहं  दूषणं  प्रिये |
अङ्गभङ्गाङ्गवाद्यादिकरास्फालनधूननम्   || 87 ||
text_mt: Stretching out one's feet, arguing, quarreling, censuring, O beloved, / twisting the limbs, making noise with the limbs, clapping the hands, waving [them],

sanskrit_iast:
dyūtakautukamallādiyuddhanṛtyādi cāmbike |
guruyogimahāsiddhipīṭhakṣetrāśrameṣu      ca |
nā    caredācarenmohāddevatāśāpamāpnuyāt || 88 ||
meaning:
द्यूतकौतुकमल्लादियुद्धनृत्यादि चाम्बिके |
गुरुयोगिमहासिद्धिपीठक्षेत्राश्रमेषु      च |
ना    चरेदाचरेन्मोहाद्देवताशापमाप्नुयात् || 88 ||
text_mt: gambling, entertainment, wrestling and other fighting, dancing, and the like, O Ambikā, / in the places of gurus, yogins, the great seats of accomplishment, sacred fields, and hermitages, / one must not practice. If one practices [them] out of delusion, one will incur the curse of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
upacāreṇa santiṣṭhed gurvagre necchayā viśet |
mukhāvalokī  seveta  taduktañca  samācaret || 89 ||
meaning:
उपचारेण सन्तिष्ठेद् गुर्वग्रे नेच्छया विशेत् |
मुखावलोकी  सेवेत  तदुक्तञ्च  समाचरेत् || 89 ||
text_mt: One should wait with polite attendance before the guru; one should not enter at one's own whim. / Looking at his face, one should serve [him], and one should carry out whatever he says.

sanskrit_iast:
gurūktānukta kāryeṣu nopekṣāṃ kārayet priye |
śirasā  yadgururbrūyāttat  kāryamaviśaṅkayā || 90 ||
meaning:
गुरूक्तानुक्त कार्येषु नोपेक्षां कारयेत् प्रिये |
शिरसा  यद्गुरुर्ब्रूयात्तत्  कार्यमविशङ्कया || 90 ||
text_mt: In tasks spoken or unspoken by the guru, one should not cause neglect, O beloved; / whatever the guru commands, that should be carried out upon one's head without hesitation.

sanskrit_iast:
nigrahe'nugrahe vāpi guruḥ  sarvasya  kāraṇam |
nirgataṃ yadgurorvaktrāt sarvaṃ śāstraṃ taducyate || 91 ||
meaning:
निग्रहेऽनुग्रहे वापि गुरुः  सर्वस्य  कारणम् |
निर्गतं यद्गुरोर्वक्त्रात् सर्वं शास्त्रं तदुच्यते || 91 ||
text_mt: Whether in punishment or in grace, the guru is the cause of everything; / whatever comes out of the mouth of the guru, all that is called scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
gurukārye svayaṃ  śakto nāparaṃ preṣayet priye |
bahubhṛtyaparairbhṛtyaiḥ  sahito'pyatibhaktimān || 92 ||
meaning:
गुरुकार्ये स्वयं  शक्तो नापरं प्रेषयेत् प्रिये |
बहुभृत्यपरैर्भृत्यैः  सहितोऽप्यतिभक्तिमान् || 92 ||
text_mt: If able himself, one should not dispatch another for the work of the guru, O beloved, / even though accompanied by many servants and devoted to attendants, having great devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchaṃstiṣṭhan svapan jāgrajjapan juhvāt prapūjayet |
gurvājñāmeva   kurvīta   tadagatenāntarātmanā || 93 ||
meaning:
गच्छंस्तिष्ठन् स्वपन् जाग्रज्जपन् जुह्वात् प्रपूजयेत् |
गुर्वाज्ञामेव   कुर्वीत   तदगतेनान्तरात्मना || 93 ||
text_mt: Walking, standing, sleeping, waking, reciting mantras, making oblations, or worshiping, / one should execute only the guru's command, with the inner self fixed upon him.

sanskrit_iast:
abhimāno na karttavyo jātividyādhanādibhiḥ |
sarvadā sevayet nityaṃ  śiṣyaḥ bhrīgurusannidhau || 94 ||
meaning:
अभिमानो न कर्त्तव्यो जातिविद्याधनादिभिः |
सर्वदा सेवयेत् नित्यं  शिष्यः भ्रीगुरुसन्निधौ || 94 ||
text_mt: Pride should not be displayed on account of caste, learning, wealth, and the like; / the disciple should always constantly serve in the presence of the venerable guru.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmakrodhaparityāgī vinītaḥ stutibhaktimān |
devi bhūmyāsane  tiṣṭhed  gurukāryaṃ  samācaret || 95 ||
meaning:
कामक्रोधपरित्यागी विनीतः स्तुतिभक्तिमान् |
देवि भूम्यासने  तिष्ठेद्  गुरुकार्यं  समाचरेत् || 95 ||
text_mt: Free from lust and anger, humble, full of praise and devotion, / O Goddess, seated on the ground, he should perform the service of the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
svakāryamanyakāryaṃ vā śiṣyaḥ svagurucittavit |
gurupārśvagato   namraḥ   prasannavadano   bhavet || 96 ||
meaning:
स्वकार्यमन्यकार्यं वा शिष्यः स्वगुरुचित्तवित् |
गुरुपार्श्वगतो   नम्रः   प्रसन्नवदनो   भवेत् || 96 ||
text_mt: Whether for his own purpose or for another's purpose, the disciple who knows his guru's mind, / having approached the side of the guru, should be humble and have a cheerful face.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyato  niṣiddhañca  tadguroryadi sannidhau |
ācarettasya sarvasya doṣaḥ koṭiguṇo bhavet || 97 ||
meaning:
सामान्यतो  निषिद्धञ्च  तद्गुरोर्यदि सन्निधौ |
आचरेत्तस्य सर्वस्य दोषः कोटिगुणो भवेत् || 97 ||
text_mt: And that which is generally forbidden, if one should practice it in the presence of the guru, / the offense of all that becomes multiplied ten million times.

sanskrit_iast:
anādṛtya gurorvākyaṃ śṛṇuyād yaḥ parāṅmukhaḥ |
ahitaṃ vā  hitaṃ  vāpi  rauravaṃ  narakaṃ  vrajet || 98 ||
meaning:
अनादृत्य गुरोर्वाक्यं शृणुयाद् यः पराङ्मुखः |
अहितं वा  हितं  वापि  रौरवं  नरकं  व्रजेत् || 98 ||
text_mt: Disregarding the word of the guru, whoever listens with averted face, / whether it be harmful or beneficial, goes to the Raurava hell.

sanskrit_iast:
gobrāhmaṇavadhaṃ kṛtvā yat pāpaṃ samavāpnuyāt |
tat pāpaṃ  samavāpnoti  gurvagre'nṛtabhāṣaṇāt || 99 ||
meaning:
गोब्राह्मणवधं कृत्वा यत् पापं समवाप्नुयात् |
तत् पापं  समवाप्नोति  गुर्वग्रेऽनृतभाषणात् || 99 ||
text_mt: The demerit that one incurs by killing a cow or a brāhmaṇa, / that demerit one incurs by speaking a falsehood before the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānāntaragatācārye  vyasane  viṣame  sthite |
śrīguruṃ na tyajet kvāpi tadādiṣṭo vrajet priye || 100 ||
meaning:
स्थानान्तरगताचार्ये  व्यसने  विषमे  स्थिते |
श्रीगुरुं न त्यजेत् क्वापि तदादिष्टो व्रजेत् प्रिये || 100 ||
text_mt: When the teacher has gone to another place, or is in misfortune or distress, / one should nowhere abandon the venerable guru; directed by him, O beloved, one may go.

sanskrit_iast:
adhaḥ sthite gurāvūrdhve na tiṣṭheta kadācana |
na gacchedagratastasya  na  tiṣṭhedutthite  gurau || 101 ||
meaning:
अधः स्थिते गुरावूर्ध्वे न तिष्ठेत कदाचन |
न गच्छेदग्रतस्तस्य  न  तिष्ठेदुत्थिते  गुरौ || 101 ||
text_mt: When the guru is situated below, one should never stay above; / one should not walk in front of him, nor remain standing when the guru has risen.

sanskrit_iast:
śakticchāyāṃ suracchāyāṃ gurucchāyāṃ na laṅghayet |
na teṣu kuryāt svacchāyāṃ  na svaped gurusannidhau || 102 ||
meaning:
शक्तिच्छायां सुरच्छायां गुरुच्छायां न लङ्घयेत् |
न तेषु कुर्यात् स्वच्छायां  न स्वपेद् गुरुसन्निधौ || 102 ||
text_mt: One should not cross the shadow of the Śakti, the shadow of a deity, or the shadow of the guru; / one should not cast one's own shadow upon them, nor sleep in the presence of the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāṣaṇaṃ pāṭhanaṃ gānaṃ bhojanaṃ śayanādikam |
anādiṣṭo na kurvīta na cāvandanapūrvakam || 103 ||
meaning:
भाषणं पाठनं गानं भोजनं शयनादिकम् |
अनादिष्टो न कुर्वीत न चावन्दनपूर्वकम् || 103 ||
text_mt: Speaking, reciting, singing, eating, sleeping, and so forth, / one should not perform without being directed, nor without prior obeisance.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyāśataṃ   kuryāt   gurvājñāparipālanāt |
vinā gurvājñayā śiṣyau viśvasennānyaśāsanāt || 104 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्याशतं   कुर्यात्   गुर्वाज्ञापरिपालनात् |
विना गुर्वाज्ञया शिष्यौ विश्वसेन्नान्यशासनात् || 104 ||
text_mt: One should commit a hundred killings of a brāhmaṇa from following the command of the guru; / without the guru's command, disciples should not trust any other decree.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ   gurvājñayā  kuryānna  nindettatstriyaṃ  priye |
bhaktyā praṇamya cottiṣṭhet kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ priye || 105 ||
meaning:
सर्वं   गुर्वाज्ञया  कुर्यान्न  निन्देत्तत्स्त्रियं  प्रिये |
भक्त्या प्रणम्य चोत्तिष्ठेत् कृताञ्जलिपुटः प्रिये || 105 ||
text_mt: One should do everything according to the guru's command; one should not slander his wife, O beloved; / bowing down with devotion, one should stand with folded palms, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
paścātpadena  nirgacchennamaskṛtya  gurorgṛhāt |
ekāsane nopaviśed guruṇā tatsamaiḥ saha || 106 ||
meaning:
पश्चात्पदेन  निर्गच्छेन्नमस्कृत्य  गुरोर्गृहात् |
एकासने नोपविशेद् गुरुणा तत्समैः सह || 106 ||
text_mt: One should leave the house of the guru by stepping backwards after paying homage; / one should not sit on a single seat with the guru, nor with his equals.

sanskrit_iast:
na  viśedāsane  devi   devatāgurusannidhau |
guroḥ siṃhāsanaṃ deyaṃ jyeṣṭhānāmuttamāsanam |
deśyāsanaṃ kaniṣṭhānāmitareṣāṃ  samāsanam || 107 ||
meaning:
न  विशेदासने  देवि   देवतागुरुसन्निधौ |
गुरोः सिंहासनं देयं ज्येष्ठानामुत्तमासनम् |
देश्यासनं कनिष्ठानामितरेषां  समासनम् || 107 ||
text_mt: One should not sit on a seat, O Goddess, in the presence of the deity or the guru. / A lion-throne should be given to the guru, an elevated seat to the elders, / an ordinary seat to juniors, and an equal seat to others.

sanskrit_iast:
jāti vidyādhanāḍhyo vā dūre dṛṣṭvā guruṃ mudā |
daṇḍapraṇāmaṃ  kṛtvaikaṃ  triḥ  pradakṣiṇamācaret || 108 ||
meaning:
जाति विद्याधनाढ्यो वा दूरे दृष्ट्वा गुरुं मुदा |
दण्डप्रणामं  कृत्वैकं  त्रिः  प्रदक्षिणमाचरेत् || 108 ||
text_mt: Even if wealthy in caste, learning, and riches, having seen the guru from afar with joy, / having made a prostration like a staff, one should circumambulate three times.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastriḥ ṣaḍ dvādaśa vā jyeṣṭhādiṣvekameva vā |
gurupraguruyogena     vandeta     praguru    priye || 109 ||
meaning:
ततस्त्रिः षड् द्वादश वा ज्येष्ठादिष्वेकमेव वा |
गुरुप्रगुरुयोगेन     वन्देत     प्रगुरु    प्रिये || 109 ||
text_mt: Then three, six, or twelve times, or only once in the case of elders and the rest; / according to the order of guru and grand-guru, one should salute the grand-guru, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
tato named guruṃ vāpi gurvājñāṃ  na  vicārayet |
praguroḥ sannidhau śiṣyaḥ svaguruṃ manasā namet || 110 ||
meaning:
ततो नमेद् गुरुं वापि गुर्वाज्ञां  न  विचारयेत् |
प्रगुरोः सन्निधौ शिष्यः स्वगुरुं मनसा नमेत् || 110 ||
text_mt: Then one should bow to the guru, or not question the guru's command; / in the presence of the grand-guru, the disciple should bow to his own guru mentally.

sanskrit_iast:
gurubuddhyā namet sarva  daivataṃ  tṛṇmeva  vā |
na nameddevabuddhyā tu pratimāṃ lauhamṛṇmayīm || 111 ||
meaning:
गुरुबुद्ध्या नमेत् सर्व  दैवतं  तृण्मेव  वा |
न नमेद्देवबुद्ध्या तु प्रतिमां लौहमृण्मयीम् || 111 ||
text_mt: With the awareness that it is the guru, one should bow to every deity or even a blade of grass; / but with the awareness that it is a deity, one should not bow to an image of iron or clay.

sanskrit_iast:
guroḥ praṇāmatritayaṃ jyeṣṭhānāmeka eva  ca |
pūjyānāmañjalistadvadanyeṣāṃ vākyavandanam || 112 ||
meaning:
गुरोः प्रणामत्रितयं ज्येष्ठानामेक एव  च |
पूज्यानामञ्जलिस्तद्वदन्येषां वाक्यवन्दनम् || 112 ||
text_mt: Three prostrations for the guru, and only one for the elders; / folded palms similarly for the venerable, and verbal greeting for others.

sanskrit_iast:
devān gurūn kulācāryān jñānavṛddhān tapodhanān |
vidyādhikān svadharmasthān praṇamet kulanāyike || 113 ||
meaning:
देवान् गुरून् कुलाचार्यान् ज्ञानवृद्धान् तपोधनान् |
विद्याधिकान् स्वधर्मस्थान् प्रणमेत् कुलनायिके || 113 ||
text_mt: To the gods, gurus, Kula masters, those advanced in wisdom, those rich in asceticism, / those superior in learning, and those abiding in their own duty, one should bow down, O Queen of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
strīdviṣṭaṃ gurubhiḥ śaptaṃ pāṣaṇḍaṃ paṇḍitaṃ śaṭham |
vikarmāṇaṃ  kṛtaghnañcānāśramiṇañca  no  namet || 114 ||
meaning:
स्त्रीद्विष्टं गुरुभिः शप्तं पाषण्डं पण्डितं शठम् |
विकर्माणं  कृतघ्नञ्चानाश्रमिणञ्च  नो  नमेत् || 114 ||
text_mt: One who hates women, one cursed by gurus, a heretic, a sophist, a rogue, / one doing forbidden deeds, an ungrateful person, and one outside the religious stages of life: one should not bow to them.

sanskrit_iast:
anivedya gurorbhuṅkte yastvekagrāmasaṃsthitaḥ |
amedhyaṃ  tadbhavedannaṃ  śūkaro  jāyate  mṛtaḥ || 115 ||
meaning:
अनिवेद्य गुरोर्भुङ्क्ते यस्त्वेकग्रामसंस्थितः |
अमेध्यं  तद्भवेदन्नं  शूकरो  जायते  मृतः || 115 ||
text_mt: He who, residing in the very same village, eats without offering to the guru, / that food of his becomes impure, and when dead he is born as a hog.

sanskrit_iast:
ekagrāmasthitaḥ śiṣyastrisandhyaṃ praṇamed gurum |
krośāmātrasthitaḥ śiṣyo  guruṃ pratidinaṃ namet || 116 ||
meaning:
एकग्रामस्थितः शिष्यस्त्रिसन्ध्यं प्रणमेद् गुरुम् |
क्रोशामात्रस्थितः शिष्यो  गुरुं प्रतिदिनं नमेत् || 116 ||
text_mt: A disciple residing in the same village should bow down to the guru at the three junctures of the day; / a disciple residing at the distance of one krośa should bow down to the guru every day.

sanskrit_iast:
arddhayojanagaḥ śiṣyaḥ  praṇamet pañcaparvasu |
ekayojanamāramya      yojanadvādaśāvadhi || 117 ||
meaning:
अर्द्धयोजनगः शिष्यः  प्रणमेत् पञ्चपर्वसु |
एकयोजनमारम्य      योजनद्वादशावधि || 117 ||
text_mt: A disciple living half a yojana away should bow down on the five sacred days; / starting from one yojana up to a limit of twelve yojanas,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsaṃkhyādivasairmāsaiḥ śrīguruṃ praṇamet priye |
dūradeśasthitaḥ śiṣyo bhaktyā tatsannidhiṃ gataḥ || 118 ||
meaning:
तत्संख्यादिवसैर्मासैः श्रीगुरुं प्रणमेत् प्रिये |
दूरदेशस्थितः शिष्यो भक्त्या तत्सन्निधिं गतः || 118 ||
text_mt: in that number of days or months, O beloved, he should bow down to the venerable guru; / a disciple residing in a distant land, having gone into his presence with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
tatra   yojanasaṃkhyoktamāsena   praṇamed  gurum |
atidūragataḥ  śiṣyo  yadicchā syāttadā vrajet || 119 ||
meaning:
तत्र   योजनसंख्योक्तमासेन   प्रणमेद्  गुरुम् |
अतिदूरगतः  शिष्यो  यदिच्छा स्यात्तदा व्रजेत् || 119 ||
text_mt: should bow down to the guru at [intervals of] months stated by that number of yojanas; / a disciple who has gone very far away may go whenever he desires.

sanskrit_iast:
riktahastaśca   nopeyādrājānaṃ  devatāṃ  gurum |
phalapuṣpāmbarādīni yathāśaktyā samarpayet || 120 ||
meaning:
रिक्तहस्तश्च   नोपेयाद्राजानं  देवतां  गुरुम् |
फलपुष्पाम्बरादीनि यथाशक्त्या समर्पयेत् || 120 ||
text_mt: And empty-handed, one should not approach a king, a deity, or a guru; / one should offer fruits, flowers, garments, and the like according to one's capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ  yo  na  careddevi  brahmarākṣasatāṃ vrajet |
guruśaktiśca tatputro jyeṣṭhabhrātā guruḥ smṛtaḥ || 121 ||
meaning:
एवं  यो  न  चरेद्देवि  ब्रह्मराक्षसतां व्रजेत् |
गुरुशक्तिश्च तत्पुत्रो ज्येष्ठभ्राता गुरुः स्मृतः || 121 ||
text_mt: Whoever does not act thus, O Goddess, attains the state of a brahmarākṣasa. / The Śakti of the guru, his son, and an elder brother are considered equal to a guru.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmavicca  kanīyāṃsaṃ  putravat  paripālayet |
kulācāryasya   deveśi   gurujyeṣṭhakaniṣṭhayoḥ |
gurukalpasya  kurvīta  praṇāmaṃ   svaraguroryathā || 122 ||
meaning:
आत्मविच्च  कनीयांसं  पुत्रवत्  परिपालयेत् |
कुलाचार्यस्य   देवेशि   गुरुज्येष्ठकनिष्ठयोः |
गुरुकल्पस्य  कुर्वीत  प्रणामं   स्वरगुरोर्यथा || 122 ||
text_mt: And the knower of the Self should protect a younger person like a son; / O Ruler of the gods, to the Kula master, to the guru's elder and younger [associates], / and to one equal to a guru, one should make a bow as if to one's own guru.

sanskrit_iast:
yāgajyeṣṭhaḥ kramajyeṣṭhaḥ kulajyeṣṭhastṛtīyakaḥ |
gurujyeṣṭhasuto devi  iti jyeṣṭhacatuṣṭayam || 123 ||
meaning:
यागज्येष्ठः क्रमज्येष्ठः कुलज्येष्ठस्तृतीयकः |
गुरुज्येष्ठसुतो देवि  इति ज्येष्ठचतुष्टयम् || 123 ||
text_mt: One senior in sacrifice, one senior in initiation lineage, one senior in Kula as the third, / and the eldest son of the guru, O Goddess: thus is the group of four seniors.

sanskrit_iast:
yāgajyeṣṭhābhivādena kramikāṣṭāṅgayogataḥ |
guruśca kulavṛkṣaśca  vandanīyau  vidhānataḥ || 124 ||
meaning:
यागज्येष्ठाभिवादेन क्रमिकाष्टाङ्गयोगतः |
गुरुश्च कुलवृक्षश्च  वन्दनीयौ  विधानतः || 124 ||
text_mt: With salutation to the senior in sacrifice, by the eight-limbed prostration of the lineage, / both the guru and the Kula tree should be venerated according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛmātrādisarveṣu    pūjyakoṭiṣu    bandhuṣu |
abhyutthānapraṇāmādyairavyakto   doṣabhāgbahiḥ || 125 ||
meaning:
पितृमात्रादिसर्वेषु    पूज्यकोटिषु    बन्धुषु |
अभ्युत्थानप्रणामाद्यैरव्यक्तो   दोषभाग्बहिः || 125 ||
text_mt: Among all relatives such as father, mother, and millions of venerable persons, / by rising up, bowing, and the like, an unmanifested [adept] incurs no fault outwardly.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tvācāryarūpeṇa cātmānaṃ samprakāśayet |
abhyutthānapraṇāmādyairddoṣabhāk  sa  bhavettadā || 126 ||
meaning:
यदा त्वाचार्यरूपेण चात्मानं सम्प्रकाशयेत् |
अभ्युत्थानप्रणामाद्यैर्द्दोषभाक्  स  भवेत्तदा || 126 ||
text_mt: When, however, he reveals himself in the form of a teacher, / then by rising up, bowing, and the like, he would incur fault.

sanskrit_iast:
patirbhūtvā paśubhyaśca praṇāmaṃ yaḥ kariṣyati |
sa  mahāpaśurityukto  devatāśāpamāpnuyāt || 127 ||
meaning:
पतिर्भूत्वा पशुभ्यश्च प्रणामं यः करिष्यति |
स  महापशुरित्युक्तो  देवताशापमाप्नुयात् || 127 ||
text_mt: Whoever, having become a master, offers a bow to uninitiated bound souls, / he is called a great bound soul and will incur the curse of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
yo gurusthānakaṃ  prāptaḥ  pādukāparisaṃkhyayā |
guruvat sa tu mantavyo jyeṣṭhairvandyo na ca priye || 128 ||
meaning:
यो गुरुस्थानकं  प्राप्तः  पादुकापरिसंख्यया |
गुरुवत् स तु मन्तव्यो ज्येष्ठैर्वन्द्यो न च प्रिये || 128 ||
text_mt: He who has attained the station of the guru by the succession of the sandals, / he indeed should be regarded as equal to the guru, and should not be bowed to by elders, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ kiñcit pādukābhaktilakṣaṇam |
samāsena kuleśāni  kiṃ  bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 129 ||
meaning:
इति ते कथितं किञ्चित् पादुकाभक्तिलक्षणम् |
समासेन कुलेशानि  किं  भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि || 129 ||
text_mt: Thus has been told to you in brief, O Mistress of Kula, / some of the characteristics of devotion to the [guru's] sandals; what more do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast: atha trayodaśollāsaḥ
meaning: अथ त्रयोदशोल्लासः

sanskrit_iast:
śrī devyuvāca
kuleśa śrotumicchāmi karuṇāmṛtavāridhe |
vaktumarhasi deveśa  lakṣaṇaṃ guruśiṣyayoḥ || 1 ||
meaning:
श्री देव्युवाच
कुलेश श्रोतुमिच्छामि करुणामृतवारिधे |
वक्तुमर्हसि देवेश  लक्षणं गुरुशिष्ययोः || 1 ||
text_mt: The glorious Goddess said: / O Lord of Kula, ocean of the nectar of compassion, I wish to hear; / you should explain, O Lord of gods, the characteristics of the guru and the disciple.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
tasya   śravaṇamātreṇa   gurubhāvaḥ  prajāyate || 2 ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि |
तस्य   श्रवणमात्रेण   गुरुभावः  प्रजायते || 2 ||
text_mt: The Lord said: / Hear, O Goddess, I shall explain what you ask of me; / merely by hearing this, the state of guruhood arises.

sanskrit_iast:
duṣṭavaṃśodbhavaṃ  duṣṭaṃ  guṇahīnaṃ  virūpiṇam |
paraśiṣyañca pāṣaṇḍaṃ ṣaṇḍaṃ paṇḍitamāninam || 3 ||
meaning:
दुष्टवंशोद्भवं  दुष्टं  गुणहीनं  विरूपिणम् |
परशिष्यञ्च पाषण्डं षण्डं पण्डितमानिनम् || 3 ||
text_mt: Born of a wicked family, wicked, devoid of good qualities, deformed, / a disciple of another, a heretic, a eunuch, one who fancies himself learned,

sanskrit_iast:
hīnādhikavikārāṅgaṃ vikalāvayavānvitam |
paṅgumandhañca badhiraṃ malinaṃ vyādhipīḍitam || 4 ||
meaning:
हीनाधिकविकाराङ्गं विकलावयवान्वितम् |
पङ्गुमन्धञ्च बधिरं मलिनं व्याधिपीडितम् || 4 ||
text_mt: having deficient, redundant, or defective limbs, possessed of crippled members, / lame, blind, deaf, filthy, afflicted with diseases,

sanskrit_iast:
utsṛṣṭaṃ  durmukhañcāpi  svecchāveśadharaṃ  priye |
duvīkārāṅgaceṣṭādigatibhāṣaṇavīkṣaṇam     || 5 ||
meaning:
उत्सृष्टं  दुर्मुखञ्चापि  स्वेच्छावेशधरं  प्रिये |
दुवीकाराङ्गचेष्टादिगतिभाषणवीक्षणम्     || 5 ||
text_mt: abandoned, foul-mouthed, dressed according to his own whim, O beloved, / having corrupted bodily gestures and manner of moving, speaking, and looking,

sanskrit_iast:
nidrātandrājaḍālasyadyūtādivyasanānvitam   |
kapāṭakuḍyastambhādau  tirohitatanuṃ sadā   |
antarbhaktikaraṃ kṣudraṃ  bāhyabhaktivivajītam || 6 ||
meaning:

text_mt: foremost, deeply profound, discerning the distinction between the worthy and the unworthy, / equal to Śiva and Viṣṇu, virtuous, exposing false doctrines,

sanskrit_iast:
nirmalo  nityasantuṣṭaḥ  svatantro mantraśaktimān |
sadbhaktavatsalo dhīraḥ kṛpāluḥ smitapūrṇavāk || 44 ||
meaning:
निर्मलो  नित्यसन्तुष्टः  स्वतन्त्रो मन्त्रशक्तिमान् |
सद्भक्तवत्सलो धीरः कृपालुः स्मितपूर्णवाक् || 44 ||
text_mt: stainless, ever-content, autonomous, endowed with the power of mantras, / affectionate toward true devotees, resolute, compassionate, of smiling speech,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktapriyaḥ  sadodāro  gambhīraḥ  śiṣṭasādhakaḥ |
sveṣṭadevagurujyeṣṭha        vanitāpūjanotsukaḥ || 45 ||
meaning:
भक्तप्रियः  सदोदारो  गम्भीरः  शिष्टसाधकः |
स्वेष्टदेवगुरुज्येष्ठ        वनितापूजनोत्सुकः || 45 ||
text_mt: beloved by devotees, always generous, profound, an accomplished practitioner among the virtuous, / eager in the worship of his chosen deity, guru, elders, and women,

sanskrit_iast:
nitye naimittike kāmye rataḥ karmaṇyanindite |
rāgadveṣabhayakleśadambhāhaṅkāravajītaḥ        || 46 ||
meaning:
नित्ये नैमित्तिके काम्ये रतः कर्मण्यनिन्दिते |
रागद्वेषभयक्लेशदम्भाहङ्कारवजीतः        || 46 ||
text_mt: delighting in daily, occasional, and optional unblamable rites, / devoid of passion, hatred, fear, affliction, ostentation, and egotism,

sanskrit_iast:
svavidyānuṣṭhānarato      dharmādīnāmupārjakaḥ |
yadṛcchālābhasantuṣṭo       guṇadoṣavibhedakaḥ || 47 ||
meaning:
स्वविद्यानुष्ठानरतो      धर्मादीनामुपार्जकः |
यदृच्छालाभसन्तुष्टो       गुणदोषविभेदकः || 47 ||
text_mt: devoted to the practice of his own lore, acquiring righteousness and the other [aims of life], / satisfied with whatever comes by chance, discerning merits and flaws,

sanskrit_iast:
strīdhanādiṣvanāsakto      duḥsaṅgavyasanādiṣu |
sarvāhambhāvasaṃyukto     nirdvandvo   niyatavrataḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
स्त्रीधनादिष्वनासक्तो      दुःसङ्गव्यसनादिषु |
सर्वाहम्भावसंयुक्तो     निर्द्वन्द्वो   नियतव्रतः || 48 ||
text_mt: unattached to women, wealth, and the like, to bad company, vices, and so on, / endowed with a sense of universal selfhood, free from dualities, steadfast in vows,

sanskrit_iast:
alolupo    hyasaṅkalpapakṣapātī   vicakṣaṇaḥ |
vittavidyādibhirmantrayantratantrādyavikrayī       || 49 ||
meaning:
अलोलुपो    ह्यसङ्कल्पपक्षपाती   विचक्षणः |
वित्तविद्यादिभिर्मन्त्रयन्त्रतन्त्राद्यविक्रयी       || 49 ||
text_mt: free from greed, devoid of bias for preconceived notions, discerning, / not selling mantras, yantras, tantras, and the like for wealth, learning, or other gains,

sanskrit_iast:
niḥsaṅgo nivīkalpaśca nirṇītārtho'tidhāmīkaḥ |
tulyanindāstutirmauno   nirapekṣo   nirāmayaḥ |
ityādilakṣaṇopetaḥ  śrīguruḥ  kathitaḥ  priye || 50 ||
meaning:
निःसङ्गो निवीकल्पश्च निर्णीतार्थोऽतिधामीकः |
तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनो   निरपेक्षो   निरामयः |
इत्यादिलक्षणोपेतः  श्रीगुरुः  कथितः  प्रिये || 50 ||
text_mt: unattached, free from conceptual construction, of settled purpose, exceedingly righteous, / viewing praise and blame as equal, silent, detached, free from affliction— / endowed with such characteristics, O beloved, the venerable guru is described.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śivaḥ sarvagaḥ sūkṣmaśconmanā niṣkalo'vyayaḥ |
vyomākāro hyajo'nantaḥ sa kathaṃ  pūjyate priye || 51 ||
meaning:
यः शिवः सर्वगः सूक्ष्मश्चोन्मना निष्कलोऽव्ययः |
व्योमाकारो ह्यजोऽनन्तः स कथं  पूज्यते प्रिये || 51 ||
text_mt: Śiva, who is all-pervading, subtle, trans-mental, undivided, imperishable, / of the nature of space, unborn, and infinite—how is He to be worshipped, O beloved?

sanskrit_iast:
ata  eva  śivaḥ  sākṣādgururūpaṃ  samāśritaḥ |
bhaktyā sampūjito devi bhuktiṃ muktiṃ prayacchati || 52 ||
meaning:
अत  एव  शिवः  साक्षाद्गुरुरूपं  समाश्रितः |
भक्त्या सम्पूजितो देवि भुक्तिं मुक्तिं प्रयच्छति || 52 ||
text_mt: For this very reason Śiva assumes the visible form of the guru; / worshipped with devotion, O Devi, he bestows enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
śivo'haṃ   nākṛtirddevi   naradṛggocaro   nahi |
tasmāt śrīgururūpeṇa śiṣyān rakṣati dhāmīkān || 53 ||
meaning:
शिवोऽहं   नाकृतिर्द्देवि   नरदृग्गोचरो   नहि |
तस्मात् श्रीगुरुरूपेण शिष्यान् रक्षति धामीकान् || 53 ||
text_mt: I am Śiva, without form, O Devi, not within the range of human sight; / therefore, in the form of the venerable guru, He protects righteous disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
manuṣyacarmaṇā baddhaḥ sākṣāt paraśivaḥ  svayam |
sacchiṣyānugrahārthāya   gūḍhaṃ   paryaṭati   kṣitau || 54 ||
meaning:
मनुष्यचर्मणा बद्धः साक्षात् परशिवः  स्वयम् |
सच्छिष्यानुग्रहार्थाय   गूढं   पर्यटति   क्षितौ || 54 ||
text_mt: Clothed in human skin, Supreme Śiva Himself directly / wanders disguised upon the earth for the sake of bestowing grace upon good disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
sadbhaktarakṣaṇāyaiva   nirākāro'pi   sākṛtiḥ |
śivaḥ  kṛpānidhirloke  saṃsārīva  hi  ceṣṭate || 55 ||
meaning:
सद्भक्तरक्षणायैव   निराकारोऽपि   साकृतिः |
शिवः  कृपानिधिर्लोके  संसारीव  हि  चेष्टते || 55 ||
text_mt: Solely to protect true devotees, Śiva, though formless, assumes a form; / the treasure of compassion acts in the world just like a transmigrating mortal.

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭalocanaṃ cāndīṃ kalāmapi ca dorddayam |
antardhāya   ca  vartteyaṃ  gururūpo   mahītale || 56 ||
meaning:
ललाटलोचनं चान्दीं कलामपि च दोर्द्दयम् |
अन्तर्धाय   च  वर्त्तेयं  गुरुरूपो   महीतले || 56 ||
text_mt: Concealing the eye on My forehead, the digit of the moon, and two of My arms, / I abide upon the surface of the earth in the form of the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
atrinetraḥ    śivaḥ    sākṣādacaturbāhuracyutaḥ |
acaturvadano   brahmā  śrīguruḥ  kathitaṃ   priye || 57 ||
meaning:
अत्रिनेत्रः    शिवः    साक्षादचतुर्बाहुरच्युतः |
अचतुर्वदनो   ब्रह्मा  श्रीगुरुः  कथितं   प्रिये || 57 ||
text_mt: He is direct Śiva without three eyes, Acyuta without four arms, / Brahmā without four faces—thus is the venerable guru declared, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
naravaddṛśyate   loke   śrīguruḥ  pāpakarmaṇā |
śivavad  dṛśyate loke  bhavāni  puṇyakarmaṇā || 58 ||
meaning:
नरवद्दृश्यते   लोके   श्रीगुरुः  पापकर्मणा |
शिववद्  दृश्यते लोके  भवानि  पुण्यकर्मणा || 58 ||
text_mt: By one of evil deeds, the venerable guru is seen in the world as a mere mortal; / by one of meritorious deeds, O Bhavānī, he is seen in the world as Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīguruṃ   paramaṃ   tattvaṃ   tiṣṭhantaṃ   cakṣuragrataḥ |
mandabhāgyā na paśyanti hyandhāḥ sūryamivoditam || 59 ||
meaning:
श्रीगुरुं   परमं   तत्त्वं   तिष्ठन्तं   चक्षुरग्रतः |
मन्दभाग्या न पश्यन्ति ह्यन्धाः सूर्यमिवोदितम् || 59 ||
text_mt: The venerable guru, the supreme reality, standing before their very eyes, / the unfortunate do not see, just as the blind do not see the risen sun.

sanskrit_iast:
guruḥ sadāśivaḥ sākṣāt satyameva na saṃśayaḥ |
śiva eva gururno cedbhukti mukti dadāti kaḥ || 60 ||
meaning:
गुरुः सदाशिवः साक्षात् सत्यमेव न संशयः |
शिव एव गुरुर्नो चेद्भुक्ति मुक्ति ददाति कः || 60 ||
text_mt: The guru is Sadāśiva directly; this is the very truth, without doubt. / If the guru were not Śiva Himself, who would bestow enjoyment and liberation?

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivasya   devasya  śrīgurorapi  pārvatī |
ubhayorantaraṃ nāsti yaḥ karoti  sa pātakī || 61 ||
meaning:
सदाशिवस्य   देवस्य  श्रीगुरोरपि  पार्वती |
उभयोरन्तरं नास्ति यः करोति  स पातकी || 61 ||
text_mt: Between the god Sadāśiva and the venerable guru, O Pārvatī, / there is no difference; whoever makes one is a sinner.

sanskrit_iast:
deśikākṛtimāsthāya  paśoḥ pāśānaśeṣataḥ |
chittvā paraṃ  padaṃ  devi  nayatyenamato  guruḥ || 62 ||
meaning:
देशिकाकृतिमास्थाय  पशोः पाशानशेषतः |
छित्त्वा परं  पदं  देवि  नयत्येनमतो  गुरुः || 62 ||
text_mt: Assuming the form of the guru, having severed the bound soul’s / bonds without remainder, he leads it, O Devi, to the supreme state; hence he is the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānugrahakarttṛtvādīśvaraḥ     karuṇānadhiḥ |
ācāryarūpamāsthāya dīkṣayā mokṣayet paśūn || 63 ||
meaning:
सर्वानुग्रहकर्त्तृत्वादीश्वरः     करुणानधिः |
आचार्यरूपमास्थाय दीक्षया मोक्षयेत् पशून् || 63 ||
text_mt: Because He is the dispenser of grace to all, the Lord, an ocean of compassion, / assuming the form of the master, liberates bound souls through initiation.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā ghaṭaśca kalasaḥ kumbhaścaikārthavācakaḥ |
tathā  devaśca  mantraśca  guruścaikārtha  ucyate || 64 ||
meaning:
यथा घटश्च कलसः कुम्भश्चैकार्थवाचकः |
तथा  देवश्च  मन्त्रश्च  गुरुश्चैकार्थ  उच्यते || 64 ||
text_mt: Just as ghaṭa, kalasa, and kumbha denote one and the same object, / so also deity, mantra, and guru are said to signify one reality.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā devastathā mantro yathā mantrastathā guruḥ |
devamantragurūṇāñca   pūjayā  sadṛśaṃ  phalam || 65 ||
meaning:
यथा देवस्तथा मन्त्रो यथा मन्त्रस्तथा गुरुः |
देवमन्त्रगुरूणाञ्च   पूजया  सदृशं  फलम् || 65 ||
text_mt: As the deity is, so is the mantra; as the mantra is, so is the guru; / through worship of deity, mantra, and guru, the fruit is identical.

sanskrit_iast:
śivarūpaṃ samāsthāya pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmi pārvatī |
gururūpaṃ   samādāya    bhavapāśānnikṛntaye || 66 ||
meaning:
शिवरूपं समास्थाय पूजां गृह्णामि पार्वती |
गुरुरूपं   समादाय    भवपाशान्निकृन्तये || 66 ||
text_mt: Assuming the form of Śiva, I receive worship, O Pārvatī; / taking the form of the guru, I cut through the bonds of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhāntaśāravettāhaṃ bījo'hamiti bodhakṛt |
avicchinnaḥ  sadā   hṛṣṭahṛdayo  gururucyate || 67 ||
meaning:
सिद्धान्तशारवेत्ताहं बीजोऽहमिति बोधकृत् |
अविच्छिन्नः  सदा   हृष्टहृदयो  गुरुरुच्यते || 67 ||
text_mt: He who awakens [the disciple with the thought], 'I am the knower of the essence of the Siddhānta, I am the source,' / unbroken, his heart ever rejoicing—he is called a guru.

sanskrit_iast:
yo vilaṃghyāśramān varṇānātmanyeva sthitaḥ sadā |
jyotivarṇāśramī  yogī  sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye || 68 ||
meaning:
यो विलंघ्याश्रमान् वर्णानात्मन्येव स्थितः सदा |
ज्योतिवर्णाश्रमी  योगी  स गुरुः कथितः प्रिये || 68 ||
text_mt: He who, having transcended stages of life and social classes, is ever established in the Self alone, / the yogin whose class and stage of life is the Light—he is declared to be a guru, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍadhvānaṃ    ṣaḍādhāraṃ    ṣoḍaśādhāranirṇayam |
yo jānāti vidhānena sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye || 69 ||
meaning:
षडध्वानं    षडाधारं    षोडशाधारनिर्णयम् |
यो जानाति विधानेन स गुरुः कथितः प्रिये || 69 ||
text_mt: He who knows the six pathways, the six centers, and the determination of the sixteen centers / according to rule—he is declared to be a guru, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛśyaṃ  vinā  sthirā dṛṣṭirmanaścālambanaṃ  vinā |
vināyāsaṃ sthiro vāyuryasya syāt sa guruḥ priye || 70 ||
meaning:
दृश्यं  विना  स्थिरा दृष्टिर्मनश्चालम्बनं  विना |
विनायासं स्थिरो वायुर्यस्य स्यात् स गुरुः प्रिये || 70 ||
text_mt: He whose gaze is steady without an object to be seen, whose mind is steady without a support, / whose vital breath is steady without effort—he would be a guru, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
yattu      saṃvittijananaṃ     parānandasamudbhavam |
tattattvaṃ  viditaṃ  yena  sa  guruḥ  kulanāyike || 71 ||
meaning:
यत्तु      संवित्तिजननं     परानन्दसमुद्भवम् |
तत्तत्त्वं  विदितं  येन  स  गुरुः  कुलनायिके || 71 ||
text_mt: That which gives birth to pure consciousness, arising from supreme bliss— / by whom that reality is known, he is a guru, O mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtabhavyau tantramantrau vetti yaḥ śāktaśāmbhavam |
vedhañca ṣaḍvidhaṃ  devi  sa  hi vedhakaro guruḥ || 72 ||
meaning:
भूतभव्यौ तन्त्रमन्त्रौ वेत्ति यः शाक्तशाम्भवम् |
वेधञ्च षड्विधं  देवि  स  हि वेधकरो गुरुः || 72 ||
text_mt: He who knows the past and the future, the tantras and mantras, the Śākta and Śāmbhava [states], / and the sixfold piercing, O Devi—he indeed is a piercing guru.

sanskrit_iast:
padamantrakalāyantrasatattvatabhuvanāśrayam         |
śodhayed yaḥ ṣaḍadhvānaṃ sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye || 73 ||
meaning:
पदमन्त्रकलायन्त्रसतत्त्वतभुवनाश्रयम्         |
शोधयेद् यः षडध्वानं स गुरुः कथितः प्रिये || 73 ||
text_mt: He who purifies the six pathways resting upon word, mantra, subtle energy, yantra, ontological reality, and cosmic sphere— / he is declared to be a guru, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
vedhaṃ  padaṃ   virodhañca  grahaṇaṃ   mokṣaṇaṃ   tathā |
yo vā samyagvijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye || 74 ||
meaning:
वेधं  पदं   विरोधञ्च  ग्रहणं   मोक्षणं   तथा |
यो वा सम्यग्विजानाति स गुरुः कथितः प्रिये || 74 ||
text_mt: Piercing, the state, impediment, grasp, and likewise release— / he who truly understands these is declared to be a guru, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
jāgrat  svapnaḥ suṣuptiśca  turīyaṃ tadatītakam |
yo vetti pañcakaṃ devi sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye || 75 ||
meaning:
जाग्रत्  स्वप्नः सुषुप्तिश्च  तुरीयं तदतीतकम् |
यो वेत्ति पञ्चकं देवि स गुरुः कथितः प्रिये || 75 ||
text_mt: Waking, dreaming, deep sleep, the fourth state, and that which transcends it— / he who knows this group of five, O Devi, is declared to be a guru, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍaṃ   padaṃ  tathā   rūpaṃ  rūpātītaṃ   catuṣṭayam |
yo vā samyagvijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye || 76 ||
meaning:
पिण्डं   पदं  तथा   रूपं  रूपातीतं   चतुष्टयम् |
यो वा सम्यग्विजानाति स गुरुः कथितः प्रिये || 76 ||
text_mt: The body, the word, the form, and that which transcends form—this tetrad / he who properly knows is declared to be a guru, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
yo vā parāñca paśyantīṃ madhyamāṃ vaikharīmapi |
catuṣṭayaṃ vijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye || 77 ||
meaning:
यो वा पराञ्च पश्यन्तीं मध्यमां वैखरीमपि |
चतुष्टयं विजानाति स गुरुः कथितः प्रिये || 77 ||
text_mt: He who knows the four [levels of speech]— / the supreme, the visionary, the intermediate, and the articulated—is declared to be a guru, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmavidyāśivasarvamiti      tattvacatuṣṭayam |
yo  vetti  parameśāni  sa  gururnāparaḥ  priye || 78 ||
meaning:
आत्मविद्याशिवसर्वमिति      तत्त्वचतुष्टयम् |
यो  वेत्ति  परमेशानि  स  गुरुर्नापरः  प्रिये || 78 ||
text_mt: Self, lore, Śiva, and the totality—the tetrad of realities— / he who knows this, O Supreme Mistress, he is the guru, none other, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
pāśacchedaṃ   vedhadīkṣāṃ   paśugrahaṇameva   ca |
trividhaṃ yo vijānāti sa guruḥ paramo mataḥ || 79 ||
meaning:
पाशच्छेदं   वेधदीक्षां   पशुग्रहणमेव   च |
त्रिविधं यो विजानाति स गुरुः परमो मतः || 79 ||
text_mt: Cutting the bonds, initiation by piercing, and the grasping of the bound soul— / he who knows this threefold [process] is considered the supreme guru.

sanskrit_iast:
padaṃ  pāśaṃ  paśunāñca  rahasyārthaṃ  vidhānataḥ |
yo jānāti varārohe sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye || 80 ||
meaning:
पदं  पाशं  पशुनाञ्च  रहस्यार्थं  विधानतः |
यो जानाति वरारोहे स गुरुः कथितः प्रिये || 80 ||
text_mt: The state, the bond, and the secret meaning of the bound souls according to rule— / he who knows this, O woman of graceful limbs, is declared to be a guru, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
cakrasaṅketakaṃ   mantraṃ   pūjāsaṅketakaṃ   tathā |
tritayaṃ yo vijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye || 81 ||
meaning:
चक्रसङ्केतकं   मन्त्रं   पूजासङ्केतकं   तथा |
त्रितयं यो विजानाति स गुरुः कथितः प्रिये || 81 ||
text_mt: The convention of the cakra, the mantra, and likewise the convention of worship— / he who knows this triad is declared to be a guru, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
vāṇetarasvayambhvākhyaliṅgatritayasaṃsthitim    |
tattvato yo vijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye || 82 ||
meaning:
वाणेतरस्वयम्भ्वाख्यलिङ्गत्रितयसंस्थितिम्    |
तत्त्वतो यो विजानाति स गुरुः कथितः प्रिये || 82 ||
text_mt: The location of the triad of liṅgas named Bāṇa, Itara, and Svayambhū / in its true nature he who knows, is declared to be a guru, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
āṇavaṃ  kārmaṇañcaiva  māyīyañca  malatrayam |
yo viśodhayituṃ śaktaḥ sa guruḥ paramo mataḥ || 83 ||
meaning:
आणवं  कार्मणञ्चैव  मायीयञ्च  मलत्रयम् |
यो विशोधयितुं शक्तः स गुरुः परमो मतः || 83 ||
text_mt: He who is capable of purifying the three impurities— / the innate, the karmic, and the illusory—is considered the supreme guru.

sanskrit_iast:
āraktaśuklamiśrā(kṛṣṇā)khyacaraṇatrayavāsanām |
yo jānāti mahādevi sa guruḥ paramo mataḥ || 84 ||
meaning:
आरक्तशुक्लमिश्रा(कृष्णा)ख्यचरणत्रयवासनाम् |
यो जानाति महादेवि स गुरुः परमो मतः || 84 ||
text_mt: O Great Goddess, he who knows the inner meaning of the three feet, / called the red, the white, and the mixed, is considered the supreme guru.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmudrāṃ nabhomudrām uṅḍīyānaṃ jalandharam |
mūlabandhañca  yo vetti sa guruḥ paramo mataḥ || 85 ||
meaning:
महामुद्रां नभोमुद्राम् उङ्डीयानं जलन्धरम् |
मूलबन्धञ्च  यो वेत्ति स गुरुः परमो मतः || 85 ||
text_mt: He who knows the Great Mudrā, the Sky Mudrā, / the Uḍḍīyāna, the Jālandhara, and the root lock, is considered the supreme guru.

sanskrit_iast:
śivādikṣitiparyantaṃ   ṣaṭtriṃśattattvanirṇayam |
yo vijānāti tattvena sa guruḥ paramo mataḥ || 86 ||
meaning:
शिवादिक्षितिपर्यन्तं   षट्त्रिंशत्तत्त्वनिर्णयम् |
यो विजानाति तत्त्वेन स गुरुः परमो मतः || 86 ||
text_mt: He who truly knows the ascertainment of the thirty-six ontological realities, / beginning with Śiva and ending with earth, is considered the supreme guru.

sanskrit_iast:
antaryāgaṃ bahiryāgaṃ kalājñānasthitiṃ priye |
cāruyantravidhānañca yo vetti sa guruḥ priye || 87 ||
meaning:
अन्तर्यागं बहिर्यागं कलाज्ञानस्थितिं प्रिये |
चारुयन्त्रविधानञ्च यो वेत्ति स गुरुः प्रिये || 87 ||
text_mt: O dear one, he who knows internal worship, external worship, / the maintenance of the knowledge of the phases, and the proper procedure for yantras, is a guru, O dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍabrahmāṇḍayoraikyaṃ sthitiṃ yo vetti tattvataḥ |
śirāsthiromasaṃkhyādi  sa   gururnāparaḥ   priye || 88 ||
meaning:
पिण्डब्रह्माण्डयोरैक्यं स्थितिं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः |
शिरास्थिरोमसंख्यादि  स   गुरुर्नापरः   प्रिये || 88 ||
text_mt: He who truly knows the oneness of the microcosm and the macrocosm and its condition, / the counts of veins, bones, hairs, and so forth, he is the guru and no other, O dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
padmādicaturaśītinānāsanavicakṣaṇaḥ     |
yamādyaṣṭāṅgayogajñaḥ sa guruḥ paramo mataḥ || 89 ||
meaning:
पद्मादिचतुरशीतिनानासनविचक्षणः     |
यमाद्यष्टाङ्गयोगज्ञः स गुरुः परमो मतः || 89 ||
text_mt: He who is skilled in the various eighty-four postures such as the lotus posture, / and who knows the eight-limbed yoga beginning with restraint, is considered the supreme guru.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛṇā saṅkā  bhayaṃ lajjā jugupsā  ceti pañcamī |
kulaṃ śīlaṃ tathā jātiraṣṭau pāśāḥ prakīttītāḥ || 90 ||
meaning:
घृणा सङ्का  भयं लज्जा जुगुप्सा  चेति पञ्चमी |
कुलं शीलं तथा जातिरष्टौ पाशाः प्रकीत्तीताः || 90 ||
text_mt: Pity, doubt, fear, shame, and disgust as the fifth, / family, character, and social class—these are proclaimed as the eight fetters.

sanskrit_iast:
pāśabaddhaḥ  pāśurjñeyaḥ  pāśamukto  maheśvaraḥ |
tasmāt pāśaharo yastu sa guruḥ paramo mataḥ || 91 ||
meaning:
पाशबद्धः  पाशुर्ज्ञेयः  पाशमुक्तो  महेश्वरः |
तस्मात् पाशहरो यस्तु स गुरुः परमो मतः || 91 ||
text_mt: Bound by the fetters, one is known as an uninitiated bound soul; freed from the fetters, one is the Great Lord. / Therefore, he who removes the fetters is considered the supreme guru.

sanskrit_iast:
bandhanaṃ   yonimudrāyā   mantracaitanyadarśanam |
yantramantrasvarūpañca yo vetti sa guruḥ priye || 92 ||
meaning:
बन्धनं   योनिमुद्राया   मन्त्रचैतन्यदर्शनम् |
यन्त्रमन्त्रस्वरूपञ्च यो वेत्ति स गुरुः प्रिये || 92 ||
text_mt: He who knows the binding of the Yonimudrā, the perception of consciousness in mantra, / and the true nature of yantra and mantra, is a guru, O dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
vinikṣiptāṃ gatāyātāṃ saṃkliṣṭāṃ saṃvinītakām |
catuvīdhāṃ  mano'vasthāṃ yo vetti sa guruḥ  priye || 93 ||
meaning:
विनिक्षिप्तां गतायातां संक्लिष्टां संविनीतकाम् |
चतुवीधां  मनोऽवस्थां यो वेत्ति स गुरुः  प्रिये || 93 ||
text_mt: He who knows the fourfold state of mind— / scattered, wandering, afflicted, and disciplined—is a guru, O dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlādibrahmarandhrāntasaptāmbhojadaleṣu      yaḥ |
jīvācāraphalaṃ  vetti  sa  gururnāparaḥ  priye || 94 ||
meaning:
मूलादिब्रह्मरन्ध्रान्तसप्ताम्भोजदलेषु      यः |
जीवाचारफलं  वेत्ति  स  गुरुर्नापरः  प्रिये || 94 ||
text_mt: He who knows the fruit of the soul's conduct within the petals of the seven lotuses / from the root [centre] to the aperture of Brahmā, he is the guru and no other, O dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
śivādiguruparyantaṃ    pāramparyakrameṇa    yaḥ |
avāptatattvasambhāraḥ  sa  gururnāparaḥ  priye || 95 ||
meaning:
शिवादिगुरुपर्यन्तं    पारम्पर्यक्रमेण    यः |
अवाप्ततत्त्वसम्भारः  स  गुरुर्नापरः  प्रिये || 95 ||
text_mt: He who has attained the fullness of reality through the succession of lineage / beginning with Śiva and ending with his own guru, he is the guru and no other, O dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
yena vā daśīte tattve tatkṣaṇāttanmayo bhavet |
manyate muktamātmānaṃ sa   gururnāparaḥ  priye || 96 ||
meaning:
येन वा दशीते तत्त्वे तत्क्षणात्तन्मयो भवेत् |
मन्यते मुक्तमात्मानं स   गुरुर्नापरः  प्रिये || 96 ||
text_mt: Or when reality is shown by him, one becomes identical with it that very moment / and considers oneself liberated; he is the guru and no other, O dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
ye dattvā   sahajānandaṃ   darantīndriyajaṃ  sukham |
sevyāste guravaḥ śiṣyairanye tyājyāḥ pratārakāḥ || 97 ||
meaning:
ये दत्त्वा   सहजानन्दं   दरन्तीन्द्रियजं  सुखम् |
सेव्यास्ते गुरवः शिष्यैरन्ये त्याज्याः प्रतारकाः || 97 ||
text_mt: Those who, having given innate bliss, take away pleasure born of the senses, / such gurus are to be served by disciples; others, being deceivers, are to be abandoned.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārabhayabhītasya śiṣyasya gururādarāt |
vratopavāsaniyamainīyantā   sa  gururmataḥ || 98 ||
meaning:
संसारभयभीतस्य शिष्यस्य गुरुरादरात् |
व्रतोपवासनियमैनीयन्ता   स  गुरुर्मतः || 98 ||
text_mt: The guru who, with care, restrains a disciple / terrified of the transmigratory cycle through vows, fasts, and observances—such a one is considered a guru.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ prasannaḥ kṣaṇārddhena mokṣalakṣmīṃ prayacchati |
durlabhaṃ taṃ vijānīyād  guruṃ saṃsāratārakam || 99 ||
meaning:
यः प्रसन्नः क्षणार्द्धेन मोक्षलक्ष्मीं प्रयच्छति |
दुर्लभं तं विजानीयाद्  गुरुं संसारतारकम् || 99 ||
text_mt: He who, being pleased, bestows the treasure of liberation in half a moment— / one should know that guru, who brings one across the transmigratory cycle, to be rare.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kṣaṇenātmasāmarthyaṃ svaśiṣyāya dadāti hi |
kriyāyāsādirahitaṃ     sa   gururddevadurlabhaḥ || 100 ||
meaning:
यः क्षणेनात्मसामर्थ्यं स्वशिष्याय ददाति हि |
क्रियायासादिरहितं     स   गुरुर्द्देवदुर्लभः || 100 ||
text_mt: He who indeed imparts his own power to his disciple in an instant, / without the exertion of ritual actions and the like—that guru is hard even for the gods to find.

sanskrit_iast:
ya sadyaḥ pratyayakaraṃ sulabhañcātmasaukhyadam |
jñānopadeśaṃ    kurute   sa  gururddevadurlabhaḥ || 101 ||
meaning:
य सद्यः प्रत्ययकरं सुलभञ्चात्मसौख्यदम् |
ज्ञानोपदेशं    कुरुते   स  गुरुर्द्देवदुर्लभः || 101 ||
text_mt: He who gives instruction in knowledge that produces immediate conviction, / is easy to comprehend, and bestows happiness of the Self—that guru is hard even for the gods to find.

sanskrit_iast:
dvīpād  dvīpāntaraṃ  devi  sañcaredyathā  tathā |
yo dadyāt sa gururjñānamabhyāsādivivajītam || 102 ||
meaning:
द्वीपाद्  द्वीपान्तरं  देवि  सञ्चरेद्यथा  तथा |
यो दद्यात् स गुरुर्ज्ञानमभ्यासादिविवजीतम् || 102 ||
text_mt: Just as one may wander, O Goddess, from one island to another, / so he who can impart knowledge free from practice and the like is a guru.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudhitasya yathā tṛptirāhārādāśu  jāyate |
tathopadeśamātreṇa jñānado   durlabho  guruḥ || 103 ||
meaning:
क्षुधितस्य यथा तृप्तिराहारादाशु  जायते |
तथोपदेशमात्रेण ज्ञानदो   दुर्लभो  गुरुः || 103 ||
text_mt: Just as satisfaction swiftly arises for a hungry person from food, / so a guru who bestows knowledge merely through instruction is rare.

sanskrit_iast:
guravo  bahavaḥ  santi dīpavacca gṛhe gṛhe |
durlabho'yaṃ gururdevi sūryavat sarvadīpakaḥ || 104 ||
meaning:
गुरवो  बहवः  सन्ति दीपवच्च गृहे गृहे |
दुर्लभोऽयं गुरुर्देवि सूर्यवत् सर्वदीपकः || 104 ||
text_mt: There are many gurus, like lamps in house after house; / rare is that guru, O Goddess, who illumines everything like the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
guravo  bahavaḥ santi vedaśāstrādipāragāḥ |
durlabho'yaṃ    gururddevi  paratattvārthapāragaḥ || 105 ||
meaning:
गुरवो  बहवः सन्ति वेदशास्त्रादिपारगाः |
दुर्लभोऽयं    गुरुर्द्देवि  परतत्त्वार्थपारगः || 105 ||
text_mt: There are many gurus who have mastered the Vedas, scriptures, and the like; / rare is that guru, O Goddess, who has mastered the meaning of the supreme reality.

sanskrit_iast:
guravo bahavaḥ santi ātmano'nyapradā bhuvi |
durlabho'yaṃ gururddevi lokeṣvātmaprakāśakaḥ || 106 ||
meaning:
गुरवो बहवः सन्ति आत्मनोऽन्यप्रदा भुवि |
दुर्लभोऽयं गुरुर्द्देवि लोकेष्वात्मप्रकाशकः || 106 ||
text_mt: There are many gurus on earth who bestow what is other than the Self; / rare in the worlds is that guru, O Goddess, who reveals the Self.

sanskrit_iast:
guravo  bahavaḥ santi kumantrauṣadhivedinaḥ |
nigamāgamaśāstroktamantrajño durlabho bhuvi || 107 ||
meaning:
गुरवो  बहवः सन्ति कुमन्त्रौषधिवेदिनः |
निगमागमशास्त्रोक्तमन्त्रज्ञो दुर्लभो भुवि || 107 ||
text_mt: There are many gurus who know petty mantras and herbs; / rare on earth is one who knows the mantras taught in the scriptures of the Vedas and Āgamas.

sanskrit_iast:
guravo bahavaḥ santi śiṣyavittāpahārakāḥ |
durlabho'yaṃ gururddevi śiṣyaduḥkhāpahārakaḥ || 108 ||
meaning:
गुरवो बहवः सन्ति शिष्यवित्तापहारकाः |
दुर्लभोऽयं गुरुर्द्देवि शिष्यदुःखापहारकः || 108 ||
text_mt: There are many gurus who take away the wealth of their disciples; / rare is that guru, O Goddess, who takes away the suffering of his disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramakulācāraniratā  bahavo  bhuvi |
sarvasaṅkalpahīno yaḥ sa gururddevi durlabhaḥ || 109 ||
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमकुलाचारनिरता  बहवो  भुवि |
सर्वसङ्कल्पहीनो यः स गुरुर्द्देवि दुर्लभः || 109 ||
text_mt: Many on earth are devoted to the conduct of Kula, social classes, and stages of life; / rare is that guru, O Goddess, who is free from all mental conceptualisation.

sanskrit_iast:
guroryasyaiva samparkāt parānando'bhijāyate |
guruṃ    tameva  vṛṇuyānnāparaṃ  matimānnaraḥ || 110 ||
meaning:
गुरोर्यस्यैव सम्पर्कात् परानन्दोऽभिजायते |
गुरुं    तमेव  वृणुयान्नापरं  मतिमान्नरः || 110 ||
text_mt: A wise man should choose as guru only that one / from whose very contact supreme bliss arises, and no other,

sanskrit_iast:
yasyānubhavaparyantaṃ    buddhistatra   pravarttate |
yasyālokanamātreṇa mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 111 ||
meaning:
यस्यानुभवपर्यन्तं    बुद्धिस्तत्र   प्रवर्त्तते |
यस्यालोकनमात्रेण मुच्यते नात्र संशयः || 111 ||
text_mt: Towards whom his intellect proceeds to the point of direct experience, / and by whose mere glance he is liberated—of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkayā bhakṣitaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram |
sā śaṅkā bhakṣitā yena sa gururddevidurlabhaḥ || 112 ||
meaning:
शङ्कया भक्षितं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् |
सा शङ्का भक्षिता येन स गुरुर्द्देविदुर्लभः || 112 ||
text_mt: The entire three worlds, moving and unmoving, are devoured by doubt; / he by whom that doubt is devoured is a guru hard to find, O Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā vahnisamīpasthaṃ  navanītaṃ  vilīyate |
tathā pāpaṃ vilīyate sadācārya samīpataḥ || 113 ||
meaning:
यथा वह्निसमीपस्थं  नवनीतं  विलीयते |
तथा पापं विलीयते सदाचार्य समीपतः || 113 ||
text_mt: Just as butter placed near a fire melts away, / so demerit dissolves near a true master.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā dīptānalaḥ kāṣṭhaṃ śuṣkamārdrañca nirdahet |
tathā gurukaṭākṣastu śiṣyapāpaṃ dahet kṣaṇāt || 114 ||
meaning:
यथा दीप्तानलः काष्ठं शुष्कमार्द्रञ्च निर्दहेत् |
तथा गुरुकटाक्षस्तु शिष्यपापं दहेत् क्षणात् || 114 ||
text_mt: Just as a blazing fire burns up wood, both dry and wet, / so the sidelong glance of a guru burns the disciple's demerit in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā mahāniloddhūtaṃ tūlaṃ  daśadiśo vrajet |
tathaiva gurukāruṇyāt pāparāśiḥ palāyate || 115 ||
meaning:
यथा महानिलोद्धूतं तूलं  दशदिशो व्रजेत् |
तथैव गुरुकारुण्यात् पापराशिः पलायते || 115 ||
text_mt: Just as cotton blown by a mighty wind scatters to the ten directions, / so indeed does a heap of demerit flee through the guru's compassion.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpadarśanamātreṇa  praṇaśyati  tamo  yathā |
sadgurorddarśanāddevi tathā'jñānaṃ vinaśyati || 116 ||
meaning:
दीपदर्शनमात्रेण  प्रणश्यति  तमो  यथा |
सद्गुरोर्द्दर्शनाद्देवि तथाऽज्ञानं विनश्यति || 116 ||
text_mt: Just as darkness perishes merely at the sighting of a lamp, / so ignorance is destroyed, O Goddess, by the sight of a true guru.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇasampanno  vedaśāstravidhānavit |
sarvopāyavidhānajñastattvajñānī guruḥ sa hi || 117 ||
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नो  वेदशास्त्रविधानवित् |
सर्वोपायविधानज्ञस्तत्त्वज्ञानी गुरुः स हि || 117 ||
text_mt: Endowed with all auspicious marks, knowing the ordinances of the Vedas and scriptures, / knowing the rules of all means, and possessing knowledge of reality—he indeed is a guru.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāhomāśramācāratapastīrthavratādikam     |
mantrāgamādivijñānaṃ tattvahīnasya niṣphalam || 118 ||
meaning:
पूजाहोमाश्रमाचारतपस्तीर्थव्रतादिकम्     |
मन्त्रागमादिविज्ञानं तत्त्वहीनस्य निष्फलम् || 118 ||
text_mt: Worship, fire sacrifices, the conduct of the stages of life, austerities, pilgrimages, vows, and so forth, / and understanding of mantras and Āgamas are fruitless for one devoid of reality.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ vedye pare tattve svātmānaṃ vetti niścalaḥ |
ātmano'nugraho nāsti parasyānugrahaḥ katham || 119 ||
meaning:
स्वयं वेद्ये परे तत्त्वे स्वात्मानं वेत्ति निश्चलः |
आत्मनोऽनुग्रहो नास्ति परस्यानुग्रहः कथम् || 119 ||
text_mt: When the supreme reality is to be known by oneself, if unmoving he does not know his own Self / and there is no grace towards himself, how can there be grace towards another?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmākāraṃ  manorūpaṃ  prapyakṣaṃ   svatanusthitam |
yo na jānāti cānyasya kathaṃ mokṣaṃ dadātyasau || 120 ||
meaning:
ब्रह्माकारं  मनोरूपं  प्रप्यक्षं   स्वतनुस्थितम् |
यो न जानाति चान्यस्य कथं मोक्षं ददात्यसौ || 120 ||
text_mt: He who does not directly know the nature of the mind shaped as Brahman, / residing in his own body—how can he grant liberation to another?

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇahīno'pi tattvajñānī guruḥ smṛtaḥ |
tasmāttattvavideveha  mukto  mocaka eva ca || 121 ||
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणहीनोऽपि तत्त्वज्ञानी गुरुः स्मृतः |
तस्मात्तत्त्वविदेवेह  मुक्तो  मोचक एव च || 121 ||
text_mt: Even if devoid of all auspicious marks, one who possesses knowledge of reality is traditionally considered a guru. / Therefore, in this world, only the knower of reality is both liberated and a liberator.

sanskrit_iast:
yastattvavinmaheśāni sa  paśuṃ  bodhayatyapi |
tattvahīnāt kuto'dhyātmatattvajñānaparigrahaḥ || 122 ||
meaning:
यस्तत्त्वविन्महेशानि स  पशुं  बोधयत्यपि |
तत्त्वहीनात् कुतोऽध्यात्मतत्त्वज्ञानपरिग्रहः || 122 ||
text_mt: He who knows reality, O Great Sovereign, awakens even an uninitiated bound soul; / from one devoid of reality, whence could there be comprehension of the spiritual knowledge of reality?

sanskrit_iast:
tattvajñairupadiṣṭā ye  tattvājñaste  na  saṃśayaḥ |
paśubhiścopadiṣṭā ye devi te paśavaḥ smṛtāḥ || 123 ||
meaning:
तत्त्वज्ञैरुपदिष्टा ये  तत्त्वाज्ञस्ते  न  संशयः |
पशुभिश्चोपदिष्टा ये देवि ते पशवः स्मृताः || 123 ||
text_mt: Those who are instructed by knowers of reality are knowers of reality, without doubt; / and those who are instructed by uninitiated bound souls, O Goddess, are recorded as uninitiated bound souls.

sanskrit_iast:
viddhastu  vedhayeddevi   nāviddho  vedhako  bhavet |
muktastu mocayed baddhaṃ na mukto mocakaḥ katham || 124 ||
meaning:
विद्धस्तु  वेधयेद्देवि   नाविद्धो  वेधको  भवेत् |
मुक्तस्तु मोचयेद् बद्धं न मुक्तो मोचकः कथम् || 124 ||
text_mt: Only one who has been pierced can pierce [another], O Goddess; one who is not pierced cannot be a piercer. / One who is liberated can liberate one who is bound; how can one who is not liberated be a liberator?

sanskrit_iast:
abhijñaścoddharenmūrkha   na   mūrkho   mūrkhamuddharet |
śilāṃ santārayennauhī kiṃ śilā tārayecchilām || 125 ||
meaning:
अभिज्ञश्चोद्धरेन्मूर्ख   न   मूर्खो   मूर्खमुद्धरेत् |
शिलां सन्तारयेन्नौही किं शिला तारयेच्छिलाम् || 125 ||
text_mt: A knowledgeable person can rescue a fool, but a fool cannot rescue a fool; / a boat can carry a stone across, but can a stone carry a stone across?

sanskrit_iast:
tattvahīnaṃ guruṃ  labdhvā  kevalaṃ  bhava  tatparaḥ |
ihāmutra phalaṃ kiñcit sa naro nāpnuyāt priye || 126 ||
meaning:
तत्त्वहीनं गुरुं  लब्ध्वा  केवलं  भव  तत्परः |
इहामुत्र फलं किञ्चित् स नरो नाप्नुयात् प्रिये || 126 ||
text_mt:
Having obtained a guru bereft of reality, if one is merely devoted to him,
that person obtains no fruit whatsoever here or in the hereafter, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
śaive  gurutrayaṃ  proktaṃ  vaiṣṇave  gurupañcakam |
vedaśāstreṣu   śataśo  gururekaḥ  kulānvaye || 127 ||
meaning:
शैवे  गुरुत्रयं  प्रोक्तं  वैष्णवे  गुरुपञ्चकम् |
वेदशास्त्रेषु   शतशो  गुरुरेकः  कुलान्वये || 127 ||
text_mt:
Three gurus are taught in the Śaiva tradition, five gurus in the Vaiṣṇava,
hundreds in the Vedic scriptures, but only one guru in the lineage of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
prerakaḥ sūcakaścaiva  vācako  darśakastathā |
śikṣako bodhakaścaiva ṣaḍete guruvaḥ smṛtāḥ || 128 ||
meaning:
प्रेरकः सूचकश्चैव  वाचको  दर्शकस्तथा |
शिक्षको बोधकश्चैव षडेते गुरुवः स्मृताः || 128 ||
text_mt:
The impelling, the indicating, the explaining, the displaying,
the instructing, and the awakening—these six are remembered as gurus.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaite kāryabhūtāḥ syuḥ kāraṇaṃ bodhako bhavet |
pūrṇābhiṣekakarttā yo gurustasyaiva pādukā |
pūjanīyā maheśāni bahutve'pi na saṃśayaḥ || 129 ||
meaning:
पञ्चैते कार्यभूताः स्युः कारणं बोधको भवेत् |
पूर्णाभिषेककर्त्ता यो गुरुस्तस्यैव पादुका |
पूजनीया महेशानि बहुत्वेऽपि न संशयः || 129 ||
text_mt:
These five are the effects; the awakening one is the cause.
He who confers the full consecration, his sandals alone
are to be worshipped, O Great Ruler, even if there are many [gurus]; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīguru lakṣaṇopetaṃ  saṃśayacchedakārakam |
labdhvā jñānapradaṃ devi na gurvantaramāśrayet || 130 ||
meaning:
श्रीगुरु लक्षणोपेतं  संशयच्छेदकारकम् |
लब्ध्वा ज्ञानप्रदं देवि न गुर्वन्तरमाश्रयेत् || 130 ||
text_mt:
Having obtained the revered guru endowed with the [proper] marks, who dispels doubt
and bestows knowledge, O Devi, one should not resort to another guru.

sanskrit_iast:
anabhijñaṃ guruṃ prāpya sadā saṃśayakārakam |
gurvantarantu  gatvā  sa  naitaddoṣeṇa lipyate || 131 ||
meaning:
अनभिज्ञं गुरुं प्राप्य सदा संशयकारकम् |
गुर्वन्तरन्तु  गत्वा  स  नैतद्दोषेण लिप्यते || 131 ||
text_mt:
Having obtained an ignorant guru who constantly causes doubt,
if one goes to another guru, one is not stained by this fault.

sanskrit_iast:
madhulubdho yathā bhṛṅgaḥ puṣpāt puṣpāntaraṃ vrajet |
jñānalubdhastathā  śiṣyaḥ  gurogurvantaraṃ  vrajet || 132 ||
meaning:
मधुलुब्धो यथा भृङ्गः पुष्पात् पुष्पान्तरं व्रजेत् |
ज्ञानलुब्धस्तथा  शिष्यः  गुरोगुर्वन्तरं  व्रजेत् || 132 ||
text_mt:
Just as a bee eager for honey goes from flower to flower,
so a disciple eager for knowledge may go from guru to guru.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ kiñcillakṣaṇaṃ guruśiṣyayoḥ |
samāsena kuleśāni kimbhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 133 ||
meaning:
इति ते कथितं किञ्चिल्लक्षणं गुरुशिष्ययोः |
समासेन कुलेशानि किम्भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि || 133 ||
text_mt:
Thus the characteristics of guru and disciple have been briefly told to you,
O Mistress of Kula; what more do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast:
atha caturdaśollāsaḥ
śrī devyuvāca
kuleśa śrotumicchāmi parīkṣāṃ guruśiṣyayoḥ |
upadeśakramaṃ   dīkṣābhedāṃśca  vada  me  prabho || 1 ||
meaning:
अथ चतुर्दशोल्लासः
श्री देव्युवाच
कुलेश श्रोतुमिच्छामि परीक्षां गुरुशिष्ययोः |
उपदेशक्रमं   दीक्षाभेदांश्च  वद  मे  प्रभो || 1 ||
text_mt:
Now the fourteenth chapter.
The auspicious Goddess said:
O Lord of Kula, I wish to hear about the examination of guru and disciple.
Tell me, O Lord, the sequence of instruction and the divisions of initiation.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
tasya  śravaṇamātreṇa  cittaśuddhiḥ  prajāyate || 2 ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि |
तस्य  श्रवणमात्रेण  चित्तशुद्धिः  प्रजायते || 2 ||

sanskrit_iast:
vinā dīkṣāṃ na mokṣaḥ syāttaduktaṃ śivaśāsane |
sā  ca  na  syādvinācāryamityācāryaparamparā || 3 ||
meaning:
विना दीक्षां न मोक्षः स्यात्तदुक्तं शिवशासने |
सा  च  न  स्याद्विनाचार्यमित्याचार्यपरम्परा || 3 ||
text_mt:
Without initiation there is no liberation; so it is stated in the teaching of Śiva.
And that cannot be without a master; hence the lineage of masters.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt siddhāntaṃ samprāpya sampradāyādihetubhiḥ |
antareṇopadeṣṭāraṃ  mantrāḥ  syunīṣphalā  yataḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
तस्मात् सिद्धान्तं सम्प्राप्य सम्प्रदायादिहेतुभिः |
अन्तरेणोपदेष्टारं  मन्त्राः  स्युनीष्फला  यतः || 4 ||
text_mt:
Therefore, having attained the established doctrine through the traditional lineage and the like, [one must learn from a master],
for without an instructor, mantras are fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
devāstameva     śaṃsanti    pāramparyapravarttakam |
guruṃ    mantrāgamābhijñaṃ   samayācārapālakam || 5 ||
meaning:
देवास्तमेव     शंसन्ति    पारम्पर्यप्रवर्त्तकम् |
गुरुं    मन्त्रागमाभिज्ञं   समयाचारपालकम् || 5 ||
text_mt:
Even the gods praise him who maintains the traditional transmission,
the guru knowledgeable in the mantras and scriptures, who preserves the conduct of the pledge.

sanskrit_iast:
guruḥ śiṣyādhikārārthaṃ virakto'pi śivājñayā |
kiñcitkālaṃ vidhāyetthaṃ svaśiṣyāya samarpayet || 6 ||
meaning:
गुरुः शिष्याधिकारार्थं विरक्तोऽपि शिवाज्ञया |
किञ्चित्कालं विधायेत्थं स्वशिष्याय समर्पयेत् || 6 ||
text_mt:
For the sake of the disciple's qualification, even if dispassionate, the guru, by the command of Śiva,
having observed this for a short time, should hand it over to his disciple.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpītādhikārasya yogaḥ sākṣāt pare śive |
dehānte  śāśvatī  muktiriti  śaṅkarabhāṣitam || 7 ||
meaning:
तस्यापीताधिकारस्य योगः साक्षात् परे शिवे |
देहान्ते  शाश्वती  मुक्तिरिति  शङ्करभाषितम् || 7 ||
text_mt:
For him whose authority has ceased, there is direct union with the supreme Śiva,
and at the end of the body, eternal liberation; so it is spoken by Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt  sarvaprayatnena  sākṣātparaśivoditam |
sampradāyamavicchinnaṃ sadā kuryāt guruḥ priye || 8 ||
meaning:
तस्मात्  सर्वप्रयत्नेन  साक्षात्परशिवोदितम् |
सम्प्रदायमविच्छिन्नं सदा कुर्यात् गुरुः प्रिये || 8 ||
text_mt:
Therefore, with every effort, the guru should always keep unbroken
the tradition spoken directly by the supreme Śiva, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktisiddhisusiddhyarthaṃ parīkṣya vidhivad guruḥ |
paścādupadiśenmantramanyathā   niṣphalaṃ    bhavet || 9 ||
meaning:
शक्तिसिद्धिसुसिद्ध्यर्थं परीक्ष्य विधिवद् गुरुः |
पश्चादुपदिशेन्मन्त्रमन्यथा   निष्फलं    भवेत् || 9 ||
text_mt:
For the proper attainment of the perfection of power, having tested [the disciple] according to rule,
the guru should then instruct the mantra; otherwise, it becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
anyāyena tu yo dadyād gṛhṇātyanyāyataśca yaḥ |
dadatā  gṛhṇatā  devi  kulaśāpo  bhaviṣyati || 10 ||
meaning:
अन्यायेन तु यो दद्याद् गृह्णात्यन्यायतश्च यः |
ददता  गृह्णता  देवि  कुलशापो  भविष्यति || 10 ||
text_mt:
Whoever gives it improperly, and whoever receives it improperly,
for both the giver and the receiver, O Devi, there will be the curse of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
guruśiṣyāvubhau   mohādaparīkṣya    parasparam |
upadeśaṃ dadad gṛhṇan prāpnuyātāṃ piśācatām || 11 ||
meaning:
गुरुशिष्यावुभौ   मोहादपरीक्ष्य    परस्परम् |
उपदेशं ददद् गृह्णन् प्राप्नुयातां पिशाचताम् || 11 ||
text_mt:
If both guru and disciple, out of delusion, without testing each other,
give and receive instruction, they will both attain the state of a piśāca.

sanskrit_iast:
aśāstrīyopadeśañca yo gṛhṇāti dadāti hi |
bhuñjāte  tāvubhau  ghorānnarakānekaviṃśatim || 12 ||
meaning:
अशास्त्रीयोपदेशञ्च यो गृह्णाति ददाति हि |
भुञ्जाते  तावुभौ  घोरान्नरकानेकविंशतिम् || 12 ||
text_mt:
Whoever receives and gives unscriptural instruction,
both of them indeed suffer twenty-one dreadful hells.

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃskṛtopadeśañca  yaḥ karoti  sa pātakī |
vinaśyati ca tanmantraṃ saikate śālibījavat || 13 ||
meaning:
असंस्कृतोपदेशञ्च  यः करोति  स पातकी |
विनश्यति च तन्मन्त्रं सैकते शालिबीजवत् || 13 ||
text_mt:
He who imparts unpurified instruction is a sinner;
and that mantra of his perishes, like a rice-seed on sandy soil.

sanskrit_iast:
anarhe   mantravijñānaṃ   na  tiṣṭhati   kadācana |
tasmāt parīkṣya karttavyamanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 14 ||
meaning:
अनर्हे   मन्त्रविज्ञानं   न  तिष्ठति   कदाचन |
तस्मात् परीक्ष्य कर्त्तव्यमन्यथा निष्फलं भवेत् || 14 ||
text_mt:
The profound knowledge of the mantra never abides in the unworthy;
therefore, it must be done after examination; otherwise, it becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā  samayadīkṣāñca dattvā  samayapādukām |
sannidhāyātmanaḥ śiṣyaṃ vadenmantraṃ na cānyathā || 15 ||
meaning:
कृत्वा  समयदीक्षाञ्च दत्त्वा  समयपादुकाम् |
सन्निधायात्मनः शिष्यं वदेन्मन्त्रं न चान्यथा || 15 ||
text_mt:
Having performed the initiation into the pledge and having given the sandals of the pledge,
having brought the disciple close to oneself, he should utter the mantra, and not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
sacchiṣyāyātibhaktāya   yajjñānamupadiśyate |
tajjñānaṃ tattuśāstrārthaṃ tadvidadhyādakhaṇḍitam || 16 ||
meaning:
सच्छिष्यायातिभक्ताय   यज्ज्ञानमुपदिश्यते |
तज्ज्ञानं तत्तुशास्त्रार्थं तद्विदध्यादखण्डितम् || 16 ||
text_mt:
The knowledge that is taught to a good disciple who is exceedingly devoted,
that knowledge indeed is the meaning of scripture; he should maintain it unbroken.

sanskrit_iast:
asacchiṣyeṣvabhakteṣu    yajjñānamupadiśyate |
tat  prayātyapavitratvaṃ  gokṣīraṃ śvaghṛtādiva || 17 ||
meaning:
असच्छिष्येष्वभक्तेषु    यज्ज्ञानमुपदिश्यते |
तत्  प्रयात्यपवित्रत्वं  गोक्षीरं श्वघृतादिव || 17 ||
text_mt:
The knowledge that is taught to bad disciples who lack devotion
falls into impurity, like cow's milk in a vessel of dog's lard or the like.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanecchābhayalobhādyairayogyaṃ  yadi  dīkṣayet |
devatāśāpamāpnoti kṛtañca niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 18 ||
meaning:
धनेच्छाभयलोभाद्यैरयोग्यं  यदि  दीक्षयेत् |
देवताशापमाप्नोति कृतञ्च निष्फलं भवेत् || 18 ||
text_mt:
If one initiates an unfit person through desire for wealth, fear, greed, or the like,
one incurs the curse of the deity, and what was done becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānena kriyayā vāpi guru śiṣyaṃ parīkṣayet |
saṃvatsaraṃ  tadarddhaṃ  vā  tadarddhaṃ  vā  prayatnataḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
ज्ञानेन क्रियया वापि गुरु शिष्यं परीक्षयेत् |
संवत्सरं  तदर्द्धं  वा  तदर्द्धं  वा  प्रयत्नतः || 19 ||
text_mt:
Through knowledge or through action, the guru should test the disciple
for a year, or half of that, or half of that, with diligence.

sanskrit_iast:
uttamāṃścādhame     kuryānnīcānuttamakarmaṇi |
prāṇadravyapraṇāmādyairādeśaiśca  svayaṃ  samaiḥ || 20 ||
meaning:
उत्तमांश्चाधमे     कुर्यान्नीचानुत्तमकर्मणि |
प्राणद्रव्यप्रणामाद्यैरादेशैश्च  स्वयं  समैः || 20 ||
text_mt:
He should put the superior ones to low tasks, and the low ones to superior work,
with demands for life, wealth, prostrations, and commands, testing them himself as equals,

sanskrit_iast:
tatkarmasūcakairvākyairmāyābhiḥ     krūraceṣṭitaiḥ |
pakṣapātairudāsīnairanekaiśca            muhurmuhuḥ || 21 ||
meaning:
तत्कर्मसूचकैर्वाक्यैर्मायाभिः     क्रूरचेष्टितैः |
पक्षपातैरुदासीनैरनेकैश्च            मुहुर्मुहुः || 21 ||
text_mt:
with words indicating those tasks, with deceptions, with harsh deeds,
with partialities, with indifferences, and with many [tests] again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
ākṛṣṭastāḍito vāpi yo viṣādaṃ na yāti ca |
guruḥ kṛpāṃ karotīti mudā  sañcintayet sadā || 22 ||
meaning:
आकृष्टस्ताडितो वापि यो विषादं न याति च |
