गुरुः कृपां करोतीति मुदा  सञ्चिन्तयेत् सदा || 22 ||
text_mt:
Dragged or even beaten, he who does not fall into despondency,
and always reflects with joy, 'The guru is showing grace,'

sanskrit_iast:
śrīguroḥ  smaraṇe  cāpi kīrttanaṃ darśane'pi ca |
vandane   paricaryāyāmāhvāne    preṣaṇe   priye || 23 ||
meaning:
श्रीगुरोः  स्मरणे  चापि कीर्त्तनं दर्शनेऽपि च |
वन्दने   परिचर्यायामाह्वाने    प्रेषणे   प्रिये || 23 ||
text_mt:
and in remembering the revered guru, in chanting his praise, in seeing him,
in saluting, in serving, in being summoned, and in being sent on an errand, O beloved,

sanskrit_iast:
ānandakamparomāñcasvaranetrādivikriyāḥ      |
yeṣāṃ syuste'tra yogyāśca dīkṣāsaṃskārakarmaṇi || 24 ||
meaning:
आनन्दकम्परोमाञ्चस्वरनेत्रादिविक्रियाः      |
येषां स्युस्तेऽत्र योग्याश्च दीक्षासंस्कारकर्मणि || 24 ||
text_mt:
those in whom there are transformations such as joy, trembling, horripilation, and changes of voice and eyes,
are fit here for the rite of the sacrament of initiation.

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyo'pi lakṣaṇairetaiḥ kuryād guruparīkṣaṇam |
ānandādyairjapastotradhyānahomārcanādiṣu      || 25 ||
meaning:
शिष्योऽपि लक्षणैरेतैः कुर्याद् गुरुपरीक्षणम् |
आनन्दाद्यैर्जपस्तोत्रध्यानहोमार्चनादिषु      || 25 ||
text_mt:
The disciple too should test the guru by these marks:
by joy and the like in repetition of mantras, hymns, meditation, fire offerings, worship, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānopadeśasāmarthyaṃ     mantrasiddhimapīśvari |
vedhakatvaṃ parijñāya śiṣyo bhūyānna cānyathā || 26 ||
meaning:
ज्ञानोपदेशसामर्थ्यं     मन्त्रसिद्धिमपीश्वरि |
वेधकत्वं परिज्ञाय शिष्यो भूयान्न चान्यथा || 26 ||
text_mt:
Having perceived the capacity to instruct knowledge, perfection in mantra, O Ruler,
and the power to penetrate, he should become a disciple, and not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
ādimadhyāvasāneṣu   yogyāḥ   śaktinipātitāḥ |
adhamā madhyamāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śiṣyā devi prakīttītāḥ || 27 ||
meaning:
आदिमध्यावसानेषु   योग्याः   शक्तिनिपातिताः |
अधमा मध्यमाः श्रेष्ठाः शिष्या देवि प्रकीत्तीताः || 27 ||
text_mt:
Those who are struck by the descent of power are fit at the beginning, in the middle, and at the end;
they are proclaimed, O Devi, as low, middling, and superior disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau bhaktirbhaveddevi dīkṣārthaṃ samudanti ye |
punavīpulahṛṣṭāste  ādiyogyā itīritāḥ || 28 ||
meaning:
आदौ भक्तिर्भवेद्देवि दीक्षार्थं समुदन्ति ये |
पुनवीपुलहृष्टास्ते  आदियोग्या इतीरिताः || 28 ||
text_mt:
Those who have devotion at first, O Devi, and rise up for the sake of initiation,
and are then exceedingly joyful, are declared fit from the beginning.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāsamayasamprāptā        jñānavijñānavajītāḥ |
bhaktyā pradhvastaparyāyā madhyayogyāśca te smṛtāḥ || 29 ||
meaning:
दीक्षासमयसम्प्राप्ता        ज्ञानविज्ञानवजीताः |
भक्त्या प्रध्वस्तपर्याया मध्ययोग्याश्च ते स्मृताः || 29 ||
text_mt:
Those who have attained the time of initiation, though devoid of knowledge and discernment,
whose stages [of hesitation] are destroyed by devotion, are remembered as middling in fitness.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau bhaktivihīnā ye madhyabhaktāstu ye narāḥ |
antapravṛddhabhaktāśca  antayogyā  bhavanti   te |
uttamajñānasaṃjñāścetyupadeśastridhā      priye || 30 ||
meaning:
आदौ भक्तिविहीना ये मध्यभक्तास्तु ये नराः |
अन्तप्रवृद्धभक्ताश्च  अन्तयोग्या  भवन्ति   ते |
उत्तमज्ञानसंज्ञाश्चेत्युपदेशस्त्रिधा      प्रिये || 30 ||

sanskrit_iast:
yathā pipīlikā mandamandaṃ vṛkṣāgragaṃ phalam |
cireṇāpnoti  karmopadeśaścāpi tathā smṛtaḥ || 31 ||
meaning:
यथा पिपीलिका मन्दमन्दं वृक्षाग्रगं फलम् |
चिरेणाप्नोति  कर्मोपदेशश्चापि तथा स्मृतः || 31 ||
text_mt:
Just as an ant very slowly reaches the fruit situated at the top of a tree
after a long time, the instruction through ritual action is remembered to be likewise.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā kapiśca śākhāyāṃ śākhāmullaṃghya yatnataḥ |
phalaṃ  prāpnoti   dharmasya  copadeśastathā  priye || 32 ||
meaning:
यथा कपिश्च शाखायां शाखामुल्लंघ्य यत्नतः |
फलं  प्राप्नोति   धर्मस्य  चोपदेशस्तथा  प्रिये || 32 ||
text_mt:
Just as a monkey, leaping with effort from branch to branch,
reaches the fruit, so is the instruction of duty, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā viyadgamaḥ śīghraṃ phala eva niṣīdati |
tathā jñānopadeśaśca  kathitaḥ kulanāyike || 33 ||
meaning:
यथा वियद्गमः शीघ्रं फल एव निषीदति |
तथा ज्ञानोपदेशश्च  कथितः कुलनायिके || 33 ||
text_mt: Just as a bird swiftly alights right upon the fruit, / so instruction in knowledge has been declared, O leader of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
sparśākhyā devi dṛksaṃjñā mānasākhyā maheśvari |
kriyāyāsādirahitā  devā  dīkṣā  tridhā smṛtā || 34 ||
meaning:
स्पर्शाख्या देवि दृक्संज्ञा मानसाख्या महेश्वरि |
क्रियायासादिरहिता  देवा  दीक्षा  त्रिधा स्मृता || 34 ||
text_mt: Known as touch, O Goddess, named sight, and named mental, O Great Lady— / initiation, devoid of ritual exertion and the like, is remembered as threefold, O Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā pakṣī svapakṣābhyāṃ śiśūn saṃvarddhayecchanaiḥ |
sparśadīkṣopadeśacca   tādṛśaḥ  kathitaḥ  priye || 35 ||
meaning:
यथा पक्षी स्वपक्षाभ्यां शिशून् संवर्द्धयेच्छनैः |
स्पर्शदीक्षोपदेशच्च   तादृशः  कथितः  प्रिये || 35 ||
text_mt: Just as a bird slowly nurtures its young with both wings, / such is declared the instruction of initiation by touch, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
svāpatyāni yathā matsyo vīkṣaṇenaiva poṣayet |
dṛgbhyāṃ   dīkṣopadeśaśca  tādṛśaḥ  parameśvari || 36 ||
meaning:
स्वापत्यानि यथा मत्स्यो वीक्षणेनैव पोषयेत् |
दृग्भ्यां   दीक्षोपदेशश्च  तादृशः  परमेश्वरि || 36 ||
text_mt: Just as a fish nourishes its offspring by its gaze alone, / such is the instruction of initiation through the eyes, O Supreme Lady.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā kūrmaḥ svatanayān dhyānamātreṇa poṣayet |
vedhadīkṣopadeśaśca  mānasaḥ syāt tathāvidhaḥ || 37 ||
meaning:
यथा कूर्मः स्वतनयान् ध्यानमात्रेण पोषयेत् |
वेधदीक्षोपदेशश्च  मानसः स्यात् तथाविधः || 37 ||
text_mt: Just as a tortoise nourishes its young by mere contemplation, / the mental instruction of piercing initiation is likewise.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktipātānusāreṇa        śiṣyo'nugrahamarhati |
yatra  śaktirna  patati  tatra  siddhirna  jāyate || 38 ||
meaning:
शक्तिपातानुसारेण        शिष्योऽनुग्रहमर्हति |
यत्र  शक्तिर्न  पतति  तत्र  सिद्धिर्न  जायते || 38 ||
text_mt: In accordance with the descent of power, the disciple is worthy of grace; / where power does not fall, success does not arise there.

sanskrit_iast:
kriyāvarṇakalāsparśavāgdṛṅmānasasaṃjñayā      |
dīkṣā  mokṣapradā  devi  saptadhā  parikīttītā || 39 ||
meaning:
क्रियावर्णकलास्पर्शवाग्दृङ्मानससंज्ञया      |
दीक्षा  मोक्षप्रदा  देवि  सप्तधा  परिकीत्तीता || 39 ||
text_mt: Under the designations of ritual action, letter, ontological energy, touch, speech, sight, and mind, / initiation, granting liberation, O Goddess, is declared to be sevenfold.

sanskrit_iast:
samayākhyā  viśeṣā ca sādhikā putrikāhvayā |
vedhakā  pūrṇasaṃjñā  cācāryā  nirvāṇasaṃjñikā || 40 ||
meaning:
समयाख्या  विशेषा च साधिका पुत्रिकाह्वया |
वेधका  पूर्णसंज्ञा  चाचार्या  निर्वाणसंज्ञिका || 40 ||
text_mt: Named probationary, special, practicing, called filial, / piercing, named full, and belonging to the master, named of final cessation:

sanskrit_iast:
kriyādīkṣāṣṭadhā proktā kuṇḍamaṇḍapapūvīkā |
kalasādisamāyuktā  karttavyā guruṇā bahiḥ |
deveśi   dehaśuddhyarthaṃ   pūrvoktavidhinācaret || 41 ||
meaning:
क्रियादीक्षाष्टधा प्रोक्ता कुण्डमण्डपपूवीका |
कलसादिसमायुक्ता  कर्त्तव्या गुरुणा बहिः |
देवेशि   देहशुद्ध्यर्थं   पूर्वोक्तविधिनाचरेत् || 41 ||
text_mt: Initiation by ritual action is declared eightfold, preceded by [preparation of] the sacrificial pit and pavilion; / equipped with the pot and other vessels, it is to be performed outwardly by the guru. / O ruler of the gods, one should perform it according to the rule declared previously, for the purification of the body.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇadīkṣā tridhā  proktā  dvicatvāriṃśadakṣaraiḥ |
pañcāśadvarṇairvā  devi  dviṣaṣṭilipibhistu  tā || 42 ||
meaning:
वर्णदीक्षा त्रिधा  प्रोक्ता  द्विचत्वारिंशदक्षरैः |
पञ्चाशद्वर्णैर्वा  देवि  द्विषष्टिलिपिभिस्तु  ता || 42 ||
text_mt: Initiation by letters is declared threefold: with forty-two letters, / or with fifty letters, O Goddess, or indeed with sixty-two scriptural signs.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇān śiṣyatanau nyasya pratilomena saṃharet |
paramātmani saṃyojya taccaitanyaṃ  guruḥ  priye || 43 ||
meaning:
वर्णान् शिष्यतनौ न्यस्य प्रतिलोमेन संहरेत् |
परमात्मनि संयोज्य तच्चैतन्यं  गुरुः  प्रिये || 43 ||
text_mt: Having placed the letters upon the body of the disciple, the guru should dissolve them in reverse order; / having united that consciousness with the Supreme Self, O beloved,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādutpādya tān varṇān nyasecchiṣyatanau punaḥ |
sṛṣṭikrameṇa   vidhinā  caitanyañca   prayojayet || 44 ||
meaning:
तस्मादुत्पाद्य तान् वर्णान् न्यसेच्छिष्यतनौ पुनः |
सृष्टिक्रमेण   विधिना  चैतन्यञ्च   प्रयोजयेत् || 44 ||
text_mt: originating those letters from that [Self], he should place them again upon the disciple's body; / and in the order of creation, according to the rule, he should unite consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
jāyate devatābhāvaḥ parānandamayaḥ  śiśoḥ |
eṣā varṇamayī proktā dīkṣā pāśaharā priye || 45 ||
meaning:
जायते देवताभावः परानन्दमयः  शिशोः |
एषा वर्णमयी प्रोक्ता दीक्षा पाशहरा प्रिये || 45 ||
text_mt: The state of the deity arises, full of supreme bliss, in the child [disciple]; / this initiation consisting of letters is declared to destroy bondage, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
kalādīkṣā tridhā jñeyā karttavyā vidhivat priye |
nivṛttirjānuparyantaṃ     talādārabhya    saṃsthitā || 46 ||
meaning:
कलादीक्षा त्रिधा ज्ञेया कर्त्तव्या विधिवत् प्रिये |
निवृत्तिर्जानुपर्यन्तं     तलादारभ्य    संस्थिता || 46 ||
text_mt: Initiation of ontological energies should be known as threefold, to be performed according to rule, O beloved: / the cessation energy stands from the sole up to the knees;

sanskrit_iast:
jānunornābhiparyantaṃ   pratiṣṭhā   tiṣṭhati   priye |
nābheḥ kaṇṭhāvadhi vyāptā vidyā śāntistataḥ param || 47 ||
meaning:
जानुनोर्नाभिपर्यन्तं   प्रतिष्ठा   तिष्ठति   प्रिये |
नाभेः कण्ठावधि व्याप्ता विद्या शान्तिस्ततः परम् || 47 ||
text_mt: from the knees up to the navel stands the foundation energy, O beloved; / pervading from the navel up to the throat is the knowledge energy; beyond that is the tranquility energy;

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭhāllalāṭaparyantaṃ vyāptā tasmācchiro'vadhi |
śāntyatītā kalā caiṣā  kalāvyāptiritīritā || 48 ||
meaning:
कण्ठाल्ललाटपर्यन्तं व्याप्ता तस्माच्छिरोऽवधि |
शान्त्यतीता कला चैषा  कलाव्याप्तिरितीरिता || 48 ||
text_mt: pervading from the throat up to the forehead, and from there up to the head / is the energy beyond tranquility; and this is proclaimed as the pervasion of ontological energies.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhārakramayogena sthānāt sthānāntaraṃ priye |
saṃyojya vidhivat samyagvidhivettā śiro'vadhi || 49 ||
meaning:
संहारक्रमयोगेन स्थानात् स्थानान्तरं प्रिये |
संयोज्य विधिवत् सम्यग्विधिवेत्ता शिरोऽवधि || 49 ||
text_mt: Through the method of the dissolution order, from one place to another place, O beloved, / having properly united [them] up to the head according to rule, the one who knows the rule,

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ proktā kuleśāni divyabhāvapradāyinī |
aṣṭatriṃśatkalābhirvā pañcāśadbhirathāpi vā || 50 ||
meaning:
इयं प्रोक्ता कुलेशानि दिव्यभावप्रदायिनी |
अष्टत्रिंशत्कलाभिर्वा पञ्चाशद्भिरथापि वा || 50 ||
text_mt: this is declared to bestow the divine state, O ruler of Kula, / either through the thirty-eight ontological energies, or else through fifty.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvanyāsakrameṇaiva       sṛṣṭisaṃhāramārgataḥ |
jñātvā gurumukhāddeviṃ śiṣye saṃyojya vedhayet || 51 ||
meaning:
तत्त्वन्यासक्रमेणैव       सृष्टिसंहारमार्गतः |
ज्ञात्वा गुरुमुखाद्देविं शिष्ये संयोज्य वेधयेत् || 51 ||
text_mt: According to the order of placing realities, via the path of creation and dissolution, / knowing the Goddess from the mouth of the guru, having united [her] in the disciple, he should pierce.

sanskrit_iast:
jāyate   devatābhāvo   yoginīvīramelanam |
kalādīkṣā  samuddiṣṭā   paśupāśāpahāriṇī || 52 ||
meaning:
जायते   देवताभावो   योगिनीवीरमेलनम् |
कलादीक्षा  समुद्दिष्टा   पशुपाशापहारिणी || 52 ||
text_mt: The state of the deity arises, the gathering together of yoginīs and heroes; / initiation of ontological energies is declared to destroy the bonds of the uninitiated bound soul.

sanskrit_iast:
ddaste śivaṃ guruṃ dhyātvā japenmūlāṅgamālinīm |
guruḥ spṛśecchiṣyatanuṃ  sparśadīkṣā  bhavediyam || 53 ||
meaning:
द्दस्ते शिवं गुरुं ध्यात्वा जपेन्मूलाङ्गमालिनीम् |
गुरुः स्पृशेच्छिष्यतनुं  स्पर्शदीक्षा  भवेदियम् || 53 ||
text_mt: Having meditated on Śiva the guru in the heart, he should recite the root mantra with its limbs and string of phonemes; / the guru should touch the body of the disciple: this is initiation by touch.

sanskrit_iast:
cittaṃ  tattve  samādhāya  paratattvopabṛṃhitān |
uccaret saṃhatānmantrān vāgdīkṣeti nigadyate || 54 ||
meaning:
चित्तं  तत्त्वे  समाधाय  परतत्त्वोपबृंहितान् |
उच्चरेत् संहतान्मन्त्रान् वाग्दीक्षेति निगद्यते || 54 ||
text_mt: Having collected the mind in reality, he should utter the united mantras / fortified by the supreme reality: this is declared to be initiation by speech.

sanskrit_iast:
nimīlya nayane dhyātvā paratattvaprasannadhīḥ |
samyak paśyedguruḥ śiṣyaṃ dṛgdīkṣā ca bhavet priye || 55 ||
meaning:
निमील्य नयने ध्यात्वा परतत्त्वप्रसन्नधीः |
सम्यक् पश्येद्गुरुः शिष्यं दृग्दीक्षा च भवेत् प्रिये || 55 ||
text_mt: Closing both eyes, having meditated, with intellect cleared in the supreme reality, / the guru should gaze fully upon the disciple: this is initiation by sight, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
gurorālokamātreṇa   bhāṣaṇāt   sparśanādapi |
sadyaḥ sañjāyate jñānaṃ sā dīkṣā śāmbhavī matā || 56 ||
meaning:
गुरोरालोकमात्रेण   भाषणात्   स्पर्शनादपि |
सद्यः सञ्जायते ज्ञानं सा दीक्षा शाम्भवी मता || 56 ||
text_mt: By the mere look of the guru, by speaking, or even by touching, / knowledge immediately arises: that initiation is held to be the Śāmbhavī initiation.

sanskrit_iast:
manodīkṣā  dvidhā  proktā tīvrā tīvratarāpi  ca |
adhvānaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ jñātvā śiṣyadehe smaran priye || 57 ||
meaning:
मनोदीक्षा  द्विधा  प्रोक्ता तीव्रा तीव्रतरापि  च |
अध्वानं षड्विधं ज्ञात्वा शिष्यदेहे स्मरन् प्रिये || 57 ||
text_mt: Mental initiation is declared twofold: intense and more intense; / knowing the sixfold path, remembering it in the disciple's body, O beloved,

sanskrit_iast:
kalpayedbhuvanaṃ  tattvaṃ  kalāṃ  varṇaṃ  padaṃ  manum |
ājānunābhihṛtkaṇṭhatālumūrddhāntamambike     || 58 ||
meaning:
कल्पयेद्भुवनं  तत्त्वं  कलां  वर्णं  पदं  मनुम् |
आजानुनाभिहृत्कण्ठतालुमूर्द्धान्तमम्बिके     || 58 ||
text_mt: the wise one should imagine world, ontological reality, ontological energy, letter, word, and mantra, / reaching to the knees, navel, heart, throat, palate, and head, O mother.

sanskrit_iast:
gurūpadiṣṭamārgeṇa     vedhaṃ    kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ |
pāśayuktaḥ kṣaṇācchiṣyaśchinnapāśastadā bhavet |
eṣā muktipradā  proktā  tīvradīkṣā  kuleśvari || 59 ||
meaning:
गुरूपदिष्टमार्गेण     वेधं    कुर्याद्विचक्षणः |
पाशयुक्तः क्षणाच्छिष्यश्छिन्नपाशस्तदा भवेत् |
एषा मुक्तिप्रदा  प्रोक्ता  तीव्रदीक्षा  कुलेश्वरि || 59 ||
text_mt: By the path instructed by the guru, he should perform the piercing; / bound by bonds, in an instant the disciple then becomes one whose bonds are cut; / this intense initiation is declared to grant liberation, O ruler of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
devi   tīvratarā   cāpi  guruṇā  smṛtamātrataḥ |
samyak saṃvedhinaḥ śiṣyaśchinnapāpastadā bhavet || 60 ||
meaning:
देवि   तीव्रतरा   चापि  गुरुणा  स्मृतमात्रतः |
सम्यक् संवेधिनः शिष्यश्छिन्नपापस्तदा भवेत् || 60 ||
text_mt: And the more intense, O Goddess, occurs by the mere remembrance by the guru; / the disciple of the one who pierces thoroughly becomes one whose demerit is cut.

sanskrit_iast:
vāhyavyāpāranirmukto   bhūmau   patati  tatkṣaṇāt |
sañjātadivyabhāvo'sau  sarvaṃ  jānāti  śāmbhavi || 61 ||
meaning:
वाह्यव्यापारनिर्मुक्तो   भूमौ   पतति  तत्क्षणात् |
सञ्जातदिव्यभावोऽसौ  सर्वं  जानाति  शाम्भवि || 61 ||
text_mt: Freed from outward activity, he falls instantly to the ground; / having attained the divine state, he knows everything, O Śāmbhavī.

sanskrit_iast:
yadasti    vedhakāle    tat   svayamevānubhūyate |
prabuddhaḥ san na śaknoti tat sukhaṃ vaktumīśvari || 62 ||
meaning:
यदस्ति    वेधकाले    तत्   स्वयमेवानुभूयते |
प्रबुद्धः सन् न शक्नोति तत् सुखं वक्तुमीश्वरि || 62 ||
text_mt: Whatever exists at the time of piercing, that is experienced by oneself alone; / being awakened, he is not able to speak of that bliss, O Lady.

sanskrit_iast:
vedhaviddhaḥ śivaḥ sākṣānna punarjanmabhāg bhavet |
eṣā   tīvratarā   dīkṣā   bhavabandhavimocanī |
śivabhāvapradā sākṣāt tvāṃ śape kulanāyike || 63 ||
meaning:
वेधविद्धः शिवः साक्षान्न पुनर्जन्मभाग् भवेत् |
एषा   तीव्रतरा   दीक्षा   भवबन्धविमोचनी |
शिवभावप्रदा साक्षात् त्वां शपे कुलनायिके || 63 ||
text_mt: Pierced by the piercing, he is Śiva visibly; he does not share in rebirth again; / this more intense initiation frees from the bondage of existence; / it bestows the state of Śiva visibly: I swear to you, O leader of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
ānandaścaiva    kampaścedbhavo  ghūrṇā   kuleśvari |
nidrā mūrcchā ca vedhasya ṣaḍavasthāḥ prakīttītāḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
आनन्दश्चैव    कम्पश्चेद्भवो  घूर्णा   कुलेश्वरि |
निद्रा मूर्च्छा च वेधस्य षडवस्थाः प्रकीत्तीताः || 64 ||
text_mt: Bliss, trembling, rising, whirling, O ruler of Kula, / sleep, and trance: these are proclaimed as the six states of piercing.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛśyante  ṣaḍguṇā  hyete  vedhakāle  kuleśvari |
vedhito yatra  kutrāpi  tiṣṭhenmuktā  na saṃśayaḥ || 65 ||
meaning:
दृश्यन्ते  षड्गुणा  ह्येते  वेधकाले  कुलेश्वरि |
वेधितो यत्र  कुत्रापि  तिष्ठेन्मुक्ता  न संशयः || 65 ||
text_mt: Indeed these six qualities are seen at the time of piercing, O ruler of Kula; / wherever the pierced one may dwell, he is liberated: there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
vedhadīkṣākaro  loke  śrīgururdurlabhaḥ   priye |
śiṣyo'pi durlabhastāddṛk puṇyayogena labhyate |
na dadyād yasya kasyāpi ityājñā parameśvari || 66 ||
meaning:
वेधदीक्षाकरो  लोके  श्रीगुरुर्दुर्लभः   प्रिये |
शिष्योऽपि दुर्लभस्ताद्दृक् पुण्ययोगेन लभ्यते |
न दद्याद् यस्य कस्यापि इत्याज्ञा परमेश्वरि || 66 ||
text_mt: The venerable guru who performs piercing initiation is rare in the world, O beloved; / such a disciple is also rare, obtained through the conjunction of merit; / one should not give it to just anyone: this is the command, O Supreme Lady.

sanskrit_iast:
kuladravyaiḥ samabhyarcya  kulacakraṃ  vidhānataḥ |
śiṣyāya darśayeddevi dīkṣaiṣā kaulikī smṛtā || 67 ||
meaning:
कुलद्रव्यैः समभ्यर्च्य  कुलचक्रं  विधानतः |
शिष्याय दर्शयेद्देवि दीक्षैषा कौलिकी स्मृता || 67 ||
text_mt: Having thoroughly worshipped the wheel of Kula with Kula substances according to the ritual, / he should display it to the disciple, O Goddess: this is remembered as Kaulika initiation.

sanskrit_iast:
kuladravyaṃ   mukhe   pūrva   pañcagavyāmṛtānvitam |
abhiṣiñced guruḥ śiṣyaṃ gaṇḍūṣākhyā samīritā || 68 ||
meaning:
कुलद्रव्यं   मुखे   पूर्व   पञ्चगव्यामृतान्वितम् |
अभिषिञ्चेद् गुरुः शिष्यं गण्डूषाख्या समीरिता || 68 ||
text_mt: First the guru should sprinkle the Kula substance into the mouth, combined with the nectar of the five products of the cow, / onto the disciple: this is proclaimed as the mouth-rinsing initiation.

sanskrit_iast:
sajīvamīnayuktena    surayā    pūritena    ca |
pañcāmṛtaiḥ   susampūrṇaśaṅkhena   kalasena   vā |
abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kuryādbāhye tat kathitaṃ priye || 69 ||
meaning:
सजीवमीनयुक्तेन    सुरया    पूरितेन    च |
पञ्चामृतैः   सुसम्पूर्णशङ्खेन   कलसेन   वा |
अभिषेकं ततः कुर्याद्बाह्ये तत् कथितं प्रिये || 69 ||
text_mt: Equipped with a living fish and filled with liquor, / or with a conch or jar completely filled with the five nectars, / he should then perform the consecration outwardly: that has been declared, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
mīnastu lambikā devi vaktraṃ  kalasa ucyate |
pañcagavayāmṛtāpūrṇaṃ    śiṣyaṃ    tenābhiṣecayet || 70 ||
meaning:
मीनस्तु लम्बिका देवि वक्त्रं  कलस उच्यते |
पञ्चगवयामृतापूर्णं    शिष्यं    तेनाभिषेचयेत् || 70 ||
text_mt: The fish is the uvula, O Goddess, and the mouth is called the jar; / filled with the nectar of the five products of the cow, with that he should consecrate the disciple.

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ siddhābhiṣekaḥ syādācāryasyāpi pārvati |
trikālaṃ  dantakāṣṭhañca  puṣpāñjalirapi  priye || 71 ||
meaning:
अयं सिद्धाभिषेकः स्यादाचार्यस्यापि पार्वति |
त्रिकालं  दन्तकाष्ठञ्च  पुष्पाञ्जलिरपि  प्रिये || 71 ||
text_mt: This is the accomplished consecration, also for the master, O Pārvatī; / three times a day, the tooth-cleaning stick and the offering of a handful of flowers, O beloved;

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhe   vedakalānyāsastajjñānañcāṣṭadhā  bhavet |
samayo dantakāṣṭhena  sādhakaḥ  kusumāñjaliḥ || 72 ||
meaning:
शङ्खे   वेदकलान्यासस्तज्ज्ञानञ्चाष्टधा  भवेत् |
समयो दन्तकाष्ठेन  साधकः  कुसुमाञ्जलिः || 72 ||
text_mt: placement of the four ontological energies on the conch and the knowledge of it is eightfold; / the probationary disciple is by means of the tooth-cleaning stick, the practitioner is by the offering of a handful of flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
putraṃ   śaṅkhābhiṣekeṇa   bodhako   vedhasaṃjñayā |
pūrṇābhiṣekeṇācāryaḥ pañcāvasthāḥ prakīttītāḥ || 73 ||
meaning:
पुत्रं   शङ्खाभिषेकेण   बोधको   वेधसंज्ञया |
पूर्णाभिषेकेणाचार्यः पञ्चावस्थाः प्रकीत्तीताः || 73 ||
text_mt:
[One is made] a spiritual son by consecration with the conch, an instructor by the piercing [initiation],
[and] a master by the complete consecration: [thus] the five stages are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
kulācāraikaniratā     gurubhaktā    dṛḍhavratāḥ |
pūrṇābhiṣekapūtā  ye  te   muktāśceha  janmani || 74 ||
meaning:
कुलाचारैकनिरता     गुरुभक्ता    दृढव्रताः |
पूर्णाभिषेकपूता  ये  ते   मुक्ताश्चेह  जन्मनि || 74 ||
text_mt:
Wholly devoted to the conduct of Kula, devoted to the guru, steadfast in their vows,
those who are purified by the complete consecration are liberated in this very life.

And those purified by the complete consecration who have died, O leader of the Kula,
having obtained another noble birth, by a guru in the form of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇābhiṣekapūtā   ye   mṛtāśca  kulanāyike |
punarlabdhvottamaṃ   janma  guruṇā  śivarūpiṇā || 75 ||
meaning:
पूर्णाभिषेकपूता   ये   मृताश्च  कुलनायिके |
पुनर्लब्ध्वोत्तमं   जन्म  गुरुणा  शिवरूपिणा || 75 ||

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhāḥ  pūrṇābhiṣekeṇa  śivasāyujyadāyinā |
tena  muktiṃ  vrajeyuste śāmbhavī vācamavravīt || 76 ||
meaning:
शुद्धाः  पूर्णाभिषेकेण  शिवसायुज्यदायिना |
तेन  मुक्तिं  व्रजेयुस्ते शाम्भवी वाचमव्रवीत् || 76 ||
text_mt:
purified by the complete consecration that bestows union with Śiva,
by that [very means] they attain liberation; the Śāmbhavī voice has proclaimed [this].

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇā(dīkṣā)bhiṣekahīno yaḥ kauliko mirayate yadi |
piśācatvamavāpnoti      yāvadāhūtasaṃplavam || 77 ||
meaning:
पूर्णा(दीक्षा)भिषेकहीनो यः कौलिको मिरयते यदि |
पिशाचत्वमवाप्नोति      यावदाहूतसंप्लवम् || 77 ||
text_mt:
If a Kaulika dies devoid of the complete consecration,
he obtains the state of a piśāca until the universal dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣā ca  dvividhā  proktā  bāhyābhyantarabhedataḥ |
kriyādīkṣā bhavedbāhyā vedhākhyābhyantarī matā || 78 ||
meaning:
दीक्षा च  द्विविधा  प्रोक्ता  बाह्याभ्यन्तरभेदतः |
क्रियादीक्षा भवेद्बाह्या वेधाख्याभ्यन्तरी मता || 78 ||
text_mt:
Initiation is declared to be of two kinds according to the distinction of outer and inner:
the initiation through ritual action is the outer, while that named "piercing" is considered inner.

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥ śuddhirbahiḥ śuddhidvīvidhā parikīttītā |
antarā ca kriyāśuddhirbahiḥ śuddhiśca dīkṣayā || 79 ||
meaning:
अन्तः शुद्धिर्बहिः शुद्धिद्वीविधा परिकीत्तीता |
अन्तरा च क्रियाशुद्धिर्बहिः शुद्धिश्च दीक्षया || 79 ||
text_mt:
Inner purification and outer purification: twofold is it proclaimed.
Inner [purification comes] by purification through ritual, and outer purification by initiation.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣayā   mokṣadīpena  caṇḍālo'pi  vimucyate |
ābhyāṃ vinā kuleśāni kauliko naiva mucyate || 80 ||
meaning:
दीक्षया   मोक्षदीपेन  चण्डालोऽपि  विमुच्यते |
आभ्यां विना कुलेशानि कौलिको नैव मुच्यते || 80 ||
text_mt:
Even an outcaste is liberated by initiation, which is the lamp of liberation;
without these two, O Mistress of Kula, a Kaulika is never liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīrasya na saṃskāro jāyate na ca karmaṇaḥ |
ātmanaḥ  kārayeddīkṣāmanādikulakuṇḍalīm || 81 ||
meaning:
शरीरस्य न संस्कारो जायते न च कर्मणः |
आत्मनः  कारयेद्दीक्षामनादिकुलकुण्डलीम् || 81 ||
text_mt:
No consecration occurs of the body, nor of action;
one should have initiation performed for the self, which is the beginningless Kuṇḍalī of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣā hyetāḥ karmasāmye bhinnārthapratipādikāḥ |
abhisandhānato  devi   deśikottamaśiṣyayoḥ || 82 ||
meaning:
दीक्षा ह्येताः कर्मसाम्ये भिन्नार्थप्रतिपादिकाः |
अभिसन्धानतो  देवि   देशिकोत्तमशिष्ययोः || 82 ||
text_mt:
For these initiations, when actions are balanced, convey distinct purposes
through the intentional conjunction of the best of gurus and the disciple, O Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrauṣadheryathā    hanyādviṣaśaktiṃ    kuleśvari |
paśupāśaṃ tathā chindyāddīkṣayā mantravit kṣaṇāt || 83 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रौषधेर्यथा    हन्याद्विषशक्तिं    कुलेश्वरि |
पशुपाशं तथा छिन्द्याद्दीक्षया मन्त्रवित् क्षणात् || 83 ||
text_mt:
Just as one destroys the power of poison through mantra and medicine, O Mistress of Kula,
so the knower of mantra in an instant severs the fetter of the uninitiated bound soul through initiation.

sanskrit_iast:
asmāt pravitatādvandhāt parasaṃsthānabodhakāt |
dīkṣaiva mokṣayet  pūrvaṃ  divyaṃ  dhāma nayatyapi || 84 ||
meaning:
अस्मात् प्रवितताद्वन्धात् परसंस्थानबोधकात् |
दीक्षैव मोक्षयेत्  पूर्वं  दिव्यं  धाम नयत्यपि || 84 ||
text_mt:
From this extended dualism that brings awareness of the supreme abode,
initiation alone first liberates and also leads to the divine dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
upapātakalakṣāṇi     mahāpātakakoṭiśaḥ |
kṣaṇāddahati deveśi dīkṣā hi vidhinā kṛtā || 85 ||
meaning:
उपपातकलक्षाणि     महापातककोटिशः |
क्षणाद्दहति देवेशि दीक्षा हि विधिना कृता || 85 ||
text_mt:
Hundreds of thousands of secondary sins, crores of great sins,
initiation performed according to rule burns away in an instant, O Ruler of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yayā conmīlitātmāno bhavanti paśavaḥ śivāḥ |
sā  dīkṣā  hyuditā  devi paśupāśavimocikā || 86 ||
meaning:
यया चोन्मीलितात्मानो भवन्ति पशवः शिवाः |
सा  दीक्षा  ह्युदिता  देवि पशुपाशविमोचिका || 86 ||
text_mt:
Through which uninitiated bound souls, their true nature awakened, become Śivas—
that indeed is declared to be initiation, O Goddess, which frees from the fetter of the bound soul.

sanskrit_iast:
yayā   dīkṣitamātreṇa  jāyante  pratyayāḥ  priye |
sā dīkṣā mokṣadā jñeyā śeṣāstu janasevikāḥ || 87 ||
meaning:
यया   दीक्षितमात्रेण  जायन्ते  प्रत्ययाः  प्रिये |
सा दीक्षा मोक्षदा ज्ञेया शेषास्तु जनसेविकाः || 87 ||
text_mt:
That through which, as soon as one is initiated, direct convictions arise, O beloved,
is to be known as the initiation that grants liberation; the rest merely serve people.

sanskrit_iast:
upāsanāśatenāpi  yāṃ  vinā  naiva  sidhyati |
tāṃ dīkṣāmāśrayed yatnāt śrīgurormantrasiddhaye || 88 ||
meaning:
उपासनाशतेनापि  यां  विना  नैव  सिध्यति |
तां दीक्षामाश्रयेद् यत्नात् श्रीगुरोर्मन्त्रसिद्धये || 88 ||
text_mt:
That without which nothing is accomplished even by hundreds of acts of worship—
that initiation one should diligently resort to from the venerable guru for the accomplishment of mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
rasendreṇa  yathā  viddhamayaḥ  suvarṇatāṃ  vrajet |
dīkṣāviddhastathā hyātmā śivatvaṃ labhate priye || 89 ||
meaning:
रसेन्द्रेण  यथा  विद्धमयः  सुवर्णतां  व्रजेत् |
दीक्षाविद्धस्तथा ह्यात्मा शिवत्वं लभते प्रिये || 89 ||
text_mt:
Just as iron pierced by mercury attains the state of gold,
even so the self, pierced by initiation, obtains the state of Śiva, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāgnidagdhakarmāsau    māyāvicchinnabandhanaḥ |
gataḥ parāṃ jñānakāṣṭhāṃ nirbījastu śivo bhavet || 90 ||
meaning:
दीक्षाग्निदग्धकर्मासौ    मायाविच्छिन्नबन्धनः |
गतः परां ज्ञानकाष्ठां निर्बीजस्तु शिवो भवेत् || 90 ||
text_mt:
With his karma burnt by the fire of initiation, his bonds severed by cosmic illusion,
reaching the supreme pinnacle of knowledge, seedless, he becomes Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
gataṃ   śūdrasya  śūdratvaṃ  viprasyāpi  ca  vipratā |
dīkṣāsaṃskārasampanne   jātibhedo  na   vidyate || 91 ||
meaning:
गतं   शूद्रस्य  शूद्रत्वं  विप्रस्यापि  च  विप्रता |
दीक्षासंस्कारसम्पन्ने   जातिभेदो  न   विद्यते || 91 ||
text_mt:
Gone is the śūdra-hood of a śūdra, and gone is the brāhmaṇa-hood of a brāhmaṇa;
for one endowed with the sacrament of initiation, no distinction of caste exists.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaliṅge śilā buddhiṃ kurvan yat pāpamaśnute |
dīkṣitaścāpi pūrvatvasmṛtyā  tat pāpamāpnuyāt || 92 ||
meaning:
शिवलिङ्गे शिला बुद्धिं कुर्वन् यत् पापमश्नुते |
दीक्षितश्चापि पूर्वत्वस्मृत्या  तत् पापमाप्नुयात् || 92 ||
text_mt:
The demerit one incurs by regarding a Śivaliṅga as stone,
that same demerit the initiated person incurs by remembering his former [caste] status.

sanskrit_iast:
dārvaśmalauhamṛdratnajātiliṅgapratiṣṭhitam       |
yathocyate tathā śuddhāḥ sarvavarṇāstu dīkṣitāḥ || 93 ||
meaning:
दार्वश्मलौहमृद्रत्नजातिलिङ्गप्रतिष्ठितम्       |
यथोच्यते तथा शुद्धाः सर्ववर्णास्तु दीक्षिताः || 93 ||
text_mt:
Just as a consecrated liṅga of wood, stone, metal, clay, or jewel
is said [to be Śiva], so all the initiated, of whatever caste, are pure.

sanskrit_iast:
yena  pūjitamātreṇa  cābrahmabhuvanāntikam |
pūjitaṃ tena sarvaṃ syāddīkṣitena na saṃśayaḥ || 94 ||
meaning:
येन  पूजितमात्रेण  चाब्रह्मभुवनान्तिकम् |
पूजितं तेन सर्वं स्याद्दीक्षितेन न संशयः || 94 ||
text_mt:
By whom, as soon as he worships, everything up to the realm of Brahmā
is worshipped—everything is indeed worshipped by such an initiate, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣitasya  na  kāryaṃ  syāttapobhinīyamavrataiḥ |
na    tīrthakṣetragamanairna   ca    śarīrayantraṇaiḥ || 95 ||
meaning:
दीक्षितस्य  न  कार्यं  स्यात्तपोभिनीयमव्रतैः |
न    तीर्थक्षेत्रगमनैर्न   च    शरीरयन्त्रणैः || 95 ||
text_mt:
The initiated person has no need of austerities, restraints, or vows,
nor of visits to holy fords and sacred sites, nor of mortifications of the body.

sanskrit_iast:
adīkṣitā ye kurvanti japapūjādikāḥ kriyāḥ |
na phalanti  priye  teṣāṃ  śilāyāmuptabījavat || 96 ||
meaning:
अदीक्षिता ये कुर्वन्ति जपपूजादिकाः क्रियाः |
न फलन्ति  प्रिये  तेषां  शिलायामुप्तबीजवत् || 96 ||
text_mt:
Those who, uninitiated, perform rites such as recitation and worship—
for them these bear no fruit, O beloved, like seed sown upon a rock.

sanskrit_iast:
devi dīkṣāvihīnasya na siddhirna ca sadgatiḥ |
tasmāt  sarvaprayatnena guruṇā  dīkṣito bhavet || 97 ||
meaning:
देवि दीक्षाविहीनस्य न सिद्धिर्न च सद्गतिः |
तस्मात्  सर्वप्रयत्नेन गुरुणा  दीक्षितो भवेत् || 97 ||
text_mt:
O Goddess, for one devoid of initiation there is no accomplishment and no noble destiny;
therefore, with every effort, one should be initiated by a guru.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijo  yo  dīkṣitaḥ  paścādantyajaḥ  pūrvadīkṣitaḥ |
dvijaḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ sa jyeṣṭha iti śāstrārthanirṇayaḥ || 98 ||
meaning:
द्विजो  यो  दीक्षितः  पश्चादन्त्यजः  पूर्वदीक्षितः |
द्विजः कनिष्ठः स ज्येष्ठ इति शास्त्रार्थनिर्णयः || 98 ||
text_mt:
A twice-born who is initiated later, and an outcaste who was initiated earlier:
the twice-born is the junior, he is the senior; such is the determination of the meaning of scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
guruśaktisutānāñca yo vā syāt pūrvadīkṣitaḥ |
guruvattena  te  pūjyā  nāvamānyāḥ  kathañcana || 99 ||
meaning:
गुरुशक्तिसुतानाञ्च यो वा स्यात् पूर्वदीक्षितः |
गुरुवत्तेन  ते  पूज्या  नावमान्याः  कथञ्चन || 99 ||
text_mt:
And whoever is earlier initiated among the guru's consort and sons,
they are to be worshipped like the guru by him; they are never to be dishonoured.

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyo dīkṣitamātraśced yadi svargaṃ gato guruḥ |
ekasantānakenaiva       pūrṇasaṃskāramācaret || 100 ||
meaning:
शिष्यो दीक्षितमात्रश्चेद् यदि स्वर्गं गतो गुरुः |
एकसन्तानकेनैव       पूर्णसंस्कारमाचरेत् || 100 ||
text_mt:
If a disciple has only just been initiated and the guru goes to heaven,
he should perform the full consecration with one belonging to the same lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
darśaneṣu  ca   sarveṣu   guruṇā  jñānaśālinā |
dīkṣito yastu vidhinā sa yukto nāparaḥ priye || 101 ||
meaning:
दर्शनेषु  च   सर्वेषु   गुरुणा  ज्ञानशालिना |
दीक्षितो यस्तु विधिना स युक्तो नापरः प्रिये || 101 ||
text_mt:
And in all philosophical systems, one who is initiated according to rule
by a guru endowed with knowledge is united [with truth], none other, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
adhivāsanapūrvantu        cakrapūjāpuraḥsaram |
dīkṣayā śodhayecchiṣyamanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 102 ||
meaning:
अधिवासनपूर्वन्तु        चक्रपूजापुरःसरम् |
दीक्षया शोधयेच्छिष्यमन्यथा निष्फलं भवेत् || 102 ||
text_mt:
Preceded by preliminary purification and accompanied by worship of the cakra,
one should purify the disciple through initiation; otherwise it becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrasaṅkarajātīnāmādiśuddhivīdhīyate       |
pādodakapradānādyaiḥ kuryāt pāpavimocanam || 103 ||
meaning:
शूद्रसङ्करजातीनामादिशुद्धिवीधीयते       |
पादोदकप्रदानाद्यैः कुर्यात् पापविमोचनम् || 103 ||
text_mt:
Initial purification is prescribed for śūdras and mixed castes;
by giving water from the feet and the like, one should effect release from demerit.

sanskrit_iast:
ekābdena dvijo yogyaḥ kṣatriyo vatsaradvayāt |
vaiśyo yogyastribhirvarṣaiścatubhiḥ  śūdra eva ca || 104 ||
meaning:
एकाब्देन द्विजो योग्यः क्षत्रियो वत्सरद्वयात् |
वैश्यो योग्यस्त्रिभिर्वर्षैश्चतुभिः  शूद्र एव च || 104 ||
text_mt:
In one year a brāhmaṇa is fit; a kṣatriya after two years;
a vaiśya is fit in three years, and a śūdra in four.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhavāyāḥ sutādeśāt kanyāyāḥ piturājñayā |
nādhikāraḥ svato nāryā bhāryāyā bhartturājñayā || 105 ||
meaning:
विधवायाः सुतादेशात् कन्यायाः पितुराज्ञया |
नाधिकारः स्वतो नार्या भार्याया भर्त्तुराज्ञया || 105 ||
text_mt:
A widow [has eligibility] by command of her son; an unmarried woman by her father's command;
a woman has no independent eligibility; a wife [has eligibility] by her husband's command.

sanskrit_iast:
syādvedādhyayane śūdro nādhikārī yathā priye |
tathaivādīkṣitaścāpi nādhikārī kuleśvari || 106 ||
meaning:
स्याद्वेदाध्ययने शूद्रो नाधिकारी यथा प्रिये |
तथैवादीक्षितश्चापि नाधिकारी कुलेश्वरि || 106 ||
text_mt:
Just as a śūdra has no eligibility for Vedic recitation, O beloved,
even so an uninitiated person has no eligibility [here], O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīguruṃ gurupatnīñca tatputraṃ śakti kaulikān |
dīkṣitastoṣayeddevi      yathāvibhavavistaram || 107 ||
meaning:
श्रीगुरुं गुरुपत्नीञ्च तत्पुत्रं शक्ति कौलिकान् |
दीक्षितस्तोषयेद्देवि      यथाविभवविस्तरम् || 107 ||
text_mt:
The venerable guru, the guru's wife, his son, his consort, and the Kaulikas,
the initiate should gratify, O Goddess, according to the extent of his wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ kiñcit parīkṣā guruśiṣyayoḥ |
dīkṣābhedādikaṃ  devi  kimbhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 108 ||
meaning:
इति ते कथितं किञ्चित् परीक्षा गुरुशिष्ययोः |
दीक्षाभेदादिकं  देवि  किम्भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि || 108 ||
text_mt:
Thus has been declared to you in brief the examination of guru and disciple,
the divisions of initiation, and so forth, O Goddess. What more do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast: atha pañcadaśollāsaḥ
meaning: अथ पञ्चदशोल्लासः

sanskrit_iast:
śrī devyuvāca
kuleśa śrotumicchāmi puraścaraṇalakṣaṇam |
sthānāhārādibhedañca  vada  me  parameśvara || 1 ||
meaning:
श्री देव्युवाच
कुलेश श्रोतुमिच्छामि पुरश्चरणलक्षणम् |
स्थानाहारादिभेदञ्च  वद  मे  परमेश्वर || 1 ||
text_mt:
The glorious Goddess said:
O Lord of Kula, I wish to hear the characteristics of preliminary repetition,
and the distinctions of place, diet, and so on; tell me, O Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
tasya   śravaṇamātreṇa  mantratattvaṃ  prakāśate || 2 ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि |
तस्य   श्रवणमात्रेण  मन्त्रतत्त्वं  प्रकाशते || 2 ||
text_mt:
The Lord said:
Listen, O Goddess, I shall declare what you ask of me,
by the mere hearing of which the truth of mantra is revealed.

sanskrit_iast:
japayajñāt paro yajño nāparo'stīha kaścana |
tasmājjapena dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca sādhayet || 3 ||
meaning:
जपयज्ञात् परो यज्ञो नापरोऽस्तीह कश्चन |
तस्माज्जपेन धर्मार्थकाममोक्षांश्च साधयेत् || 3 ||
text_mt:
There is no other sacrifice higher in this world than the sacrifice of recitation;
therefore, through recitation, one should accomplish duty, wealth, desire, and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapādān  parityajya  mantrapādaṃ   samabhyaset |
apramādād bhavet siddhiḥ pramādādaśubhaṃ phalam || 4 ||
meaning:
सर्वपादान्  परित्यज्य  मन्त्रपादं   समभ्यसेत् |
अप्रमादाद् भवेत् सिद्धिः प्रमादादशुभं फलम् || 4 ||
text_mt:
Abandoning all other pursuits, one should practice the pursuit of mantra;
from vigilance arises accomplishment; from negligence, inauspicious fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
bhogāpavargasaṅkalpakalpavrataśubho   japaḥ |
japadhyānamayaṃ yogaṃ tasmāddevi samācaret || 5 ||
meaning:
भोगापवर्गसङ्कल्पकल्पव्रतशुभो   जपः |
जपध्यानमयं योगं तस्माद्देवि समाचरेत् || 5 ||
text_mt:
Recitation is auspicious, like a wish-fulfilling vow for the intention of enjoyment and liberation;
therefore, O Goddess, one should practice the yoga that consists of recitation and meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
ābrahmabījadoṣāśca      niyamātikramodbhavāḥ |
jñānājñānakṛtāḥ sarvaṃ praṇaśyanti japāt priye || 6 ||
meaning:
आब्रह्मबीजदोषाश्च      नियमातिक्रमोद्भवाः |
ज्ञानाज्ञानकृताः सर्वं प्रणश्यन्ति जपात् प्रिये || 6 ||
text_mt: Flaws stemming from the seed of Brahmā, flaws arising from transgressions of observances, / and those committed consciously or unconsciously, are all destroyed by recitation, my dear.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāre duḥkhabhūyiṣṭhe yadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥ |
pañcāṅgopāsanenaiva  mantrajāpī  vrajet  sukham || 7 ||
meaning:
संसारे दुःखभूयिष्ठे यदीच्छेत् सिद्धिमात्मनः |
पञ्चाङ्गोपासनेनैव  मन्त्रजापी  व्रजेत्  सुखम् || 7 ||
text_mt: If one desires one's own perfection in this transmigratory cycle filled with suffering, / the mantra-reciter will attain happiness only by the practice of the fivefold limb.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjā traikālikī nityaṃ japastarpaṇameva ca |
homo   brāhmaṇabhuktiśca   puraścaraṇamucyate || 8 ||
meaning:
पूजा त्रैकालिकी नित्यं जपस्तर्पणमेव च |
होमो   ब्राह्मणभुक्तिश्च   पुरश्चरणमुच्यते || 8 ||
text_mt: Regular worship performed three times a day, recitation, libation, / fire oblation, and feeding the Brāhmaṇas: this is called preliminary practice.

sanskrit_iast:
yad yadaṅgaṃ vihīyeta  tatsaṃkhyādviguṇo japaḥ |
kuryād dvitricatuḥpañca-saṃkhyāṃ vā sādhakaḥ priye || 9 ||
meaning:
यद् यदङ्गं विहीयेत  तत्संख्याद्विगुणो जपः |
कुर्याद् द्वित्रिचतुःपञ्च-संख्यां वा साधकः प्रिये || 9 ||
text_mt: Whichever limb might be omitted, twice that number of recitation / the practitioner should perform, or two, three, four, or five times that amount, my dear.

sanskrit_iast:
kurvīta cāṅgasiddhyarthaṃ tadaśaktau sa bhaktitaḥ |
taccedaṅgaṃ   vihīyeta  mantrī  neṣṭamavāpnuyāt || 10 ||
meaning:
कुर्वीत चाङ्गसिद्ध्यर्थं तदशक्तौ स भक्तितः |
तच्चेदङ्गं   विहीयेत  मन्त्री  नेष्टमवाप्नुयात् || 10 ||
text_mt: And he should perform it out of devotion for the perfection of the limbs if he is unable [to perform them directly]; / if that limb is omitted, the practitioner of mantras will not attain the desired result.

sanskrit_iast:
annaiścatuvīdhairdevi  padārthaiḥ  ṣaḍrasānvitaiḥ |
subhojiteṣu vipreṣu sarvaṃ hi saphalaṃ bhavet || 11 ||
meaning:
अन्नैश्चतुवीधैर्देवि  पदार्थैः  षड्रसान्वितैः |
सुभोजितेषु विप्रेषु सर्वं हि सफलं भवेत् || 11 ||
text_mt: When the Brāhmaṇas are well fed, O Goddess, with four kinds of food / and dishes containing the six tastes, everything indeed bears fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
samyaksiddhaikamantrasya   pañcāṅgopāsanena   ca |
sarvamantrāśca sidhyanti tvatprasādāt kuleśvari || 12 ||
meaning:
सम्यक्सिद्धैकमन्त्रस्य   पञ्चाङ्गोपासनेन   च |
सर्वमन्त्राश्च सिध्यन्ति त्वत्प्रसादात् कुलेश्वरि || 12 ||
text_mt: For one who has fully mastered a single mantra through the practice of the fivefold limb, / all mantras are also mastered by your grace, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
upadeśasya  sāmarthyāt  śrīgurośca  prasādataḥ |
mantraprabhāvādbhaktyā ca mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate || 13 ||
meaning:
उपदेशस्य  सामर्थ्यात्  श्रीगुरोश्च  प्रसादतः |
मन्त्रप्रभावाद्भक्त्या च मन्त्रसिद्धिः प्रजायते || 13 ||
text_mt: Through the efficacy of the instruction, through the grace of the venerable guru, / through the power of the mantra, and through devotion, mantra-perfection is born.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhamantrād gurorlabdho mantro yaḥ siddhibhāgbhavet |
pūrvajanmakṛtābhyāsānmantro    vā   śīghrasiddhidaḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
सिद्धमन्त्राद् गुरोर्लब्धो मन्त्रो यः सिद्धिभाग्भवेत् |
पूर्वजन्मकृताभ्यासान्मन्त्रो    वा   शीघ्रसिद्धिदः || 14 ||
text_mt: A mantra obtained from a guru who has mastered the mantra partakes in perfection; / or, a mantra may bestow quick perfection due to practice performed in a previous birth.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāpūrvaṃ      kuleśāni   pāramparyakramāgatam |
nyāyalabdhaśca yo mantraḥ sa ca siddho na saṃśayaḥ || 15 ||
meaning:
दीक्षापूर्वं      कुलेशानि   पारम्पर्यक्रमागतम् |
न्यायलब्धश्च यो मन्त्रः स च सिद्धो न संशयः || 15 ||
text_mt: Preceded by initiation, O Mistress of Kula, handed down through the lineage tradition, / and properly received: such a mantra is undoubtedly perfected.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraṃ     prajapenmantraṃ   mātṛkākṣarasaṃpuṭam |
anulomavilomena   mantrasiddhiḥ   prajāyate || 16 ||
meaning:
सहस्रं     प्रजपेन्मन्त्रं   मातृकाक्षरसंपुटम् |
अनुलोमविलोमेन   मन्त्रसिद्धिः   प्रजायते || 16 ||
text_mt: One should recite the mantra a thousand times, enclosed within the letters of the syllabary, / in direct and reverse order; mantra-perfection is thereby produced.

sanskrit_iast:
triṣaṣṭyakṣarasaṃyuktamātṛkākṣarasaṃpuṭam        |
kramotkramātsahasrantu tasya siddho bhavenmanuḥ || 17 ||
meaning:
त्रिषष्ट्यक्षरसंयुक्तमातृकाक्षरसंपुटम्        |
क्रमोत्क्रमात्सहस्रन्तु तस्य सिद्धो भवेन्मनुः || 17 ||
text_mt: Enclosed within the sixty-three letters along with the letters of the syllabary, / repeated a thousand times in regular and reverse order, his mantra becomes perfected.

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛkājapamātreṇa  mantrāṇāṃ koṭikoṭayaḥ |
jaṣitāḥ syurna sandeho yataḥ sarvaṃ tadudbhavam || 18 ||
meaning:
मातृकाजपमात्रेण  मन्त्राणां कोटिकोटयः |
जषिताः स्युर्न सन्देहो यतः सर्वं तदुद्भवम् || 18 ||
text_mt: Merely by the recitation of the syllabary, many millions of mantras / are recited, there is no doubt, since everything originates from it.

sanskrit_iast:
anekakoṭimantrāṇi  cittākulakarāṇi  ca |
mantraṃ gurukṛpāprāptamekaṃ syāt sarvasiddhidam || 19 ||
meaning:
अनेककोटिमन्त्राणि  चित्ताकुलकराणि  च |
मन्त्रं गुरुकृपाप्राप्तमेकं स्यात् सर्वसिद्धिदम् || 19 ||
text_mt: Many millions of mantras cause agitation of the mind; / a single mantra obtained through the grace of the guru bestows all perfections.

sanskrit_iast:
yadṛcchayā   śrutaṃ   mantraṃ   dṛṣṭenāpi  chalena  ca |
patre sthitaṃ vā cādhyāpya tajjapaḥ syādanarthakṛt || 20 ||
meaning:
यदृच्छया   श्रुतं   मन्त्रं   दृष्टेनापि  छलेन  च |
पत्रे स्थितं वा चाध्याप्य तज्जपः स्यादनर्थकृत् || 20 ||
text_mt: A mantra heard by chance, or acquired by sight or by deceit, / or learned from a written page: reciting it brings about misfortune.

sanskrit_iast:
pustake likhitānmantrān vilokya prajapanti ye |
brahmahatyāsamaṃ   teṣāṃ   pātakaṃ  vyādhiduḥkhadam || 21 ||
meaning:
पुस्तके लिखितान्मन्त्रान् विलोक्य प्रजपन्ति ये |
ब्रह्महत्यासमं   तेषां   पातकं  व्याधिदुःखदम् || 21 ||
text_mt: Those who recite mantras after looking at them written in a book / incur a sin equal to the slaying of a Brāhmaṇa, which brings disease and sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyakṣetraṃ   nadītīraṃ   guhā  parvatamastakam |
tīrthapradeśāḥ sindhūnāṃ  saṅgamaḥ pāvanaṃ vanam || 22 ||
meaning:
पुण्यक्षेत्रं   नदीतीरं   गुहा  पर्वतमस्तकम् |
तीर्थप्रदेशाः सिन्धूनां  सङ्गमः पावनं वनम् || 22 ||
text_mt: A sacred field, a riverbank, a cave, a mountain peak, / pilgrimage sites, the confluence of rivers, a purifying forest,

sanskrit_iast:
udyānāni viviktāni vilvamūlaṃ taṭaṃ gireḥ |
devatāyatanaṃ  kūlaṃ  samudrasya  nijaṃ  gṛham || 23 ||
meaning:
उद्यानानि विविक्तानि विल्वमूलं तटं गिरेः |
देवतायतनं  कूलं  समुद्रस्य  निजं  गृहम् || 23 ||
text_mt: secluded gardens, the foot of a bilva tree, the slope of a mountain, / an abode of a deity, the seashore, one's own home:

sanskrit_iast:
sādhaneṣu praśastāni sthānānyetāni mantriṇām |
athavā   nivasettatra   yatra  cittaṃ  prasīdati || 24 ||
meaning:
साधनेषु प्रशस्तानि स्थानान्येतानि मन्त्रिणाम् |
अथवा   निवसेत्तत्र   यत्र  चित्तं  प्रसीदति || 24 ||
text_mt: these are praised as suitable places for the practitioners of mantras in their spiritual practices; / or one should reside wherever the mind becomes serene.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryasyāgnergurorindordīpasya ca  jalasya ca |
goviprakulavṛkṣāṇāṃ sannidhau śasyate japaḥ || 25 ||
meaning:
सूर्यस्याग्नेर्गुरोरिन्दोर्दीपस्य च  जलस्य च |
गोविप्रकुलवृक्षाणां सन्निधौ शस्यते जपः || 25 ||
text_mt: In the presence of the sun, of fire, of the guru, of the moon, of a lamp, of water, / of cows, of Brāhmaṇas, and of Kula trees, recitation is praised.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhe śataguṇaṃ vidyād goṣṭhe lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet |
koṭirdevālaye   puṇyamanantaṃ  śivasannidhau || 26 ||
meaning:
गृहे शतगुणं विद्याद् गोष्ठे लक्षगुणं भवेत् |
कोटिर्देवालये   पुण्यमनन्तं  शिवसन्निधौ || 26 ||
text_mt: In a house it should be known as a hundredfold; in a cowpen it becomes a hundred-thousandfold; / in a temple of the gods the merit is tenfold million; in the presence of Śiva it is endless.

sanskrit_iast:
mlecchaduṣṭamṛgavyālaśaṅkātaṅkavivajītaḥ     |
ekāntapāvane   nindārahite   bhaktisaṃyute || 27 ||
meaning:
म्लेच्छदुष्टमृगव्यालशङ्कातङ्कविवजीतः     |
एकान्तपावने   निन्दारहिते   भक्तिसंयुते || 27 ||
text_mt: Free from fear and dread of barbarians, vicious beasts, and venomous serpents, / in a solitary, purifying place, free of censure, and endowed with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
svadeśe dhāmīke  deśe  subhikṣe  nirupadrave |
rājabhaktajanasthāne      nivasettāpasāśraye || 28 ||
meaning:
स्वदेशे धामीके  देशे  सुभिक्षे  निरुपद्रवे |
राजभक्तजनस्थाने      निवसेत्तापसाश्रये || 28 ||
text_mt: in one's own country, in a righteous land, where food is plentiful, undisturbed by calamity, / in an area populated by persons loyal to the king, in a hermitage of ascetics, one should reside.

sanskrit_iast:
rājānaḥ sacivā rājñāṃ puruṣāḥ prabhavo janāḥ |
caranti  yena  mārgeṇa na  vasettatra  mantravit || 29 ||
meaning:
राजानः सचिवा राज्ञां पुरुषाः प्रभवो जनाः |
चरन्ति  येन  मार्गेण न  वसेत्तत्र  मन्त्रवित् || 29 ||
text_mt: Along the route traversed by kings, royal ministers, / royal officers, and powerful people, the knower of mantras should not dwell.

sanskrit_iast:
jīrṇadevālayodyānagṛhavṛkṣataleṣu        ca |
nadītaḍāgakūpeṣu  bhūcchidrādiṣu  no  vaset || 30 ||
meaning:
जीर्णदेवालयोद्यानगृहवृक्षतलेषु        च |
नदीतडागकूपेषु  भूच्छिद्रादिषु  नो  वसेत् || 30 ||
text_mt: In a dilapidated temple, an old garden, at the base of trees in an abandoned house, / at rivers, reservoirs, and wells, and in fissures of the earth, one should not dwell.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpanāthamayaṣṭvā  yo  japapūjādikaṃ  caret |
tatphalaṃ gṛhyate tena tasyāyāsaḥ  phalaṃ bhavet || 31 ||
meaning:
दीपनाथमयष्ट्वा  यो  जपपूजादिकं  चरेत् |
तत्फलं गृह्यते तेन तस्यायासः  फलं भवेत् || 31 ||
text_mt: Whoever undertakes recitation, worship, and the like without having worshipped Dīpanātha, / the fruit thereof is seized by him, and his only fruit will be exhaustion.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃśāśmadharaṇīdārutṛṇapallavanimītam      |
varjayedāsanaṃ dhīmān dāridryavyādhiduḥkhadam || 32 ||
meaning:
वंशाश्मधरणीदारुतृणपल्लवनिमीतम्      |
वर्जयेदासनं धीमान् दारिद्र्यव्याधिदुःखदम् || 32 ||
text_mt: A seat made of bamboo, stone, the bare earth, wood, grass, or sprouts, / the wise person should avoid, as it brings poverty, illness, and sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
tūlakambalavastrāṇāṃ   siṃhavyāghramṛgājinam |
kalpayedāsanaṃ dhīmān saubhāgyajñānavṛddhidam || 33 ||
meaning:
तूलकम्बलवस्त्राणां   सिंहव्याघ्रमृगाजिनम् |
कल्पयेदासनं धीमान् सौभाग्यज्ञानवृद्धिदम् || 33 ||
text_mt: A seat fashioned of cotton, woollen blanket, cloth, / or the hide of a lion, tiger, or deer, the wise person should prepare, as it increases good fortune and knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
padmasvastikavīrādiṣvāsaneṣūpaviśya     ca |
japārccanādikaṃ kuryādanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 34 ||
meaning:
पद्मस्वस्तिकवीरादिष्वासनेषूपविश्य     च |
जपार्च्चनादिकं कुर्यादन्यथा निष्फलं भवेत् || 34 ||
text_mt: Having seated oneself in the lotus, auspicious, hero, or other postures, / one should perform recitation, worship, and other rites; otherwise it will be fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāvarttayan  buddhyā  praṇavantu  trimātrakam |
muñcet piṅgalayā vāyumantaḥsthaṃ recako bhavet || 35 ||
meaning:
द्वादशावर्त्तयन्  बुद्ध्या  प्रणवन्तु  त्रिमात्रकम् |
मुञ्चेत् पिङ्गलया वायुमन्तःस्थं रेचको भवेत् || 35 ||
text_mt: Recalling the Praṇava with three morae twelve times with the intellect, / one should expel the air residing within through the piṅgalā; this is the exhalation.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśāvarttayan tāraṃ  pūrayed  bāhyamārutam |
śanakairiḍayā baddhvā pūrakaṃ parikīttītam || 36 ||
meaning:
षोडशावर्त्तयन् तारं  पूरयेद्  बाह्यमारुतम् |
शनकैरिडया बद्ध्वा पूरकं परिकीत्तीतम् || 36 ||
text_mt: Repeating the tāra sixteen times, one should draw in the external wind / slowly through the iḍā, holding it; this is declared to be the inhalation.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāvarttayan tāraṃ vāyuṃ madhye ca kumbhayet |
śoṣayedvāyubījena        dehaśoṣaṇamīritam || 37 ||
meaning:
द्वादशावर्त्तयन् तारं वायुं मध्ये च कुम्भयेत् |
शोषयेद्वायुबीजेन        देहशोषणमीरितम् || 37 ||
text_mt: Repeating the tāra twelve times, one should retain the breath within / and desiccate [the body] with the wind seed-syllable; this is declared as the desiccation of the body.

sanskrit_iast:
punaśca   pūrvavadvāyuṃ   virecyāpūrya  kumbhayet |
dahet      dahanabījena     dehadāhanamīritam || 38 ||
meaning:
पुनश्च   पूर्ववद्वायुं   विरेच्यापूर्य  कुम्भयेत् |
दहेत्      दहनबीजेन     देहदाहनमीरितम् || 38 ||
text_mt: Again, having exhaled, inhaled, and retained the breath as before, / one should burn [the body] with the fire seed-syllable; this is declared as the incineration of the body.

sanskrit_iast:
punaśca  pūrvavadvāyuṃ   virecyāpūrya   kumbhayet |
śivakuṇḍalinīyogasyandanāmṛtadhārayā       |
āpādamastakaṃ devi plāvayet plāvanaṃ bhavet || 39 ||
meaning:
पुनश्च  पूर्ववद्वायुं   विरेच्यापूर्य   कुम्भयेत् |
शिवकुण्डलिनीयोगस्यन्दनामृतधारया       |
आपादमस्तकं देवि प्लावयेत् प्लावनं भवेत् || 39 ||
text_mt: Again, having exhaled, inhaled, and retained the breath as before, / with the flowing stream of nectar from the union of Śiva and Kuṇḍalinī, / one should flood [the body] from foot to head, O Goddess; this is the flooding.

sanskrit_iast:
japadhyānaṃ   vinā'garbhaḥ  sagarbhastadviparyayāt |
agarbhād garbhasaṃyuktaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ śatādhikaḥ || 40 ||
meaning:
जपध्यानं   विनाऽगर्भः  सगर्भस्तद्विपर्ययात् |
अगर्भाद् गर्भसंयुक्तः प्राणायामः शताधिकः || 40 ||
text_mt: Without recitation and meditation, it is 'without seed'; with them, it is 'with seed' by reverse definition; / breath control endowed with seed is a hundred times superior to that without seed.

sanskrit_iast:
tapāṃsi    tīrthayātrādyā    makhadānavratādayaḥ |
prāṇāyāmasya tasyaite kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 41 ||
meaning:
तपांसि    तीर्थयात्राद्या    मखदानव्रतादयः |
प्राणायामस्य तस्यैते कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् || 41 ||
text_mt: Austerities, pilgrimages and the like, sacrifices, gifts, vows, and such / are not worth a sixteenth part of that breath control.

sanskrit_iast:
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ pāpaṃ kāyikaṃ vāpi yat kṛtam |
tat  sarvaṃ   nirddahecchīghraṃ  prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ   śive || 42 ||
meaning:
मानसं वाचिकं पापं कायिकं वापि यत् कृतम् |
तत्  सर्वं   निर्द्दहेच्छीघ्रं  प्राणायामत्रयं   शिवे || 42 ||
text_mt: Whatever sin has been committed through mind, speech, or body, / all of that three breath controls consume completely and swiftly, O Auspicious One.

sanskrit_iast:
dahyate  dhmāryamānānāṃ  dhātūnāñca  yathā malam |
tathendriyāṇāṃ dahyante doṣāḥ prāṇasya saṃyamāt || 43 ||
meaning:
दह्यते  ध्मार्यमानानां  धातूनाञ्च  यथा मलम् |
तथेन्द्रियाणां दह्यन्ते दोषाः प्राणस्य संयमात् || 43 ||
text_mt: Just as the impurity of base metals is burned away when they are smelted, / even so the faults of the senses are burned away by the restraint of the breath.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmaivīśuddhātmā yad yat karma karoti hi |
tattat   phalatyasandehastvaprayatnena   vā  kṛtam || 44 ||
meaning:
प्राणायामैवीशुद्धात्मा यद् यत् कर्म करोति हि |
तत्तत्   फलत्यसन्देहस्त्वप्रयत्नेन   वा  कृतम् || 44 ||
text_mt: Whatever action one whose self is purified by breath control performs, / that indeed bears fruit without doubt, even if done without effort.

sanskrit_iast:
āgamoktena mārgeṇābhyāsaṃ nityaṃ karoti yaḥ |
devatābhāvamāpnoti   mantrasiddhiḥ   prajāyate || 45 ||
meaning:
आगमोक्तेन मार्गेणाभ्यासं नित्यं करोति यः |
देवताभावमाप्नोति   मन्त्रसिद्धिः   प्रजायते || 45 ||
text_mt: Whoever regularly performs practice according to the path taught in the Āgama / attains the state of the deity, and mantra-perfection is born.

sanskrit_iast:
yo  nyāsakavacacchando  mantraṃ  japati  taṃ  priye |
vighnā dṛṣṭvā palāyante siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭavā yathā gajāḥ || 46 ||
meaning:
यो  न्यासकवचच्छन्दो  मन्त्रं  जपति  तं  प्रिये |
विघ्ना दृष्ट्वा पलायन्ते सिंहं दृष्टवा यथा गजाः || 46 ||
text_mt: When one recites the mantra with the ritual placement of syllables, armor, and meter, my dear, / obstacles flee on seeing him, just as elephants flee on seeing a lion.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtvā nyāsajālaṃ yo mūḍhātmā prajapenmanum |
vādhyate   sarvavighnaiśca   vyāghrairmṛgaśiśuryathā || 47 ||
meaning:
अकृत्वा न्यासजालं यो मूढात्मा प्रजपेन्मनुम् |
वाध्यते   सर्वविघ्नैश्च   व्याघ्रैर्मृगशिशुर्यथा || 47 ||
text_mt: A foolish soul who recites the mantra without having performed the network of ritual placements / is tormented by all obstacles, just as a fawn is by tigers.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣamālā  dvidhā  proktā  kalpitā'kalpiteti  ca |
kalpitā maṇibhiḥ kḷptā mātṛkā syādakalpitā || 48 ||
meaning:
अक्षमाला  द्विधा  प्रोक्ता  कल्पिताऽकल्पितेति  च |
कल्पिता मणिभिः कॢप्ता मातृका स्यादकल्पिता || 48 ||
text_mt: The rosary is taught to be twofold: constructed and unconstructed. / The constructed is formed of beads; the unconstructed is the alphabet.

sanskrit_iast:
ādikṣāntākṣavarṇatvādakṣamāleti    kīttītā |
anulomavilomābhyāṃ     gaṇayenmantravittamaḥ || 49 ||
meaning:
आदिक्षान्ताक्षवर्णत्वादक्षमालेति    कीत्तीता |
अनुलोमविलोमाभ्यां     गणयेन्मन्त्रवित्तमः || 49 ||
text_mt: It is called a rosary of letters because it consists of characters from 'a' to 'kṣa'. / The foremost knower of mantras should count [upon it] in direct and reverse order.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikamaṅgulībhiḥ  syādrekhābhirddaśadhā  phalam |
maṇibhiḥ   śatasāhasraṃ   māṇikyā'nantamucyate || 50 ||
meaning:
एकैकमङ्गुलीभिः  स्याद्रेखाभिर्द्दशधा  फलम् |
मणिभिः   शतसाहस्रं   माणिक्याऽनन्तमुच्यते || 50 ||
text_mt: Onefold fruit comes from the fingers, tenfold by the lines [of the hand]; / a hundred-thousandfold with beads, and with rubies it is said to be infinite.

sanskrit_iast:
triṃśadbhiḥ syāddhanaṃ puṣṭiḥ saptaviṃśatibhirbhavet |
pañcaviṃśatibhirmokṣaṃ       pañcadaśyābhicārake |
pañcāśadbhiḥ    kuleśāni  sarvasiddhirudīritā || 51 ||
meaning:
त्रिंशद्भिः स्याद्धनं पुष्टिः सप्तविंशतिभिर्भवेत् |
पञ्चविंशतिभिर्मोक्षं       पञ्चदश्याभिचारके |
पञ्चाशद्भिः    कुलेशानि  सर्वसिद्धिरुदीरिता || 51 ||
text_mt: Wealth comes from thirty, nourishment from twenty-seven; / liberation from twenty-five, in sorcery from fifteen; / with fifty [beads], O Mistress of Kula, all attainments are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhena  ca  mokṣaḥ syāttarjanī  śatrunāśinī |
madhyamāṃ dhanadāṃ vidyāt  śāntikarmaṇyanāmikā |
kaniṣṭhā stambhanyākarṣaṇyaṅgulī suprakīttītā || 52 ||
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठेन  च  मोक्षः स्यात्तर्जनी  शत्रुनाशिनी |
मध्यमां धनदां विद्यात्  शान्तिकर्मण्यनामिका |
कनिष्ठा स्तम्भन्याकर्षण्यङ्गुली सुप्रकीत्तीता || 52 ||
text_mt: Liberation comes with the thumb; the forefinger destroys enemies; / one should know the middle finger gives wealth; the ring finger is for pacification; / the little finger is well proclaimed as the digit for immobilizing and attracting.

sanskrit_iast:
etajjapiṣyāmītyādau  saṅkalpya  mantravittamaḥ |
sthirāsano japitvā'tha devyai sodakamarpayet || 53 ||
meaning:
एतज्जपिष्यामीत्यादौ  सङ्कल्प्य  मन्त्रवित्तमः |
स्थिरासनो जपित्वाऽथ देव्यै सोदकमर्पयेत् || 53 ||
text_mt: Having first resolved, 'I shall recite this,' the foremost knower of mantras, / firm in seat, having recited, should then offer [the recitation] with water to the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
uccairjapo'dhamaḥ prokta upāṃśumadhyamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
uttamo mānaso devi trividhaḥ kathito japaḥ || 54 ||
meaning:
उच्चैर्जपोऽधमः प्रोक्त उपांशुमध्यमः स्मृतः |
उत्तमो मानसो देवि त्रिविधः कथितो जपः || 54 ||
text_mt: Recitation aloud is taught to be the lowest; whispered is held to be middling; / mental is the highest, O Goddess: recitation is declared to be of three kinds.

sanskrit_iast:
atihrasvo     vyādhiheturatidīrghastapaḥkṣayaḥ |
akṣarākṣarasaṃyukto yo  mantraḥ sa na sidhyati || 55 ||
meaning:
अतिह्रस्वो     व्याधिहेतुरतिदीर्घस्तपःक्षयः |
अक्षराक्षरसंयुक्तो यो  मन्त्रः स न सिध्यति || 55 ||
text_mt: Too short causes disease; too long exhausts ascetic power; / a mantra joined syllable to syllable does not succeed.

sanskrit_iast:
manasā yaḥ smaret stotraṃ vacasā vā manuṃ japet |
ubhayaṃ niṣphalaṃ devi  bhinnabhāṇḍodakaṃ yathā || 56 ||
meaning:
मनसा यः स्मरेत् स्तोत्रं वचसा वा मनुं जपेत् |
उभयं निष्फलं देवि  भिन्नभाण्डोदकं यथा || 56 ||
text_mt: Whoever remembers a hymn in the mind or recites a mantra aloud— / both are fruitless, O Goddess, like water in a broken pot.

sanskrit_iast:
jātasūtakamādau   syāttadante   mṛtasūtakam |
sūtakadvayasaṃyukto yo mantraḥ sa na sidhyati || 57 ||
meaning:
जातसूतकमादौ   स्यात्तदन्ते   मृतसूतकम् |
सूतकद्वयसंयुक्तो यो मन्त्रः स न सिध्यति || 57 ||
text_mt: At the beginning there is birth-impurity, and at its end death-impurity; / a mantra conjoined with the two impurities does not succeed.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyantarahitaṃ   kṛtvā  mantramāvarttayeddhiyā |
sūtakadvayanirmukto yo mantraḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ || 58 ||
meaning:
आद्यन्तरहितं   कृत्वा  मन्त्रमावर्त्तयेद्धिया |
सूतकद्वयनिर्मुक्तो यो मन्त्रः सर्वसिद्धिदः || 58 ||
text_mt: Having rendered the mantra free from beginning and end, one should repeat it with the intellect; / a mantra liberated from the two impurities grants all attainments.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrārthaṃ mantracaitanyaṃ yonimudrāṃ na vetti yaḥ |
śatakoṭijapenāpi tasya siddhirna  jāyate || 59 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रार्थं मन्त्रचैतन्यं योनिमुद्रां न वेत्ति यः |
शतकोटिजपेनापि तस्य सिद्धिर्न  जायते || 59 ||
text_mt: He who does not know the meaning of the mantra, the consciousness of the mantra, and the yonimudrā, / for him no attainment arises, even with a hundred crore recitations.

sanskrit_iast:
suptabījāśca ye mantrā na dāsyanti phalaṃ priye |
mantrā caitanyasahitāḥ sarvasiddhikarāḥ smṛtāḥ || 60 ||
meaning:
सुप्तबीजाश्च ये मन्त्रा न दास्यन्ति फलं प्रिये |
मन्त्रा चैतन्यसहिताः सर्वसिद्धिकराः स्मृताः || 60 ||
text_mt: And mantras whose seed-syllables are asleep will not give fruit, my dear; / mantras endowed with consciousness are remembered as bringing about all attainments.

sanskrit_iast:
caitanyarahitā mantrāḥ proktā varṇāstu kevalam |
phalaṃ   naiva  prayacchanti  lakṣakoṭijapādapi || 61 ||
meaning:
चैतन्यरहिता मन्त्राः प्रोक्ता वर्णास्तु केवलम् |
फलं   नैव  प्रयच्छन्ति  लक्षकोटिजपादपि || 61 ||
text_mt: Mantras devoid of consciousness are declared to be mere letters; / they do not bestow fruit at all, even from a hundred thousand or crore recitations.

sanskrit_iast:
mantroccāre kṛte yādṛk svarūpaṃ prathamaṃ bhavet |
śataiḥ sahasrairlakṣairvā koṭijāpen tat phalam || 62 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रोच्चारे कृते यादृक् स्वरूपं प्रथमं भवेत् |
शतैः सहस्रैर्लक्षैर्वा कोटिजापेन् तत् फलम् || 62 ||
text_mt: Such as the initial form becomes when the mantra is uttered, / that is the fruit [obtained] by hundreds, thousands, hundreds of thousands, or a crore of recitations.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtkaṇṭhagranthibhedaśca     sarvāvayavavarddhanam |
ānandāśru ca pulako dehāveśaḥ kuleśvari |
gadgadoktiśca sahasā jāyate  nātra saṃśayaḥ || 63 ||
meaning:
हृत्कण्ठग्रन्थिभेदश्च     सर्वावयववर्द्धनम् |
आनन्दाश्रु च पुलको देहावेशः कुलेश्वरि |
गद्गदोक्तिश्च सहसा जायते  नात्र संशयः || 63 ||
text_mt: The piercing of the knots of heart and throat, the swelling of all limbs, / tears of bliss, horripilation, bodily possession, O Mistress of Kula, / and sudden faltering of speech arise—there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛduccarite'pyevaṃ    mantre   caitanyasaṃyute |
dṛśyante  pratyayā  yatra  pāramparya   taducyate || 64 ||
meaning:
सकृदुच्चरितेऽप्येवं    मन्त्रे   चैतन्यसंयुते |
दृश्यन्ते  प्रत्यया  यत्र  पारम्पर्य   तदुच्यते || 64 ||
text_mt: Even when the mantra endowed with consciousness is uttered just once, / where such signs are seen, that is called the lineage transmission.

sanskrit_iast:
ruddhaḥ kūṭākṣaro mugdho  baddhaḥ  kruddhaśca  bheditaḥ |
bālaḥ  kumāro  yuvakaḥ prauḍho  vṛddhaśca gavītaḥ || 65 ||
meaning:
रुद्धः कूटाक्षरो मुग्धो  बद्धः  क्रुद्धश्च  भेदितः |
बालः  कुमारो  युवकः प्रौढो  वृद्धश्च गवीतः || 65 ||
text_mt: Obstructed, enigmatic, deluded, bound, enraged, divided, / child, youth, young man, mature, old, arrogant,

sanskrit_iast:
stambhito rmūcchito mattaḥ kīlitaḥ khaṇḍitaḥ śaṭhaḥ |
mandaḥ parāṅmukhaśchinno  badhiro'ndhastvacetanaḥ || 66 ||
meaning:
स्तम्भितो र्मूच्छितो मत्तः कीलितः खण्डितः शठः |
मन्दः पराङ्मुखश्छिन्नो  बधिरोऽन्धस्त्वचेतनः || 66 ||
text_mt: immobilized, swooned, intoxicated, nailed, broken, deceitful, / sluggish, turned away, severed, deaf, blind, unconscious,

sanskrit_iast:
kiṅkaraḥ kṣudhitaḥ stabdhaḥ sthānabhraṣṭañca pīḍitaḥ |
niḥsneho vikalo dhvasto nirjīvaḥ khaṇḍitārikaḥ || 67 ||
meaning:
किङ्करः क्षुधितः स्तब्धः स्थानभ्रष्टञ्च पीडितः |
निःस्नेहो विकलो ध्वस्तो निर्जीवः खण्डितारिकः || 67 ||
text_mt: servant, starved, stiffened, fallen from its place, afflicted, / lacking affection, impaired, destroyed, lifeless, having its enemy broken,

sanskrit_iast:
suptastiraskṛto   nīco   malinaśca  durāsadaḥ |
niḥsattvo   nijīto  dagdhacapalaśca  bhayaṅkaraḥ || 68 ||
meaning:
सुप्तस्तिरस्कृतो   नीचो   मलिनश्च  दुरासदः |
निःसत्त्वो   निजीतो  दग्धचपलश्च  भयङ्करः || 68 ||
text_mt: sleeping, rejected, base, dirty, unapproachable, / devoid of vital essence, conquered, burnt, fickle, terrifying,

sanskrit_iast:
nistriṃśo ninditaḥ krūraḥ phalahīno nikṛntanaḥ |
nirvīryo bhramito śapta rugṇaḥ kaṣṭo'ṅgahīnakaḥ |
jaḍo ripurudāsīno  lajjito  mohito'lasaḥ || 69 ||
meaning:
निस्त्रिंशो निन्दितः क्रूरः फलहीनो निकृन्तनः |
निर्वीर्यो भ्रमितो शप्त रुग्णः कष्टोऽङ्गहीनकः |
जडो रिपुरुदासीनो  लज्जितो  मोहितोऽलसः || 69 ||
text_mt: pitiless, reviled, cruel, fruitless, cutting down, / lacking vigor, wandering, cursed, diseased, distressed, missing parts, / dull, inimical, indifferent, ashamed, bewildered, lazy—

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭyetān mantradoṣāṃśca yo'jñātvā prajapenmanum |
siddhirna   jāyate   tasya  lakṣakoṭijapādapi || 70 ||
meaning:
षष्ट्येतान् मन्त्रदोषांश्च योऽज्ञात्वा प्रजपेन्मनुम् |
सिद्धिर्न   जायते   तस्य  लक्षकोटिजपादपि || 70 ||
text_mt: whoever recites a mantra without knowing these sixty defects of mantras, / for him no attainment arises, even from a hundred thousand or crore recitations.

sanskrit_iast:
kathyante  daśa  saṃskārā  mantradoṣaharāḥ  priye |
jananaṃ   jīvanaṃ   paścāttāḍanaṃ   bodhanaṃ   tataḥ || 71 ||
meaning:
कथ्यन्ते  दश  संस्कारा  मन्त्रदोषहराः  प्रिये |
जननं   जीवनं   पश्चात्ताडनं   बोधनं   ततः || 71 ||
text_mt: The ten purifications that remove the defects of mantras are told, my dear: / generation, enlivening, then striking, then awakening,

sanskrit_iast:
abhiṣeko'tha   vimalīkaraṇāpyāyane   tathā |
tarpaṇaṃ dīpanaṃ  guptiḥ  saṃskārāḥ kulanāyike || 72 ||
meaning:
अभिषेकोऽथ   विमलीकरणाप्यायने   तथा |
तर्पणं दीपनं  गुप्तिः  संस्काराः कुलनायिके || 72 ||
text_mt: consecration, then purification, and replenishment, / propitiation, kindling, and concealment are the purifications, O Queen of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
śāṇolloḍhāni śastrāṇi yathā syunīśitāni vai |
mantrāśca   sphūttīmāyānti  saṃskārairddaśabhistathā || 73 ||
meaning:
शाणोल्लोढानि शस्त्राणि यथा स्युनीशितानि वै |
मन्त्राश्च   स्फूत्तीमायान्ति  संस्कारैर्द्दशभिस्तथा || 73 ||
text_mt: Just as weapons ground upon a whetstone become truly sharp, / so mantras attain manifestation through the ten purifications.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyaṃ haviṣyaṃ śākādi vihitāni phalānyapi |
mūlaṃ śaktu yavānāñca śastānyetāni mantriṇām || 74 ||
meaning:
भक्ष्यं हविष्यं शाकादि विहितानि फलान्यपि |
मूलं शक्तु यवानाञ्च शस्तान्येतानि मन्त्रिणाम् || 74 ||
text_mt: Eatable food is sacrificial offering, vegetables and the like, and permitted fruits; / roots, barley groats—these are commended for practitioners of mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyānnapānapuṣṭāṅgaḥ   kurute   dharmasañcayam |
annadātuḥ phalaṃ cārddhaṃ karttuścārddhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 75 ||
meaning:
यस्यान्नपानपुष्टाङ्गः   कुरुते   धर्मसञ्चयम् |
अन्नदातुः फलं चार्द्धं कर्त्तुश्चार्द्धं न संशयः || 75 ||
text_mt: By whose food and drink one's body is nourished while accumulating virtue, / half the fruit belongs to the giver of food, and half to the performer; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena parānnaṃ varjayet sudhīḥ |
puraścaraṇakāle  ca kāmyakarmasvapīśvari || 76 ||
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन परान्नं वर्जयेत् सुधीः |
पुरश्चरणकाले  च काम्यकर्मस्वपीश्वरि || 76 ||
text_mt: Therefore, with every effort the wise should avoid another's food / at the time of preparatory rites, and even in desire-prompted rites, O Sovereign Lady.

sanskrit_iast:
jihvā  dagdhā  parānnena  karau  dagdhau  pratigrahāt |
mano dagdhaṃ parastrībhiḥ kāryasiddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 77 ||
meaning:
जिह्वा  दग्धा  परान्नेन  करौ  दग्धौ  प्रतिग्रहात् |
मनो दग्धं परस्त्रीभिः कार्यसिद्धिः कथं भवेत् || 77 ||
text_mt: The tongue burnt by another's food, the hands burnt by receiving gifts, / the mind burnt by others' women—how could accomplishment of the goal occur?

sanskrit_iast:
indrāgnirudragrahadṛgvedārkadikṣaḍaṣṭasu           |
ṣoḍaśamanubāṇābdhitithitrayodaśasvapi         || 78 ||
meaning:
इन्द्राग्निरुद्रग्रहदृग्वेदार्कदिक्षडष्टसु           |
षोडशमनुबाणाब्धितिथित्रयोदशस्वपि         || 78 ||
text_mt: In [the cells corresponding to] Indra, fire, Rudra, planets, eyes, Vedas, the sun, directions, six, eight, / sixteen, Manu, arrows, oceans, lunar days, and thirteen,

sanskrit_iast:
likhet ṣoḍaśakoṣṭheṣu mātṛkārṇān vicakṣaṇaḥ |
svanāmādyakṣarād       yāvanmantrādyakṣaradarśanam || 79 ||
meaning:
लिखेत् षोडशकोष्ठेषु मातृकार्णान् विचक्षणः |
स्वनामाद्यक्षराद्       यावन्मन्त्राद्यक्षरदर्शनम् || 79 ||
text_mt: the discerning one should write the letters of the alphabet in sixteen compartments, / starting from the first letter of his own name until seeing the first letter of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhādīn kalpayenmantrī kuryāt sādhyādibhiḥ punaḥ |
catuścatuvībhāgena   siddhādīn  gaṇayet  punaḥ || 80 ||
meaning:
सिद्धादीन् कल्पयेन्मन्त्री कुर्यात् साध्यादिभिः पुनः |
चतुश्चतुवीभागेन   सिद्धादीन्  गणयेत्  पुनः || 80 ||
text_mt: The mantrin should establish the attained and the rest, and again through the attainable and the rest; / dividing by four and four, he should count the attained and the rest again.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhasiddho japāt siddho dviguṇāt siddhasādhyakaḥ |
siddhasusiddho'rddhajapāt   siddhārirhanti  bāndhavān || 81 ||
meaning:
सिद्धसिद्धो जपात् सिद्धो द्विगुणात् सिद्धसाध्यकः |
सिद्धसुसिद्धोऽर्द्धजपात्   सिद्धारिर्हन्ति  बान्धवान् || 81 ||
text_mt: The attained-attained succeeds through recitation; the attained-attainable through double [recitation]; / the attained-perfectly-attained through half the recitation; the attained-enemy slays relatives.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhyasiddho'tisaṃkleśāt sādhyasādhyo nirarthakaḥ |
sādhyasusiddho  bhajanāt  sādhyārihanti  gotrajān || 82 ||
meaning:
साध्यसिद्धोऽतिसंक्लेशात् साध्यसाध्यो निरर्थकः |
साध्यसुसिद्धो  भजनात्  साध्यारिहन्ति  गोत्रजान् || 82 ||
text_mt: The attainable-attained [succeeds] through great torment; the attainable-attainable is useless; / the attainable-perfectly-attained [succeeds] through devotion; the attainable-enemy slays kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
susiddhasiddho'rddhajapāttatsādhyastu yathoktataḥ |
tatsusiddho grahādeva  susiddhāriḥ svagotrahā || 83 ||
meaning:
सुसिद्धसिद्धोऽर्द्धजपात्तत्साध्यस्तु यथोक्ततः |
तत्सुसिद्धो ग्रहादेव  सुसिद्धारिः स्वगोत्रहा || 83 ||
text_mt: The perfectly-attained-attained [succeeds] through half the recitation; its attainable according to what is stated; / its perfectly-attained through mere reception; the perfectly-attained-enemy slays his own clan.

sanskrit_iast:
arisiddhaḥ  sutaṃ  hanyādarisādhyastu  yoṣitam |
tatsusiddhaḥ kulaṃ hanti svātmānaṃ hanti tadripuḥ || 84 ||
meaning:
अरिसिद्धः  सुतं  हन्यादरिसाध्यस्तु  योषितम् |
तत्सुसिद्धः कुलं हन्ति स्वात्मानं हन्ति तद्रिपुः || 84 ||
text_mt: The enemy-attained slays a son; the enemy-attainable slays a wife; / its perfectly-attained slays the family; its enemy slays oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhārṇā bāndhavāḥ proktāḥ sādhyāste sevakāḥ smṛtāḥ |
susiddhāḥ poṣakā jñeyāḥ śatravo ghātakāḥ smṛtāḥ || 85 ||
meaning:
सिद्धार्णा बान्धवाः प्रोक्ताः साध्यास्ते सेवकाः स्मृताः |
सुसिद्धाः पोषका ज्ञेयाः शत्रवो घातकाः स्मृताः || 85 ||
text_mt: The attained letters are declared to be friends; the attainable are remembered as servants; / the perfectly attained should be known as nourishers; enemies are remembered as destroyers.

sanskrit_iast:
bāndhavā navabārṇakāḥ syudviṣaḍdaśa sevakāḥ |
vahnirudramunayastu(poṣakā) dvādaśāṣṭakacaturastu(ghātakāḥ) |86
prāpa lobhā  paṭu  prāhyaṃ  rudrasyādriruruḥ karam |
loka lopa paṭuḥ prāyaḥ khaloghobheditāḥ priye |
varṇāḥ kramāt svarāntau  tu revatyaṃśagatau tadā || 87 ||
meaning:
बान्धवा नवबार्णकाः स्युद्विषड्दश सेवकाः |
वह्निरुद्रमुनयस्तु(पोषका) द्वादशाष्टकचतुरस्तु(घातकाः) |86
प्राप लोभा  पटु  प्राह्यं  रुद्रस्याद्रिरुरुः करम् |
लोक लोप पटुः प्रायः खलोघोभेदिताः प्रिये |
वर्णाः क्रमात् स्वरान्तौ  तु रेवत्यंशगतौ तदा || 87 ||
text_mt: Letters [numbered] nine are friends; twelve and ten are servants; / fire, Rudra, and the sages [three, eleven, and seven] are [nourishers]; twelve, eight, and four are [destroyers]. / […] / […] / letters in order; but the two vowels situated in the portion of Revatī then […].

sanskrit_iast:
janma sampad vipat kṣema pratyariḥ sādhako vadhaḥ |
mitraṃ   paramamitrañca  janmādīni   punaḥ   punaḥ || 88 ||
meaning:
जन्म सम्पद् विपत् क्षेम प्रत्यरिः साधको वधः |
मित्रं   परममित्रञ्च  जन्मादीनि   पुनः   पुनः || 88 ||
text_mt: Birth, prosperity, calamity, well-being, adversary, accomplisher, destruction, / friend, and supreme friend—[these repeat] birth and the rest, again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
vālaṃ gauraṃ  khuraṃ  śoṇaṃ  śamīśobheti  rāśiṣu |
krameṇa bheditā varṇāḥ kanyāyāṃ śādayaḥ smṛtā || 89 ||
meaning:
वालं गौरं  खुरं  शोणं  शमीशोभेति  राशिषु |
क्रमेण भेदिता वर्णाः कन्यायां शादयः स्मृता || 89 ||
text_mt: Vāla, gaura, khura, śoṇa, śamī, and śobhā among the zodiac signs— / the letters divided in succession; in Virgo, the letters beginning with śa and the rest are remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
lagno   dhanaṃ   bhrātṛbandhuputraśatrukalatrakāḥ |
maraṇaṃ  dharmakarmāya  vyayā  dvādaśa  rāśayaḥ || 90 ||
meaning:
लग्नो   धनं   भ्रातृबन्धुपुत्रशत्रुकलत्रकाः |
मरणं  धर्मकर्माय  व्यया  द्वादश  राशयः || 90 ||
text_mt: Ascendant, wealth, brothers, relatives, sons, enemies, spouses, / death, virtue, action, gain, and loss—[these are] the twelve signs.

sanskrit_iast:
svarāśermantraśaśyantaṃ gaṇanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ |
ajñāte  rāśinakṣatre  nāmādyakṣararāśitaḥ || 91 ||
meaning:
स्वराशेर्मन्त्रशश्यन्तं गणनीयं विचक्षणैः |
अज्ञाते  राशिनक्षत्रे  नामाद्यक्षरराशितः || 91 ||
text_mt: The wise must calculate from their own sign up to that of the mantra's moon. / When the sign and lunar mansion are unknown, [one calculates] from the sign of the first letter of the name.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmādyakṣaramārabhya     yāvanmantrādimākṣaram |
tridhā kṛtvā svaraibhindyāttadanyadviparītakam || 92 ||
meaning:
नामाद्यक्षरमारभ्य     यावन्मन्त्रादिमाक्षरम् |
त्रिधा कृत्वा स्वरैभिन्द्यात्तदन्यद्विपरीतकम् || 92 ||
text_mt: Starting from the first letter of the name up to the initial letter of the mantra, / dividing it into three, one should break it down with vowels; other than that, it is reversed.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvādhikamṛṇaṃ jñeyaṃ  ṛṇī cenmantravittamaḥ |
svayamṛṇī   cettanmantraṃ  japetpūrvamṛṇī  yataḥ || 93 ||
meaning:
कृत्वाधिकमृणं ज्ञेयं  ऋणी चेन्मन्त्रवित्तमः |
स्वयमृणी   चेत्तन्मन्त्रं  जपेत्पूर्वमृणी  यतः || 93 ||
text_mt: Having added them up, an excess is known as debt; if the knower of mantras is indebted, / if he is indebted himself, he should recite that mantra, because he was indebted before.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyvagnibhūjalākāśāḥ pañcāśallipayaḥ kramāt |
pañca hrasvāḥ pañca dīrghā bindvantāḥ sandhisambhavāḥ |
kādayaḥ   pañcaśaḥ   ṣakṣasahāntāśca  prakīttītāḥ || 94 ||
meaning:
वाय्वग्निभूजलाकाशाः पञ्चाशल्लिपयः क्रमात् |
पञ्च ह्रस्वाः पञ्च दीर्घा बिन्द्वन्ताः सन्धिसम्भवाः |
कादयः   पञ्चशः   षक्षसहान्ताश्च  प्रकीत्तीताः || 94 ||
text_mt: Wind, fire, earth, water, and space are the fifty letters in order: / five short, five long, ending in the bindu, born of conjunction; / and the letters beginning with ka by fives, ending in ṣa, kṣa, and sa, ha are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīsalilayomītramanilānalayorapi       |
śātravaṃ  vaiparītyena  maitraṃ  sarvatra  cāparam || 95 ||
meaning:
महीसलिलयोमीत्रमनिलानलयोरपि       |
शात्रवं  वैपरीत्येन  मैत्रं  सर्वत्र  चापरम् || 95 ||
text_mt: Earth and water are mutual friends, as are air and fire; / their enmity is in reverse, and friendship exists everywhere else.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparaviruddhānāṃ  varṇānāṃ  yatra  saṅgatiḥ |
varjayettādṛśaṃ  mantraṃ nāśakṛttat  kuleśvari || 96 ||
meaning:
परस्परविरुद्धानां  वर्णानां  यत्र  सङ्गतिः |
वर्जयेत्तादृशं  मन्त्रं नाशकृत्तत्  कुलेश्वरि || 96 ||
text_mt: Where there is a conjunction of mutually hostile letters, / one must avoid such a mantra; it brings destruction, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
ekākṣare   tathā   kūṭe  traipure  mantranāyike |
strīdatte svapnalabdhe ca siddhādīnnaiva śodhayet || 97 ||
meaning:
एकाक्षरे   तथा   कूटे  त्रैपुरे  मन्त्रनायिके |
स्त्रीदत्ते स्वप्नलब्धे च सिद्धादीन्नैव शोधयेत् || 97 ||
text_mt: For a single-syllable [mantra], for a kūṭa, for the queen of mantras belonging to Tripurā, / for one given by a woman, and for one obtained in a dream, one should never examine siddha and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrasiddhopadiṣṭeṣu   caturāmnāyajeṣu    ca |
mālāmantreṣu deveśi siddhādīnnaiva śodhayet || 98 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रसिद्धोपदिष्टेषु   चतुराम्नायजेषु    च |
मालामन्त्रेषु देवेशि सिद्धादीन्नैव शोधयेत् || 98 ||
text_mt: For those taught by one who has perfected mantras, for those born of the four sacred transmissions, / and for mālā-mantras, O Queen of the Gods, one should never examine siddha and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃhārkavarāhāṇāṃ   prāsādapraṇavasya   ca |
sapiṇḍākṣaramantrāṇāṃ siddhādīnnaiva śodhayet || 99 ||
meaning:
नृसिंहार्कवराहाणां   प्रासादप्रणवस्य   च |
सपिण्डाक्षरमन्त्राणां सिद्धादीन्नैव शोधयेत् || 99 ||
text_mt: For [the mantras] of Nṛsiṃha, the Sun, and Varāha, and of the prāsāda and the praṇava, / and for mantras composed of composite syllables, one should never examine siddha and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
mano'nyatra śivo'nyatra śaktiranyatra mārutaḥ |
na   sidhyati  varārohe  lakṣakoṭijapādapi || 100 ||
meaning:
मनोऽन्यत्र शिवोऽन्यत्र शक्तिरन्यत्र मारुतः |
न   सिध्यति  वरारोहे  लक्षकोटिजपादपि || 100 ||
text_mt: The mind elsewhere, Śiva elsewhere, Śakti elsewhere, the breath elsewhere— / perfection is not attained, O lovely woman, even from ten million recitations.

sanskrit_iast:
vādārthaṃ paṭhyate vidyā parārthaṃ kriyate japaḥ |
khyātyarthaṃ dīyate dānaṃ  kathaṃ siddhirvarānane || 101 ||
meaning:
वादार्थं पठ्यते विद्या परार्थं क्रियते जपः |
ख्यात्यर्थं दीयते दानं  कथं सिद्धिर्वरानने || 101 ||
text_mt: Knowledge is recited for the sake of debate, recitation is performed for the sake of others, / a gift is given for the sake of fame—how could there be perfection, O fair-faced one?

sanskrit_iast:
dhanārthaṃ gamyate tīrthaṃ dambhārthaṃ kriyate tapaḥ |
kāryārthe devatāpūjā kathaṃ siddhirnu jāyate || 102 ||
meaning:
धनार्थं गम्यते तीर्थं दम्भार्थं क्रियते तपः |
कार्यार्थे देवतापूजा कथं सिद्धिर्नु जायते || 102 ||
text_mt: A sacred ford is visited for the sake of wealth, asceticism is performed for the sake of hypocrisy, / worship of the deity is performed for an ulterior motive—how indeed can perfection arise?

sanskrit_iast:
amedhyena  tu   dehena  nyāsaṃ  devārcanaṃ  japam |
homaṃ kuvanti cenmūḍhāstat sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 103 ||
meaning:
अमेध्येन  तु   देहेन  न्यासं  देवार्चनं  जपम् |
होमं कुवन्ति चेन्मूढास्तत् सर्वं निष्फलं भवेत् || 103 ||
text_mt: If fools perform nyāsa, deity worship, recitation, / and fire offerings with an impure body, all of that becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
viṇmūtratyāgaśeṣādiyuktaḥ karma karoti yaḥ |
japārcanādikaṃ  sarvamapavitraṃ  bhavet   priye || 104 ||
meaning:
विण्मूत्रत्यागशेषादियुक्तः कर्म करोति यः |
जपार्चनादिकं  सर्वमपवित्रं  भवेत्   प्रिये || 104 ||
text_mt: One who performs a ritual while still bearing traces of evacuation of feces or urine— / all his recitation, worship, and other practices become impure, my dear.

sanskrit_iast:
malināmbarakeśādimukhadaurgandhasaṃyutaḥ       |
yo  japettaṃ  dahatyāśu  devatā  sujugupsitā || 105 ||
meaning:
मलिनाम्बरकेशादिमुखदौर्गन्धसंयुतः       |
यो  जपेत्तं  दहत्याशु  देवता  सुजुगुप्सिता || 105 ||
text_mt: He who recites with soiled clothes, messy hair, and bad breath— / the deity, deeply repulsed, swiftly consumes him.

sanskrit_iast:
ālasyaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ nidrāṃ kṣutaṃ niṣṭhīvanaṃ bhayam |
nīcāṅgasparśanaṃ  kopaṃ  japakāle  vivarjayet || 106 ||
meaning:
आलस्यं जृम्भणं निद्रां क्षुतं निष्ठीवनं भयम् |
नीचाङ्गस्पर्शनं  कोपं  जपकाले  विवर्जयेत् || 106 ||
text_mt: Laziness, yawning, sleep, sneezing, spitting, fear, / touching lower limbs, and anger—one must avoid these at the time of recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
atyāhāraḥ   pralāpaśca   prajalpo  niyamāgrahaḥ |
anyāsaṅgaśca laulyañca ṣaḍbhirmantro na sidhyati || 107 ||
meaning:
अत्याहारः   प्रलापश्च   प्रजल्पो  नियमाग्रहः |
अन्यासङ्गश्च लौल्यञ्च षड्भिर्मन्त्रो न सिध्यति || 107 ||
text_mt: Overeating, prattle, gossip, obstinate attachment to rules, / association with outsiders, and fickleness—through these six a mantra does not succeed.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣṇīśī kañcukī nagno muktakeśo gaṇāvṛtaḥ |
apavitrottarīyaścāśucirgacchaṃśca     no   japet || 108 ||
meaning:
उष्णीशी कञ्चुकी नग्नो मुक्तकेशो गणावृतः |
अपवित्रोत्तरीयश्चाशुचिर्गच्छंश्च     नो   जपेत् || 108 ||
text_mt: One wearing a turban, wearing a jacket, naked, with disheveled hair, surrounded by a crowd, / wearing an impure upper garment, unpurified, or walking about should not recite.

sanskrit_iast:
jāḍyaṃ duḥkhaṃ tṛṇacchedaṃ vivādaṃ vā manoratham |
bahistu   dehavāyuñca  japakāle  vivarjayet || 109 ||
meaning:
जाड्यं दुःखं तृणच्छेदं विवादं वा मनोरथम् |
बहिस्तु   देहवायुञ्च  जपकाले  विवर्जयेत् || 109 ||
text_mt: Dullness, grief, cutting grass, disputation or daydreaming, / and the outward expulsion of bodily wind—one should avoid these at the time of recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntaḥ śucimitāhāro bhūśāyī bhaktimān vaśī |
nirdvandvaḥ  sthiradhīmaunī  saṃyatātmā  japet  priye || 110 ||
meaning:
शान्तः शुचिमिताहारो भूशायी भक्तिमान् वशी |
निर्द्वन्द्वः  स्थिरधीमौनी  संयतात्मा  जपेत्  प्रिये || 110 ||
text_mt: Tranquil, pure, moderate in eating, sleeping on the ground, devoted, self-controlled, / free from dualities, steady-minded, silent, and restrained in self—[thus] one should recite, my dear.

sanskrit_iast:
