viśvāsāstikyakaruṇāśraddhāniyamaniścayaiḥ |
santoṣautsukyadharmādiguṇairyukto   japennaraḥ || 111 ||
meaning:
विश्वासास्तिक्यकरुणाश्रद्धानियमनिश्चयैः |
सन्तोषौत्सुक्यधर्मादिगुणैर्युक्तो   जपेन्नरः || 111 ||
text_mt: Endowed with faith, trust in the divine, compassion, conviction, observance, determination, / contentment, zeal, and virtues such as righteousness, a man should recite.

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhipuṣpābharaṇavastrādibhiralaṅkṛtaḥ    |
tasya hastagatā siddhirnānyasya japakoṭitaḥ || 112 ||
meaning:
सुगन्धिपुष्पाभरणवस्त्रादिभिरलङ्कृतः    |
तस्य हस्तगता सिद्धिर्नान्यस्य जपकोटितः || 112 ||
text_mt: Adorned with fragrant flowers, ornaments, garments, and the like— / perfection comes into his hand, not to another even through ten million recitations.

sanskrit_iast:
tanniṣṭhastadgataprāṇastaccittastatparāyaṇaḥ   |
tatpadārthānusandhānaṃ kurvan mantraṃ japet priye || 113 ||
meaning:
तन्निष्ठस्तद्गतप्राणस्तच्चित्तस्तत्परायणः   |
तत्पदार्थानुसन्धानं कुर्वन् मन्त्रं जपेत् प्रिये || 113 ||
text_mt: Devoted to it, his vital breath merged in it, his mind fixed on it, wholly intent upon it, / contemplating the meaning of its words, one should recite the mantra, my dear.

sanskrit_iast:
japāt śrāntaḥ punardhyāyeddhyānāt śrāntaḥ punarjapet |
japadhyānādiyuktasya kṣipraṃ mantraḥ prasidhyati || 114 ||
meaning:
जपात् श्रान्तः पुनर्ध्यायेद्ध्यानात् श्रान्तः पुनर्जपेत् |
जपध्यानादियुक्तस्य क्षिप्रं मन्त्रः प्रसिध्यति || 114 ||
text_mt: Tired from recitation, one should meditate again; tired from meditation, one should recite again; / for one joined with recitation, meditation, and the like, the mantra quickly yields perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ  kiñcit  puraścaraṇalakṣaṇam |
samāsena kuleśāni kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 115 ||
meaning:
इति ते कथितं  किञ्चित्  पुरश्चरणलक्षणम् |
समासेन कुलेशानि किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि || 115 ||
text_mt: Thus the characteristics of preparatory mastery have been briefly declared to you / in summary, O Mistress of Kula; what more do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast: atha ṣoḍaśollāsaḥ
meaning: अथ षोडशोल्लासः

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevyuvāca
kuleśa śrotumicchāmi karuṇāmṛtavāridhe |
kāmyakarmavidhānañca  vada  me parameśvara || 1 ||
meaning:
श्रीदेव्युवाच
कुलेश श्रोतुमिच्छामि करुणामृतवारिधे |
काम्यकर्मविधानञ्च  वद  मे परमेश्वर || 1 ||
text_mt: The glorious Goddess said: / O Lord of Kula, I wish to hear, O ocean of the nectar of compassion; / tell me, O Supreme Lord, the procedure for desire-prompted rituals.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
tasya  śravaṇāmātreṇa  prayoganipuṇo  bhavet || 2 ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि |
तस्य  श्रवणामात्रेण  प्रयोगनिपुणो  भवेत् || 2 ||
text_mt: The Lord said: / Listen, O Goddess, I shall declare what you ask of me, / merely by hearing which one becomes skilled in practical applications.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrī viśuddhahṛdayaḥ pūrvoktaniyamānvitaḥ |
śrīprāsādaparāmantraṃ  tattvalakṣaṃ japet priye || 3 ||
meaning:
मन्त्री विशुद्धहृदयः पूर्वोक्तनियमान्वितः |
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रं  तत्त्वलक्षं जपेत् प्रिये || 3 ||
text_mt: A practitioner of pure heart, endowed with the observances spoken of before, / should recite the supreme mantra of the glorious prāsāda twenty-four hundred thousand times, my dear.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāṃśaṃ   juhuyāddevi   saṃskṛte  havyavāhane |
daśāṃśaṃ tarpayeddugdhaiḥ salilaiḥ śālitaṇḍulaiḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
दशांशं   जुहुयाद्देवि   संस्कृते  हव्यवाहने |
दशांशं तर्पयेद्दुग्धैः सलिलैः शालितण्डुलैः || 4 ||
text_mt: He should offer a tenth part into the consecrated fire, O Goddess; / he should offer libation with milk, water, and grains of winter rice for a tenth part.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpākṣatākalpadhanavastrādibhiḥ  priye |
bhakṣyāthonyānnapānādyairhavyadravyairmanoharaiḥ    || 5 ||
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पाक्षताकल्पधनवस्त्रादिभिः  प्रिये |
भक्ष्याथोन्यान्नपानाद्यैर्हव्यद्रव्यैर्मनोहरैः    || 5 ||
text_mt: With perfumes, flowers, unbruised grains, ornaments, wealth, garments, and the like, my dear, / with delicious eatables, cooked food, drinks, and delightful sacrificial substances,

sanskrit_iast:
toṣayed yoginīcakraṃ yathāvibhavavistaram |
evaṃ       nyāsajapadhyānasahomārccanatarpaṇaḥ || 6 ||
meaning:
तोषयेद् योगिनीचक्रं यथाविभवविस्तरम् |
एवं       न्यासजपध्यानसहोमार्च्चनतर्पणः || 6 ||
text_mt: he should satisfy the circle of yoginīs according to the extent of his means. / Thus performing nyāsa, recitation, meditation, fire offerings, worship, and libation,

sanskrit_iast:
mantrī siddhimanurddevi sākṣāt paraśivo bhavet |
tataḥ svamanaso'bhīṣṭān prayogān  kulanāyike || 7 ||
meaning:
मन्त्री सिद्धिमनुर्द्देवि साक्षात् परशिवो भवेत् |
ततः स्वमनसोऽभीष्टान् प्रयोगान्  कुलनायिके || 7 ||
text_mt: the practitioner becomes one who has perfected mantras, O Goddess, becoming the Supreme Śiva in visible form. / Thereafter, for applications desired in his own mind, O Queen of Kula,

sanskrit_iast:
mantreṇānena   matimān  sādhayed   bhuktimuktaye |
siddhamantrasya sidhyanti ṣaṭ karmāṇi na saṃśayaḥ |
naiva   sidhyantyasiddhasya   devatāśāpamāpnuyāt || 8 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रेणानेन   मतिमान्  साधयेद्   भुक्तिमुक्तये |
सिद्धमन्त्रस्य सिध्यन्ति षट् कर्माणि न संशयः |
नैव   सिध्यन्त्यसिद्धस्य   देवताशापमाप्नुयात् || 8 ||
text_mt: the wise one should accomplish [his goals] through this mantra, for enjoyment and liberation. / The six rites succeed for one who has perfected mantras—there is no doubt; / they never succeed for one who has not perfected them, and he would incur the curse of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmyaprayogakarttṝṇāṃ  paraloko  na  vidyate |
prayogasiddhirevaiṣāṃ   phalamanyanna  tu   priye || 9 ||
meaning:
काम्यप्रयोगकर्त्तॄणां  परलोको  न  विद्यते |
प्रयोगसिद्धिरेवैषां   फलमन्यन्न  तु   प्रिये || 9 ||
text_mt: For those who perform desire-prompted applications, the next world does not exist; / the accomplishment of the application is their only fruit, and nothing else, my dear.

sanskrit_iast:
ekasyāpi vidhānasya na kutrāpi phaladvayam |
deveśi dṛśyate tasmānniṣkāmo devatāṃ yajet || 10 ||
meaning:
एकस्यापि विधानस्य न कुत्रापि फलद्वयम् |
देवेशि दृश्यते तस्मान्निष्कामो देवतां यजेत् || 10 ||
text_mt: Nowhere is there seen two fruits for even a single rite, / O Queen of the Gods; therefore, one should worship the deity free from desire.

sanskrit_iast:
homatarpaṇamantrādyairnyāsadhyānaviśeṣakaiḥ       |
ātmanaśca parasyāpi ṣaṭ karmāṇi samācaret || 11 ||
meaning:
होमतर्पणमन्त्राद्यैर्न्यासध्यानविशेषकैः       |
आत्मनश्च परस्यापि षट् कर्माणि समाचरेत् || 11 ||
text_mt: By means of fire offerings, libations, mantras, and the like, along with specific nyāsas and meditations, / one should carry out the six rites for oneself and for others as well.

sanskrit_iast:
prayogānte  cakrapūjāṃ   vidhinaiva   samācaret |
lakṣamekaṃ   japenmantraṃ   nyāsadhyānasamanvitaḥ || 12 ||
meaning:
प्रयोगान्ते  चक्रपूजां   विधिनैव   समाचरेत् |
लक्षमेकं   जपेन्मन्त्रं   न्यासध्यानसमन्वितः || 12 ||
text_mt: At the conclusion of the application, one should perform the worship of the cakra strictly according to rule; / one should recite the mantra one hundred thousand times, endowed with nyāsa and meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
prayogadoṣaśāntyarthamātmarakṣārthameva         ca |
na cet phalaṃ na cāpnoti devatāśāpamāpnuyāt || 13 ||
meaning:
प्रयोगदोषशान्त्यर्थमात्मरक्षार्थमेव         च |
न चेत् फलं न चाप्नोति देवताशापमाप्नुयात् || 13 ||
text_mt:
for pacifying the faults of the ritual procedure and for the protection of oneself.
If not, one obtains no fruit and incurs the curse of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
tithivārañca    nakṣatraṃ   yogamāsarttu   pakṣakam |
dīpeśaṃ kulacakrāṇi jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet || 14 ||
meaning:
तिथिवारञ्च    नक्षत्रं   योगमासर्त्तु   पक्षकम् |
दीपेशं कुलचक्राणि ज्ञात्वा कर्माणि साधयेत् || 14 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the lunar day, weekday, lunar mansion, astrological yoga, month, season, fortnight,
ruler of the lamp, and Kula wheels, one should accomplish the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiṣchandodevatāṅganyāsadhyānārccanādikam       |
bījaṃ śaktiṃ kīlakañca jñātvā mantrāṇi sādhayet || 15 ||
meaning:
ऋषिष्छन्दोदेवताङ्गन्यासध्यानार्च्चनादिकम्       |
बीजं शक्तिं कीलकञ्च ज्ञात्वा मन्त्राणि साधयेत् || 15 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the seer, metre, deity, bodily nyāsa, meditation, worship, and so on,
the seed-syllable, power, and pin, one should accomplish the mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
putrabāndhavadārāśca       rāśivarṇānukūlatā |
bhūtamaitrīṃ tathodyantaṃ jñātvā mantrāṇi sādhayet || 16 ||
meaning:
पुत्रबान्धवदाराश्च       राशिवर्णानुकूलता |
भूतमैत्रीं तथोद्यन्तं ज्ञात्वा मन्त्राणि साधयेत् || 16 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the harmony of zodiac sign and caste [with respect to] sons, kin, and wives,
the friendship of the elements, and likewise the rising sign, one should accomplish the mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
mantravidyā'bhedarūpaṃ   nidrāñca   bodharūpakam |
strīpuṃnapuṃsakādīṃśca jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet || 17 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रविद्याऽभेदरूपं   निद्राञ्च   बोधरूपकम् |
स्त्रीपुंनपुंसकादींश्च ज्ञात्वा कर्माणि साधयेत् || 17 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the identity between mantra and vidyā, the nature of sleeping and waking,
and the feminine, masculine, and neuter [types], one should accomplish the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
svaravarṇapadadvitvaṃ        viduścaitanyasūtakam |
hṛsvadīrghaplutādīṃśca jñātvā mantrāṇi sādhayet || 18 ||
meaning:
स्वरवर्णपदद्वित्वं        विदुश्चैतन्यसूतकम् |
हृस्वदीर्घप्लुतादींश्च ज्ञात्वा मन्त्राणि साधयेत् || 18 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the doubling of vowel, syllable, and word, the impurity of consciousness known to the wise,
and the short, long, and protracted [vowels], one should accomplish the mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaśuddhyāsanaprāṇāyāmanyāsākṣamālikāḥ    |
doṣasaṃskāramudrādīn jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet || 19 ||
meaning:
पञ्चशुद्ध्यासनप्राणायामन्यासाक्षमालिकाः    |
दोषसंस्कारमुद्रादीन् ज्ञात्वा कर्माणि साधयेत् || 19 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the five purifications, posture, breath control, nyāsa, rosary,
defects, corrective rites, mudrās, and so forth, one should accomplish the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaivāsanadigbandhanāḍībandhādisaṅgatim      |
devatākālamudrādi jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet || 20 ||
meaning:
तथैवासनदिग्बन्धनाडीबन्धादिसङ्गतिम्      |
देवताकालमुद्रादि ज्ञात्वा कर्माणि साधयेत् || 20 ||
text_mt:
Likewise knowing posture, binding of the directions, the alignment of the channels, and the like,
the deity, time, mudrā, and so on, one should accomplish the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhyasādhakakarmāṇi     lekhanīdravyapañcakam |
sthānaṃ yantraṃ pramāṇañca jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet || 21 ||
meaning:
साध्यसाधककर्माणि     लेखनीद्रव्यपञ्चकम् |
स्थानं यन्त्रं प्रमाणञ्च ज्ञात्वा कर्माणि साधयेत् || 21 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the target, practitioner, and rites, the five writing substances,
the location, yantra, and proper measure, one should accomplish the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
utpattivāsanāvarṇamūttīsaṃskārasaṃsthitam      |
kuṇḍadravyapramāṇādīn jñātvā homaṃ samācaret || 22 ||
meaning:
उत्पत्तिवासनावर्णमूत्तीसंस्कारसंस्थितम्      |
कुण्डद्रव्यप्रमाणादीन् ज्ञात्वा होमं समाचरेत् || 22 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the origin, inner meaning, syllable, image, and established purifications,
the fire-pit, substances, measurements, and so on, one should perform the fire sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
agniprabhāṃ   dhūmravarṇadhvanigandhaśikhākṛtīḥ |
śubhaceṣṭādikaṃ jñātvā kalpayettu śubhāśubham || 23 ||
meaning:
अग्निप्रभां   धूम्रवर्णध्वनिगन्धशिखाकृतीः |
शुभचेष्टादिकं ज्ञात्वा कल्पयेत्तु शुभाशुभम् || 23 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the radiance of the fire, the smoky color, sound, smell, and shape of the flame,
and the auspicious movements and so forth, one should discern the auspicious and inauspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
mantratattvānusandhānadehāveśādilakṣaṇam       |
mantroccāraṇabhedañca jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet || 24 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रतत्त्वानुसन्धानदेहावेशादिलक्षणम्       |
मन्त्रोच्चारणभेदञ्च ज्ञात्वा कर्माणि साधयेत् || 24 ||
text_mt:
Knowing contemplation on the ontological reality of the mantra, signs such as bodily possession,
and the varieties of mantra recitation, one should accomplish the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalaṃ kalasadravyaśuddhi gandhāṣṭakādikam |
dīkṣānāmapradānādi  jñātvā dīkṣāṃ samācaret || 25 ||
meaning:
मण्डलं कलसद्रव्यशुद्धि गन्धाष्टकादिकम् |
दीक्षानामप्रदानादि  ज्ञात्वा दीक्षां समाचरेत् || 25 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the mandala, the purification of the water-pot and substances, the eightfold scent, and so on,
and the granting of the initiation name, one should perform initiation.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ niyamaṃ nāma vāsanām |
pūjādhāraṇayantrādi jñātvā  karmāṇi sādhayet || 26 ||
meaning:
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं काम्यं नियमं नाम वासनाम् |
पूजाधारणयन्त्रादि ज्ञात्वा  कर्माणि साधयेत् || 26 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the daily, occasional, and optional rites, the vows, names, and inner meaning,
the worship, wearing [of amulets], yantras, and so forth, one should accomplish the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāgṛhapraveśādikulapūjakalakṣaṇam          |
kuladravyādiśuddhiñca  jñātvā  pūjāṃ samācaret || 27 ||
meaning:
पूजागृहप्रवेशादिकुलपूजकलक्षणम्          |
कुलद्रव्यादिशुद्धिञ्च  ज्ञात्वा  पूजां समाचरेत् || 27 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the entry into the house of worship and the characteristics of the Kula worshipper,
and the purification of the Kula substances and so forth, one should perform worship.

sanskrit_iast:
antaryāgaṃ   bahiryāgaṃ   ghaṭārghyasthāpanādikam |
pañcapuṣpāñjaliṃ devi jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet || 28 ||
meaning:
अन्तर्यागं   बहिर्यागं   घटार्घ्यस्थापनादिकम् |
पञ्चपुष्पाञ्जलिं देवि ज्ञात्वा कर्माणि साधयेत् || 28 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the internal sacrifice, the external sacrifice, the installation of the vessel and water offering,
and the offering of five handfuls of flowers, O Goddess, one should accomplish the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
pātrādhārālipiśitaṃ     kalāmudrādhvamelanam |
baṭukādibaliṃ devi jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet || 29 ||
meaning:
पात्राधारालिपिशितं     कलामुद्राध्वमेलनम् |
बटुकादिबलिं देवि ज्ञात्वा कर्माणि साधयेत् || 29 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the vessel, its base, the script, the flesh, the union of parts, mudrās, and pathways,
and the food offering to Baṭuka and the rest, O Goddess, one should accomplish the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
kulākulākhyasahajaśaktibhedañca    lakṣaṇam |
śubhalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ   strīsaṃskārārcanādikam |
devi sambhogakālañca jñātvā śaktiṃ parigrahet || 30 ||
meaning:
कुलाकुलाख्यसहजशक्तिभेदञ्च    लक्षणम् |
शुभलक्षणसंयुक्तं   स्त्रीसंस्कारार्चनादिकम् |
देवि सम्भोगकालञ्च ज्ञात्वा शक्तिं परिग्रहेत् || 30 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the distinctions and characteristics of the innate energy called Kula and Akula,
the purification and worship of the woman endowed with auspicious marks,
and the time of sexual union, O Goddess, one should receive the śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
pānabhedaṃ   phalollāsapramāṇaṃ  sthitilakṣaṇam |
tattvatrayasya svīkāraṃ jñātvā kulasudhāṃ pibet || 31 ||
meaning:
पानभेदं   फलोल्लासप्रमाणं  स्थितिलक्षणम् |
तत्त्वत्रयस्य स्वीकारं ज्ञात्वा कुलसुधां पिबेत् || 31 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the varieties of drinking, the measure of joy from the result, the marks of stability,
and the acceptance of the three realities, one should drink the nectar of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
cakrapraveśaṃ   praṇati   sthiti  nirgamanaṃ  priye |
yoginībhogaceṣṭādi jñātvā bhavati kaulikaḥ || 32 ||
meaning:
चक्रप्रवेशं   प्रणति   स्थिति  निर्गमनं  प्रिये |
योगिनीभोगचेष्टादि ज्ञात्वा भवति कौलिकः || 32 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the entry into the cakra, the bow, the dwelling, and the exit, O beloved,
and the enjoyment and activities of the yoginīs, one becomes a Kaulika.

sanskrit_iast:
ratyullāsanakālañca         kuladīpanivedanam |
śāntastavādipaṭhanaṃ jñātvā syāt kuladeśikāḥ || 33 ||
meaning:
रत्युल्लासनकालञ्च         कुलदीपनिवेदनम् |
शान्तस्तवादिपठनं ज्ञात्वा स्यात् कुलदेशिकाः || 33 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the time for the joy of love, the presentation of the Kula lamp,
and the recitation of pacifying hymns and the like, one becomes a Kula guru.

sanskrit_iast:
mithunānugrahāṣṭāṣṭapuṣpiṇīkanyakārccanām    |
viśeṣatithipūjāñca jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet || 34 ||
meaning:
मिथुनानुग्रहाष्टाष्टपुष्पिणीकन्यकार्च्चनाम्    |
विशेषतिथिपूजाञ्च ज्ञात्वा कर्माणि साधयेत् || 34 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the grace upon couples, the worship of the eight-by-eight menstruating maidens,
and the worship on special lunar days, one should accomplish the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
āmnāyabhedaṃ   saṅketaṃ  puṣpasaṅkocameva   ca |
gurutrayaṃ sampradāya jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet || 35 ||
meaning:
आम्नायभेदं   सङ्केतं  पुष्पसङ्कोचमेव   च |
गुरुत्रयं सम्प्रदाय ज्ञात्वा कर्माणि साधयेत् || 35 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the distinctions of sacred transmission, the secret convention, the contraction of the flower,
the three gurus, and the lineage, one should accomplish the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
śrautavidyākulācāraṃ   manubhedañca  pādukām |
caraṇatritayaṃ devi jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet || 36 ||
meaning:
श्रौतविद्याकुलाचारं   मनुभेदञ्च  पादुकाम् |
चरणत्रितयं देवि ज्ञात्वा कर्माणि साधयेत् || 36 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the scriptural vidyā, the conduct of Kula, the distinctions of mantras, the sandals,
and the three feet, O Goddess, one should accomplish the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
svādhikasya  samanyūnakaulikārādhanakramam |
siddhamudrādharārcādi jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet || 37 ||
meaning:
स्वाधिकस्य  समन्यूनकौलिकाराधनक्रमम् |
सिद्धमुद्राधरार्चादि ज्ञात्वा कर्माणि साधयेत् || 37 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the sequence of worship for Kaulikas superior, equal, or inferior to oneself,
and the worship of those who bear the signs of accomplishment, one should accomplish the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
gurvagnipretasaṃskāramantyeṣṭiṃ    digbalikramam |
mokṣadīpavidhānādi jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet || 38 ||
meaning:
गुर्वग्निप्रेतसंस्कारमन्त्येष्टिं    दिग्बलिक्रमम् |
मोक्षदीपविधानादि ज्ञात्वा कर्माणि साधयेत् || 38 ||
text_mt:
Knowing the purificatory rites for the guru, the fire, and the departed, the funeral rites, the bali for the directions,
and the rite of the lamp of liberation, one should accomplish the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
ityādyāḥ kathitāḥ kiñcidviśeṣāḥ kulanāyike |
sarveṣāmeva   mantrāṇāṃ   vidhiḥ  sādhāraṇakramaḥ || 39 ||
meaning:
इत्याद्याः कथिताः किञ्चिद्विशेषाः कुलनायिके |
सर्वेषामेव   मन्त्राणां   विधिः  साधारणक्रमः || 39 ||
text_mt:
These and other particulars have been stated briefly, O leader of Kula.
The rule is a common procedure for all mantras whatsoever.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrāḥ  puruṣadevāḥ  syuvīdyāḥ  strīdevatāḥ  priye |
mantrāḥ  puṃso  huṃphaḍantāḥ  prāṇe  carati  dakṣiṇe |
prabudhyante'gnijāyāntā  vidyāḥ strīdevatāḥ priye || 40 ||
meaning:
मन्त्राः  पुरुषदेवाः  स्युवीद्याः  स्त्रीदेवताः  प्रिये |
मन्त्राः  पुंसो  हुंफडन्ताः  प्राणे  चरति  दक्षिणे |
प्रबुध्यन्तेऽग्निजायान्ता  विद्याः स्त्रीदेवताः प्रिये || 40 ||
text_mt:
Mantras are male deities, and vidyās are female deities, O beloved.
Male mantras end in 'huṃ phaṭ'; when the breath flows in the right [channel],
vidyās, which are female deities, awaken, ending in the wife of fire [svāhā], O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
vāme  prāṇe  prabudhyante  namo'ntāḥ syurnapuṃsakāḥ |
nāḍīdvayagate   prāṇe  sarve  bodhaṃ  prayānti   ca || 41 ||
meaning:
वामे  प्राणे  प्रबुध्यन्ते  नमोऽन्ताः स्युर्नपुंसकाः |
नाडीद्वयगते   प्राणे  सर्वे  बोधं  प्रयान्ति   च || 41 ||
text_mt:
They awaken when the breath is in the left [channel]; neuter mantras end in 'namaḥ'.
When the breath has entered both channels, all go to wakefulness.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntike   manavaḥ  saumyā  bhūyiṣṭhendvamṛtākṣarāḥ |
svāhāntāḥ  syuvīyatprāyāścāgneyāḥ  krūrakarmasu || 42 ||
meaning:
शान्तिके   मनवः  सौम्या  भूयिष्ठेन्द्वमृताक्षराः |
स्वाहान्ताः  स्युवीयत्प्रायाश्चाग्नेयाः  क्रूरकर्मसु || 42 ||
text_mt:
In pacification rites, mantras are gentle, consisting mostly of moon and nectar syllables,
ending in 'svāhā'; in cruel rites, they are fiery, consisting mostly of wind and fire.

sanskrit_iast:
phaṭ ca puṣṭau vaṣaṭ vaśye huṃphaṭ caiva  tu māraṇe |
stambhane ca namaḥ proktaṃ svāhā śāntikapauṣṭike || 43 ||
meaning:
फट् च पुष्टौ वषट् वश्ये हुंफट् चैव  तु मारणे |
स्तम्भने च नमः प्रोक्तं स्वाहा शान्तिकपौष्टिके || 43 ||
text_mt:
'Phaṭ' is in nourishment, 'vaṣaṭ' in subjugation, 'huṃ phaṭ' in slaying,
'namaḥ' is declared in immobilization, and 'svāhā' in pacification and nourishment.

sanskrit_iast:
homatarpaṇayoḥ    svāhā   nyāsapūjanayornamaḥ |
mantrānte yojayenmantrī japakāle yathāsthitam || 44 ||
meaning:
होमतर्पणयोः    स्वाहा   न्यासपूजनयोर्नमः |
मन्त्रान्ते योजयेन्मन्त्री जपकाले यथास्थितम् || 44 ||
text_mt:
'Svāhā' is in the fire offering and libation, 'namaḥ' in nyāsa and worship;
at the end of the mantra, the mantrin should join them, [leaving the mantra] as it is at the time of repetition.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntike rājataṃ tāmraṃ  bhūrjapatrantu  vaśyake |
sarvakāryeṣu sauvarṇe krūre syāt pretakarpaṭam || 45 ||
meaning:
शान्तिके राजतं ताम्रं  भूर्जपत्रन्तु  वश्यके |
सर्वकार्येषु सौवर्णे क्रूरे स्यात् प्रेतकर्पटम् || 45 ||
text_mt:
In pacification silver [is used], copper and birch bark in subjugation,
golden [plates] in all rites, and a shroud from a corpse in cruel [rites].

sanskrit_iast:
trigandhaṃ śāntike proktaṃ pañcagandhañca vaśyake |
sarvakāryaṃṣvaṣṭagandhaṃ   krūre  cāṣṭaviṣāṇi  ca || 46 ||
meaning:
त्रिगन्धं शान्तिके प्रोक्तं पञ्चगन्धञ्च वश्यके |
सर्वकार्यंष्वष्टगन्धं   क्रूरे  चाष्टविषाणि  च || 46 ||
text_mt:
The threefold scent is prescribed in pacification, the fivefold scent in subjugation,
the eightfold scent in all rites, and the eight poisons in cruel [rites].

sanskrit_iast:
śāntake lekhanī dūrvā vaśyādau śikhipucchikā |
hemnā tu sarvakāryāṇi krūre syāt kākapucchikā || 47 ||
meaning:
शान्तके लेखनी दूर्वा वश्यादौ शिखिपुच्छिका |
हेम्ना तु सर्वकार्याणि क्रूरे स्यात् काकपुच्छिका || 47 ||
text_mt:
In pacification the pen is dūrvā grass; in subjugation and the like, a peacock feather;
gold for all rites; and in cruel [rites] it should be a crow's feather.

sanskrit_iast:
svagṛhe śāntikarmaṃ syādvaśyādyaṃ caṇḍikālaye |
sarvakāryaṃ   devagṛhe  śmaśāne  krūrakarma  ca || 48 ||
meaning:
स्वगृहे शान्तिकर्मं स्याद्वश्याद्यं चण्डिकालये |
सर्वकार्यं   देवगृहे  श्मशाने  क्रूरकर्म  च || 48 ||
text_mt:
A pacification rite should be in one's own home, subjugation and the like in a shrine of Caṇḍikā,
all rites in a temple of God, and a cruel rite in a cremation ground.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇānyevamādīni jñātvā gurumukhāt priye |
sarvakarmāṇi kurvīta  mantrī  tattatphalāptaye || 49 ||
meaning:
लक्षणान्येवमादीनि ज्ञात्वा गुरुमुखात् प्रिये |
सर्वकर्माणि कुर्वीत  मन्त्री  तत्तत्फलाप्तये || 49 ||
text_mt:
Knowing these and other characteristics from the mouth of the guru, O beloved,
the mantrin should perform all rites to attain their respective fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
mūle prāsādabījañca taruṇādityasannibham |
uttamāṅge   parābījaṃ   candrāyutasamaprabham || 50 ||
meaning:
मूले प्रासादबीजञ्च तरुणादित्यसन्निभम् |
उत्तमाङ्गे   पराबीजं   चन्द्रायुतसमप्रभम् || 50 ||
text_mt:
At the root [cakra is] the prāsāda-seed, resembling the rising sun;
at the crown of the head is the parā-seed, with radiance equal to ten thousand moons.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparajanasparśajanitānandanirbharaḥ      |
mūlādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ anavacchinnarūpibhiḥ || 51 ||
meaning:
परस्परजनस्पर्शजनितानन्दनिर्भरः      |
मूलादिब्रह्मरन्ध्रान्तं अनवच्छिन्नरूपिभिः || 51 ||
text_mt:
Full of the bliss produced by their mutual contact,
by uninterrupted streams

sanskrit_iast:
parāmṛtarasāsekaiḥ siktamāpādamastakam |
ātmānaṃ bhāvayennityaṃ sa bhavedajarāmaraḥ || 52 ||
meaning:
परामृतरसासेकैः सिक्तमापादमस्तकम् |
आत्मानं भावयेन्नित्यं स भवेदजरामरः || 52 ||
text_mt:
of the pouring essence of supreme nectar, drenched from foot to head,
one should constantly contemplate oneself; such a one becomes ageless and immortal.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvā kuleśāni sarvakarmāṇi sādhayet |
sidhyanti  tarasā devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 53 ||
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वा कुलेशानि सर्वकर्माणि साधयेत् |
सिध्यन्ति  तरसा देवि नात्र कार्या विचारणा || 53 ||
text_mt:
Meditating thus, O Mistress of Kula, one should accomplish all rites;
they succeed swiftly, O Goddess; here no doubt should be entertained.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānabhedaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvasiddhikaraṃ priye |
īpsitaṃ labhate yena pūjāhomādikaṃ vinā || 54 ||
meaning:
ध्यानभेदं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वसिद्धिकरं प्रिये |
ईप्सितं लभते येन पूजाहोमादिकं विना || 54 ||
text_mt:
I shall declare the variety of meditation that produces all supernatural powers, O beloved,
by which one obtains what is desired without worship, fire sacrifice, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāne manohare devi sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ |
sthito  mṛdvāsane dhyāyed guruvandanapūrvakam || 55 ||
meaning:
स्थाने मनोहरे देवि साधकः स्थिरमानसः |
स्थितो  मृद्वासने ध्यायेद् गुरुवन्दनपूर्वकम् || 55 ||
text_mt: In a delightful place, O Goddess, with a steady mind, / seated on a soft seat, the practitioner should meditate, having first saluted the guru,

sanskrit_iast:
mastakasthitasampūrṇacandramaṇḍalamadhyagam    |
śrīprāsādaparābījaṃ      ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyutam || 56 ||
meaning:
मस्तकस्थितसम्पूर्णचन्द्रमण्डलमध्यगम्    |
श्रीप्रासादपराबीजं      षोडशस्वरसंयुतम् || 56 ||
text_mt: On the seed-syllable of the venerable Prāsādaparā, located in the middle of the full moon-orb situated in the head, / endowed with the sixteen vowels,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhasphaṭikakarpūrakundendudhavalaṃ      priye |
saccandrabimbasañjātasudhāplāvitavigraham  || 57 ||
meaning:
शुद्धस्फटिककर्पूरकुन्देन्दुधवलं      प्रिये |
सच्चन्द्रबिम्बसञ्जातसुधाप्लावितविग्रहम्  || 57 ||
text_mt: Pure, white as crystal, camphor, the kunda flower, and the moon, O beloved, / its form flooded with nectar produced from the orb of the true moon.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ bhāvayennityaṃ niścalenāntarātmanā |
sarvāriṣṭaṃ vilīyeta śubhaśrīpuṣṭikārakam || 58 ||
meaning:
आत्मानं भावयेन्नित्यं निश्चलेनान्तरात्मना |
सर्वारिष्टं विलीयेत शुभश्रीपुष्टिकारकम् || 58 ||
text_mt: He should constantly meditate on himself with an unmoving inner self; / every misfortune dissolves, bringing auspiciousness, prosperity, and nourishment.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīprāsādaparāmantramaṣṭottarasahasrakam       |
taruṇollāsasahito maṇḍalaṃ pūjayet priye || 59 ||
meaning:
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रमष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम्       |
तरुणोल्लाससहितो मण्डलं पूजयेत् प्रिये || 59 ||
text_mt: Endowed with youthful enthusiasm, O beloved, he should worship the maṇḍala, / [reciting] the mantra of the venerable Prāsādaparā one thousand and eight times.

sanskrit_iast:
apamṛtyumahārogajarāmaraṇajaṃ      bhayam |
grahāpasmāravetālabhūtonmādādijaṃ   bhayam || 60 ||
meaning:
अपमृत्युमहारोगजरामरणजं      भयम् |
ग्रहापस्मारवेतालभूतोन्मादादिजं   भयम् || 60 ||
text_mt: The fear arising from untimely death, great diseases, old age, and death, / the fear arising from seizing spirits, epilepsy, vetālas, bhūtas, madness, and the like—

sanskrit_iast:
jitvādhivyādhirahitaḥ  putrapautrasamanvitaḥ |
jīvedvarṣaśataṃ  sāgraṃ  pūjitaḥ  sarvamānavaḥ || 61 ||
meaning:
जित्वाधिव्याधिरहितः  पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः |
जीवेद्वर्षशतं  साग्रं  पूजितः  सर्वमानवः || 61 ||
text_mt: Having conquered [these], free from mental and physical diseases, accompanied by sons and grandsons, / revered by all people, he shall live for a full hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
aśrutaṃ budhyate śāstraṃ  kavitā nirmalā bhavet |
cinmayo jāyate sākṣānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 62 ||
meaning:
अश्रुतं बुध्यते शास्त्रं  कविता निर्मला भवेत् |
चिन्मयो जायते साक्षान्नात्र कार्या विचारणा || 62 ||
text_mt: He understands scriptures he has not heard; his poetry becomes flawless; / he becomes directly composed of consciousness; there should be no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
jvaronmādādirogeṣu    japecchirasi   cintayan |
śūlavātavraṇagranthimūtrakṛcchrādisambhave         |
tattatsthāneṣu  deveśi   pūrvavaccintayan   japet || 63 ||
meaning:
ज्वरोन्मादादिरोगेषु    जपेच्छिरसि   चिन्तयन् |
शूलवातव्रणग्रन्थिमूत्रकृच्छ्रादिसम्भवे         |
तत्तत्स्थानेषु  देवेशि   पूर्ववच्चिन्तयन्   जपेत् || 63 ||
text_mt: In diseases such as fevers and madness, he should repeat [it] while meditating on the head; / when colic, wind-disorders, sores, tumors, painful urination, and the like occur, / O Ruler of the Gods, he should repeat [it] meditating on those respective places as before.

sanskrit_iast:
mahārogeṣu   jāteṣu    sarvāṅgeṣu   vicintayet |
tatkṣaṇācchāntimāyānti rogāḥ sarve na saṃśayaḥ || 64 ||
meaning:
महारोगेषु   जातेषु    सर्वाङ्गेषु   विचिन्तयेत् |
तत्क्षणाच्छान्तिमायान्ति रोगाः सर्वे न संशयः || 64 ||
text_mt: When great diseases arise, he should meditate [on it] in all limbs; / all diseases attain pacification in that very instant, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
daśendriyeṣu yo dhyāyellabhedindriyasauṣṭhavam |
yatra bījaṃ  smarettatra  tatphalaṃ bhavati dhruvam || 65 ||
meaning:
दशेन्द्रियेषु यो ध्यायेल्लभेदिन्द्रियसौष्ठवम् |
यत्र बीजं  स्मरेत्तत्र  तत्फलं भवति ध्रुवम् || 65 ||
text_mt: He who meditates in the ten sense-faculties attains excellence of the senses; / wherever he recalls the seed-syllable, there that result certainly occurs.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā   yaścintayenmūdhnī   sa  bhavedajarāmaraḥ |
sarvarogapraharaṇaṃ     vidyārogyapradaṃ     priye || 66 ||
meaning:
सदा   यश्चिन्तयेन्मूध्नी   स  भवेदजरामरः |
सर्वरोगप्रहरणं     विद्यारोग्यप्रदं     प्रिये || 66 ||
text_mt: He who constantly meditates [on it] on the crown of the head becomes free from aging and death; / it dispels all diseases and grants knowledge and health, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
asmāt parataradhyānaṃ nāsti satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
sāttvikadhyānajaṃ   devi   phalametadudīritam || 67 ||
meaning:
अस्मात् परतरध्यानं नास्ति सत्यं न संशयः |
सात्त्विकध्यानजं   देवि   फलमेतदुदीरितम् || 67 ||
text_mt: There is no meditation higher than this, truly, there is no doubt; / this result arising from sattva-natured meditation has been proclaimed, O Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntikarmāṇi sarvāṇi vidhinānena kārayet |
vidhinānena  deveśi  saubhāgyamatulaṃ   bhavet || 68 ||
meaning:
शान्तिकर्माणि सर्वाणि विधिनानेन कारयेत् |
विधिनानेन  देवेशि  सौभाग्यमतुलं   भवेत् || 68 ||
text_mt: One should perform all pacifying rites according to this rule; / by this rule, O Ruler of the Gods, incomparable good fortune arises.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśādhārapadmeṣu      dvādaśasvarasaṃyutam |
bījaṃ sañcintayed yastu sa bhavedajarāmaraḥ || 69 ||
meaning:
द्वादशाधारपद्मेषु      द्वादशस्वरसंयुतम् |
बीजं सञ्चिन्तयेद् यस्तु स भवेदजरामरः || 69 ||
text_mt: He who contemplates the seed-syllable endowed with the twelve vowels / in the twelve lotuses of the base becomes free from aging and death.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍādhāreṣu ṣaḍdīrghayuktaṃ bījaṃ vicintayet |
ṣaḍādhārasthadevībhiḥ pūjyate kulanāyike || 70 ||
meaning:
षडाधारेषु षड्दीर्घयुक्तं बीजं विचिन्तयेत् |
षडाधारस्थदेवीभिः पूज्यते कुलनायिके || 70 ||
text_mt: One should contemplate the seed-syllable endowed with the six long [vowels] in the six bases; / he is worshipped by the goddesses residing in the six bases, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtpadmakaṇīkāmadhye  sūryamaṇḍalasaṃsthitam |
parāprāsādabījantu     taruṇāruṇasannibham || 71 ||
meaning:
हृत्पद्मकणीकामध्ये  सूर्यमण्डलसंस्थितम् |
पराप्रासादबीजन्तु     तरुणारुणसन्निभम् || 71 ||
text_mt: In the center of the pericarp of the heart-lotus, located in the sun-orb, / [one should meditate on] the Parāprāsāda seed-syllable, resembling the young morning sun,

sanskrit_iast:
javābandhūkasindūrapadmarāgaprabhojjvalam    |
pañcaviśatibhiḥ sparśākṣaraiḥ saṃvītamambike || 72 ||
meaning:
जवाबन्धूकसिन्दूरपद्मरागप्रभोज्ज्वलम्    |
पञ्चविशतिभिः स्पर्शाक्षरैः संवीतमम्बिके || 72 ||
text_mt: Blazing with the radiance of the javā flower, bandhūka, vermilion, and ruby, / surrounded by the twenty-five stop-consonants, O Ambikā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatprabhāpaṭalacchāyāvyaktīkṛtajagattrayam    |
ātmānañca   smareddevi  niścalenāntarātmanā || 73 ||
meaning:
तत्प्रभापटलच्छायाव्यक्तीकृतजगत्त्रयम्    |
आत्मानञ्च   स्मरेद्देवि  निश्चलेनान्तरात्मना || 73 ||
text_mt: The three worlds made manifest by the shade of the mass of its radiance, / he should remember himself [as such], O Goddess, with an unmoving inner self.

sanskrit_iast:
parāprāsādabījantu   taruṇollāsasaṃyutaḥ |
aṣṭottarasahasrantu maṇḍalaṃ prajapet sudhīḥ || 74 ||
meaning:
पराप्रासादबीजन्तु   तरुणोल्लाससंयुतः |
अष्टोत्तरसहस्रन्तु मण्डलं प्रजपेत् सुधीः || 74 ||
text_mt: Endowed with youthful enthusiasm, the wise man should recite / the Parāprāsāda seed-syllable one thousand and eight times for one maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
devadānavagandharvasiddhakinnaraguhyakān           |
vidyādharānmunīn yakṣān  nāgānapsarasaḥ striyaḥ || 75 ||
meaning:
देवदानवगन्धर्वसिद्धकिन्नरगुह्यकान्           |
विद्याधरान्मुनीन् यक्षान्  नागानप्सरसः स्त्रियः || 75 ||
text_mt: Gods, dānavas, gandharvas, siddhas, kinnaras, guhyakas, / vidyādharas, sages, yakṣas, nāgas, celestial nymphs, women,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhavyāghroragendrādīnanyān         duṣṭamṛgānapi |
vaśyān karotyasandehaṃ  kiṃ  punarmānavādikān || 76 ||
meaning:
सिंहव्याघ्रोरगेन्द्रादीनन्यान्         दुष्टमृगानपि |
वश्यान् करोत्यसन्देहं  किं  पुनर्मानवादिकान् || 76 ||
text_mt: Lions, tigers, serpent-kings, and other wild beasts as well, / he brings under his control without doubt, not to speak of humans and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
mahadaiśvaryamāpnoti svargabhogādikaṃ priye |
yasya mūdhnī smaran japyāt sa vaśyo jāyate haṭhāt || 77 ||
meaning:
महदैश्वर्यमाप्नोति स्वर्गभोगादिकं प्रिये |
यस्य मूध्नी स्मरन् जप्यात् स वश्यो जायते हठात् || 77 ||
text_mt: He attains great sovereignty, the pleasures of heaven, and the like, O beloved; / he on whose head he recites while remembering [it] is forcibly brought under control.

sanskrit_iast:
rājasadhyānajaṃ    devi   phalametadudīritam |
vaśyakarmāṇi sarvāṇi vidhinānena kārayet || 78 ||
meaning:
राजसध्यानजं    देवि   फलमेतदुदीरितम् |
वश्यकर्माणि सर्वाणि विधिनानेन कारयेत् || 78 ||
text_mt: This result arising from rajas-natured meditation has been proclaimed, O Goddess; / one should perform all subjugation rites according to this rule.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavaśyakaraṃ     devi    sarvaiśvaryaphalapradam |
asmāt parataraṃ dhyānaṃ nāsti satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 79 ||
meaning:
सर्ववश्यकरं     देवि    सर्वैश्वर्यफलप्रदम् |
अस्मात् परतरं ध्यानं नास्ति सत्यं न संशयः || 79 ||
text_mt: It brings all under control, O Goddess, and grants the fruit of all sovereignty; / there is no meditation higher than this, truly, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
likhettrikoṇaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ aṣṭārañca mahīpuram |
mūlamantraṃ  likhenmadhye  sādhyanāmasamanvitam || 80 ||
meaning:
लिखेत्त्रिकोणं षट्कोणं अष्टारञ्च महीपुरम् |
मूलमन्त्रं  लिखेन्मध्ये  साध्यनामसमन्वितम् || 80 ||
text_mt: One should draw a triangle, a hexagon, an eight-spoked [lotus], and an earth-city; / in the center one should write the root-mantra accompanied by the name of the person to be acted upon.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni vilikhet parameśvari |
keśareṣu svarānaṣṭau  vargān  patreṣu  pārvati || 81 ||
meaning:
षट्कोणेषु षडङ्गानि विलिखेत् परमेश्वरि |
केशरेषु स्वरानष्टौ  वर्गान्  पत्रेषु  पार्वति || 81 ||
text_mt: In the six corners one should write the six limbs, O Supreme Mistress; / on the filaments, the eight vowels; and the [consonant] groups on the petals, O Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūgṛhasya  catuṣkoṇe  vilikhenmūlamambike |
pañcavarṇarajobhiśca    śubhaṃ    dṛṣṭimanoharam || 82 ||
meaning:
भूगृहस्य  चतुष्कोणे  विलिखेन्मूलमम्बिके |
पञ्चवर्णरजोभिश्च    शुभं    दृष्टिमनोहरम् || 82 ||
text_mt: In the four corners of the earth-enclosure, one should write the root[-mantra], O Ambikā; / and [draw it] auspicious and pleasing to the eye with five-colored powders.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yantraṃ  samālikhya  vidhivanmantravittamaḥ |
ekatriṣaḍvasucatuḥkalasān sthāpayet priye || 83 ||
meaning:
एवं यन्त्रं  समालिख्य  विधिवन्मन्त्रवित्तमः |
एकत्रिषड्वसुचतुःकलसान् स्थापयेत् प्रिये || 83 ||
text_mt: Having thus drawn the yantra according to the injunctions, the best knower of mantras, / O beloved, should install one, three, six, eight, or four jars,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyādicaturasrāntaṃ dvātriṃśat kalasān priye |
athavāṣṭādaśeśāni sapta  vā  daśa vā priye || 84 ||
meaning:
मध्यादिचतुरस्रान्तं द्वात्रिंशत् कलसान् प्रिये |
अथवाष्टादशेशानि सप्त  वा  दश वा प्रिये || 84 ||
text_mt: From the center up to the square enclosure, thirty-two jars, O beloved; / or eighteen, O Ruler, or seven, or ten, O beloved,

sanskrit_iast:
caturo vāpyathaikaṃ vā kuryāt sādhakasattamaḥ |
asthiraktaśirātantumṛṇmāṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ jalam || 85 ||
meaning:
चतुरो वाप्यथैकं वा कुर्यात् साधकसत्तमः |
अस्थिरक्तशिरातन्तुमृण्मांसं रुधिरं जलम् || 85 ||
text_mt: Or four, or even one, the best of practitioners should place; / bone, blood, veins, fiber, clay, flesh, blood, water,

sanskrit_iast:
carmavastraśilākūrmanārikelaphalaṃ   śiraḥ |
mantraprāṇasamāyuktāṃ yajet  kalasadevatām || 86 ||
meaning:
चर्मवस्त्रशिलाकूर्मनारिकेलफलं   शिरः |
मन्त्रप्राणसमायुक्तां यजेत्  कलसदेवताम् || 86 ||
text_mt: Skin, cloth, stone, tortoise, coconut fruit, head— / one should worship the deity of the jar endowed with the life of the mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrīnāparāṅgāni mātaroj bhairavānvitāḥ |
vidikṣu   guruvighneśadurgākṣetrapatīn  priye || 87 ||
meaning:
सावित्रीनापराङ्गानि मातरोज् भैरवान्विताः |
विदिक्षु   गुरुविघ्नेशदुर्गाक्षेत्रपतीन्  प्रिये || 87 ||
text_mt: The limbs of Sāvitrī and Parā, the Mothers accompanied by Bhairavas, / and in the intermediate directions, O beloved, the guru, Vighneśa, Durgā, and the lords of the field.

sanskrit_iast:
kalaseṣu  samabhyarcya  vidhivanmantravittamaḥ |
abhiṣiñcet priyaṃ śiṣyaṃ sarvapāpapraśāntaye || 88 ||
meaning:
कलसेषु  समभ्यर्च्य  विधिवन्मन्त्रवित्तमः |
अभिषिञ्चेत् प्रियं शिष्यं सर्वपापप्रशान्तये || 88 ||
text_mt: Having worshipped properly in the jars, the best knower of mantras / should consecrate the beloved disciple for the complete pacification of all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
āyuḥ śrīkāntisaubhāgyavidyārogyādikaṃ bhavet |
rājābhiṣikto   labhate  catuḥsāgaragāṃ   mahīm || 89 ||
meaning:
आयुः श्रीकान्तिसौभाग्यविद्यारोग्यादिकं भवेत् |
राजाभिषिक्तो   लभते  चतुःसागरगां   महीम् || 89 ||
text_mt: Long life, prosperity, radiance, good fortune, learning, health, and the like shall come to be; / consecrated, a king attains the earth extending to the four oceans;

sanskrit_iast:
akiñcano'bhiṣiktaśca  mahadaiśvaryamāpnuyāt |
vandhyābhiṣiktā labhate putraṃ sarvaguṇānvitam || 90 ||
meaning:
अकिञ्चनोऽभिषिक्तश्च  महदैश्वर्यमाप्नुयात् |
वन्ध्याभिषिक्ता लभते पुत्रं सर्वगुणान्वितम् || 90 ||
text_mt: And a destitute person, when consecrated, obtains great sovereignty; / a barren woman, when consecrated, obtains a son endowed with all virtues;

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtāpamṛtyurogādyā  vinaśyanti   na   saṃśayaḥ |
trilauhe vāpi bhūrje vā  likhitvā yantramuttamam || 91 ||
meaning:
भूतापमृत्युरोगाद्या  विनश्यन्ति   न   संशयः |
त्रिलौहे वापि भूर्जे वा  लिखित्वा यन्त्रमुत्तमम् || 91 ||
text_mt: Spirits, untimely death, diseases, and the like are destroyed without doubt. / Having written this supreme yantra on three metals or on birch bark,

sanskrit_iast:
vidhṛtaṃ  bāhunā   devi   sarvarakṣākaraṃ   bhavet |
āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ  vidyālābhaṃ  yaśo  jayam || 92 ||
meaning:
विधृतं  बाहुना   देवि   सर्वरक्षाकरं   भवेत् |
आयुरारोग्यमैश्वर्यं  विद्यालाभं  यशो  जयम् || 92 ||
text_mt: When worn on the arm, O Goddess, it grants all protection, / lifespan, health, sovereignty, acquisition of learning, fame, and victory.

sanskrit_iast:
yad yat  svamanaso'bhīṣṭaṃ  tattadāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ |
khaḍgavaśyaṃ vayaḥstambhaṃ yakṣiṇyañjanapādukām || 93 ||
meaning:
यद् यत्  स्वमनसोऽभीष्टं  तत्तदाप्नोत्यसंशयः |
खड्गवश्यं वयःस्तम्भं यक्षिण्यञ्जनपादुकाम् || 93 ||
text_mt: Whatever is desired by his own mind, that he obtains without doubt: / mastery of the sword, arresting of age, yakṣiṇī, magical eye-salve, sandals,

sanskrit_iast:
aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhyādi      mahārasarasāyanam |
sañjīvayogaguṭikāpramukhākhilasiddhayaḥ      || 94 ||
meaning:
अणिमाद्यष्टसिद्ध्यादि      महारसरसायनम् |
सञ्जीवयोगगुटिकाप्रमुखाखिलसिद्धयः      || 94 ||
text_mt: The eight supernatural powers beginning with atomicity, the great elixir of mercury, / and all supernatural powers headed by the life-restoring pill.

sanskrit_iast:
parāprāsādamantrajñairdṛśyante     nātra    saṃśayaḥ |
ṣaṭ  karmāṇi  prayuñjīta nānyathā bhavati priye || 95 ||
meaning:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रज्ञैर्दृश्यन्ते     नात्र    संशयः |
षट्  कर्माणि  प्रयुञ्जीत नान्यथा भवति प्रिये || 95 ||
text_mt: These are seen by those who know the Parāprāsāda mantra, there is no doubt; / one should apply the six rites; it does not happen otherwise, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
pītadravyairharidrādyaiḥ     samitpatraphalādibhiḥ |
juhuyāt   pūrvavanmantrī   devatādhyānatatparaḥ || 96 ||
meaning:
पीतद्रव्यैर्हरिद्राद्यैः     समित्पत्रफलादिभिः |
जुहुयात्   पूर्ववन्मन्त्री   देवताध्यानतत्परः || 96 ||
text_mt: With yellow substances such as turmeric, with firewood, leaves, fruits, and the like, / the practitioner, intent upon meditation on the deity, should offer oblations as before.

sanskrit_iast:
vākśrotragatidṛksenānadīgraharipūn     priye |
nānāduṣṭamṛgān  devi  stambhayennātra  saṃśayaḥ || 97 ||
meaning:
वाक्श्रोत्रगतिदृक्सेनानदीग्रहरिपून्     प्रिये |
नानादुष्टमृगान्  देवि  स्तम्भयेन्नात्र  संशयः || 97 ||
text_mt: Speech, hearing, movement, sight, an army, a river, planets, enemies, O beloved, / and various harmful beasts, O Goddess, he immobilizes; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
grahavegādiduṣṭānāṃ      vināśanakaraṃ     priye |
asmāt parataraṃ dhyānaṃ nāsti satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 98 ||
meaning:
ग्रहवेगादिदुष्टानां      विनाशनकरं     प्रिये |
अस्मात् परतरं ध्यानं नास्ति सत्यं न संशयः || 98 ||
text_mt: It brings about the destruction of evil beings such as seizing spirits and [dangerous] drives, my dear; / there is no meditation superior to this, truly, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmasadhyānajaṃ    devi   phalametadudīritam |
duṣṭamāraṇakarmāṇi  vidhinānena   sādhayet || 99 ||
meaning:
तामसध्यानजं    देवि   फलमेतदुदीरितम् |
दुष्टमारणकर्माणि  विधिनानेन   साधयेत् || 99 ||
text_mt: This fruit, O Goddess, has been proclaimed as arising from tamasic meditation. / Through this rite one should accomplish magical acts of slaying the wicked.

sanskrit_iast:
ityādi dhyānabhedena jñātvā gurumukhāt priye |
ṣaṭ karmāṇi prayuñjīta nānyathā vīravandite || 100 ||
meaning:
इत्यादि ध्यानभेदेन ज्ञात्वा गुरुमुखात् प्रिये |
षट् कर्माणि प्रयुञ्जीत नान्यथा वीरवन्दिते || 100 ||
text_mt: Having learned thus from the mouth of the guru according to the divisions of meditation, my dear, / one should apply the six magical acts, not otherwise, O you who are praised by heroes.

sanskrit_iast:
khadiraśvetamandārasitabhānusamidvaraiḥ      |
palāśodumbarāśvatthaplakṣāpāmārgasatvacaiḥ || 101 ||
meaning:
खदिरश्वेतमन्दारसितभानुसमिद्वरैः      |
पलाशोदुम्बराश्वत्थप्लक्षापामार्गसत्वचैः || 101 ||
text_mt: With choice firewood of khadira, white mandāra, and white arka; / with the sound barks of palāśa, udumbara, aśvattha, plakṣa, and apāmārga;

sanskrit_iast:
nandyāvarttasitāmbhojahayārikusumādibhiḥ  |
sitairanyaiḥ śubhairdrravyaiḥ samitpatraphalāntaraḥ || 102 ||
meaning:
नन्द्यावर्त्तसिताम्भोजहयारिकुसुमादिभिः  |
सितैरन्यैः शुभैर्द्र्रव्यैः समित्पत्रफलान्तरः || 102 ||
text_mt: with flowers such as nandyāvarta, white lotus, and oleander; / and with other white, auspicious substances, amidst firewood, leaves, and fruits;

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyaiśca   pāyasairdūrvāsahitaistilataṇḍulaiḥ |
madhuratrayasaṃyuktairmantravit    kulanāyike || 103 ||
meaning:
भक्ष्यैश्च   पायसैर्दूर्वासहितैस्तिलतण्डुलैः |
मधुरत्रयसंयुक्तैर्मन्त्रवित्    कुलनायिके || 103 ||
text_mt: and with foods, milk-porridge, along with dūrvā grass, sesamum and rice-grains, / joined with the three sweet substances, the knower of mantra, O heroine of Kula,

sanskrit_iast:
ekena  vātha   sarvairvā   tatkāryagurulāghavam |
jñātvā  devi  sahasrantu  juhuyādatha  pañca  vā || 104 ||
meaning:
एकेन  वाथ   सर्वैर्वा   तत्कार्यगुरुलाघवम् |
ज्ञात्वा  देवि  सहस्रन्तु  जुहुयादथ  पञ्च  वा || 104 ||
text_mt: with one or with all [of these], having perceived / the gravity or lightness of that undertaking, O Goddess, should offer one thousand oblations, or five [hundred],

sanskrit_iast:
ayutaṃ  niyutaṃ  vāpi  prayutaṃ  vā  kuleśvari |
tattatkarmodite   kuṇḍe  saṃskṛte   havyavāhane || 105 ||
meaning:
अयुतं  नियुतं  वापि  प्रयुतं  वा  कुलेश्वरि |
तत्तत्कर्मोदिते   कुण्डे  संस्कृते   हव्यवाहने || 105 ||
text_mt: or ten thousand, one hundred thousand, or even one million, O Mistress of Kula, / in the sacrificial pit prescribed for that respective rite, in consecrated fire.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhya devatāmasmin dhyātvā sāvaraṇāṃ priye |
vidhivajjuhuyāddevi       tadgatenāntarātmanā || 106 ||
meaning:
आवाह्य देवतामस्मिन् ध्यात्वा सावरणां प्रिये |
विधिवज्जुहुयाद्देवि       तद्गतेनान्तरात्मना || 106 ||
text_mt: Having invoked the deity in it and meditated on her together with her retinue, my dear, / he should offer oblations according to rule, O Goddess, with his inner self focused upon her.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvarogavraṇonmādāpasmārotpātayakṣmajam     |
sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ    tatkṣaṇānnātra   saṃśayaḥ || 107 ||
meaning:
सर्वरोगव्रणोन्मादापस्मारोत्पातयक्ष्मजम्     |
सर्वदुःखप्रशमनं    तत्क्षणान्नात्र   संशयः || 107 ||
text_mt: It pacifies all suffering arising from all diseases, wounds, insanity, / epilepsy, portents, and consumption immediately, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
anena sarvaśāntiñca jñānaṃ  vidyāṃ labhet priye |
kadambāśokavakulapunnāgāmramadhūkajaiḥ    || 108 ||
meaning:
अनेन सर्वशान्तिञ्च ज्ञानं  विद्यां लभेत् प्रिये |
कदम्बाशोकवकुलपुन्नागाम्रमधूकजैः    || 108 ||
text_mt: Through this one obtains all pacification, knowledge, and wisdom, my dear. / With [flowers] born of kadamba, aśoka, bakula, punnāga, mango, and madhūka;

sanskrit_iast:
campakadvayapālāśapāṭalaśrīkapitthakaiḥ   |
mālatīmallikājātibandhūkāruṇapaṅkajaiḥ || 109 ||
meaning:
चम्पकद्वयपालाशपाटलश्रीकपित्थकैः   |
मालतीमल्लिकाजातिबन्धूकारुणपङ्कजैः || 109 ||
text_mt: with both kinds of campaka, palāśa, pāṭalā, bilva, and kapittha; / with mālatī, mallikā, jātī, bandhūka, and red lotuses;

sanskrit_iast:
kalhārāruṇamandārayūthikundajavādibhiḥ   |
sanārikelakadalīdrākṣekṣupṛthukairapi      || 110 ||
meaning:
कल्हारारुणमन्दारयूथिकुन्दजवादिभिः   |
सनारिकेलकदलीद्राक्षेक्षुपृथुकैरपि      || 110 ||
text_mt: with kalhāra, red mandāra, yūthikā, kunda, and javā, and so forth; / and with coconuts, plantains, grapes, sugarcane, and flattened rice;

sanskrit_iast:
candanāgurukarpūrarocanākuṃkumādibhiḥ     |
raktairanyaiḥ  śubhadravyaiḥ samidhṛtaphalodbhavaiḥ || 111 ||
meaning:
चन्दनागुरुकर्पूररोचनाकुंकुमादिभिः     |
रक्तैरन्यैः  शुभद्रव्यैः समिधृतफलोद्भवैः || 111 ||
text_mt: with sandalwood, agallochum, camphor, rocanā, saffron, and so forth; / and with other red, auspicious substances produced from firewood, ghee, and fruits;

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavajjuhuyāddevi vidhivanmantravittamaḥ    |
mahīpatīṃśca puruṣān kāntā yauvanagavītāḥ || 112 ||
meaning:
पूर्ववज्जुहुयाद्देवि विधिवन्मन्त्रवित्तमः    |
महीपतींश्च पुरुषान् कान्ता यौवनगवीताः || 112 ||
text_mt: the foremost knower of mantras should offer oblations as before according to rule, O Goddess: / rulers of the earth, men, and lovely women proud of their youth,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhān mattān tathā vyāghrān mṛgān duṣṭān gajānapi |
siddhadevāpsaroyakṣagandharvavanitāstathā    |
devānapi kuleśāni vaśayennātra saṃśayaḥ || 113 ||
meaning:
सिंहान् मत्तान् तथा व्याघ्रान् मृगान् दुष्टान् गजानपि |
सिद्धदेवाप्सरोयक्षगन्धर्ववनितास्तथा    |
देवानपि कुलेशानि वशयेन्नात्र संशयः || 113 ||
text_mt: lions, rutting tigers, wild beasts, and even rogue elephants, / as well as the women of siddhas, gods, apsarases, yakṣas, and gandharvas, / and even gods, O Sovereign of Kula, he subjugates—there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
vājīlavaṇahomena striyamākarṣayed dhruvam |
vidhinānena deveśi saubhāgyamuttamaṃ labhet || 114 ||
meaning:
वाजीलवणहोमेन स्त्रियमाकर्षयेद् ध्रुवम् |
विधिनानेन देवेशि सौभाग्यमुत्तमं लभेत् || 114 ||
text_mt: Through the offering of horse-salt into the fire, he definitely attracts a woman. / Through this rite, O Goddess of the gods, one obtains supreme good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
bahunātra kimuktena triṣu lokeṣu mantriṇām |
anena mantrarājena nāsādhyaṃ vidyate kvacit || 115 ||
meaning:
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन त्रिषु लोकेषु मन्त्रिणाम् |
अनेन मन्त्रराजेन नासाध्यं विद्यते क्वचित् || 115 ||
text_mt: What is the use of saying much here? For practitioners in the three worlds, / there is nothing anywhere that cannot be accomplished by this king of mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvāmnāyaikaniṣṇātaḥ parāprāsādamantravit |
kulārṇavārthatattvajño jīvanmuktaḥ kuleśvari || 116 ||
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायैकनिष्णातः पराप्रासादमन्त्रवित् |
कुलार्णवार्थतत्त्वज्ञो जीवन्मुक्तः कुलेश्वरि || 116 ||
text_mt: One who is skilled solely in the upper transmission, knowing the parāprāsāda mantra, / and knowing the truth of the meaning of the Kulārṇava, is liberated while living, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
sutīrthe vāpyatīrthe vā jalamadhye'pi vā vasan |
parāprāsādamantrajño   mukta  eva   na  saṃśayaḥ || 117 ||
meaning:
सुतीर्थे वाप्यतीर्थे वा जलमध्येऽपि वा वसन् |
पराप्रासादमन्त्रज्ञो   मुक्त  एव   न  संशयः || 117 ||
text_mt: Whether residing at an auspicious pilgrimage site, at a non-pilgrimage site, or even amidst water, / the knower of the parāprāsāda mantra is liberated indeed; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
dikpīṭhakṣetramudrādivṛkṣavallīmaṭhādikāḥ  |
jñeyā bhairavadevyaśca ūrdhvāmnāyasya pārvati || 118 ||
meaning:
दिक्पीठक्षेत्रमुद्रादिवृक्षवल्लीमठादिकाः  |
ज्ञेया भैरवदेव्यश्च ऊर्ध्वाम्नायस्य पार्वति || 118 ||
text_mt: The directions, seats, sacred fields, seals, and so on, the trees, creepers, hermitages, and so forth, / and the Bhairavas and goddesses of the upper transmission must be known, O Pārvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
nimbakāraskaronmattakaṇṭakīvipradantibhiḥ     |
asthikaṇṭakavṛkṣādyairdravyairaśubhasādhanaiḥ       || 119 ||
meaning:
निम्बकारस्करोन्मत्तकण्टकीविप्रदन्तिभिः     |
अस्थिकण्टकवृक्षाद्यैर्द्रव्यैरशुभसाधनैः       || 119 ||
text_mt: With nimba, kāraskara, dhattūra, thorny trees, and danti; / with bones, thorny trees, and so on, substances which are means of inauspicious rites;

sanskrit_iast:
vaṭukaiḥ    kṛṣṇavarṇaiśca   samitpatraphalāntaraiḥ |
gṛhadhūmacitāṅgāratrikaṭvamlacitāñjanaiḥ        || 120 ||
meaning:
वटुकैः    कृष्णवर्णैश्च   समित्पत्रफलान्तरैः |
गृहधूमचिताङ्गारत्रिकट्वम्लचिताञ्जनैः        || 120 ||
text_mt: with black vaṭuka beans, along with firewood, leaves, and fruits; / with soot from the house, charcoal from the funeral pyre, the three pungents, sour gruel, and funeral-pyre collyrium;

sanskrit_iast:
unmattarasasaṃsiktai  piṣṭvā  samyak  prasecitaiḥ |
sādhyapādarajobhiśca      citābhasmasamanvitaiḥ || 121 ||
meaning:
उन्मत्तरससंसिक्तै  पिष्ट्वा  सम्यक्  प्रसेचितैः |
साध्यपादरजोभिश्च      चिताभस्मसमन्वितैः || 121 ||
text_mt: ground and thoroughly moistened with juice of dhattūra, / and mixed with the dust of the target's feet and ashes from the funeral pyre,

sanskrit_iast:
sādhyapratikṛtiṃ       kuryādekanakṣatravṛkṣajām |
samyakpratiṣṭhitaprāṇāṃ kuṇḍasyopari lambayet || 122 ||
meaning:
साध्यप्रतिकृतिं       कुर्यादेकनक्षत्रवृक्षजाम् |
सम्यक्प्रतिष्ठितप्राणां कुण्डस्योपरि लम्बयेत् || 122 ||
text_mt: he should make an effigy of the target born from the tree of [the target's] birth-star; / having properly installed the vital breaths in it, he should hang it over the sacrificial pit.

sanskrit_iast:
khanettatpratimāṃ  mantrī  kuṇḍasyādho  yathāvidhi |
malīmasena       manasā     cogradṛṣṭiramarṣaṇaḥ || 123 ||
meaning:
खनेत्तत्प्रतिमां  मन्त्री  कुण्डस्याधो  यथाविधि |
मलीमसेन       मनसा     चोग्रदृष्टिरमर्षणः || 123 ||
text_mt: The practitioner should dig up that effigy from beneath the sacrificial pit according to rule / with an impure mind, a fierce gaze, and full of wrath.

sanskrit_iast:
citānale  viṣataru  saptakāṣṭhasamedhite |
taddravyairjuhuyāddevi  vidhivanmantravittamaḥ || 124 ||
meaning:
चितानले  विषतरु  सप्तकाष्ठसमेधिते |
तद्द्रव्यैर्जुहुयाद्देवि  विधिवन्मन्त्रवित्तमः || 124 ||
text_mt: In the fire of a funeral pyre, kindled with wood from seven poison trees, / with those substances the foremost knower of mantras should offer oblations according to rule, O Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādvidveṣaṇoccāṭamāraṇāni na saṃśayaḥ |
śāntike sāttvikaṃ devi śvetavarṇaṃ vicintayet || 125 ||
meaning:
कुर्याद्विद्वेषणोच्चाटमारणानि न संशयः |
शान्तिके सात्त्विकं देवि श्वेतवर्णं विचिन्तयेत् || 125 ||
text_mt: He will accomplish sowing dissension, expulsion, and slaying; there is no doubt. / In an act of pacification, O Goddess, one should imagine a sattvic, white form.

sanskrit_iast:
vaśye  tu  rājasaṃ  devi  raktavarṇaṃ  vicintayet |
tāmasaṃ   krūrakāryeṣu  kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ   vicintayet || 126 ||
meaning:
वश्ये  तु  राजसं  देवि  रक्तवर्णं  विचिन्तयेत् |
तामसं   क्रूरकार्येषु  कृष्णवर्णं   विचिन्तयेत् || 126 ||
text_mt: In subjugation, however, O Goddess, one should imagine a rajasic, red form; / in cruel deeds, one should imagine a tamasic, black form.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmarakṣāṃ purā kṛtvā paścāt karmāṇi sādhayet |
yo'nyathā  kurute  mohāt   sa  bhaveddevatāpaśuḥ || 127 ||
meaning:
आत्मरक्षां पुरा कृत्वा पश्चात् कर्माणि साधयेत् |
योऽन्यथा  कुरुते  मोहात्   स  भवेद्देवतापशुः || 127 ||
text_mt: Having first performed self-protection, one should later accomplish the rites. / He who acts otherwise out of delusion becomes a beast of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddevi  mahāṣoḍhānyāsaṃ pūjāṃ baliṃ sudhīḥ |
kṛtvā karmāṇi kurvīta nānyathā vīravandite || 128 ||
meaning:
तस्माद्देवि  महाषोढान्यासं पूजां बलिं सुधीः |
कृत्वा कर्माणि कुर्वीत नान्यथा वीरवन्दिते || 128 ||
text_mt: Therefore, O Goddess, having performed the great sixteenfold nyāsa, worship, and the animal offering, / the wise one should perform the rites, not otherwise, O you who are praised by heroes.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlādhārasarojāntarvahnimadhyagataṃ       priye |
parāprāsādabījaṃ tat kalpāntāgnisamaprabham || 129 ||
meaning:
मूलाधारसरोजान्तर्वह्निमध्यगतं       प्रिये |
पराप्रासादबीजं तत् कल्पान्ताग्निसमप्रभम् || 129 ||
text_mt: Situated in the middle of the fire within the lotus of the mūlādhāra, my dear, / is that seed-syllable of parāprāsāda, equal in radiance to the fire of universal destruction,

sanskrit_iast:
pratilomasu   saṃvītaṃ   daśabhirvyāpakākṣaraiḥ |
svayaṃ   kālānalasamaḥ  sarvabhūtabhayaṅkaraḥ || 130 ||
meaning:
प्रतिलोमसु   संवीतं   दशभिर्व्यापकाक्षरैः |
स्वयं   कालानलसमः  सर्वभूतभयङ्करः || 130 ||
text_mt: encompassed in reverse order by the ten all-pervading letters, / he himself being like the fire of destruction, terrifying to all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāśāmukho  bhūtvātyugradṛṣṭimalīmasaḥ |
yauvanollāsasahitaḥ  parāprāsādasaṃjñakam || 131 ||
meaning:
दक्षिणाशामुखो  भूत्वात्युग्रदृष्टिमलीमसः |
यौवनोल्लाससहितः  पराप्रासादसंज्ञकम् || 131 ||
text_mt: Facing the southern quarter, with an extremely fierce gaze, soiled, / accompanied by the exuberance of youth, [the mantra] named parāprāsāda—

sanskrit_iast:
mantraṃ  maṇḍalakaṃ  japyādaṣṭottarasahasrakam |
aniṣṭakāriṇaḥ sattvān kalahāyāsakāriṇaḥ || 132 ||
meaning:
मन्त्रं  मण्डलकं  जप्यादष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम् |
अनिष्टकारिणः सत्त्वान् कलहायासकारिणः || 132 ||
text_mt: he should recite this mantra for a cycle of one thousand and eight times. / Harm-inflicting beings, those who cause strife and exhaustion,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛthā dveṣakarān  krūrān  saparyāvighnakāriṇaḥ |
bhūtopagrahavetālān  piśācān   yakṣarākṣasān || 133 ||
meaning:
वृथा द्वेषकरान्  क्रूरान्  सपर्याविघ्नकारिणः |
भूतोपग्रहवेतालान्  पिशाचान्   यक्षराक्षसान् || 133 ||
text_mt: those who needlessly cause hatred, the cruel ones who cause obstacles to worship, / bhūtas, secondary spirits, vetālas, piśācas, yakṣas, and rākṣasas,

sanskrit_iast:
ityādiduṣṭajantūṃśca  sadā  kleśakarān  parān |
tadvahnimadhyapatitānnirdagdhāṃśca         cintayet |
kṣaṇena  nāśamāyānti   śalabhā  iva   pāvake || 134 ||
meaning:
इत्यादिदुष्टजन्तूंश्च  सदा  क्लेशकरान्  परान् |
तद्वह्निमध्यपतितान्निर्दग्धांश्च         चिन्तयेत् |
क्षणेन  नाशमायान्ति   शलभा  इव   पावके || 134 ||
text_mt: and other such malignant creatures, who continually inflict affliction upon others— / he should imagine them fallen into the middle of that fire and consumed. / In an instant they perish like moths in a fire.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyamūdhnī smaredbījaṃ sa mṛtyumadhigacchati |
dhyānenānena deveśi kālādīnapi nāśayet || 135 ||
meaning:
यस्यमूध्नी स्मरेद्बीजं स मृत्युमधिगच्छति |
ध्यानेनानेन देवेशि कालादीनपि नाशयेत् || 135 ||
text_mt: On whose head he remembers this seed-syllable, that person attains death. / Through this meditation, O Goddess of the gods, he destroys even Time and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaḥ kiñcit kāmyakarmavidhiḥ priye |
samāsena  kuleśāni  ki  bhūyaḥ  śrotumicchasi || 136 ||
meaning:
इति ते कथितः किञ्चित् काम्यकर्मविधिः प्रिये |
समासेन  कुलेशानि  कि  भूयः  श्रोतुमिच्छसि || 136 ||
text_mt: Thus has the rule of desire-prompted rites been told to you in part, my dear, / in brief, O Sovereign of Kula. What more do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast: atha saptadaśollāsaḥ
meaning: अथ सप्तदशोल्लासः

sanskrit_iast:
śrī devyuvāca
kuleśa śrotumicchāmi gurunāmādivāsanām |
tattvaṃ  kulapadārthānāṃ  vada  me  parameśvara || 1 ||
meaning:
श्री देव्युवाच
कुलेश श्रोतुमिच्छामि गुरुनामादिवासनाम् |
तत्त्वं  कुलपदार्थानां  वद  मे  परमेश्वर || 1 ||
text_mt: The auspicious Goddess said: / O Lord of Kula, I wish to hear the inner meaning of the names of the guru and others. / Tell me, O Supreme Lord, the reality of the categories of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
tasya   śravaṇamātreṇa  kulajñānaṃ  prakāśate || 2 ||
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि |
तस्य   श्रवणमात्रेण  कुलज्ञानं  प्रकाशते || 2 ||
text_mt:
The Lord said:
Listen, Goddess, I shall proclaim what you ask of me; / merely by hearing it, Kula knowledge shines forth.

sanskrit_iast:
namaste  nātha  bhagavan  śivāya  gururūpiṇe |
vidyāvatārasaṃsiddhyai     svīkṛtānekavigraha || 3 ||
meaning:
नमस्ते  नाथ  भगवन्  शिवाय  गुरुरूपिणे |
विद्यावतारसंसिद्ध्यै     स्वीकृतानेकविग्रह || 3 ||
text_mt: Obeisance to you, Lord, blessed one, to Śiva in the form of the guru, / who have assumed multiple physical forms to bring about the descent of sacred knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇasvarūpāya       paramātmasvarūpiṇe |
sarvājñānatamobhedabhānave     caitanyāya    ca || 4 ||
meaning:
नारायणस्वरूपाय       परमात्मस्वरूपिणे |
सर्वाज्ञानतमोभेदभानवे     चैतन्याय    च || 4 ||
text_mt: To him whose intrinsic nature is Nārāyaṇa, whose intrinsic nature is the Supreme Self, / the sun that pierces the darkness of all ignorance, and pure consciousness;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñāya dayākḷptavigrahāya     śivātmane |
paratreha  ca  bhaktānāṃ  bhavyānāṃ  bhāvadāyine || 5 ||
meaning:
सर्वज्ञाय दयाकॢप्तविग्रहाय     शिवात्मने |
परत्रेह  च  भक्तानां  भव्यानां  भावदायिने || 5 ||
text_mt: to the omniscient one, whose physical form is fashioned from compassion, whose self is Śiva, / who bestows spiritual realization upon his devoted, auspicious devotees both in the hereafter and here;

sanskrit_iast:
purastāt pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhe namaḥ kuryāmuparyadhaḥ |
sadā  saccittarūpeṇa  vidhehi  tava dāsatām || 6 ||
meaning:
पुरस्तात् पार्श्वयोः पृष्ठे नमः कुर्यामुपर्यधः |
सदा  सच्चित्तरूपेण  विधेहि  तव दासताम् || 6 ||
text_mt: I offer obeisance in front, on both sides, behind, above, and below; / through your form of eternal, pure consciousness, always ordain my servitude to you.

sanskrit_iast:
guśabdastvandhakāraḥ syāt ruśabdastannirodhakaḥ |
andhakāranirodhatvāt       gururityabhidhīyate || 7 ||
meaning:
गुशब्दस्त्वन्धकारः स्यात् रुशब्दस्तन्निरोधकः |
अन्धकारनिरोधत्वात्       गुरुरित्यभिधीयते || 7 ||
text_mt: The syllable 'gu' is darkness, and the syllable 'ru' is that which obstructs it; / because he obstructs darkness, he is designated as 'guru'.

sanskrit_iast:
gakāraḥ siddhadaḥ prokto rephaḥ pāpasya dāhakaḥ |
ukāro  viṣṇurityuktastritayātmā  guruḥ  paraḥ || 8 ||
meaning:
गकारः सिद्धदः प्रोक्तो रेफः पापस्य दाहकः |
उकारो  विष्णुरित्युक्तस्त्रितयात्मा  गुरुः  परः || 8 ||
text_mt: The letter 'g' is said to bestow spiritual perfection, the letter 'r' consumes demerit, / and the letter 'u' is said to be Viṣṇu: the supreme guru is identical with this triad.

sanskrit_iast:
gakāro jñānasampattī rephastatra prakāśakaḥ |
ukāraḥ śivatādātmyaṃ  gururityabhidhīyate || 9 ||
meaning:
गकारो ज्ञानसम्पत्ती रेफस्तत्र प्रकाशकः |
उकारः शिवतादात्म्यं  गुरुरित्यभिधीयते || 9 ||
text_mt: The letter 'g' is the attainment of knowledge, the letter 'r' is the illuminator thereof, / and the letter 'u' is identity with Śiva; [thus] he is designated as 'guru'.

sanskrit_iast:
guhyāgamātmatattvāndhanaddhānāṃ    bodhanādapi |
rudrādidevarūpatvād      gururityabhidhīyate || 10 ||
meaning:
गुह्यागमात्मतत्त्वान्धनद्धानां    बोधनादपि |
रुद्रादिदेवरूपत्वाद्      गुरुरित्यभिधीयते || 10 ||
text_mt: Moreover, because he awakens those bound in blindness to the reality of the secret Āgamas and the Self, / and because his form is that of the deities beginning with Rudra, he is designated as 'guru'.

sanskrit_iast:
svayamācarate   śiṣyānācāre  sthāpayatyapi |
ācinotīha śāstrārthānācāryastena kathyate || 11 ||
meaning:
स्वयमाचरते   शिष्यानाचारे  स्थापयत्यपि |
आचिनोतीह शास्त्रार्थानाचार्यस्तेन कथ्यते || 11 ||
text_mt: He practices it himself, he establishes his disciples in proper conduct, / and he gathers here the meanings of the scriptures; therefore he is called 'ācārya'.

sanskrit_iast:
carācarasamāsannamadhyāpayati   yaḥ  svayam |
yamādiyogasiddhatvādācārya   iti  kathyate || 12 ||
meaning:
चराचरसमासन्नमध्यापयति   यः  स्वयम् |
यमादियोगसिद्धत्वादाचार्य   इति  कथ्यते || 12 ||
text_mt: He who himself teaches what pertains to the moving and unmoving [world], / and who is perfected in yoga beginning with restraint, is called 'ācārya'.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmabhāvapradānāttu     rāgadveṣādivarjjanāt |
dhyānaikaniṣṭhācittatvādārādhya iti kathyate || 13 ||
meaning:
आत्मभावप्रदानात्तु     रागद्वेषादिवर्ज्जनात् |
ध्यानैकनिष्ठाचित्तत्वादाराध्य इति कथ्यते || 13 ||
text_mt: Because he imparts the state of the Self, is free from passion and hatred, / and has a mind single-mindedly intent upon meditation, he is called 'ārādhya'.

sanskrit_iast:
devatārūpadhāritvācchiṣyānugrahakāraṇāt   |
karuṇāmayamūttītvāddeśikaḥ kathitaḥ priye || 14 ||
meaning:
देवतारूपधारित्वाच्छिष्यानुग्रहकारणात्   |
करुणामयमूत्तीत्वाद्देशिकः कथितः प्रिये || 14 ||
text_mt: Because he bears the form of the deity, for the sake of bestowing grace upon his disciples, / and because his physical form is made of compassion, he is called 'deśika', my beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
svāntaḥśāntisamunmīlatparatattvārthacintanāt    |
mithyājñānavihīnatvāt svāmīti kathitaḥ priye || 15 ||
meaning:
स्वान्तःशान्तिसमुन्मीलत्परतत्त्वार्थचिन्तनात्    |
मिथ्याज्ञानविहीनत्वात् स्वामीति कथितः प्रिये || 15 ||
text_mt: Because he contemplates the meaning of the supreme reality blossoming in the peace of his inner heart, / and because he is free of false knowledge, he is called 'svāmin', my beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
manodoṣādidūratvāddhetuvādādivarjjanāt         |
śvādiprāṇiṣu sādṛśyād ramyatvācca maheśvaraḥ || 16 ||
meaning:
मनोदोषादिदूरत्वाद्धेतुवादादिवर्ज्जनात्         |
श्वादिप्राणिषु सादृश्याद् रम्यत्वाच्च महेश्वरः || 16 ||
text_mt: Because he is far removed from the faults of the mind, rejects dialectical disputation, / sees sameness in living beings such as dogs, and is delightful, [he is] 'maheśvara'.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmokṣajñānadātṛtvānnādabrahmātmabodhanāt       |
sthagitājñānacihnatvāt śrīnāthaḥ kathitaḥ priye || 17 ||
meaning:
श्रीमोक्षज्ञानदातृत्वान्नादब्रह्मात्मबोधनात्       |
स्थगिताज्ञानचिह्नत्वात् श्रीनाथः कथितः प्रिये || 17 ||
text_mt: Because he gives the auspicious knowledge of liberation, awakens the Self to the phonic absolute, / and has obscured the marks of ignorance, he is called 'śrīnātha', my beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
deśakālāvirodhena varttamānāt kulāgame |
vaśīkṛtajagajjīvāddeva   ityabhidhīyate || 18 ||
meaning:
देशकालाविरोधेन वर्त्तमानात् कुलागमे |
वशीकृतजगज्जीवाद्देव   इत्यभिधीयते || 18 ||
text_mt: Because he conducts himself in accordance with the Kula transmission without conflict with place and time, / and has brought under control the living souls of the universe, he is designated as 'deva'.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavapāśapraśamanāt     ṭaṅkārendukaśekharāt |
rakṣaṇāt kamanīyatvāt bhaṭṭāraka itīritaḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
भवपाशप्रशमनात्     टङ्कारेन्दुकशेखरात् |
रक्षणात् कमनीयत्वात् भट्टारक इतीरितः || 19 ||
text_mt: Because he pacifies the bonds of worldly existence, has the crest-crescent moon of a mason's chisel, / protects, and is desirable, he is called 'bhaṭṭāraka'.

sanskrit_iast:
praguptāgamavedāntarahasyārthavibhāvanāt   |
bhuktimuktipradānācca prabhurityabhidhīyate || 20 ||
meaning:
प्रगुप्तागमवेदान्तरहस्यार्थविभावनात्   |
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदानाच्च प्रभुरित्यभिधीयते || 20 ||
text_mt: Because he fully realizes the secret meaning of the hidden Āgamas and Vedānta, / and because he bestows enjoyment and liberation, he is designated as 'prabhu'.

sanskrit_iast:
yonimudrānusandhānāt    prasphuranmantravaibhavāt |
gīrvāṇagaṇapūjyatvād yogīti kathitaḥ priye || 21 ||
meaning:
योनिमुद्रानुसन्धानात्    प्रस्फुरन्मन्त्रवैभवात् |
गीर्वाणगणपूज्यत्वाद् योगीति कथितः प्रिये || 21 ||
text_mt: Because of his contemplation of the yonimudrā, the glory of his radiant mantras, / and his worthiness to be worshipped by the host of gods, he is called 'yogin', my beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
saṅgaduḥkhaparityāgāt yatra kutrāśramāśrayāt |
mitha ātmanibandhatvāt saṃyamītyabhidhīyate || 22 ||
meaning:
सङ्गदुःखपरित्यागात् यत्र कुत्राश्रमाश्रयात् |
मिथ आत्मनिबन्धत्वात् संयमीत्यभिधीयते || 22 ||
text_mt: Because he has cast aside the suffering of attachment, takes shelter in any hermitage whatsoever, / and is internally bound to the Self, he is designated as 'saṃyamin'.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvasvarūpamananāt      parivādādivajītāt |
svīkārāt śubhakāryāṇāṃ tapasvītyabhidhīyate || 23 ||
meaning:
तत्त्वस्वरूपमननात्      परिवादादिवजीतात् |
स्वीकारात् शुभकार्याणां तपस्वीत्यभिधीयते || 23 ||
text_mt: Because he contemplates the intrinsic nature of reality, is free from slander and the like, / and undertakes auspicious actions, he is designated as 'tapasvin'.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣaratvādvareṇyatvāddhūtasaṃsārabandhanāt    |
tattvamasyarthasiddhatvāt avadhūto'bhidhīyate || 24 ||
meaning:
अक्षरत्वाद्वरेण्यत्वाद्धूतसंसारबन्धनात्    |
तत्त्वमस्यर्थसिद्धत्वात् अवधूतोऽभिधीयते || 24 ||
text_mt: Because he is imperishable, supreme, has shaken off the bonds of the transmigratory cycle, / and has accomplished the meaning of 'Thou art that', he is designated as 'avadhūta'.

sanskrit_iast:
vītarāgamadakleśakopamātsaryamohataḥ |
rajastamovidūratvādvīra  ityabhidhīyate || 25 ||
meaning:
वीतरागमदक्लेशकोपमात्सर्यमोहतः |
रजस्तमोविदूरत्वाद्वीर  इत्यभिधीयते || 25 ||
text_mt: Because he is free from passion, pride, affliction, anger, envy, and delusion, / and because he is far removed from passion and darkness, he is designated as 'vīra'.

sanskrit_iast:
kulaṃ gotraṃ samākhyātaṃ tacca śaktiśivodbhavam |
yena mokṣa iti jñānaṃ kaulikaḥ so'bhidhīyate || 26 ||
meaning:
कुलं गोत्रं समाख्यातं तच्च शक्तिशिवोद्भवम् |
येन मोक्ष इति ज्ञानं कौलिकः सोऽभिधीयते || 26 ||
text_mt: Kula is declared to be lineage, and that arises from Śakti and Śiva; / he through whom knowledge is liberation is designated as a 'Kaulika'.

sanskrit_iast:
akulaṃ śiva ityuktaṃ kulaṃ śaktiḥ prakīttītā |
kulākulānusandhānānnipuṇāḥ kaulikāḥ priye || 27 ||
meaning:
अकुलं शिव इत्युक्तं कुलं शक्तिः प्रकीत्तीता |
कुलाकुलानुसन्धानान्निपुणाः कौलिकाः प्रिये || 27 ||
text_mt: Akula is said to be Śiva, and Kula is proclaimed to be Śakti; / those skilled in the continuous contemplation of Kula and Akula are Kaulikas, my beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
sārasaṃgrahaṇāccaiva        dharmamārgapravarttanāt |
karaṇagrāmaniyamāt sādhakaḥ so'bhidhīyate || 28 ||
meaning:
सारसंग्रहणाच्चैव        धर्ममार्गप्रवर्त्तनात् |
करणग्रामनियमात् साधकः सोऽभिधीयते || 28 ||
text_mt: Because he gathers the essential core, sets in motion the path of righteousness, / and restrains the collection of sensory organs, he is designated as a 'sādhaka'.

sanskrit_iast:
bhajanāt parayā bhaktyā manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ |
taratyakhiladuḥkhāni    tasmādbhakta   itīritaḥ || 29 ||
meaning:
भजनात् परया भक्त्या मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः |
तरत्यखिलदुःखानि    तस्माद्भक्त   इतीरितः || 29 ||
text_mt: Because he worships with supreme devotion through actions of mind, speech, and body, / he crosses over all sorrows; therefore he is called a 'bhakta'.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīramarthaṃ prāṇāṃśca sadgurubhyo nivedya yaḥ |
gurubhyaḥ śikṣate yogaṃ śiṣya ityabhidhīyate || 30 ||
meaning:
शरीरमर्थं प्राणांश्च सद्गुरुभ्यो निवेद्य यः |
गुरुभ्यः शिक्षते योगं शिष्य इत्यभिधीयते || 30 ||
text_mt: He who surrenders body, wealth, and life-breaths to true gurus / and learns yoga from gurus is designated as a 'śiṣya'.

sanskrit_iast:
yonimudrānusandhānāt   girijāpādasevanāt |
nirlīnopādhivibhavād yoginītyabhidhīyate || 31 ||
meaning:
योनिमुद्रानुसन्धानात्   गिरिजापादसेवनात् |
निर्लीनोपाधिविभवाद् योगिनीत्यभिधीयते || 31 ||
text_mt: Because of her contemplation of the yonimudrā, service to the feet of the Mountain-born Goddess, / and because the power of limiting adjuncts has dissolved, she is designated as a 'yoginī'.

sanskrit_iast:
śatakoṭimahādivyayoginīprītikāraṇāt |
tīvramuktipradānācca śaktirityabhidhīyate || 32 ||
meaning:
शतकोटिमहादिव्ययोगिनीप्रीतिकारणात् |
तीव्रमुक्तिप्रदानाच्च शक्तिरित्यभिधीयते || 32 ||
text_mt: Because she brings pleasure to hundreds of millions of great divine yoginīs, / and because she grants intense liberation, she is designated as 'śakti'.

sanskrit_iast:
pālanādduritacchedāt kāmitārthasya varddhanāt |
pāduketi samākhyātā mama tattvaṃ  tava  priye || 33 ||
meaning:
पालनाद्दुरितच्छेदात् कामितार्थस्य वर्द्धनात् |
पादुकेति समाख्याता मम तत्त्वं  तव  प्रिये || 33 ||
text_mt: Because it protects, cuts through misfortune, and increases desired wealth, / it is proclaimed as 'pādukā'—my ontological reality and yours, my beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
janmāntarasahasreṣu kṛtapāpapraṇāśanāt |
paradevaprakāśācca japa ityabhidhīyate || 34 ||
meaning:
जन्मान्तरसहस्रेषु कृतपापप्रणाशनात् |
परदेवप्रकाशाच्च जप इत्यभिधीयते || 34 ||
text_mt: Because it destroys demerit accumulated in thousands of other births, / and reveals the supreme deity, it is designated as 'japa'.

sanskrit_iast:
stokastokena manasaḥ paramaprītikāraṇāt |
stotṛsantāraṇāddevi   stotramityabhidhīyate || 35 ||
meaning:
स्तोकस्तोकेन मनसः परमप्रीतिकारणात् |
स्तोतृसन्तारणाद्देवि   स्तोत्रमित्यभिधीयते || 35 ||
text_mt: Because little by little it causes supreme delight of the mind, / and because it delivers the praise-singer, O Goddess, it is designated as 'stotra'.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadindriyasantāpaṃ  manasā  saṃniyamya ca |
svāntenābhīṣṭadevasya cintanaṃ dhyānamucyate || 36 ||
meaning:
यावदिन्द्रियसन्तापं  मनसा  संनियम्य च |
स्वान्तेनाभीष्टदेवस्य चिन्तनं ध्यानमुच्यते || 36 ||
text_mt: Completely restraining the agitation of the senses by means of the mind, / contemplation of one's chosen deity with the inner heart is called 'dhyāna'.

sanskrit_iast:
caritārthavikāśācca rakṣaṇādapi pārvati |
naranārīsvarūpācca caraṇaṃ kathitaṃ priye || 37 ||
meaning:
चरितार्थविकाशाच्च रक्षणादपि पार्वति |
नरनारीस्वरूपाच्च चरणं कथितं प्रिये || 37 ||
text_mt: Because of the manifestation of the attained goal, and because of protection, O Pārvatī, / and because of having the intrinsic nature of both man and woman, it is called 'caraṇa', my beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
veditā'khilaśāstrārthasaddharmārthanirūpaṇāt |
darśanānāṃ    pramāṇatvādveda  ityabhidhīyate || 38 ||
meaning:
वेदिताऽखिलशास्त्रार्थसद्धर्मार्थनिरूपणात् |
दर्शनानां    प्रमाणत्वाद्वेद  इत्यभिधीयते || 38 ||
text_mt: Because it makes known the meaning of all scriptures, ascertains the true goals of duty, / and is the authoritative means of knowledge for philosophical systems, it is designated as 'veda'.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyapāpādikathanādrākṣasādinivāraṇāt   |
navabhaktyādijananāt purāṇa iti kathyate || 39 ||
meaning:
पुण्यपापादिकथनाद्राक्षसादिनिवारणात्   |
नवभक्त्यादिजननात् पुराण इति कथ्यते || 39 ||
text_mt: Because it expounds merit, demerit, and the like, wards off demons and other evils, / and engenders the nine kinds of devotion, it is called 'purāṇa'.

sanskrit_iast:
śāsanādaniśaṃ devi varṇāśramanivāsinām |
tāraṇāt sarvapāpebhyaḥ śāstramityabhidhīyate || 40 ||
meaning:
शासनादनिशं देवि वर्णाश्रमनिवासिनाम् |
तारणात् सर्वपापेभ्यः शास्त्रमित्यभिधीयते || 40 ||
text_mt: Because it unceasingly governs those who abide in the classes and life-stages, O Goddess, / and delivers them from all demerits, it is designated as 'śāstra'.

sanskrit_iast:
smaraṇotsukaniṣṭhānāṃ dharmādharmanirūpaṇāt |
timirotpāṭanāddevi smṛtirityabhidhīyate || 41 ||
meaning:
स्मरणोत्सुकनिष्ठानां धर्माधर्मनिरूपणात् |
तिमिरोत्पाटनाद्देवि स्मृतिरित्यभिधीयते || 41 ||
text_mt: Because it determines duty and non-duty for those devoted to and eager for recollection, / and eradicates darkness, O Goddess, it is designated as 'smṛti'.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭadharmādikathanāttimirājñānabhañjanāt |
haraṇāt sarvaduḥkhānāṃ itihāsa iti smṛtaḥ || 42 ||
meaning:
इष्टधर्मादिकथनात्तिमिराज्ञानभञ्जनात् |
हरणात् सर्वदुःखानां इतिहास इति स्मृतः || 42 ||
text_mt: Because it expounds desirable duty and the like, dispels the darkness of ignorance, / and removes all sorrows, it is remembered as 'itihāsa'.

sanskrit_iast:
ācārakathanāddivyagatiprāptinidānataḥ |
mahātmatattvakathanādāgamaḥ kathitaḥ priye || 43 ||
meaning:
आचारकथनाद्दिव्यगतिप्राप्तिनिदानतः |
महात्मतत्त्वकथनादागमः कथितः प्रिये || 43 ||
text_mt: Because it expounds conduct, is the cause of attaining the divine realm, / and expounds the reality of the Great Self, it is called 'āgama', my beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
śākinīgaṇapūjyatvāttāraṇādbhavavāridhe |
parādiśaktisānnidhyācchākta ityabhidhīyate || 44 ||
meaning:
शाकिनीगणपूज्यत्वात्तारणाद्भववारिधे |
परादिशक्तिसान्निध्याच्छाक्त इत्यभिधीयते || 44 ||
text_mt: Because he is worthy of worship by the hosts of Śākinīs, delivers from the ocean of worldly existence, / and is in proximity to the supreme primal Śakti, he is designated as 'Śākta'.

sanskrit_iast:
kaumārādinirodhatvāt layajanmādibhañjanāt |
aśeṣakulasambandhāt kaula ityabhidhīyate || 45 ||
meaning:
कौमारादिनिरोधत्वात् लयजन्मादिभञ्जनात् |
अशेषकुलसम्बन्धात् कौल इत्यभिधीयते || 45 ||
text_mt: Because he restrains [states] beginning with youth, breaks through dissolution, birth, and the like, / and is connected to all Kulas, he is designated as 'Kaula'.

sanskrit_iast:
pāśacchedakarāddevi   rañjanāt   paratejasaḥ |
yatibhiścintyamānatvāt paramparyamitīritam || 46 ||
meaning:
पाशच्छेदकराद्देवि   रञ्जनात्   परतेजसः |
यतिभिश्चिन्त्यमानत्वात् परम्पर्यमितीरितम् || 46 ||
text_mt: Because it severs bonds, O Goddess, delights the supreme splendor, / and is constantly contemplated by ascetics, it is said to be 'pāramparya'.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārasārabhūtatvāt      prakāśānandadānataḥ |
yaśaḥ saubhāgyakaraṇāt sampradāya itīritaḥ || 47 ||
meaning:
संसारसारभूतत्वात्      प्रकाशानन्ददानतः |
यशः सौभाग्यकरणात् सम्प्रदाय इतीरितः || 47 ||
text_mt: Because it constitutes the essence of the transmigratory cycle, because it grants the bliss of illumination, / and because it produces fame and good fortune, it is proclaimed tradition.

sanskrit_iast:
āditvāt sarvamārgāṇāṃ manollāsapravarddhanāt |
yajñādidharmahetutvādāmnāya   iti   kītītaḥ || 48 ||
meaning:
आदित्वात् सर्वमार्गाणां मनोल्लासप्रवर्द्धनात् |
यज्ञादिधर्महेतुत्वादाम्नाय   इति   कीतीतः || 48 ||
text_mt: Because it is the origin of all paths, because it magnifies the joy of the mind, / and because it is the cause of righteousness through sacrifice and the like, it is declared sacred transmission.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutānekamahāmantrayantratantrādidaivatāt     |
śrutau yadanavicchinnācchrauta ityabhidhīyate || 49 ||
meaning:
श्रुतानेकमहामन्त्रयन्त्रतन्त्रादिदैवतात्     |
श्रुतौ यदनविच्छिन्नाच्छ्रौत इत्यभिधीयते || 49 ||
text_mt: Because its deities begin with the many great mantras, yantras, and tantras that are revealed, / and because it is uninterrupted in revelation, it is designated as based on revelation.

sanskrit_iast:
āmnāyatattvarūpatvāccāturyārthanirūpaṇāt |
rāgadveṣādiśamanādācāra  iti   kīrttyate || 50 ||
meaning:
आम्नायतत्त्वरूपत्वाच्चातुर्यार्थनिरूपणात् |
रागद्वेषादिशमनादाचार  इति   कीर्त्त्यते || 50 ||
text_mt: Because it consists of the reality of sacred transmission, because it establishes the four aims, / and because it pacifies passion, hatred, and the rest, it is proclaimed conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
divyabhāvapradānācca kṣālanāt kalmaṣasya ca |
dīkṣeti   kathitā sadbhirbhavabandhavimocanāt || 51 ||
meaning:
दिव्यभावप्रदानाच्च क्षालनात् कल्मषस्य च |
दीक्षेति   कथिता सद्भिर्भवबन्धविमोचनात् || 51 ||
text_mt: Because it grants the divine state and washes away defilement, / and because it frees [one] from the bond of worldly existence, it is called initiation by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
ahambhāvaharādbhītimathanāt   secanādapi |
kampānandādijananādabhiṣeka iti smṛtaḥ || 52 ||
meaning:
अहम्भावहराद्भीतिमथनात्   सेचनादपि |
कम्पानन्दादिजननादभिषेक इति स्मृतः || 52 ||
text_mt: Because it destroys egoism, churns away fear, and is an asperging, / and because it produces trembling, bliss, and the like, it is traditionally known as consecration.

sanskrit_iast:
ulbaṇatvāt paratvācca devatāprītidānataḥ |
śaktipātanimittādapyupadeśa  iti  smṛtaḥ || 53 ||
meaning:
उल्बणत्वात् परत्वाच्च देवताप्रीतिदानतः |
शक्तिपातनिमित्तादप्युपदेश  इति  स्मृतः || 53 ||
text_mt: Because of its pre-eminence and supreme nature, because it grants the favour of the deity, / and because it is the occasion for the descent of power, it is traditionally known as instruction.

sanskrit_iast:
mananāttattvarūpasya   devasyāmitatejasaḥ |
trāyate sarvabhayatastasmānmantra itīritaḥ || 54 ||
meaning:
मननात्तत्त्वरूपस्य   देवस्यामिततेजसः |
त्रायते सर्वभयतस्तस्मान्मन्त्र इतीरितः || 54 ||
text_mt: Because of the meditation upon the God of boundless radiance who is the nature of reality, / and because it protects from all fear, it is therefore called mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
dehamāsthāya bhaktānāṃ varadānācca pārvati |
tāpatrayādiśamanāddevatā     parikīttītā || 55 ||
meaning:
देहमास्थाय भक्तानां वरदानाच्च पार्वति |
तापत्रयादिशमनाद्देवता     परिकीत्तीता || 55 ||
text_mt: Because, assuming a body, it grants boons to devotees, O Pārvatī, / and because it pacifies the threefold affliction and other [sorrows], it is proclaimed deity.

sanskrit_iast:
nyāyopājītavittānāmaṅgeṣu viniveśanāt |
sarvarakṣākarāddevi nyāsa ityabhidhīyate || 56 ||
meaning:
न्यायोपाजीतवित्तानामङ्गेषु विनिवेशनात् |
सर्वरक्षाकराद्देवि न्यास इत्यभिधीयते || 56 ||
text_mt: Because it deposits within the limbs treasures rightfully acquired, / and because it provides all-around protection, O Goddess, it is designated nyāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
mudaṃ kurvanti  devānāṃ  manāṃsi  drāvayanti   ca |
tasmānmudrā iti khyātā daśītavyāḥ kuleśvari || 57 ||
meaning:
मुदं कुर्वन्ति  देवानां  मनांसि  द्रावयन्ति   च |
तस्मान्मुद्रा इति ख्याता दशीतव्याः कुलेश्वरि || 57 ||
text_mt: They produce delight for the gods and melt their minds; / therefore they are known as mudrās, and they must be displayed, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
anantaphaladānācca kṣapitāśeṣakalmaṣāt |
mātṛkātmatayā lābhakaraṇādakṣamālikā || 58 ||
meaning:
अनन्तफलदानाच्च क्षपिताशेषकल्मषात् |
मातृकात्मतया लाभकरणादक्षमालिका || 58 ||
text_mt: Because it grants endless fruit, because it destroys all defilement, / and because it brings attainment through its identity with the Mātṛkās, [it is called] rosary.

sanskrit_iast:
maṅgalatvācca ḍākinyā yoginīgaṇasaṃśrayāt |
lalitatvācca deveśi maṇḍalaṃ parikīttītam || 59 ||
meaning:
मङ्गलत्वाच्च डाकिन्या योगिनीगणसंश्रयात् |
ललितत्वाच्च देवेशि मण्डलं परिकीत्तीतम् || 59 ||
text_mt: Because of its auspiciousness, because it is the resort of ḍākinīs and the host of yoginīs, / and because of its loveliness, O Ruler of the Gods, it is proclaimed maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
kamalāsanarūpatvāllaghutattvādināśanāt    |
śamitāpārapāpācca kalaśaḥ parikīttītaḥ || 60 ||
meaning:
कमलासनरूपत्वाल्लघुतत्त्वादिनाशनात्    |
शमितापारपापाच्च कलशः परिकीत्तीतः || 60 ||
