text_mt: Because it has the nature of a lotus seat, because it destroys trivial realities and the like, / and because it pacifies boundless demerit, it is proclaimed the ritual pitcher.

sanskrit_iast:
yamabhūtādisarvebhyo bhayebhyo'pi kuleśvari |
trāyate satatañcaiva tasmād  yantramitīritam || 61 ||
meaning:
यमभूतादिसर्वेभ्यो भयेभ्योऽपि कुलेश्वरि |
त्रायते सततञ्चैव तस्माद्  यन्त्रमितीरितम् || 61 ||
text_mt: From all terrors beginning with Yama and spirits, O Mistress of Kula, / it protects constantly; therefore it is proclaimed yantra.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmasiddhipradānācca sarvaroganivāraṇāt |
navasiddhipradānācca āsanaṃ kathitaṃ priye || 62 ||
meaning:
आत्मसिद्धिप्रदानाच्च सर्वरोगनिवारणात् |
नवसिद्धिप्रदानाच्च आसनं कथितं प्रिये || 62 ||
text_mt: Because it grants realization of the Self, because it wards off all diseases, / and because it grants the nine supernatural powers, it is declared the seat, O Beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
māyājālādiśamanānmokṣamārganirūpaṇāt |
aṣṭaduḥkhādivirahān  madyamityabhidhīyate || 63 ||
meaning:
मायाजालादिशमनान्मोक्षमार्गनिरूपणात् |
अष्टदुःखादिविरहान्  मद्यमित्यभिधीयते || 63 ||
text_mt: Because it pacifies the web of cosmic illusion and the like, because it reveals the path to liberation, / and because it removes the eight miseries and the like, it is designated liquor.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādānārtharūpatvād yāgabhūmyekakāraṇāt |
madbhāvajananāddevi   madyamityabhidhīyate || 64 ||
meaning:
महादानार्थरूपत्वाद् यागभूम्येककारणात् |
मद्भावजननाद्देवि   मद्यमित्यभिधीयते || 64 ||
text_mt: Because it has the nature of the object of supreme gift, because it is the sole cause of the sacrificial ground, / and because it produces My state of being, O Goddess, it is designated liquor.

sanskrit_iast:
sumanasaḥ sevitatvād rājyadatvāt sadā priye |
surākārapradānatvāt   sureti   parikīttītā || 65 ||
meaning:
सुमनसः सेवितत्वाद् राज्यदत्वात् सदा प्रिये |
सुराकारप्रदानत्वात्   सुरेति   परिकीत्तीता || 65 ||
text_mt: Because it is enjoyed by the wise, because it always bestows kingdom, O Beloved, / and because it grants a divine form, it is proclaimed wine.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtāṃśusvarūpatvānmṛtyubhītinivāraṇāt |
tattvaprakāśahetutvādamṛtaṃ  kathitaṃ   priye || 66 ||
meaning:
अमृतांशुस्वरूपत्वान्मृत्युभीतिनिवारणात् |
तत्त्वप्रकाशहेतुत्वादमृतं  कथितं   प्रिये || 66 ||
text_mt: Because it is of the nature of the moon, because it wards off fear of death, / and because it is the cause of the revelation of reality, it is declared nectar, O Beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
pānāṅgaviśvarūpatvāttricatuṣkakalāśrayāt |
patitatrāṇanāddevi     pātramityabhidhīyate || 67 ||
meaning:
पानाङ्गविश्वरूपत्वात्त्रिचतुष्ककलाश्रयात् |
पतितत्राणनाद्देवि     पात्रमित्यभिधीयते || 67 ||
text_mt: Because it is the universal form of the vessel for drinking, because it is the resort of the twelve digits, / and because it protects the fallen, O Goddess, it is designated the vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
āśuśukṣaṇirūpatvāddhātṛdevapriyādapi    |
rakṣaṇādapi cādheyasyādhāraṃ tu vidurbudhāḥ || 68 ||
meaning:
आशुशुक्षणिरूपत्वाद्धातृदेवप्रियादपि    |
रक्षणादपि चाधेयस्याधारं तु विदुर्बुधाः || 68 ||
text_mt: Because it has the nature of fire, because it is dear to the creator god, / and because it protects the contents, the wise know it as the base.

sanskrit_iast:
māṅgalyajananāddevi  saṃvivadānandadānataḥ |
sarvadevapriyatvācca māṃsa ityabhidhīyate || 69 ||
meaning:
माङ्गल्यजननाद्देवि  संविवदानन्ददानतः |
सर्वदेवप्रियत्वाच्च मांस इत्यभिधीयते || 69 ||
text_mt: Because it produces auspiciousness, O Goddess, because it grants the bliss of disputation, / and because it is dear to all the gods, it is designated meat.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvajanmānuśamanājjanmamṛtyunivāraṇāt    |
sampūrṇaphaladānācca pūjeti kathitā priye || 70 ||
meaning:
पूर्वजन्मानुशमनाज्जन्ममृत्युनिवारणात्    |
सम्पूर्णफलदानाच्च पूजेति कथिता प्रिये || 70 ||
text_mt: Because it quenches previous births, because it wards off birth and death, / and because it grants complete fruit, it is declared worship, O Beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
abhīṣṭaphaladānācca caturvargaphalāśrayāt |
nandanāt sarvadevānāmarcanaṃ   samudāhṛtam || 71 ||
meaning:
अभीष्टफलदानाच्च चतुर्वर्गफलाश्रयात् |
नन्दनात् सर्वदेवानामर्चनं   समुदाहृतम् || 71 ||
text_mt: Because it grants the desired fruit, because it is the ground for the fruit of the four aims of life, / and because it gladdens all the gods, it is declared adoration.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvātmakasya devasya parivāravṛtasya ca |
navānandaprajananāttarpaṇaṃ     samudāhṛtam || 72 ||
meaning:
तत्त्वात्मकस्य देवस्य परिवारवृतस्य च |
नवानन्दप्रजननात्तर्पणं     समुदाहृतम् || 72 ||
text_mt: For the God whose nature is reality and who is surrounded by his retinue, / because it produces fresh bliss, it is declared libation.

sanskrit_iast:
gambhīrāpāradaurbhāgyakleśanāśanakāraṇāt |
dharmajñānapradānācca  gandha  ityabhidhīyate || 73 ||
meaning:
गम्भीरापारदौर्भाग्यक्लेशनाशनकारणात् |
धर्मज्ञानप्रदानाच्च  गन्ध  इत्यभिधीयते || 73 ||
text_mt: Because it destroys deep and boundless misfortune and affliction, / and because it grants knowledge of righteousness, it is designated perfume.

sanskrit_iast:
āghrāṇanaprajananān mokṣamārgapradarśanāt |
dagdhaduḥkhādidamanādāmoda iti kathyate || 74 ||
meaning:
आघ्राणनप्रजननान् मोक्षमार्गप्रदर्शनात् |
दग्धदुःखादिदमनादामोद इति कथ्यते || 74 ||
text_mt: Because it produces sweet scent, because it displays the path to liberation, / and because it subdues burnt sorrow and the like, it is called fragrance.

sanskrit_iast:
annadānāt kuleśāni kṣapitāśeṣakalmaṣāt |
tādātmyakaraṇāddevi akṣatāḥ parikīttītāḥ || 75 ||
meaning:
अन्नदानात् कुलेशानि क्षपिताशेषकल्मषात् |
तादात्म्यकरणाद्देवि अक्षताः परिकीत्तीताः || 75 ||
text_mt: Because they give food, O Mistress of Kula, because they destroy all defilement, / and because they produce identity, O Goddess, they are proclaimed unbroken grains.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyasaṃvarddhanāccāpi   pāpaughaparihārataḥ |
puṣkalārthapradānācca puṣpamityabhidhīyate || 76 ||
meaning:
पुण्यसंवर्द्धनाच्चापि   पापौघपरिहारतः |
पुष्कलार्थप्रदानाच्च पुष्पमित्यभिधीयते || 76 ||
text_mt: Because it increases merit, because it wards off the flood of demerit, / and because it grants abundant wealth, it is designated flower.

sanskrit_iast:
dhūtāśeṣamahādoṣapūtigandhaprabhāvataḥ   |
paramānandajananāddhūpa ityabhidhīyate || 77 ||
meaning:
धूताशेषमहादोषपूतिगन्धप्रभावतः   |
परमानन्दजननाद्धूप इत्यभिधीयते || 77 ||
text_mt: Because its power dispels foul odours and all great faults, / and because it produces supreme bliss, it is designated incense.

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghājñānamahādhvāntāhaṅkāraparivarjanāt  |
paratattvaprakāśācca dīpa ityabhidhīyate || 78 ||
meaning:
दीर्घाज्ञानमहाध्वान्ताहङ्कारपरिवर्जनात्  |
परतत्त्वप्रकाशाच्च दीप इत्यभिधीयते || 78 ||
text_mt: Because it removes the great darkness and egoism of long-standing ignorance, / and because it reveals the supreme reality, it is designated lamp.

sanskrit_iast:
mohadhvāntapraśamanāt   kṣayātīvinivāraṇāt |
divyarūpapradānācca      paratattvaprakāśanāt |
khyāto mokṣo dīpa iti mokṣamārgaikasādhanaḥ || 79 ||
meaning:
मोहध्वान्तप्रशमनात्   क्षयातीविनिवारणात् |
दिव्यरूपप्रदानाच्च      परतत्त्वप्रकाशनात् |
ख्यातो मोक्षो दीप इति मोक्षमार्गैकसाधनः || 79 ||
text_mt: Because it pacifies the darkness of delusion, because it wards off wasting and illness, / because it grants a divine form, and because it reveals the supreme reality, / liberation is known as the lamp, the sole means to the path of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
catuvīdhaṃ kuleśāni dravyañca ṣaḍrasānvitam |
nivedanādbhavettṛptirnaivedyaṃ      samudāhṛtam || 80 ||
meaning:
चतुवीधं कुलेशानि द्रव्यञ्च षड्रसान्वितम् |
निवेदनाद्भवेत्तृप्तिर्नैवेद्यं      समुदाहृतम् || 80 ||
text_mt: Substance of four kinds, O Mistress of Kula, endowed with the six flavours, / from the offering of which satisfaction arises, is declared food offering.

sanskrit_iast:
bahuprakāravicarad bhūtaughaprītikāraṇāt |
liptapāpapraśamanād balirityabhidhīyate || 81 ||
meaning:
बहुप्रकारविचरद् भूतौघप्रीतिकारणात् |
लिप्तपापप्रशमनाद् बलिरित्यभिधीयते || 81 ||
text_mt: Because it pleases the multitude of spirits roaming in many ways, / and because it pacifies clinging demerit, it is designated bali.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvatrayaviśuddhiḥ syāttvatsevāmātrataḥ priye |
tattvaprakāśahetutvāttattvatrayamitīritam     || 82 ||
meaning:
तत्त्वत्रयविशुद्धिः स्यात्त्वत्सेवामात्रतः प्रिये |
तत्त्वप्रकाशहेतुत्वात्तत्त्वत्रयमितीरितम्     || 82 ||
text_mt: Purity of the triad of realities arises merely from service to You, O Beloved; / because it is the cause of the revelation of reality, it is proclaimed the triad of realities.

sanskrit_iast:
caturvargaphalāvāpāt luṇṭhitājñānabandhanāt |
kalyāṇadharmamūlatvāccalukaṃ kathitaṃ priye || 83 ||
meaning:
चतुर्वर्गफलावापात् लुण्ठिताज्ञानबन्धनात् |
कल्याणधर्ममूलत्वाच्चलुकं कथितं प्रिये || 83 ||
text_mt: Because of obtaining the fruit of the four aims of life, because of stripping away the bonds of ignorance, / and because it is the root of auspicious duty, it is declared the sip of water, O Beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśānandajananāt   sāmarasyapradānataḥ |
darśanāt paratattvasya prasāda iti kathyate || 84 ||
meaning:
प्रकाशानन्दजननात्   सामरस्यप्रदानतः |
दर्शनात् परतत्त्वस्य प्रसाद इति कथ्यते || 84 ||
text_mt: Because it produces the bliss of illumination, because it grants identity of essence, / and because of the vision of supreme reality, it is called grace.

sanskrit_iast:
pāśasañchedanāddevi narakasya nivāraṇāt |
pābanāt parameśāni pānamityabhidhīyate || 85 ||
meaning:
पाशसञ्छेदनाद्देवि नरकस्य निवारणात् |
पाबनात् परमेशानि पानमित्यभिधीयते || 85 ||
text_mt: Because it severs bonds, O Goddess, because it wards off hell, / and because it purifies, O Supreme Ruler, it is designated drink.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā manasā vācā sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā |
samīpasevā vidhivat upāstiriti kathyate || 86 ||
meaning:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा सर्वावस्थासु सर्वदा |
समीपसेवा विधिवत् उपास्तिरिति कथ्यते || 86 ||
text_mt: By action, mind, and speech, in all states, at all times, / service performed close by according to rule is called worship.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāṅgopāsaneneṣṭadevatā    prītidānataḥ |
puraścarati bhaktasya tat puraścaraṇaṃ priye || 87 ||
meaning:
पञ्चाङ्गोपासनेनेष्टदेवता    प्रीतिदानतः |
पुरश्चरति भक्तस्य तत् पुरश्चरणं प्रिये || 87 ||
text_mt: Because it grants pleasure to the chosen deity through the five-limbed worship, / it moves forward before the devotee; that, O Beloved, is preparatory rite.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhanādikarmāṇi ṣoḍaśa dvādaśāvadhi |
vidhinācaraṇaṃ proktaṃ upahāramiti smṛtam || 88 ||
meaning:
आवाहनादिकर्माणि षोडश द्वादशावधि |
विधिनाचरणं प्रोक्तं उपहारमिति स्मृतम् || 88 ||
text_mt: The rites beginning with invocation, sixteen or up to twelve, / performed according to rule, are declared and traditionally known as offering.

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjya sāvṛtiṃ devaṃ ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ |
svasthānapreṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ mṛdvāsanamiti priye || 89 ||
meaning:
सम्पूज्य सावृतिं देवं षोडशैरुपचारकैः |
स्वस्थानप्रेषणं प्रोक्तं मृद्वासनमिति प्रिये || 89 ||
text_mt: Having worshipped the God with his retinue through the sixteen articles of worship, / sending him to his own abode is declared the soft seat, O Beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
devaṃ     pūjārthamāhvānamāvāhanamiti    smṛtam |
āsane sanniveśaḥ syāt sthāpanaṃ kulanāyike || 90 ||
meaning:
देवं     पूजार्थमाह्वानमावाहनमिति    स्मृतम् |
आसने सन्निवेशः स्यात् स्थापनं कुलनायिके || 90 ||
text_mt: Summoning the God for the sake of worship is traditionally known as invocation; / placing [him] on the seat is the establishing, O Mistress of Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
anyonyasammukhākāraḥ sannidhāpanamīritam |
yatra kutrāpyacalanaṃ    sannirodhanamīritam || 91 ||
meaning:
अन्योन्यसम्मुखाकारः सन्निधापनमीरितम् |
यत्र कुत्राप्यचलनं    सन्निरोधनमीरितम् || 91 ||
text_mt: Bringing face-to-face with one another is proclaimed bringing near; / remaining motionless anywhere is proclaimed confinement.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāṅge ṣaḍaṅgānāṃ nyāsaḥ syāt sakalīkṛtiḥ |
ācchādanaṃ         samuddiṣṭamavaguṇṭhanamīritam || 92 ||
meaning:
देवताङ्गे षडङ्गानां न्यासः स्यात् सकलीकृतिः |
आच्छादनं         समुद्दिष्टमवगुण्ठनमीरितम् || 92 ||
text_mt: The placement of the six limbs upon the body of the deity is ritual completion; / covering, as taught, is proclaimed veiling.

sanskrit_iast:
darśanaṃ dhenumudrāyā amṛtīkaraṇaṃ  priye |
kṣamasvetyañjalirddevi paramīkaraṇaṃ priye |
svāgataṃ kuśalapraśnaṃ nigadeddevatāgrataḥ || 93 ||
meaning:
दर्शनं धेनुमुद्राया अमृतीकरणं  प्रिये |
क्षमस्वेत्यञ्जलिर्द्देवि परमीकरणं प्रिये |
स्वागतं कुशलप्रश्नं निगदेद्देवताग्रतः || 93 ||
text_mt: The display of the cow-gesture is the nectarisation, O dear one; / the folded hands uttering 'Forgive me', O Goddess, is the supreme sanctification, O dear one; / greeting is an inquiry after well-being pronounced before the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
pādyaṃ śyāmākadūrvābjaviṣṇukrāntābhirucyate |
jātālavaṅgakakkolairuktamācamanīyakam   || 94 ||
meaning:
पाद्यं श्यामाकदूर्वाब्जविष्णुक्रान्ताभिरुच्यते |
जातालवङ्गकक्कोलैरुक्तमाचमनीयकम्   || 94 ||
text_mt: Water for the feet is declared to consist of śyāmāka grain, dūrvā grass, lotus, and viṣṇukrāntā; / water for rinsing the mouth is declared to consist of nutmeg, cloves, and kakkola berries.

sanskrit_iast:
akhilāghapraśamanārddhanaputravivarddhanāt    |
anarghaphaladānācca arghyamityabhidhīyate || 95 ||
meaning:
अखिलाघप्रशमनार्द्धनपुत्रविवर्द्धनात्    |
अनर्घफलदानाच्च अर्घ्यमित्यभिधीयते || 95 ||
text_mt: Because it appeases all sins, increases wealth and sons, / and gives priceless fruit, it is called a water offering.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhārthamakṣatañcaiva kuśāgraṃ tilameva ca |
yavaṃ gandhaḥ phalaṃ puṣpamaṣṭāṅgārghyaṃ prakīttītam || 96 ||
meaning:
सिद्धार्थमक्षतञ्चैव कुशाग्रं तिलमेव च |
यवं गन्धः फलं पुष्पमष्टाङ्गार्घ्यं प्रकीत्तीतम् || 96 ||
text_mt: White mustard, unhusked barley, tips of kuśa grass, sesame seeds, / barley, fragrant paste, fruit, and flowers are declared to be the eightfold water offering.

sanskrit_iast:
madhvājyadadhibhiḥ prokto madhuparkaḥ kuleśvari |
dehaprakṣālanaṃ  snānaṃ    sugandhisalilaiḥ  saha || 97 ||
meaning:
मध्वाज्यदधिभिः प्रोक्तो मधुपर्कः कुलेश्वरि |
देहप्रक्षालनं  स्नानं    सुगन्धिसलिलैः  सह || 97 ||
text_mt: The honey-mixture offering is stated to be made of honey, clarified butter, and curd, O Mistress of Kula; / bathing is the washing of the body together with fragrant waters.

sanskrit_iast:
candrācandanakastūrīkālāgurubhirucyate       |
aṣṭāṅgapraṇipātantu   kathitaṃ   vandanaṃ priye || 98 ||
meaning:
चन्द्राचन्दनकस्तूरीकालागुरुभिरुच्यते       |
अष्टाङ्गप्रणिपातन्तु   कथितं   वन्दनं प्रिये || 98 ||
text_mt: Camphor, sandalwood, musk, and dark aloe are declared [for perfumes]; / eight-limbed prostration is described as homage, O dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
etaccarācaraṃ    sarvaṃ    kṣetramityabhidhīyate |
tat kṣetraṃ pālitaṃ yena kṣetrapālaḥ sa ucyate || 99 ||
meaning:
एतच्चराचरं    सर्वं    क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते |
तत् क्षेत्रं पालितं येन क्षेत्रपालः स उच्यते || 99 ||
text_mt: All this moving and unmoving world is called the sacred field; / he by whom that sacred field is protected is called the guardian of the sacred field.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitā kiñcid gurunāmādivāsanā |
samāsena maheśāni yo jānāti sa pūjakaḥ || 100 ||
meaning:
इति ते कथिता किञ्चिद् गुरुनामादिवासना |
समासेन महेशानि यो जानाति स पूजकः || 100 ||
text_mt: Thus has the inner meaning of the name of the guru and the rest been briefly told to you, / O Great Lady; he who knows it is a true worshipper.

sanskrit_iast:
rahasyātirahasyānāṃ rahasyo'yaṃ    maheśvari |
ūrdhvāmnāyo'yamākhyātaḥ samāsena savistarāt || 101 ||
meaning:
रहस्यातिरहस्यानां रहस्योऽयं    महेश्वरि |
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायोऽयमाख्यातः समासेन सविस्तरात् || 101 ||
text_mt: This secret among the most secret of secrets, O Great Goddess, / this upper transmission has been declared in summary and in full detail.

sanskrit_iast:
kulārṇavamidaṃ śāstraṃ yoginīnāṃ hṛdi sthitam |
prakāśitaṃ  mayā  cādya  gopanīyaṃ  prayatnataḥ || 102 ||
meaning:
कुलार्णवमिदं शास्त्रं योगिनीनां हृदि स्थितम् |
प्रकाशितं  मया  चाद्य  गोपनीयं  प्रयत्नतः || 102 ||
text_mt: This scripture, the Kulārṇava, abiding in the hearts of the yoginīs, / has been revealed by me today; it must be concealed with great effort.

sanskrit_iast:
pustakañca maheśāni  paśugehe  na   nikṣipet |
na dadyāt paśuhaste  ca na paṭhet paśusannidhau |
na paṭhedāsavollāsaṃ granthaṃ bhūmau na nikṣipet || 103 ||
meaning:
पुस्तकञ्च महेशानि  पशुगेहे  न   निक्षिपेत् |
न दद्यात् पशुहस्ते  च न पठेत् पशुसन्निधौ |
न पठेदासवोल्लासं ग्रन्थं भूमौ न निक्षिपेत् || 103 ||
text_mt: O Great Lady, one must not deposit the manuscript in the house of an uninitiated bound soul, / nor place it into the hands of an uninitiated bound soul, nor read it in the presence of an uninitiated bound soul; / one must not recite the chapter on fermented liquor [aloud], nor place the book upon the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ  sampūjayedbhaktyā  jānīyād  guruvaktrataḥ |
nāputrāya   pravaktavyaṃ    nāśiṣyāya    kadācana || 104 ||
meaning:
नित्यं  सम्पूजयेद्भक्त्या  जानीयाद्  गुरुवक्त्रतः |
नापुत्राय   प्रवक्तव्यं    नाशिष्याय    कदाचन || 104 ||
text_mt: One should worship it daily with devotion and learn it from the guru's mouth; / it must never be spoken to one who is not a son, nor to one who is not a disciple.

sanskrit_iast:
snehāllobhādbhayāduktvā so'cirānnaśyati dhruvam |
devi yadvidyate prājñe  tattat  kiñcinmayoditam || 105 ||
meaning:
स्नेहाल्लोभाद्भयादुक्त्वा सोऽचिरान्नश्यति ध्रुवम् |
देवि यद्विद्यते प्राज्ञे  तत्तत्  किञ्चिन्मयोदितम् || 105 ||
text_mt: Speaking it out of affection, greed, or fear, he surely perishes before long; / O Goddess, whatever [wisdom] exists in the wise person, all that has been spoken by me in some measure,

sanskrit_iast:
sādhakānāṃ hitārthāya bhuktimuktiphaleṣiṇām |
yaścordhvāmnāyamāhātmyaṃ paṭhet śrīcakrasannidhau || 106 ||
meaning:
साधकानां हितार्थाय भुक्तिमुक्तिफलेषिणाम् |
यश्चोर्ध्वाम्नायमाहात्म्यं पठेत् श्रीचक्रसन्निधौ || 106 ||
text_mt: for the benefit of practitioners who desire the fruits of enjoyment and liberation. / And whoever reads the greatness of the upper transmission in the presence of the Śrīcakra,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā paramayā devi yaḥ śṛṇoti sa kaulikaḥ |
vrataṃ   snānaṃ    tapastīrthaṃ   yajñadevārcanādiṣu || 107 ||
meaning:
भक्त्या परमया देवि यः शृणोति स कौलिकः |
व्रतं   स्नानं    तपस्तीर्थं   यज्ञदेवार्चनादिषु || 107 ||
text_mt: or whoever hears it with supreme devotion, O Goddess, that Kaulika / [receives the fruit of] vows, ablutions, ascetic penance, pilgrimages, sacrifices, worship of deities, and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
tat  phalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ  labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
tvatsannidhau  sannivasennātra kāryā  vicāraṇā || 108 ||
meaning:
तत्  फलं कोटिगुणितं  लभते नात्र संशयः |
त्वत्सन्निधौ  सन्निवसेन्नात्र कार्या  विचारणा || 108 ||
text_mt: he obtains that fruit multiplied ten-millionfold, there is no doubt about this; / he dwells in your presence, no doubt should be entertained here.
